title: POST Certified Patrol Deputy
description:
CLASS DESCRIPTION:

The purpose of this class is to perform general law enforcement work of average difficulty and responsibility in the preservation and protection of life and property, the prevention of crime, the maintenance of good public order, and the enforcement of civil and criminal law. This class works under general supervision and requires considerable judgment, initiative, and skill in a variety of situations.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

Below are examples and are intended only as an illustration of the various types of work performed in positions allocated to this class. The omission of specific statements of duties does not exclude them from the position if the work is similar, related, or logical assignment to the position.

  1. Promotes public safety in patrol area consistent with agency policies by conducting routine active patrolling of assigned area and observing and investigating all suspicious activities and/or persons.
  2. Monitors and responds to all dispatch service calls promptly and consistently with call classification and by agency policies.
  3. Enforces traffic laws and arrests or issues summons to traffic law violators. Reports unsafe road conditions and directs the flow of traffic when required. Investigates traffic accidents.
  4. Performs checks on dwellings, buildings, grounds, and property to ensure the prevention of damage by fire, theft, and/or vandalism.
  5. Collects complete and accurate information and prepares clear and concise reports and affidavits. Keeps records of all activities per established agency policy.
  6. Protects crime scenes, gathers and preserves matters of evidence, takes and records testimonies, and directs and coordinates activities on-site until relieved by a superior officer, and assists detectives in specialized investigations.
  7. Serves warrants, capiases, court orders, and other legal processes, and locates and arrests persons wanted on warrants or court orders.
  8. Makes arrests and testifies in the prosecution of law violators and conducts preliminary and/or detailed investigations of the commission of crime or law violations.
  9. Foresees potential danger and eliminates or controls it. Performs law enforcement activities without injuring self or others.
  10. Provides backup to other law enforcement personnel.
  11. Assesses situations, secures scenes, and restores order including the use of restraints and force where appropriate up to and including deadly force.
  12. Operates and maintains emergency and non-emergency equipment, including computerized information management systems to retrieve or enter information.
  13. Attends staff meetings to exchange information, and attends in-service training and technical/professional classes, seminars, and/or conferences to improve technical/professional skills.
  14. Assists the general public and other governmental agencies.
  15. Performs other duties as required or assigned.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  1. Certification by the State of Louisiana Peace Officer Standards & Training Council as Law Enforcement Officer.

At a minimum, all employees must be at least 21 years of age (upon the date of hire); have a high school diploma or equivalency; have no felony, drug, or domestic violence convictions; pass all required pre-employment screenings; possess a valid Louisiana driver’s license; be able to communicate both verbally and in writing as required; and possess basic computer skills such as typing, writing reports, and sending and/or receiving emails as applicable to the position.

WORKING CONDITIONS AND ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

  1. Must be able to work in any geographically defined region within Natchitoches Parish.
  2. Must be able to work shift work, any days/hours including weekends and holidays as required.
  3. In the event of a hurricane, major storm, natural or human-made disaster that may threaten the area, the employee will be expected to work.

ADA COMPLIANCE:

Physical and Dexterity Requirements: The job requires performance of extremely physically demanding work, typically involving some combination of reaching, bending, stooping, kneeling, crouching, running, scaling, and climbing. May involve lifting, carrying, pushing, or pulling. Must be able to exert enough force based on Cooper Institute Standards to chase, apprehend, restrain, and control potentially violent and combative law violators, offenders, and detainees. Must possess and maintain physical agility, and strength, including good coordination and reflexes. Tasks may also involve standing, sitting, walking, and driving for long periods of time.

Environmental Hazards: The job requires inside and outside work; ability to tolerate inclement weather including heat, humidity, cold, fog, and sleet. Possible exposure to hazardous materials and conditions, toxic conditions, fumes, odors, vibration, dust, confined areas, animal/human waste and/or bodily fluids.

Sensory Requirements: This job requires normal visual acuity and field of vision, hearing, and speaking.

TRAVEL:

Extensive travel inside/outside of Natchitoches Parish (80 - 100%).

title: Product Manager Roll Shop / Flat Rolling
description:
As the Product Manager, you will be the strategic architect of our repair and maintenance solutions. Your mission is to establish a portfolio of innovative, reliable, and cost-effective services that drive efficiency for our customers and internal operations alike. You will serve as the central hub for aligning product development with emerging industry technologies and the specific needs of the North American metals market.


This role is a high-impact leadership position focused on unifying the SMS group flat rolling service portfolio across North America. You will bridge the gap between innovative engineering and operational excellence, ensuring that our roll shops in Washington, PA, Mokena, IL, Gary, IN, and Osceola, AR operate as a cohesive, world-class network.



What you'll do

  • Maintains dialog with the SMS Service / roll Shops, SMS sales & customer to offer solutions for roll shops + WR + BUR chock & oil film bearing repairs / modernizations / spares / services
  • Regular customer visits to hot, cold, aluminum mills for in collaboration with our central sales responsible person
  • Supports customers operation issues by analysis of IBA data, dimensional inspection, etc. utilizing onsite resources to perform inspection, and gather data to provide a maintenance, modernization & or new solution for the operational issues
  • Identifies repairs to be developed / executed in the SMS workshops
  • Develops standard repairs ,modifications, modernization packages that can be scaled across multiple customers
  • Collaborate with OEM engineer for engineered repairs & enhancements
  • Creates market analysis for new and existing products & services
  • Responsible tracking of chock fleet program and oil film bearings
  • Collaborates with OPS team to create and implement digital inspection & ERP system
  • Creates data base of chocks & oil film bearings that can be altered to cover multiple customers equipment
  • Supports spare part group for chocks & oil film bearings
  • Collaborates with marketing to create & or update roll shop & chock & oil film bearing products service website & product brochures
  • In addition to above, support all customer and roll shop / workshop needs in regard to flat rolling where applicable
  • Other duties as assigned


What you’ll need

  • Education: Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering or a related technical field
  • Experience: 5+ years of advanced knowledge of Flat Rolling Mill Roll Shops / steel production / mill maintenance / chock maintenance / roll grinding / operation
  • Technical Aptitude: Strong mechanical background with a deep understanding of flat rolling processes and roll shop operations
  • Leadership: Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and align multiple regional sites under a single strategic vision
  • Travel: Ability to travel frequently (up to 50%) to customer sites and North American workshop locations

What we offer

Competitive compensation, medical/dental/vision coverage, paid vacation, paid holiday time, 401k with a company match, training (parts of it in Germany), a tuition reimbursement program and more!

What we do

SMS group is the leading partner in the world of metals. We are an original equipment supplier offering comprehensive maintenance and spare part services for metals production, continuous casting and rolling (flat and long products), tubes, welded pipes, forging, non-ferrous technology, and heat treatment plants - all from a single source.

SMS group Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, religion, national origin, age, sexual orientation, disability, veteran status, gender identity or other categories protected by law. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a drug screen and physical capacity profile test.

title: RV FRONT END ALIGNMENT TECHNICIAN
description:
Alignment Technician

North Trail RV has been a family-owned and operated RV Dealership in Fort Myers, FL for over 30 years. A career with North Trail RV means unwavering support from a tight-knit group of individuals who care deeply about our craft, one another, and the community we share.

As a member of the North Trail family, you will be provided every opportunity to utilize your skills as part of a collaborative culture that encourages innovation and values kindness and respect above all. In addition to competitive wages, we offer health, dental, and vision insurance. We also offer paid time off, life insurance, HSA, and 401K retirement benefits with employer match.

Join us and discover the North Trail difference for yourself!

North Trail RV is currently seeking a qualified RV Alignment Technician to join our team.

The Alignment Technician is responsible for ensuring that vehicles are properly aligned. This is a critical service that helps to ensure safe and efficient operation of vehicles on the road. The Alignment Technician commonly works with heavy equipment such as trucks, RVs, and other specialized equipment to realign wheels or axles after they have been improperly aligned by driving or other factors. The Alignment Technician must be highly skilled in their field. They must know how to use all relevant equipment and tools correctly and safely. They also need to understand how each component of a vehicle’s suspension works so that they can properly align it.

***Pay rate is based on experience and will be discussed during the interview.***

Responsibilities:

  • Inspecting tire wear and measuring tread depth to determine when tires need to be replaced
  • Inspecting vehicles for alignment issues and repairing them as needed using specialized tools and equipment
  • Performing wheel alignment using computerized alignment machines
  • Inspecting vehicle suspension components to ensure they are working properly to support the weight of the vehicle.
  • Determining the causes of alignment problems by inspecting tires, wheels, and suspension components for signs of damage or wear.
  • Inspecting vehicle suspension systems to ensure they are working properly.
  • Recommendation of repair options based on inspection findings.
  • Measuring wheel alignment angles and adjusting them as required to ensure proper tracking.
  • Installing new tires onto vehicles when needed based on alignment issues identified during inspection.

Requirements:

  • 1 to 3 months related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience preferred
  • Pre-employment screenings including background and drug test
  • Understands and complies with Federal and State regulations
  • Operates all tools and equipment in a safe manner
  • Willingness to report any safety issues or concerns to management
  • Positive attitude
  • Good Attendance and ability to work 8 hours shift Monday-Friday and weekends as needed

Valid driver’s license required

title: Project Manager
description:
For over four decades, Big Top has manufactured and installed high-performance fabric structures in the United States, delivering American-made quality, innovation, and reliability. We don’t just build shelters - we engineer solutions that optimize operations, safeguard assets, and provide a competitive edge for companies worldwide. With the support and financial backing of Altamont Capital Partners, we are in an exciting phase of growth, expansion, and innovation.

Job Summary: The Project Manager is responsible for the planning, execution and completion of various projects within the company. This position will report to the Installation and Special Projects Manager.


Supervisory Responsibilities: Leads project teams to ensure satisfactory completion of tasks to ensure projects remain on schedule and within budget.

FLSA Classification: Exempt


Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • With input from executive management and outside parties, defines the project's scope, goals, deliverables, tasks, and required resources; ensures projects are well defined before placing out for bid; participates in vendor selection.
  • Selects members for project team; leads cross-functional teams and manages relationships with outside service providers.
  • Manages project progress and adapts timeline as required; monitors for “scope creep.”
  • Keeps stakeholders engaged and informed of pending action items and approaching deadlines.
  • Identifies and suggests opportunities to optimize and improve existing processes.
  • Anticipates problems that may arise throughout the project and takes appropriate action to mitigate risk. When issues arise during a project, works to find viable solutions to ensure stakeholder satisfaction.
  • Upon completion of a project, evaluates the project’s efficiency and effectiveness; uses data to guide future decision-making.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Required Skills & Abilities:

  • Strong individual and team-focused time management skills.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Detail oriented and organized.
  • Capacity to handle high stress situations and resolve conflicts.

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in relevant field required.
  • Five years of relevant experience preferred.

Physical Demands:

  • Must be able to accurately exchange information with co-workers, management, customers, and vendors.
  • Occasionally moves files and boxes of records weighing up to 20 lbs.
  • Constantly operates a computer and other office machinery, such as copiers, printers, and telephones.
  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position for 90% of the time.

At Big Top, our actions are guided by a strong set of core values; a pursuit of excellence, a commitment to teamwork, a sense of ownership and a focus on being solution-oriented. We believe each team member plays an important role in helping us achieve our shared goals and we are continuously striving to build a workplace where employees are empowered to contribute in new ways.


After 60 days, employees are provided with health, dental and vision insurance at no cost – the premiums are 100% employer-paid! Other benefits include 401(k) with company match, free short-term and long-term disability, life insurance, and an employee assistance program. We also offer a generous vacation allowance to support work-life balance and employee wellbeing.


Big Top does not discriminate based upon race, religion, gender, disability, veteran status, or other protected characteristics. We comply with all federal and state disability laws and make reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact our Human Resources department.


Drug-Free Workplace.


Big Top is headquartered in Perry, Florida, about 50 miles outside of Tallahassee. Located along Florida's Nature Coast, Perry offers an abundance of outdoor activities such as hunting, fishing, camping, and boating. Learn more about Perry by visiting .

title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager – Brand Revolution

About Us

Brand Revolution is a global brand experience agency specializing in B2B marketing, events, content, activations, and integrated campaigns. We partner with some of the world’s most innovative brands to bring their stories to life through strategic, creative, and flawlessly executed programs.

As our portfolio and project volume grow, we’re evolving our Account Services structure to balance client leadership with operational excellence. To support this evolution, we are adding a Project Manager to our team.

Project Manager – Fabrication

About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced and highly organised Project Manager to lead the successful delivery of custom fabrication projects from initial handover through to final installation.

Working alongside our Creative, Production, Fabrication and Account teams, you’ll keep projects moving, solve problems before they become roadblocks, and ensure every build is delivered safely, on time, on budget and to the exceptional standard our clients expect.

If you thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy bringing order to complexity, and love seeing projects come to life on-site, we’d love to hear from you.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll take ownership of multiple fabrication projects, ensuring every stage runs smoothly from planning through to installation.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Leading fabrication projects from project handover to installation and final close-out.
  • Building and managing realistic project plans, production schedules and installation timelines.
  • Reviewing engineering drawings, shop drawings and fabrication plans to ensure builds are accurate, achievable and ready for production.
  • Collaborating with our Creative, Production, Fabrication and Account teams to keep everyone aligned and informed.
  • Monitoring project budgets, procurement, production progress and change requests to keep projects on track.
  • Building strong relationships with suppliers, subcontractors, installers and clients through clear, proactive communication.
  • Visiting sites and overseeing installations to ensure quality, safety and seamless execution.
  • Identifying risks early, solving challenges quickly and keeping projects moving when plans change.
  • Maintaining project documentation, including drawings, approvals, RFIs, schedules and punch lists.
  • Championing quality, health & safety and attention to detail throughout every stage of the project.

What You’ll Bring

We’re looking for someone who combines strong project management skills with a genuine understanding of fabrication and production environments.

Ideally, you’ll have:

  • 3–5 years’ experience managing fabrication, retail, experiential, exhibition, millwork or custom build projects.
  • A solid understanding of fabrication processes, materials and manufacturing methods.
  • Confidence reading engineering drawings, technical plans and shop drawings.
  • Experience coordinating on-site installations and working with multiple stakeholders.
  • Outstanding organisational skills with the ability to manage several projects simultaneously.
  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach to problem solving.
  • Experience using project management platforms alongside Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.

It Would Be Great If You Also Have

  • Experience within retail fixture fabrication, experiential marketing or environmental design.
  • Knowledge of CNC machining, wood, metal, acrylic, paint or large-format fabrication.
  • Experience coordinating logistics, permitting and installation planning.
  • Familiarity with job-site health and safety standards.

Why Join Us?

We’re passionate about bringing ideas to life through collaboration, craftsmanship and innovation. You’ll join a team that values accountability, creativity and continuous improvement, where no two projects are the same and every build presents an opportunity to create something exceptional.

If you’re passionate about turning ambitious ideas into reality and enjoy seeing your work make an impact in the real world, we’d love to hear from you.

Wolters Kluwer is a global leader in professional information services that combines deep domain knowledge with specialized technology. Our portfolio offers software tools coupled with content and services that customers need to make decisions with confidence. Every day, our customers make critical decisions to help save lives, improve the way we do business, build better judicial and regulatory systems. We help them get it right.

Who We Are: Wolters Kluwer: The world is a big place, find your place here.

The Senior Content Editing Associate role offers growth potential opportunities, professional development, an engaging small team environment, the ability to work a hybrid schedule, and amazing benefits.

Our Locations: Contact Wolters Kluwer | Wolters Kluwer

The Sr. Content Editing Associate contributes to the success of the overall MEMP portfolio through maintenance of existing product, sales and customer-facing product documentation, support Acquisitions and Development Editors in the research and development of new product, and rollout and adoption of standardized processes within and across teams.

The person in this role must be a careful listener with the ability to recognize shared challenges across teams and team members and the confidence to propose potential solutions. title: Sr. Systems Administrator, Operational Tech
description:
We’re looking for a technically skilled and collaborative Sr. Systems Administrator, Operational Technology Systems to support and improve the critical systems that power electric utility operations. This role supports Operational Technology (OT) platforms including ADMS, OMS, SCADA, Advanced Systems, Mobile Field Client technologies, and OT/IT integrations such as IVR and AMI.

Working closely with Operations, Engineering, and Technology teams, this position helps ensure OT systems are reliable, secure, and aligned with business and operational goals. The role includes troubleshooting and supporting critical production systems, leading system upgrades and improvement initiatives, coordinating with vendors and stakeholders, and contributing to ongoing grid modernization and operational technology projects.

Compensation:

The anticipated hiring range is between $115,000 - 150,885. The final compensation offered is based on the selected candidate's qualifications, experience and skill level. In addition, this position is eligible for an annual bonus with a target payout of 8% based on company performance.

In this position, you will:

Production Support & System Analysis

  • Provide Tier 2/3 support for critical OT systems to minimize downtime and operational impact
  • Troubleshoot system issues, perform root cause analysis, and coordinate resolution with internal teams and vendors
  • Monitor system health, conduct log analysis, and support recovery activities
  • Perform patch management, change management, and ongoing system maintenance
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with software vendors and business stakeholders
  • Participate in an on-call support rotation

System Upgrades, Modernization & Project Leadership

  • Research, plan, test, and implement software patches and version upgrades
  • Lead OT-related software upgrade and implementation projects while coordinating cross-functional teams and IT resources
  • Coordinate testing activities, including user testing and user acceptance testing (UAT)
  • Educate business stakeholders on OT platform capabilities such as ADMS and AMI
  • Follow established change management methodologies and adoption frameworks
  • Support quality assurance activities including requirements validation, test planning, and test case execution

Strategic Systems Support & Business Collaboration

  • Develop expertise in OT business systems and recommend strategic technology improvements
  • Support configuration updates and enhancements to resolve operational business issues
  • Partner with business units to identify operational and process requirements
  • Document business processes and support continuous improvement initiatives
  • Stay informed on emerging technologies and utility industry best practices

Need to have:

  • Associate degree in computer sciences or related field
  • Seven or more years of hands-on OT / IT infrastructure work including systems like SCADA.
  • Five or more years of experience with ADMS or OMS systems.
  • Five or more years of direct user interaction experience.
  • Current and valid driver’s license

OR

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer sciences or related field
  • Five or more years of hands-on OT / IT infrastructure work including systems like SCADA.
  • Three or more years of experience with ADMS or OMS systems.
  • Three or more years of direct user interaction experience
  • Current and valid driver’s license

Pre-Employment Requirement: Employment is contingent upon successfully completing a pre-employment background check and drug screen

title: Specialist, Compliance
description:
Job Description:

As a privately-owned, biopharmaceutical company, Ferring pioneers and delivers life-changing therapies that help people build families and live better lives. Our independence helps us cultivate an entrepreneurial spirit and long-term perspective that enables us to achieve growth and scale, while remaining agile and true to our ‘people first’ philosophy. Built on a 70-year plus commitment to science and research, Ferring is relentless in its pursuit of science that drives powerful discoveries and therapies to help people build families, stay healthy, and stand up to the world’s oldest enemy: disease.

As the Specialist, Compliance you will lead and author GMP investigations related to deviations, nonconformances, audit findings, and other quality events in a pharmaceutical manufacturing environment. You will partner cross-functionally with Manufacturing, Quality Control, Engineering, Validation, Information Systems, Supply Chain, and the Quality team to ensure thorough root cause analysis, effective CAPAs, and sustained regulatory compliance.

You will be responsible for the timely and accurate completion of compliance documentation, supports an inspection-ready state, and contributes to a strong quality culture through risk-based, right-first-time investigation execution.

With Ferring, you will be joining a recognized leader, identified as one of “The World’s Most Innovative Companies” by Fast Company, and honored by Fortune with inclusion on its “Change the World List,” for addressing society’s unmet needs. Ferring US is also Great Places to Work® Certified, distinguishing it as one of the best companies to work for in the country.

Responsibilities:

Investigation Leadership & Documentation

  • Lead and author GMP deviations, nonconformances, and quality investigations.
  • Drive root cause analysis using structured tools (e.g., 5 Whys, Fishbone, Fault Tree, human performance concepts).
  • Ensure investigations are thorough, scientifically sound, and compliant with regulatory expectations.
  • Facilitate cross-functional investigation meetings and follow up on action items.
  • Ensure investigations are completed right-first-time and within required timelines.

CAPA Management

  • Develop, document, implement (as assigned), and tracks effectiveness  of Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPAs).
  • Escalate risks when CAPAs are inadequate, overdue, or ineffective.
  • Ensure assigned action items are completed within the required timelines.

Change Management

  • Initiate Change Controls and complete assigned action tasks.
  • Ensure assigned tasks are completed within the required timelines.

Regulatory & Inspection Readiness

  • Support inspections and internal audits.
  • Participate in inspection back-room support and follow-up activities as needed.

Risk Assessment & Decision Support

  • Perform and document risk assessments (e.g., product impact, patient safety, data integrity).
  • Identify investigation trends and recurring issues; escalate systemic risks.

Quality Systems & Continuous Improvement

  • Support continuous improvement of investigation and deviation processes.

title: Senior System Industrialization Engineer
description:
Introduction to the job

As a Supplier Quality Engineer within Strategic Sourcing & Procurement, you will operate in a fast-paced and multidisciplinary development environment while supporting Development & Engineering projects.

The SQE maintains and develops the relation with the suppliers with the purpose to create an Industrial engineering collaboration between the suppliers and ASML. Using your personal skills, you will work closely together with the suppliers & ASML development teams to optimize the effectiveness and efficiency of the product generation process, in alignment with the ASML part project plan. The main goal of this cross-sector activity is to secure an excellent quality and timely delivery of parts by our suppliers.

Role and responsibilities

Within the Strategic Sourcing & Procurement organization, the SQE is primarily responsible for supplier quality activities from early supplier involvement through product and process maturity, ensuring readiness for volume release. Using your in-depth technical knowledge, analytic thinking, political antenna and excellent people skills, you work closely with suppliers to build up intimate knowledge of their IP and technological capabilities.

The main responsibilities are:

  • Coordinating role with respect to all SQE activities and deliverables (incl. other SQE colleagues) within the allocated project.

  • New product introduction (NPI) and supplier selection.

  • Early supplier involvement in development projects to ensure ASML and supplier technology expertise are effectively integrated.

  • Document project collaboration, including supplier and ASML responsibilities and roles via a Statement of Work (SoW).

  • Ensure that parts quality, manufacturability and serviceability aspects are covered in the design phase, including implementation of lessons learned.

  • Deliverables that secure parts quality from suppliers in the ASML product generation process, such as:

    • Acceptance of the specification and/or design

    • Complete & detailed parts qualification process

    • Acceptance of qualified parts

    • Process flow and Process failure mode effect analysis

    • First article inspection

    • Define and maintain supplier interface processes, such as: Issue resolution, Qualification deviation, Configuration & change management and ASML factory disturbances

    • Contribute to supplier development to improve operational excellence by driving execution of existing agreements, improvement actions, and participation in supplier audits.

The SQE is part of cross-functional development project teams and interfaces with project leaders, design engineers, architects, manufacturing and customer support engineers, logistics, procurement, and suppliers.

Education and experience

  • Bachelor or Master’s degree in industrial engineering, optics, mechatronics, electronics or related field.

  • Broad (at least 3 -5 years, preferably >5 Minimum 5 years of experience with a Bachelor's degree or 3 years with a Masters degree.

  • Experience in high-tech industry, and complex modules, with a focus on industrial engineering, supplier quality management or part quality or project management in engineering. We encourage candidates with experience with Quality systems and – methods to apply for this vacancy (preferably Six Sigma Green or Black Belt) as well as candidates with experience in engineering towards production processes.

Skills

The ideal candidate demonstrates a combination of technical, manufacturing, and supplier quality competencies, including:

  • Strong understanding of New Product Introduction (NPI) and product industrialization processes.

  • Proficiency in Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA/PFMEA), Control Plans, and process flow development.

  • Experience with First Article Inspection (FAI), Measurement System Analysis (MSA), Statistical Process Control (SPC), and capability analysis (Cp/Cpk).

  • Working knowledge of root cause analysis and structured problem-solving methodologies such as 8D, A3, DMAIC, 5-Why, and Ishikawa.

  • Ability to assess manufacturing processes and process capability across precision machining, sheet metal fabrication, optics, coatings, mechatronics, electronics, or assembly technologies.

  • Experience with supplier visits, process assessments, and driving corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).

  • Understanding of configuration management, engineering change control, and product lifecycle management processes.

  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings, GD&T, technical specifications, and critical-to-quality (CTQ) requirements.

  • Familiarity with risk management methods and qualification planning for complex components and assemblies.

  • Experience analyzing technical data using statistical methods and quality tools to drive process improvements.

  • Experience with Production Part Approval Process (PPAP), and qualification methodologies.

  • Familiarity with semiconductor, optics, precision mechanics, mechatronics, or other complex high-tech products is a strong plus.

The following personal skills are also crucial for a successful execution:

  • Ability to initiate, influence and steer without formal authority.

  • Strong networking and negotiating skills.

  • Strong communication skills.

  • Ability to switch between complex matters and high-level conclusions.

  • Self-propelling, showing initiative and drive.

  • Flexible, result driven and committed.

  • Team player.

  • Process oriented.

  • Fluent in English.

$109,200-150,150

title: Assistant Controller
description:
For over four decades, Big Top has manufactured and installed high-performance fabric structures in the United States, delivering American-made quality, innovation, and reliability. We don’t just build shelters—we engineer solutions that optimize operations, safeguard assets, and provide a competitive edge for companies worldwide. With the support and financial backing of Altamont Capital Partners, we are in an exciting phase of growth, expansion, and innovation.

Title: Assistant Controller


Job Summary: The Assistant Controller will oversee daily accounting operations and support the month-end close and financial reporting process for Big Top Manufacturing. This role ensures accurate and timely financial information across the general ledger, inventory, and project accounting while helping refine policies, improve controls, and streamline processes as the company scales. The Assistant Controller partners closely with the Controller and department leaders to strengthen the connection between finance and operations. This position reports to the CFO and is located on-site in our Perry, Florida office.

Supervisory Responsibilities: Provides leadership and direction to members of the accounting team, ensuring accuracy, accountability, and professional growth within the department.


FLSA Classification: Exempt


Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

Month-End Close & Reporting

  • Manage and participate in the month-end and year-end close process, including journal entries, accruals, and account reconciliations.
  • Prepare and review financial statements, variance analyses, and supporting schedules.
  • Support the Controller in developing management reports and dashboards for leadership review.
  • Ensure accurate cutoff of revenue and expenses, including prepaids, accruals, and job cost timing.
  • Maintain full ownership of the general ledger, ensuring all subledgers (AP, AR, inventory, payroll, fixed assets) reconcile and post accurately to the GL each period.

AP, AR, and Treasury Management

  • Oversee AP and AR processing, ensuring accuracy, coding integrity, and alignment with GAAP.
  • Support weekly cash forecasting and working capital management (DSO, DPO, inventory turns).
  • Strengthen internal cash controls, payment workflows, and vendor/customer billing procedures.

Inventory & Cost Accounting

  • Partner with operations to reconcile physical counts, analyze material flows, and validate cost of goods sold.
  • Investigate inventory anomalies and ensure consistent costing and job-tracking methods across departments.
  • Support gross margin analysis and cost allocation methodologies for production and installation projects.

Compliance & Audit

  • Lead and project manage the annual external audit process, serving as the primary liaison with auditors and internal stakeholders to ensure timely completion and clear communication of deliverables.
  • Maintain reconciliations, schedules, and supporting documentation for audits and tax filings.
  • Support development, implementation, and enforcement of accounting policies and internal controls.
  • Assist with statutory and regulatory compliance activities (e.g., state registrations, good standing certificates) and other related filings.

Process Improvement & Projects

  • Identify and implement process enhancements to improve accuracy and efficiency of financial operations.
  • Participate in ERP system optimization, cost accounting refinement, and reporting automation.
  • Assist in capital expenditure tracking, budgeting, and ad hoc financial projects as needed.

Required Skills & Abilities:

  • Experience working with an ERP/MRP system required.
  • Strong analytical skills and advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
  • Strong understanding of GL structure, subledger integration, and reconciliation processes within an ERP environment.
  • Strong knowledge of GAAP and month-end close best practices.
  • Proven ability to design, document, and improve accounting processes.
  • High attention to detail with the ability to communicate findings clearly to both accounting and non-accounting audiences.

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or related field required; MBA/CMA a plus.
  • 6+ years progressive accounting experience, ideally in manufacturing, job-cost, or project-based environments.
  • Prior experience supporting or leading financial reporting and audit preparation.
  • Experience working with inventory, job costing, and margin analysis preferred.


Physical Demands:

  • Must be able to accurately exchange information with customers, co-workers, management, and vendors.
  • Occasionally moves files and boxes of records weighing up to 20 lbs.
  • Constantly operates a computer and other office machinery, such as copiers, printers, and telephones.

title: Safety Administrator
description:
Life at Fulton Hogan is about making the most of opportunities, taking responsibility, and making it happen. We appreciate our peoples’ courage, curiosity and unique perspectives, and look to collaborate as much as possible to explore safer, smarter and more efficient ways of working in this rapidly changing world. We don’t stand still – there are always opportunities to do more and do better.

  • Keen to progress your career? Take full advantage of our tailored training, leadership, and mentoring programs; or leverage our partnerships with industry association such as Engineers Australia, Chartered Accountants, CPA Australia, Infrastructure Sustainability Council, The National Association of Women in Construction, plus many more.

  • Looking to enhance your wellbeing? We will encourage you to explore flexible working arrangements where possible. We offer great benefits, including corporate health and fitness programs, health insurance discounts, personal banking support, a range of retailer discounts, up to 18 weeks paid primary carers parental leave and up to 10 days paid secondary carers leave, access to our Employee Assistance Program (including your immediate family), and the option to take more time for yourself throughout the year with our Purchase Leave Policy.

  • Want to help us better the communities we live and work in? Our purpose of creating, connecting, and caring for communities is more than a saying to us – it’s a way of thinking, working, and living because we're locals too, and seek to give back in ways that strengthen and build resilient communities. We do this because we genuinely care, enjoy what we do, and even manage to have some fun along the way! You’ll find us partnering with local and national community groups, like Clontarf Foundation and Black Dog Institute, in addition to indigenous groups and social enterprises, to ensure that our good work positively impacts and brings about sustainable change within our industry.

  • Do we offer a ‘competitive’ salary package? Of course! Speak to our Talent Acquisition or People & Culture team to learn more.

What’s on offer?

We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Safety Administrator to support our Health & Safety Team on the Coomera Connector Project based in Helensvale, Queensland. In this role, you will help with the coordinate safety documentation, reporting, compliance records, and day-to-day administrative support to keep site safety operations running smoothly.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Maintain accurate safety records, including inductions, training logs, SWMS, permits, and incident reports.
  • Support the H&S team with tracking and scheduling of training, medicals, inductions, and certifications.
  • Assist with the preparation and distribution of safety communications, toolbox talks, and alerts
  • Help coordinate safety meetings, audits, and inspections by preparing documentation and taking minutes.
  • Ensure all site-based personnel have completed the required safety documentation management tools.
  • Maintain and update the H&S register, reporting systems, and documentation management tools.
  • Liaise with subcontractors and staff to ensure compliance with safety policies and procedures.

How you’ll connect to the role?

  • Previous experience in a construction or industrial environment, ideally in a safety or administrative support role.
  • Strong attention to detail and excellent organisational skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook). Experience with safety management tool is advantageous.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with a wide range of stakeholders on-site.
  • Understanding of safety documentation and compliance processes (desirable).
  • A proactive team player with a focus on continuous improvement and safe work practices.

Our people share the same set of values that keep us REAL. Respect, Energy and Effort, Attitude and Leadership encapsulate what we stand for at Fulton Hogan and encourage us to foster a diverse and inclusive culture where we listen to, care for, celebrate, and respect everyone.

We are committed to reconciliation and building and nurturing respectful relationships with First Nations peoples. Through our First Nations Engagement Strategy and Reconciliation Action Plan (RAP), we aim to promote opportunities, cultural understanding and partnerships that celebrate and acknowledge the contributions of Indigenous communities.

If our values resonate with you, please submit an application for the position. If you’re not sure that you meet 100% of the selection criteria, that’s okay, we would still like to hear from you and potentially discuss how your skills could be utilised at Fulton Hogan.

For over 90 years, Fulton Hogan has been delivering high-quality infrastructure to improve the lives of people every day. Our 10,000+ team works in every kind of weather and environment, creating, connecting, and caring for communities across Australia, New Zealand and the South Pacific.

title: Terminalarbetare
description:
Om arbetet som Terminalarbetare:
Vi behöver utöka vårt team i hjärtat av verksamheten - produktionen. I våra terminaler inkommer dagligen paket som ska sorteras och levereras till våra kunder, men även paket som skall lastas om och skickas till andra städer.

Du kommer bland annat att:

  • Säkerställa att verksamheten fortskrider under dagtid och kvällstid utan hinder.

  • Noggrant se till så att gods kommer in och ut ur terminalen enligt tidtabell.

  • Jobbet är deltid 75% och arbetskiften kan variera mellan 15:00-02:00 efter schema under veckans alla dagar.

  • Med kollektivavtal säkerställer vi schyssta villkor för alla involverade parter, främjar en positiv arbetsmiljö och investerar i våra medarbetares välbefinnande. Ett viktigt steg för Instabee mot att skapa en mer jämlik och trivsam arbetsplats.

Om dig som söker tjänsten som Terminalarbetare:
Du är en individ som utmärker sig genom punktlighet och noggrannhet. Med en positiv attityd sprider du glädje omkring dig och är en naturlig problemlösare som älskar att ta dig an nya utmaningar. Du trivs särskilt bra hos oss om du uppskattar en arbetsmiljö som präglas av ständig aktivitet och snabba förändringar. Vi söker dig som vill ta lite extra ansvar och kliva in som ansvarig vid behov.

  • Du har erfarenhet inom lager eller logistik.

  • Du är en stark lagspelare som trivs med samarbete.

  • Du uppskattar att arbeta fysiskt med kroppen.

  • Du behärskar svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift

Övrigt:
Denna rekryteringsprocess består av personlighets- och logiktest via Alva Labs samt bakgrundskontroller via Svensk Bakgrundsanalys för granskning av tidigare offentliga kriminalregister. Resultatet är offentlig information som hanteras konfidentiellt. Detta är obligatoriskt för alla rekryteringsprocesser på Instabee i Sverige.

description:

Campus

JOB ROLES:

To fulfill SST Schools' mission and goals through two integrated areas of responsibility: (1) coordinating and supporting the campus-level implementation of SST's Character Education Initiative, including the Kern Family Foundation–funded character education priorities; and (2) supporting family and community engagement efforts through the FACE Department by fostering meaningful partnerships among students, families, staff, and community stakeholders to strengthen student success and school culture.

This position reports administratively to the Campus Dean of Students and serves as the campus implementation coordinator for character education. Working under the direction of the Campus Dean of Students and in close collaboration with the District Character Education Coordinator, the position supports campus implementation, facilitates implementation and coordination across assigned feeder campuses, and assists the Dean of Students in fulfilling the campus's character education responsibilities and advancing SST's Character Formation Roadmap 2026–2029.


QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree required

  • Successful teaching and/or school leadership experience preferred

  • Prior experience in character education, student leadership, school culture, or related initiatives preferred


KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS:

  • Belief in and commitment to the mission and core values of SST Schools.

  • Demonstrated leadership with the ability to lead people and get results through work with others.

  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks with a willingness to be flexible when needed.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, demonstrating strong prioritization, organization, and follow-up skills.

  • Ability to build positive relationships and collaborate effectively with students, staff, families, and community partners

  • Ability to facilitate professional learning, campus initiatives, and student engagement activities

  • Excellent interpersonal skills.

  • Positive attitude, enthusiasm, and energy.

  • Openness to giving and receiving frequent feedback.




FACE PROGRAMS RESPONSIBILITIES (0.5 FTE):

  • Promote the creation and development of new clubs and help identify potential club advisors among existing campus personnel; provide resources/training opportunities for club advisors.

  • Support student club advisors for fundraising opportunities and supervise requests for club projects and fundraisers.

  • Support all stakeholders in identifying, developing, and maintaining mentoring programs.

  • Organize, support, and coordinate engagement activities and events for students, parents, and staff.

  • Create programs to help students to and through high school and college.

  • Collaborate with all stakeholders (admins, staff, students, parents, parent volunteer committee, community leaders, higher education institutions, etc.) to fulfill the school mission and goals.

  • Analyze and evaluate ongoing FACE programs, providing data to the administration and central office executives.

  • Meet with the principal and Director of Programs regularly to report and discuss concerns.

  • Collaborate with the Regional FACE Coordinator on middle-high school transition, internships, certificate programs, scholarships, and senior-alumni transition.

  • Organize expedition/exploration programs such as college trips, in/out-of-state trips, camps, and Festival of Language and Culture.

  • Oversee the Before/After School Care Program.

CHARACTER EDUCATION RESPONSIBILITIES (0.5 FTE):

  • Coordinate and support the campus-level implementation of SST's Character Education Initiative under the direction of the Campus Dean of Students and in collaboration with the District Character Education Coordinator.

  • Lead the development, implementation, and annual review of the Campus Character Action Plan for the assigned high school while providing leadership, coaching, and implementation support to assigned feeder campuses to ensure consistent alignment with Character.org's 11 Principles, the Jubilee Centre Framework, and district priorities

  • Coordinate campus implementation of districtwide character education initiatives, including Texas Character Education Week, STARS in the Character Sky, the Color the World with Character Traits Poster Drive, C-STREAM Summer Camps, and other district-approved initiatives.

  • Provide implementation support, coordination, and collaboration across assigned feeder campuses to promote aligned character education practices and continuity of student character development.

  • Support teachers in integrating character education strategies, storytelling-based resources, and character development activities into classroom instruction and campus programs.

  • Collect, maintain, and submit implementation evidence, survey results, and required campus reports to the District Character Education Coordinator

  • Lead and coordinate the campus's National School of Character designation process and the development and submission of Promising Practices. Serve as the primary campus coordinator for these initiatives while collaborating with the Campus Dean of Students and the District Character Education Coordinator, and provide implementation support to assigned feeder campuses pursuing the same recognitions

  • Participate in district-provided professional learning, implementation meetings, coaching sessions, and the Developing Educators Certification Program.

  • Meet regularly with the District Character Education Coordinator and the Campus Dean of Students to review implementation progress, identify needs, and support continuous improvement efforts

  • Demonstrate flexibility, initiative, and a strong commitment to supporting the successful implementation of the SST Character Formation Roadmap 2026–2029 by enthusiastically embracing new responsibilities, district priorities, and implementation initiatives as they emerge


WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Light Work: may require occasional light lifting.

  • Nights and weekend activities will be occasionally required.

  • Position is in an office setting and may involve prolonged work at a desk in one location.

  • Moderate travel is required.

Define Long-Term Product Strategy

Lead Large-Scale, Cross-Functional Initiatives

Identify Revenue Opportunities & Innovation
Identify and evaluate new revenue opportunities, product enhancements, and innovation strategies that drive differentiation and growth. Stay attuned to market trends, competitive dynamics, and emerging customer needs to continuously evolve the portfolio and unlock new sources of value.

Mentor & Develop Product Managers
Mentor and develop product managers by providing guidance, sharing best practices, and fostering strong product management discipline across the team. Play an active role in elevating team performance, strengthening capabilities, and building a pipeline of future product leadership talent.

title: Commercial Co-ordinator
description:
Role: Compliance Co-ordinator

Hours: 40 per week Monday - Friday

Location: Preston, Head Office

Salary: £30,000 per annum plus commission structure


The Role:

To act as the first point of contact for all incoming WEEE and Battery enquiries, providing a professional and responsive service while identifying opportunities that support both Recycling Lives Services operational sites and Producer Compliance Scheme obligations.


The role qualifies enquiries, gathers information and coordinates internally to ensure each opportunity is directed to the appropriate commercial or operational lead. Working closely with operational sites, customer service, compliance, transport and commercial teams, the role develops a broad understanding of the wider business to recognise cross-selling opportunities and drive additional material volumes.


The Business:

Recycling Lives Services is not a typical recycling company. Since 2008, the business has been structurally built around social value, employing people from disadvantaged backgrounds, partnering with the justice system to reduce reoffending, and delivering environmental excellence at scale. The social mission is not a layer added on top of commercial activity. It is the reason the business operates in the way it does.


As a certified B Corp (scoring 103.5 against a business median of 50.9), Recycling Lives Services generated £42.9m in social value in 2024, achieved a 61% reduction in CO2 emissions, and diverted 97% of waste from landfill. 15% of our team have been welcomed through our rehabilitation programmes, and only 6% of people we support reoffend — compared to a national average of over 25%.


We operate UK-wide across construction, manufacturing, retail, utilities and public sector markets, offering total waste management, WEEE recycling, and specialist hazardous waste services.


Our PACE values underpin how we work and the culture we are building across the business: Passion – we care about what we do; Accountability – we take responsibility; Collaboration – we work together respectfully; and Excellence – we aim high. We look for people who share these values and want to make a positive contribution to our business, our customers and the communities we support.



What You'll Be Doing:

As our Commercial Coordinator, you will play a key role in supporting business growth by managing incoming enquiries and ensuring opportunities are directed to the right teams.


Key duties include:

  • Acting as the first point of contact for WEEE and Battery enquiries via telephone and email.
  • Qualifying, recording and managing customer enquiries through Salesforce CRM.
  • Allocating opportunities and leads to the appropriate internal stakeholders.
  • Working closely with operational sites to understand capacity, service capabilities and commercial opportunities.
  • Identifying cross-selling opportunities across the wider business to maximise customer value.
  • Building and maintaining strong working relationships with colleagues across multiple departments.
  • Producing and maintaining basic reports on enquiry volumes, conversions and business performance metrics.
  • Delivering excellent customer service and ensuring timely responses to all enquiries.


This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong communication and organisational skills who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and helping to drive business growth.



What We Are Looking For:

We're looking for a motivated and customer-focused individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys building strong working relationships across teams.


Essential Skills & Experience:

  • Excellent communication skills, with the confidence to engage professionally with customers and colleagues via phone and email.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple enquiries and priorities effectively.
  • Proactive approach with a positive attitude and a willingness to take ownership of tasks.
  • Customer-focused mindset, committed to delivering a high standard of service.
  • Good IT skills, with the ability to use CRM systems, Microsoft Office applications and reporting tools.
  • Eagerness to learn and develop knowledge of the waste and recycling industry.


Desirable Skills & Experience:

  • Previous experience within the waste management or recycling sector.
  • Experience using Salesforce or other CRM systems.
  • Knowledge of WEEE and Battery regulations, collections or compliance services.


What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary Plus commission
  • The opportunity to work for a certified B Corp making a genuine social and environmental impact.
  • 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays.
  • Company pension (5% employee / 3% employer).
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Free financial wellbeing support
  • Healthcare Cash Plan.*
  • Cycle to Work Scheme.*
  • Enhanced maternity and paternity pay.*


*Available after 12 months' service.


We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitable qualified persons regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.

title: HR Partner
description:
Ecolab is looking for a HR People Partner!

The HR People Partner will provide proactive, commercially focused and pragmatic HR support to the Pest division

across the UK and Ireland. Working as part of the UK & Ireland HR team, the role will partner with managers to

strengthen people capability, support effective employee relations, enable consistent execution of core people

processes, and contribute to an inclusive, engaging and high-performing culture aligned to Ecolab’s values.

The role will act as a trusted advisor to managers, using people data, business insight and sound judgement to identify

trends, manage risk and support practical solutions that improve associate experience, manager effectiveness and

business performance.

Ecolab’s commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion (DE&I) reflects our longstanding value of working together to integrate diverse perspectives to challenge ourselves, reach our goals and do what’s right.

What will you do:

People partnering and manager support

  • Partner with Pest division managers to support delivery of the people agenda, ensuring consistent application of company procedures and effective risk management.
  • Provide practical, commercially focused HR advice across a field-based, multi-site and customer-facing environment.
  • Coach and build manager capability in core people processes, enabling leaers to manage confidently, consistently and in line with Ecolab values.
  • Support managers to create inclusive, engaging team environments where associates feel valued, heard and able to perform at their best

Employee relations, compliance and risk

  • Advise managers on employee relations matters including disciplinary, grievance, performance, absence management and capability cases, in line with company procedures and employment legislation.
  • Identify and escalate complex, sensitive or high-risk matters appropriately, ensuring clear judgement, robust documentation and balanced decision making.
  • Remain up to date with relevant UK and Ireland employment law, internal polcy requirements and external HR trends, translating these into practical guidance for managers.
  • Support consultation activity, restructures, TUPE transfers, acquisitions and integration activity where required, including risk assessment, due diligence and employee communication suppor.

Talent, performance and engagement

  • Support recruitment, onboarding and probation processes, working with managers and Talent Acquisition to ensure a positive and effective new starter experience.

Data, Insights and Continuous improvement

  • Proactively identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve consistency and drive efficiencies through digital tools, MyEcolab, Workday and smarter ways of working.

Desirable qualifications

title: Catastrophe Research & Development Intern
description:
Howden Re is the global reinsurance broker and risk, capital & strategic advisor focused on relentless innovation & superior analytics for top client service. ​ ​

Internship: Catastrophe Research & Development

Location: Edina, MN

Salary: $25/hr + overtime
Deadline to apply: Friday 16th October

Introduction

Working with our reinsurance team in North America you’ll learn more about applying business analytics, ML/AI, and creative data visualization to tackle complex problems for clients and the insurance industry as a whole, risk mitigation solutions and doing real work for Howden Re's current and prospective clients.

What you’ll be doing

Reinsurance is a complex world; the easiest way to think about it is that it’s insurance for the insurers. Working with our teams, you’ll help insurance companies protect their futures, and the people they insure.

The Howden Re Decision Support Team (Modeling and Analytics) is unmatched in the industry in facilitating catastrophe reinsurance placements while also being integrally embedded within our clients' operations. Howden Re employs cutting edge technology in a collaborative environment; striving always to develop solutions and present ideas that align with our clients' core philosophy of profitable growth.

As a Catastrophe R&D Intern, you will collaborate both internally and externally with analysts and senior executives.

On a day-to-day basis you’ll:

  • Assist in analysis projects under guidance of senior catastrophe modelers.

  • Perform analyses to extract data sets that can be used to calculate the client's risk exposure.

  • Assist senior R&D team members in preparing and formatting summaries, presentations, and reports in order to convey potential risk and loss results for clients.

Who we’re looking for

Working at Howden Re:

At Howden Re, we’re on a mission to do things differently. Our no silo approach, elite team, and clear focus on innovation and relentless execution means our clients are at the heart of all we do.

As a big 4 global reinsurance broker, we deliberately avoid the one-size-fits-all approach, committing to creating bespoke solutions that address the unique challenges of a modern and dynamic marketplace. We're looking for a Power BI Data Analyst to help transform how we use data across our business. This is an exciting opportunity to build and shape our Finance and FP&A reporting capability, turning complex operational and financial data into trusted insights that inform smarter decisions across the organisation.

What you'll be doing:

You'll sit at the intersection of Finance, Data and Technology, helping TLC move from manual reporting processes to automated, scalable and insightful business intelligence solutions.

Reporting & Business Intelligence

  • Design, build and maintain engaging Power BI dashboards and reports focused on Finance and FP&A reporting.

  • Transform data from Microsoft Dataverse, Cosmos DB and other enterprise systems into trusted, reporting-ready datasets.

  • Create high-quality semantic models, dimensional data structures and DAX calculations that support business decision-making.

  • Use Power Query, SQL and the Microsoft data ecosystem to cleanse, transform and combine data from multiple sources.

  • Translate business requirements into meaningful reports, KPIs and analytical insights.

  • Develop reporting across revenue, profitability, budgets, forecasts, costs, client performance, variance analysis and management reporting.

Data Quality & Continuous Improvement

  • Ensure reporting outputs accurately reconcile back to source systems and can be trusted by stakeholders.

  • Investigate and resolve data quality issues in partnership with Finance, Data and Technology teams.

  • Optimise Power BI models and reports for performance, usability and scalability.

  • Apply consistent KPI definitions, governance standards and appropriate security controls.

  • Document datasets, business rules, calculations and reporting logic.

  • Drive continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to automate and streamline reporting processes.

Partnering With The Business

  • Collaborate with Finance, FP&A, Data, Technology and commercial teams across the organisation.

  • Build strong stakeholder relationships and become a trusted advisor for reporting and analytics.

  • Present insights and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Who we're looking for:
Essential Experience

  • Strong commercial experience developing Power BI reports and dashboards.

  • Advanced skills in Power Query, DAX and Power BI data modelling.

  • Strong SQL skills and the ability to investigate, validate and transform data independently.

  • Experience working with Microsoft Dataverse, Dynamics 365 data or similarly complex operational datasets.

  • Experience building reporting solutions that require substantial data preparation and transformation.

  • Strong understanding of data modelling principles including star schemas, facts, dimensions and relationship design.

  • Experience gathering requirements and translating business needs into scalable reporting solutions.

  • Confidence working with financial data and partnering with Finance stakeholders.

  • Understanding of FP&A and financial reporting concepts including budgets, forecasts, actuals, profitability analysis, variance reporting and management reporting.

Nice To Have

  • Experience with Azure Cosmos DB, Microsoft Fabric, Azure SQL or SQL Server.

  • Experience with Power BI Service administration, deployment pipelines or Dataflows.

  • Experience with Fabric Lakehouse, Warehousing or modern Microsoft data platforms.

  • Experience with source control, structured BI deployment practices or CI/CD.

  • Exposure to budgeting, planning or FP&A systems.

At TLC, attitude is just as important as capability. We're looking for someone who is:

  • Curious about the story behind the data, not just the dashboard.

title: Data Scientist / AI Engineer, AVP
description:
Job Description:

Job Title: Data Scientist / AI Engineer, AVP

Location: Bangalore, India

Role Description

Driving the creation of new AI solutions for Corporate Banking and Investment Banking Operations and Controls (CBIBOC).

  • As Deutsche Bank enters into a phase where a variety of data and AI development tools are becoming more accessible, we are seeking a Data Scientist / AI Engineer to help drive the implementation of the Corporate Banking and Investment Banking Operations and Controls data, AI and analytics strategy.
  • The role holder will report up to the Head of Data Science and AI Engineering for Corporate Banking and Investment Banking Operations and Controls, and will be a key part of a collaborative, respected and growing team consisting of Data Scientists / AI Engineers, Product Managers, data experts, and transformation leads (~20 individuals based in London, Bangalore, and New York).
  • The role holder will be expected to contribute to the design, development and implementation of new AI solutions for stakeholders across CBIBOC. These solutions will vary in terms of complexity, but all will have the goal of simplifying and accelerating Operations and Controls activities, achieving cost save targets, and driving revenue growth.
  • The design and development of new AI solutions will be done in collaboration with staff from IT (TDI) and other teams across CBIBOC and Deutsche Bank more broadly. Development activities will range from the use of no-code / low-code platforms (e.g. to build new workflow automations or multi-agent solutions) to the engineering of new data products, models, and scalable AI solutions in collaboration with IT.

Your Contribution:

  • You will be instrumental in shaping the future of the CB IB operations and controls landscape by re-imagining how existing processes could be improved using AI, and driving the development of new solutions to make this vision a reality.
  • Its key responsibility is to support the rapid turnaround of new AI solutions to enhance efficiency, increase effectiveness, and drive business growth.

What we’ll offer you

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy:

  • Best-in-class annual leave policy
  • Gender-neutral parental leaves
  • 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender-neutral)
  • Sponsorship for industry-relevant certifications and education
  • Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
  • Comprehensive hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
  • Accident and term life Insurance
  • Complementary health screening for 35 yrs. and above

Your key responsibilities

  • Leadership (5%):
    • Help drive the adoption of AI and analytics best practice across CBIBOC, IT (TDI), and Deutsche Bank more widely
    • Stay abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies in data warehousing, business intelligence, and cloud analytics, particularly within the Google Cloud Platform ecosystem.
  • Stakeholder Management and Governance (20%):
    • Ensure AI governance requirements, as mandated by bank policy, regulation, or law, are adhered to for all new solutions developed
    • Provide demos of new solutions, training materials, slides, and other materials as required to support the CBIBOC communication and upskilling agenda
  • Hands-on Development of AI Solutions (75%):
    • Lead by example, working with other Squad members to design, develop, and implement novel AI solutions
    • Partner with business stakeholders and other Squad members to understand their needs and priorities, and identify new opportunities for the development or use of AI solutions
    • Ensure new AI use cases (Squad projects) are rigorously evaluated and prioritized based on expected ROI, strategic alignment, technical feasibility and risk
    • Ensure all new AI solutions are thoroughly tested, validated, controlled (e.g. implementation of guardrails, access permissions, etc.), and monitored on an ongoing basis
    • Ensure all new AI solutions are recorded in a centralized inventory and brought through the required approval steps prior to production implementation
    • Track against agreed KPIs to demonstrate the effectiveness and value of each AI solution (e.g. costs and benefits as well as accuracy/consistency/performance)

Your skills and experience

  • Demonstrable experience using classical Machine Learning algorithms/models and/or cutting-edge AI tools to deliver new solutions into production, ideally at a tier 1 / G-SIB bank
  • Demonstrable experience using Data Science / AI developer tools and platforms such as: Github, VS Code, PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, MLflow, Weights and Biases, Jupyter Notebook, Hugging Face, Langchain, Langgraph, Google Vertex, Neo4J, etc.
  • Experience using no-code / low-code AI tools to rapidly generate new AI and automation solutions (e.g. Microsoft AI Builder / Power Automate, Google AI Studio, Claude Cowork, etc.)
  • Experience with data / feature engineering and modern data solutions such as BigQuery, Looker, PostgreSQL, Pinecone, Spark, Clickhouse, MongoDB, Redis, Databricks, Denodo, Snowflake, etc.
  • Strong knowledge of current best practice for AI risk management across the solution lifecycle, and how to leverage technology to implement these controls (e.g. from development, testing, and validation of new solutions to setting access controls/permissions, implementing guardrails, and automating performance monitoring and reporting / dashboards)
  • Ability to write / review Python code and experience using AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Github Copilot, etc.). SQL and Java experience desirable but not essential.
  • The desire to grow and learn, keep up with the latest developments and new AI offerings emerging across the industry, and progress their Data Science / AI career.

Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

How we’ll support you

  • Training and development to help you excel in your career
  • Coaching and support from experts in your team
  • A culture of continuous learning to aid the progression of your career
  • A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs

Shell is looking for an Asset Engineer to join our team at the Sewaren Terminal in New Jersey.

The position leads risk management, reliability improvement, maintenance strategies, and project execution while partnering across operations, maintenance, integrity, HSSE, and project teams to optimize asset performance and deliver business value.

This position is primarily site-based at the Sewaren Terminal in New Jersey, with a requirement to be on site at least four days per week. Travel of up to 40% within the region is required to support other assets.

Accountabilities:

title: Senior Risk Officer
description:
Alma Bank, headquartered in Long Island City, New York and having 13 branches located throughout Queens, NYC, New Jersey, Brooklyn and the Bronx, brings personal service back to personal banking. We have genuine banking professionals ready to serve our customers, and offer a full range of products and services. Alma delivers a private banking style experience to our business banking customers. Come join our winning team!

Alma Bank is currently looking to hire an experienced Senior Risk Officer to work out of our Corporate office in Long Island City, Queens. This position is fully onsite.

Salary range is $170,000 - $190,000, commensurate with experience.

SUMMARY

Responsible for the development and implementation of bank wide integrated Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) Program. Administrative oversight of Internal Audit, Compliance and BSA functions of the Bank to ensure that the Bank is in full compliance with applicable laws and regulations. Enable the efficient and effective governance of significant risks in order for the Bank to balance risk and reward.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  • Manage organizational risk by conducting activities consistent with established goals, objectives, and policies.
  • Follows direction set by President & CEO, Board of Directors, Risk & Compliance and Audit Committees of the Board of Directors.
  • Reviews programs to ensure attainment of business plan for growth and profit consistent with the risk recognized by the Board of Directors.
  • Create process for assessing, identifying, monitoring, and mitigating business risk.
  • Responsible for ensuring the Bank complies with operating policies and procedures.
  • Conduct meetings with C-level executives and other senior management within the Bank that are assigned risk management responsibilities to discuss problems or explain procedural changes or practices necessary to mitigate risk.
  • Provide leadership and direction; establish work priorities to achieve risk goals and objectives.
  • Provide administration of risk activities; fostering the integration of risk management practices throughout the Bank.
  • Responsible for the development and implementation of a comprehensive ERM governance framework.
  • Oversee the Information Security team and the Bank’s vendor management process.
  • Develop and revise risk management policies; ensure quantification of management’s risk appetite (policy limits and triggers.)
  • Prepare periodic reporting to senior management and the Board of Directors to include the Risk Dashboard, Executive Scorecard, Risk Profile and Narrative Summary.
  • Collaborate and work with policy administrator and counsel to ensure that policies are in compliance with banking laws, regulations, and internal policies and procedures. Ensure new policies and policy change are effected timely to include the introduction of new products, revised work flow (procedures), revisions to laws, rules or regulations which are applicable to the Bank.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with regulators, providing quarterly updates as required.
  • As needed, attend Board meetings and serve on management committees as required.

QUALIFICATIONS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Position requires excellent interpersonal skills as well as strong communication skills. Ability to read, analyze, and interpret financial reports, and legal documents. Ability to respond to common inquiries or complaints from customers, regulatory agencies, or members of the business community. Ability to effectively present information to senior management, and/or Boards of Directors.

Must possess sound judgment and have a unique ability to solve problems. Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Must be detail-oriented and able to handle multiple tasks simultaneously.

Foundational competencies should include the following: flexibility, teamwork, facilitation, initiative, leadership, risk management and strategic planning capabilities.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

Bachelor’s degree required plus a Master's degree preferred; 15 years of banking experience, 10 years in risk, compliance or internal audit. Possess strong leadership skills with prior managerial experience.

  • Salary commensurate with experience.
  • Alma Bank employees work in an open and collaborative environment.
  • Alma Bank Offers its eligible employees a generous matching 401(k); excellent healthcare coverage (medical/dental/vision); short and long term disability and ife insurance options.

As an EMT-P (Emergency Medical Technician-Paramedic), you will play a critical role in providing advanced emergency medical care to patients in urgent situations. You will work closely with other emergency responders and healthcare professionals to ensure a seamless transition of care.
