  • Perform comprehensive patient assessments to determine the nature and extent of injuries or illnesses.
  • Administer advanced life support interventions, including medication administration, intubation, and cardiac monitoring.
  • Operate emergency medical equipment and vehicles safely and efficiently during transport.
  • Collaborate with other emergency services and healthcare providers to ensure continuity of care.
  • Document patient care and treatment accurately in compliance with legal and organizational standards.

The required skills for this position include advanced medical knowledge and the ability to perform complex procedures in high-stress situations. Strong communication skills are essential for effectively interacting with patients, families, and other healthcare professionals. About Us – Christchurch City Mission

The Christchurch City Mission (Te Whare Mīhana Ki Ōtautahi) helps anyone in need, no matter their situation. We work alongside people going through tough times—whether it’s due to job loss, housing issues, addiction, family difficulties, or financial stress.


We respond to both immediate crises and long-term challenges. Our services aim to build confidence, dignity, and skills so people can live independently and feel proud of themselves. Apply today and tell us why this casual opportunity is a good fit for you.

title: Head of Data Engineering
description:
An innovative financial services organisation is seeking a Head of Data Engineering to lead and scale its data function. This is a hybrid leadership and hands-on technical role, offering the opportunity to shape data strategy, drive engineering excellence, and support business-critical data initiatives. The position combines approximately 50% people leadership and 50% hands-on engineering, requiring a leader who can define and execute a strategic roadmap while remaining technically involved in architecture, solution design, and key engineering initiatives.

  • Reports directly to a senior executive leadership team member
  • High-profile position with significant influence across the organisation
  • Responsible for hiring, performance management, coaching, and team development

Team Structure

  • Lead a team of 3 Data Engineering professionals
  • Planned team growth during the next 12 months
  • Responsible for fostering a high-performance, collaborative engineering culture

Key Responsibilities: Data Strategy & Leadership

  • Define and evolve the organisation's data strategy and roadmap in alignment with business objectives
  • Balance short-term business priorities with long-term scalable architecture decisions
  • Drive adoption of data best practices, governance standards, and engineering principles
  • Act as the key stakeholder for data-related decision making across the organisation

Team Management

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a growing Data Engineering team
  • Manage hiring processes, onboarding, coaching, and career development
  • Conduct performance reviews and establish effective team operating rhythms
  • Create a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement

Hands-On Data Engineering

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and data platforms
  • Develop datasets, infrastructure, and internal tooling supporting analytics, research, and product initiatives
  • Contribute directly to engineering projects where required
  • Make architectural decisions and provide technical leadership across the data estate

Data Quality & Reliability

  • Define and own data quality, availability, coverage, and reliability KPIs
  • Implement monitoring, alerting, and observability frameworksImprove resilience, validation processes, and incident management procedures
  • Ensure data platforms are scalable, secure, and operationally robust

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with engineering, product, analytics, and business stakeholders
  • Translate business requirements into scalable data solutions
  • Enable data-driven decision making through robust and accessible datasets
  • Align technical priorities with organisational goals

Engineering Excellence

  • Establish standards for testing, code quality, documentation, and deployment practices
  • Drive operational excellence and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Promote modern software engineering principles across the data team
  • Ensure sustainable scaling of both technology and team capabilities

Desired Skills and Experience Leadership Experience

  • 5-10+ years of Data Engineering experience
  • Minimum 2 years of team leadership or management experience
  • Proven track record of building, mentoring, and developing engineering teams
  • Experience creating and executing technical roadmaps aligned to business goals

Desired Skills and Experience Technical Expertise

  • Strong background designing, building, and operating production-grade data platforms
  • Expertise in data pipeline development, orchestration, monitoring, and operational support
  • Experience with orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow or equivalent technologies
  • Strong software engineering foundations with a focus on maintainability, scalability, and reliability

Desired Skills and Experience Data & Domain Knowledge

  • Experience working with complex, large-scale datasets
  • Exposure to financial services, capital markets, investment management, or similarly data-intensive environments is highly desirable
  • Understanding of market data, reference data, time-series datasets, or comparable analytical domains

Desired Skills and Experience Technology Stack Experience with several of the following

  • Python
  • Apache Spark
  • Apache Iceberg
  • PostgreSQL
  • AWS or equivalent cloud platforms
  • Data orchestration and workflow automation technologies
  • Monitoring and observability platforms
  • Modern data platform architectures

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on delivery
  • Pragmatic approach to engineering trade-off decisions
  • Passion for driving continuous improvement and innovation
  • Collaborative leadership style with a commitment to diversity, inclusion, and teamwork

title: Lineworker, Journey
description:
Connexus Energy has an exciting opportunity for a Journey Lineworker. As a Lineworker, you will gain knowledge and experience in all aspects of safe construction and maintenance of our electrical distribution system. Additionally, you will construct and maintain the overhead and underground electrical distribution lines in a safe, reliable, and timely manner that will provide customers with safe, reliable service.


Compensation:

The hiring wage for this union position is $62.22 per hour in accordance with the union contract. In addition, this position is eligible for an annual bonus with a target payout of 5% of annual earnings based on company performance.


In this position, you will:

  • Construct and maintain our overhead and underground electrical distribution system within the appropriate specifications, guidelines, and standards so that reliable service is provided in a safe and timely manner to our members.
  • Construct overhead lines including framing, setting poles, stringing conductor, hanging materials and electrical devices according to all specifications
  • Install primary and secondary underground electrical distribution system within the appropriate specifications, guidelines and standards
  • Plow and trench cable
  • Maintain the electrical distribution system to ensure its safety and reliability while minimizing any disruption of service
  • Repair broken equipment such as poles and conductors
  • Perform general troubleshooting
  • Perform appropriate repairs
  • Restore power in a safe and timely manner
  • Analyze situation that led to the power outage

Need to have:

  • High School or GED diploma AND Electrical Lineworker diploma
  • Completion of a four-year Apprenticeship program and Journey Lineworker certification
  • Current and valid Class A CDL Driver’s License with a good driving record
  • Current and valid health card
  • Certified First Aid and CPR training
  • Trained/able to perform bucket and pole top rescue
  • Certified in pole climbing for construction and maintenance
  • Ability to operate various equipment such as boom, digger derrick trucks and heavy equipment
  • Mechanical aptitude to work with machines and equipment
  • Ability to read and understand written work documents such as charts, diagrams, schematics and staking sheets
  • Ability to meet the physical standards of the job: Lift & carry up to 75 lbs.; Push/pull up to 150 lbs.; climb & work at heights that may exceed 60 feet
  • Commitment to customer service and ability to present a positive Connexus Energy image

Other information:

Successful candidates will be required to meet the following conditions:

  • Normal work hours will occur anywhere between 6:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m. with emergency or scheduled work on weekends, holidays or any time of the day
  • Live within a 30-minute response time to Connexus Energy headquarters
  • Become qualified for on-call rotation to handle emergencies that may occur at all hours of the day or night


Pre-Employment Requirement: Employment is contingent upon successfully completing a pre-employment background check and drug screen

Based in Ramsey, Connexus Energy is Minnesota’s largest electric cooperative, providing electricity, renewable energy alternatives and related services to 150,000 residential and commercial members just north of the Twin Cities. We offer a collaborative work environment with challenging and rewarding work, which provides for professional development and work-life balance in a highly technical, stable and innovative industry. We give back to the communities we have served for more than 80 years by embracing opportunities to volunteer, donate and support economic development. Our talented and friendly staff focuses on achieving our mission of powering our members and communities toward a smarter energy future with a passionate focus on affordability, innovation, safety, and grid reliability.

Connexus Energy’s benefits package includes medical/dental/vision insurance, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, 401(k) plan with generous company matching and non-matching contributions and independent investment advisory services, accrued PTO, holiday pay, tuition reimbursement, recognition program, employee referral program, and employee activities. Company paid life insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability is also provided.

Equal Opportunity Employer:

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability status, veteran status, or other legally protected status.

title: Managing Director - Voluntary Benefits
description:
Who are we?

Howden is a global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no-limits mindset, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 24,000 employees spanning over 56 countries.

People join Howden for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down headhunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work / life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like-minded people driving change at Howden.

Why Join Howden US?

At Howden, we're building a different kind of insurance and people advisory business. With over 22,000 employees across more than 50 countries and ambitious growth plans in the U.S., we bring together insurance, reinsurance, employee benefits, and human capital expertise to help organizations navigate risk and drive performance. Howden's producer-focused, entrepreneurial culture is built around empowering talented professionals to grow their business while providing access to a full suite of risk, benefits, and advisory capabilities.

As a Senior Producer within our Workforce Solutions practice, you'll have the opportunity to build meaningful client relationships, shape workforce strategies for leading organizations, and leverage the full strength of Howden's global platform to deliver innovative solutions.

The Role

The Senior Producer, Workforce Solutions is responsible for driving organic growth through the acquisition of new clients and expansion of existing relationships. This individual will serve as a trusted advisor to employers seeking solutions across employee benefits, total rewards, workforce strategy, wellbeing, compliance, retirement, and other human capital challenges.

The ideal candidate combines strong business development skills with a consultative approach and deep understanding of the workforce solutions landscape.

What Your Day Will Look Like

  • Develop and execute a strategic sales plan designed to achieve annual revenue and growth objectives.
  • Generate new business opportunities through networking, referrals, centers of influence, and targeted prospecting efforts.
  • Build relationships with C-suite executives, HR leaders, CFOs, and business owners to understand workforce challenges and strategic priorities.
  • Conduct consultative client meetings focused on employee benefits, talent attraction and retention, wellbeing, compensation strategy, workforce planning, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Develop and deliver compelling proposals, presentations, and business cases that demonstrate measurable client value.
  • Partner with internal specialists across employee benefits, retirement, actuarial, wellbeing, compliance, analytics, and consulting functions to deliver comprehensive solutions.
  • Lead sales and renewal strategy discussions, identifying opportunities to deepen client engagement and expand service offerings.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of market trends, workforce challenges, healthcare cost drivers, labor market dynamics, and regulatory developments.
  • Collaborate closely with service teams to ensure exceptional client experiences and long-term retention.
  • Utilize CRM systems and sales analytics to manage pipeline activity, forecast revenue, and track business development efforts.
  • Represent Howden at industry conferences, networking events, and client functions to enhance market presence and brand recognition.
  • Serve as a mentor and resource to junior producers and business development professionals where appropriate.

Key Areas of Focus

Workforce Solutions may include:

  • Employee Benefits
  • Health & Welfare Programs
  • Retirement and Financial Wellness
  • Executive Benefits
  • Compensation and Total Rewards
  • Workforce Analytics
  • Talent Attraction and Retention Strategies
  • Wellbeing Programs
  • Leave and Absence Solutions
  • HR Technology and Administration
  • Compliance and Regulatory Consulting
  • Human Capital Risk Management

Skills and Experience That Will Lead to Success

  • 7+ years of successful business development, producer, consultant, or advisory experience within employee benefits, workforce solutions, human capital consulting, HR technology, retirement consulting, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated track record of generating new business revenue and developing long-term client relationships.
  • Strong understanding of employee benefits and workforce-related solutions.
  • Consultative selling approach with the ability to engage senior business leaders in strategic discussions.
  • Ability to identify complex workforce challenges and develop tailored solutions.
  • Excellent presentation, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
  • Strong organizational and pipeline management capabilities.
  • Experience working with CRM platforms such as Salesforce or similar systems.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and client advocacy.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across multiple service lines and disciplines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • Active Life, Accident & Health License, or ability to obtain upon hire.
  • CEBS, SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, HRCI, CLU, ChFC, or other industry certifications preferred.
  • Experience working with middle market and large employer clients.
  • Established network within the employer, HR, benefits, or business leadership community.

Compensation and Benefits

The expected base salary range for this role is $350,000 and $450,000, depending on experience and location.

In addition to a competitive base salary, employees are eligible to receive a production based bonus. Howden also offers a variety of benefits and programs, subject to eligibility, including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance, including healthcare savings and reimbursement accounts

  • 401(k) retirement plan

  • Flexible Paid Time Off and paid parental leave

  • Life and Disability insurance

What Do We Offer in Return? A Career That You Define.

Our business succeeds by allowing our people to make a mark in the areas they care about most, whether that's personal development, volunteering, or creating solutions that help clients address their most significant workforce challenges. We support our people in every aspect of their lives, recognizing that fulfillment at home and work go hand in hand. We provide competitive benefits, opportunities for professional development, and the ability to participate in a unique employee ownership culture.

Our Sustainability Promise

We're on a life-long journey to become an ever-more sustainable group. It's a commitment to taking care of our people and the world we live in, to doing good business, and to making a positive impact wherever we can.

What do we offer in return?

A career that you define. At Howden, we value diversity – there is no one Howden type. Instead, we’re looking for individuals who share the same values as us:

  • Our successes have all come from someone brave enough to try something new

  • We support each other in the small everyday moments and the bigger challenges

  • We are determined to make a positive difference at work and beyond

Reasonable adjustments

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations at Howden to ensure that our positions align well with your needs. Besides the usual adjustments such as software, IT, and office setups, we can also accommodate other changes such as flexible hours* or hybrid working*.

If you're excited by this role but have some doubts about whether it’s the right fit for you, send us your application – if your profile fits the role’s criteria, we will be in touch to assist in helping to get you set up with any reasonable adjustments you may require.

*Not all positions can accommodate changes to working hours or locations. Reach out to your Recruitment Partner if you want to know more.

Permanent

title: Inventory Specialist
description:
Position: Green Tobacco Inventory Specialist

Location/Department: Universal Leaf North America/Nashville, NC/Accounting

Status: Full-Time, Salaried

Reports To: Vice President, Financial Analysis


Our Company

Universal Leaf North America (ULNA), a subsidiary of Universal Corporation, is the premier supplier of quality, compliant, and sustainable tobaccos and services to our customers, where we conduct business in Canada, Guatemala, Mexico, and the U.S.

Our Nash Facility is the most technologically advanced tobacco threshing operation in the world. We can process over one million pounds of semi-perishable tobacco per day by transforming it into a stable tobacco material that can be stored for years, all while meeting the exacting standards of the tobacco product manufacturers.

As a compliment to ULNA’s leaf stemming business, our J. P. Taylor Company, L.L.C. facility provides tobacco stems and scrap blending, rolling, and cutting, which further enhances the total value and usability of the entire tobacco leaf. Both the Nash and J.P. Taylor facilities maintain ISO9001 Quality and ISO 14001 Environmental systems, which further support our commitment to our customers and other stakeholders. The unusable tobacco waste material from both facilities is transformed into organic compost at our Carolina Recycled Ag Materials, LLC (CRAM) facility, which provides a cost-effective and environmentally friendly alternative to commercial fertilizers.

Additional services include Universal Storages, where we assist our customers in managing their tobacco logistics and storage requirements.

At Universal Leaf North America, our employees have proven a strong commitment to providing a quality product, excellent customer service, and operating in a sustainable and compliant manner.


Summary

As a Green Tobacco Inventory Specialist at Universal Leaf North America, you will establish internal controls for and monitor the purchase of green tobacco and other business activities at buying stations. You will also maintain control of operating costs, quality and production to satisfy company commitments.

What You’ll Be Doing (Essential Responsibilities)

  • Track and document green tobacco purchases from point of purchase to stemmery and into production.
  • Work jointly with leaf department to maintain all farmer contract information for different styles of tobacco.
  • Process payments to farmers during season, and ensure pounds, amounts, and recipients are correct
  • Communicate effectively with farmers, lending institutions, leaf, and accounting departments to maintain DAX accounting system’s vendor information
  • Ensure up to date certifications and requirements at buying stations (i.e. weighmaster licenses scale and weight certifications, any state moisture requirements
  • Assist during internal and external audits
  • Identify, manage and correct all discrepancies in the receipts of tobacco, as compared to the shipments made from buying stations, auction sites and third parties
  • Work closely with accounting personnel to prepare operating budgets for market operations
  • Track possible green tobacco sales and purchases from third parties to aid in invoicing as well as end of season/ year reconciliation
  • Work jointly with IT department to install, test and monitor computer equipment used at buying stations
  • Develop a detailed understanding of the Buying Station processes and the supporting TIMS system. Assist IT department in any changes to existing programs, or development of new programs due to changing customer requirements
  • Work jointly with IT and HR departments to ensure access to Company systems and provide training as needed with buying station personnel
  • Prepare all weekly, monthly, and yearly payment memos to buying station agents, government agencies, and farmers alike related to tobacco purchases throughout the season
  • Other duties may be assigned.


Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor Degree in Business Administration, or equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Effective analytical, planning and organizing skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Shows high level of commitment to developing excellence in technical and/or business skills
  • Adapt to frequent changes in climate, environment, workload and schedules, including Saturday and Sunday work when required


Preferred Requirements

  • Willingness to travel among U.S. Buying Stations (20% per year is required)
  • Working knowledge of DAX, TIMS and OPS systems preferred
  • Experience using Cyberquery



Benefits
We offer a wide range of market-competitive total rewards that include 401(k) match, pension, merit increases, paid holidays, medical, dental, life, vision, short and long-term disability benefits, and tuition assistance to name a few.


EOE M/F/Disabled/Vet Employer
All applicants must be authorized to work in the United States.

title: Public Health Dental Hygiene Practitioner (PHDHP)
description:
Community Health and Dental Care

Announces Position Opening For

Public Health Dental Hygiene Practitioner

Reports to Chief Dental Officer

Full-time, exempt

About CHDC

CHDC (Community Health and Dental Care, Inc.) is a quickly growing Community Health Center in Pennsylvania with locations in Pottstown, Barto, and Boyertown, providing care for all patients in our service area, regardless of insurance status or ability to pay.

Our staff put the care and well-being of our patients at the forefront of everything we do at CHDC.

About the Public Health Dental Hygiene Practitioner Position

The PHDHP provides preventive and therapeutic dental services to patients within the scope of practice of Registered Dental Hygienists according to Pennsylvania standards. The PHDHP also maintains proper dental records and timely completion of billing information.

Benefits Package

Competitive base salary, Medical Insurance, Dental and Vision Insurance, PTO Accrual, 401K Company Match, 12 Paid Holidays, Company paid life insurance, Employee Health Reimbursement Program, No PTO needed for employee preventative care appointments, Employee Assistance Program, employee discounts, summer picnic, and much more!

Duties include but are not limited to:

  • Provides quality dental hygiene care in all venues through which agency personnel provide dental care.
  • Assist with policy/procedure development in the dental department.
  • Implement and adhere to the policies of the organization, as well as those of funding sources and third-party payers.
  • Attend all regular dental team meetings.
  • Implementation of the dental department’s Quality Improvement Plan.
  • Maintain cleanliness and infection control measures in the dental clinic.
  • Maintain supply inventory for hygiene treatment.
  • Work with front desk personnel to efficiently schedule hygiene patients.
  • Seat and dismiss patients and set up operatories for procedures.
  • Chart all patients, including date, service rendered, instruction given, treatment planning, medical history updates, etc.
  • Perform clinical procedures within the scope of hygiene practice, including thorough and gentle prophylaxis, scaling, root planning and selective polishing when medically necessary, expose radiographs as prescribed by dentist, apply topical fluoride as appropriate.
  • Provide patient instruction and demonstrate, when necessary, as delegated by dentist.
  • Maintain current CPR licensure.
  • Other related duties as assigned.
  • Adheres to the organizations mission, vision, and values.
  • Adheres to the organization’s policies regarding time and attendance.
  • Complies with accepted dress code and maintains a professional image.
  • Demonstrates reliability and trustworthiness.
  • Manages time and other resources to meet established goals within the agreed upon time frames.
  • Demonstrates flexibility in the acceptance and completion of work assignments.
  • Participates in the department’s performance improvement activities.
  • Maintains patient/employee confidentiality in the management of information.
  • Observes the Health Care System’s compliance policies.

Requirements:

Qualifications, Education, and Knowledge

  • At least two years of post-secondary education from an accredited dental hygiene program required.
  • Must be licensed to practice dental hygiene in Pennsylvania.
  • PHDHP required
  • CPR Certified
  • At least one-year dental hygiene experience strongly preferred.
  • Ability to work with a diverse population and sensitivity to low-income populations.
  • Highly organized.
  • Computer proficient in office management software
  • Attendance required at assigned CHDC site(s)
  • Must generally be present during operating hours at assigned CHDC site(s).
  • Must be available outside the health center’s normal business hours when necessary. Bilingual/bicultural preferred.
  • Strong interpersonal skills

Our Mission

It is the mission of Community Health and Dental Care to identify gaps in health services and to ensure access to appropriate levels of care for all people in the service area regardless of their ability to pay. We are a non-profit health center that provides primary care medical and dental services to all regardless of insurance status. We accept patients with or without insurance and provide health care discounts based on income and family size using the federal poverty guidelines.

Our Vision

The vision of CHDC is to be the health care provider and employer of choice by establishing a culture that champions patient centered-care, promotes staff engagement, embraces the latest technology, and pursues partnerships and strategic alliances.

Our Values

Quality, Integrity, Respect, Teamwork, & Communication

Our History

Community Health and Dental Care was formed through the generous funding of the Pottstown Area Health and Wellness Foundation along with various local businesses. Our doors opened in October 2008 with 39 medical and dental patients seen that first week and we’ve grown to see thousands of medical and dental patients each year. As a non-profit community health center, we have been organized to become the patient’s medical home for preventive care and to promote overall well-being, thus reducing the number of emergency room visits.

CHDC is an equal opportunity employer. For more information about CHDC and its services, visit us online at www.ch-dc.org.

title: Underwriting Technician
description:
About DUAL


Working across 21 countries, DUAL has built a reputation as a specialist underwriting group and the market of choice for insurance intermediaries around the world. That’s how we have become one of the world’s largest international underwriting agencies (or MGAs) with US$3.4bn GWP.


DUAL is part of Howden, a leading global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. Founded in 1994, it provides insurance, reinsurance and underwriting services to clients ranging from private individuals to the largest multinational companies. The Group operates in 57 countries, employs over 24,000 people and manages premiums totalling US$50bn on behalf of its clients.



The Underwriting Technician delivers accurate, timely underwriting administration and responsive broker support across Personal Lines products. The role supports brokers, underwriters and internal teams by processing policy transactions, maintaining high-quality records and applying agreed underwriting procedures within delegated authority.

The role contributes to strong broker service, compliant customer outcomes and efficient operational delivery, escalating matters outside authority or requiring technical judgement.

Key accountabilities

Policy administration and processing

  • Process new business, renewals, mid-term adjustments, endorsements, cancellations and policy documentation accurately and within agreed service levels.
  • Check policy information and supporting documentation for completeness, consistency and accuracy.
  • Maintain clear and accurate records across relevant insurance and workflow systems.
  • Identify errors, missing information or unusual features and take appropriate action or escalate.

Broker support and service excellence

  • Provide professional, clear and timely support to brokers by telephone, email and approved digital channels.
  • Respond to queries regarding products, policy documentation, underwriting requirements and operational processes.
  • Build effective broker relationships through ownership, reliability and high-quality service.
  • Escalate complex, sensitive or technical matters promptly to the appropriate colleague or manager.

Technical underwriting support

  • Support underwriters by gathering information, preparing referrals and completing agreed underwriting administration.
  • Apply underwriting guidelines, procedures and delegated authority consistently.
  • Recognise underwriting anomalies, potential risk issues and policy discrepancies, escalating them appropriately.
  • Support implementation of product, process and underwriting changes.

Quality, risk and compliance

  • Complete work in line with internal procedures, quality standards and control requirements.
  • Maintain strong data quality and protect confidential business, broker and customer information.
  • Operate in accordance with applicable FCA requirements, Consumer Duty expectations and company policies.
  • Complete mandatory training and support quality assurance, audit and compliance activity when required.

Continuous improvement and teamwork

  • Identify practical opportunities to improve broker experience, accuracy, turnaround times and efficiency.
  • Participate in process reviews, system testing, training and change initiatives.
  • Share knowledge and good practice, supporting colleagues during workload peaks and operational change.
  • Take ownership of personal development and build broader product and underwriting knowledge.

Knowledge, skills and experience

Essential

  • Experience in Motor Personal Lines insurance and Agricultural Fleet.
  • Underwriting support, broking, policy administration or a comparable regulated service environment.
  • Good understanding of insurance terminology and the policy lifecycle.
  • High attention to detail, with the ability to work accurately at pace.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including confident broker contact.
  • Ability to prioritise work, meet deadlines and take ownership through to resolution.
  • Competence using Microsoft 365 and the ability to learn insurance and workflow systems.
  • Collaborative approach and willingness to seek guidance when a matter is outside authority.

Desirable

  • Experience of UK Motor or other Personal Lines insurance products.
  • Experience working directly with insurance brokers.
  • Understanding of underwriting principles, referrals and delegated authority.
  • Cert CII, progress towards an insurance qualification, or willingness to study.

Personal qualities and behaviours

  • Broker and customer focused, with a commitment to fair outcomes.
  • Professional, dependable and accountable.
  • Curious and willing to build technical knowledge.
  • Calm, resilient and organised in a fast-paced environment.
  • Positive team contributor who communicates openly and respectfully.
  • Proactive, solutions-focused and receptive to feedback.

Development opportunities

The role provides a foundation for broader technical authority and future progression, subject to capability, business need and available opportunities. Potential pathways may include Senior Underwriting Technician, Team Leader, technical underwriting, product or operational specialist roles.

General responsibilities

  • Act consistently with company values, policies and standards of conduct.
  • Carry out other reasonable duties aligned to the nature and level of the role.
  • Maintain confidentiality and comply with information security and data protection requirements.
  • Support an inclusive working environment in which colleagues, brokers and customers are treated with dignity and respect.

What do we offer in return?

A career that you define.

Of course, we offer a competitive range of rewards and benefits to support you, but we know you expect all that.

What you might not expect is a job where everyone has a voice, where volunteering in the community is part of the day job, and where everyone is encouraged to play a part towards our sustainability goals. We want people who want to make a difference - not just in the workplace, but in the industry and in the wider community.

Our culture: people first

Our core values dictate how we live and work. We’re a group with independence and people at its heart – and a home for talent with a unique culture: the biggest small company in the world.

Being a people-first business has always been central to who we are. Our vision was to create an independent organisation with a distinctive culture that would survive and thrive through the people who shape it. Finding the most talented and entrepreneurial individuals to join the group has been, and will continue to be, key to our success.

Diversity and inclusion

At DUAL, our people are our greatest strength. We are committed to building an open and inclusive culture where everyone feels trusted and that they belong. We work to ensure all candidates, employees, clients and business partners are treated with fairness and respect.

We want every candidate to be able to bring their best to the recruitment process, so if you require reasonable accommodation at any stage, please let us know and we will work with you to provide appropriate support.



Permanent

title: Stevedore Foreman
description:
Position Summary:

The Stevedore Foreman oversees vessel cargo operations. This role provides direct supervision to crane crews, riggers, and labor personnel while ensuring safe, efficient, and compliant cargo handling operations. The Foreman is responsible for executing daily operational plans, maintaining equipment readiness, and supporting workforce coordination in a fast-paced maritime environment.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Supervise daily cargo operations, including crane crews, riggers, and laborers during vessel loading and unloading.
  • Assist with the setup, inspection, and safe operation of cranes and related lifting equipment.
  • Ensure cargo is handled in accordance with load charts, lifting plans, and vessel-specific requirements.
  • Support operations across multiple job sites and travel as required to meet operational demands.
  • Monitor workflow and adjust operations as needed to maintain productivity and efficiency.
  • Identify and report equipment issues, unsafe conditions, or operational delays to Operations leadership.
  • Train, mentor, and coach crew members on crane operation, rigging practices, and safety procedures.
  • Enforce all company policies, OSHA regulations, environmental requirements, and proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE).
  • Maintain accurate records of work performed, equipment inspections, and safety activities.
  • Communicate effectively with vessel personnel, terminal staff, and leadership regarding operational progress and issues.
  • Assist with basic troubleshooting and operational adjustments of ship’s gear equipment.
  • Act as the timekeeping lead for assigned crews, ensuring accurate tracking and approval of employee hours.
  • Assist in developing and managing crew schedules based on vessel schedules, cargo type, and operational requirements.
  • Review and submit payroll information for assigned personnel in a timely and accurate manner.
  • Coordinate with Operations Management and Human Resources on staffing needs, attendance, and schedule adjustments.
  • Maintain organized records of timekeeping, attendance, and payroll documentation to support compliance and reporting requirements.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent (GED) preferred.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in stevedoring, port operations, or marine terminal environments.
  • At least 1 year of supervisory or lead experience in crane, rigging, or cargo handling operations.
  • Strong knowledge of crane operations, rigging procedures, and cargo handling practices.
  • Ability to read and interpret lifting plans, load charts, and cargo documentation.
  • Demonstrated leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Flexibility to work nights, weekends, and holidays based on vessel schedules.

Preferred Experience:

  • OSHA 30 certification.
  • Transportation Worker Identification Credential (TWIC) or ability to obtain.
  • Certifications in rigging, signaling, or crane operation.
  • Experience with bulk materials, aggregates, or breakbulk cargo.
  • Basic computer skills for reporting, documentation, and communication.

Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds and perform physically demanding tasks.
  • Ability to climb ladders and access vessel cargo holds safely.
  • Ability to work outdoors in varying weather conditions and around heavy equipment.
  • Required use of PPE (hard hat, safety vest, steel‑toe boots) in operational areas.

Work Environment:

  • Field-based role primarily at port terminals and traveling job sites.
  • Exposure to noise, dust, weather, and heavy equipment operations.
  • Fast-paced, safety-sensitive environment requiring strong situational awareness and clear communication.
  • Irregular hours, travel, and on-call availability based on vessel schedules and operational demands.

title: Psychologist
description:

title: EUROSPAR Ålesund Storsenter søker tilkallingsvikar
description:
EUROSPAR Ålesund Storsenter søker tilkallingsvikar

Har du lyst på en variert jobb i butikk, liker å møte mennesker og trives når det er litt tempo? Da kan det være deg vi ser etter!

EUROSPAR Ålesund Storsenter søker en tilkallingsvikar over 18 år som kan stille opp ved behov og bli en del av laget vårt.

Hva betyr det å være tilkallingsvikar?

Som tilkallingsvikar har du ikke nødvendigvis faste vakter hver uke, men blir spurt om å jobbe når vi har behov for ekstra hjelp. Det kan for eksempel være ved sykdom, ferie, travle perioder eller når det dukker opp ledige vakter.

Vi ser derfor etter deg som er fleksibel og har mulighet til å stille opp på kort varsel. Arbeidstid kan være både dag, kveld og helg.

Arbeidsoppgavene vil blant annet være:

  • Kundebehandling og service

  • Kassearbeid

  • Varepåfylling og vareplassering

  • Holde butikken ryddig, ren og innbydende

  • Forefallende butikkarbeid

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi tror du vil trives hos oss dersom du er positiv, serviceinnstilt og liker å ta i et tak. Du jobber godt sammen med andre, men er også trygg på å jobbe selvstendig.

Det viktigste for oss er at du har lyst til å jobbe, møter opp når du skal og bidrar til et godt arbeidsmiljø. Erfaring fra butikk er en fordel, men ikke et krav – riktig innstilling og vilje til å lære betyr mye.

Du må være fylt 18 år.

Vi tilbyr:

  • En variert og aktiv arbeidshverdag

  • Et hyggelig og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø

  • God opplæring

  • Verdifull erfaring fra dagligvare og kundeservice

Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Send oss en søknad og fortell litt om hvem du er, hvorfor du ønsker å jobbe hos oss og når du har mulighet til å jobbe.

Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

SPAR og EUROSPAR-kjeden er NorgesGruppens profilkjede for lokale supermarkeder. Kjeden består av ca. 300 lokale supermarkeder spredt over hele Norge. Merkevaren SPAR forvaltes og driftes av Kjøpmannshuset Norge AS, NorgesGruppens profilhus for kjøpmannseide butikker. I SPAR legger vi vekt på å gi kunden den beste lokale handleopplevelsen og gode tilbud hver uke.

title: Head of Culture & Partnerships, APAC
description:
Job Description :

Head of Culture & Partnerships, APAC

About the Function

Innovation

Innovation is where new ideas take shape, and where we challenge what our brands can become next.

From evolving existing products to creating something entirely new, this team works across markets and disciplines to push boundaries and turn fresh thinking into real experiences.

It’s a space for people who are curious, open to experimentation and comfortable with trying, learning and refining as they go.

If you’re excited by the idea of shaping what comes next, and seeing it brought to life, you’ll feel at home here.

About the role

PURPOSE OF ROLE:

In the Marketing Operations & MarTech (MOM) team, we establish the tools, capabilities, processes and ways of working that enable Diageo marketers to drive growth and competitive advantage. This includes making our brands relevant in culture and ensuring that cultural programs reach consumers at scale, and transforming Diageo’s approach to social media to be fit for purpose in an increasingly social-first marketing environment.

The Head of Culture & Partnerships, APAC is accountable for the translation of global direction into culturally relevant regional execution, management of regional and priority local “jewel” social media handles, delivery of best-in-class always-on and campaign-based content, and integration of influencer and creator activation with a connected cultural marketing ecosystem that turns brand strategy into culturally resonant programs with earned media moments and scaled amplification.

This is a hands-on role for someone who combines strategic thinking with the instincts of a cultural strategist, creativity of a brand builder, discipline of an operator, and the commercial mindset of a growth leader. You will report to the regional Marketing Operations & MarTech Director in APAC within the global MOM function, and partner closely with the Global MOM, Category and Brand teams.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Accountability for the social transformation agenda in the APAC region, aligned to the new Diageo global operating model, including planning, management, governance and hands-on execution within the Culture and Partnerships portfolio.
  • Localization of blueprints for global campaigns, ensuring that consumer and cultural insights and performance data are integrated into the global program development.
  • Review and coordination of local briefs to ensure alignment with global strategy and priorities, and amplification of business impact by identifying and scaling potentially high-impact local programs across the region.
  • Creation of unified cultural activation plans across channels through seamless integration with Content, Media, Consumer Planning, Commercial, and Category & Brand Teams, and elimination of siloed planning and execution.
  • Stewardship of the agency ecosystem to deliver on the agreed outcomes, including but not limited to community management of owned social media channels, scheduling and publishing of partnered and organic content, active social listening for proactive identification of highly relevant, engaged trends, topics and responses.
  • Oversight of activation and content calendars, ensuring seamless integration of global content and talent activations as well as any local PR, experiential and shopper activations into the regional calendar across all relevant brands and markets.
  • Governance and compliance, ensuring that all activations meet responsible marketing principles, legal and regulatory directives, and strict brand standards.
  • Consistent adoption of approved tools, processes, and measurement methodologies.

Experience / skills required

KEY REQUIREMENTS:

  • Proven success experiences in leading in social media, influencer marketing or cultural activations across multiple markets.
  • Strategic thinker with a consumer-first mindset and strong operational ability to translate brand and campaign objectives into impactful social and creator strategies.
  • Demonstrated ability in leading agency ecosystems and outsourced delivery models to deliver best-in-class brand in culture work across platforms.
  • Deep expertise in social platforms (e.g., Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, emerging channels) and content ecosystems; additional knowledge of influencer marketing platforms and talent management is ideal.
  • Strong understanding of paid social amplification, social analytics, integrated measurement frameworks and performance optimization.
  • Committed to responsible marketing and brand integrity, with strong grounding in brand safety, influencer compliance and responsible marketing standards.
  • Skilled at leading through complexity, enabling both regional consistency and local relevance with strong stakeholder management and influencing skills within complex, matrixed organizations with cross-functional collaboration.
  • Excellent written, oral, presentation and communication skills in English and Korean languages.

Working with Us

Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you, so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.

We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including:

Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.

We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.

Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity.

If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application.

Recruitment Scam Warning

Protecting candidates is very important to us. All communications regarding your application will come from an email address ending in @diageo.com. In our recruitment process, we'll never ask for money.

title: Workday Financial Planning Analyst
location: Florida Polytechnic University South at Polk State College
description:
Make a difference at one of Florida’s premier institutions for education in science, technology, engineering, and math (STEM). Florida Polytechnic University, ranked the No. 1 public college in the region by U.S. News and World Report, offers a unique working environment that encourages faculty and staff to be part of a culture that prizes collaboration, innovation, and the willingness to go above and beyond to ensure our students and University succeed. Florida Poly offers a small campus academic environment where students form connections with their faculty and peers as they pursue high-value degrees in engineering and applied sciences.

The University is equipped with cutting-edge facilities and equipment and two award-winning, architecturally distinct academic buildings. Its evolving curriculum, designed to meet the needs of industry and provide a life-long educational foundation for students, has helped the institution grow in prominence since its opening in 2014. Florida Poly’s deliberately small classes, affordability, and outstanding graduate outcomes have helped it earn recognitions such as being named a top value school, in the top 25 nationally for affordability, and in the top five best universities in the South for tech students. Accredited by ABET and SACSCOC, Florida Poly is educating some of the brightest minds in Florida and attracting standout talent from across the nation.

JOB TITLE

Workday Financial Planning Analyst

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

The Workday Financial Planning Analyst serves as the University’s primary technical and functional subject matter expert for Workday Adaptive Planning. This position is responsible for architecting, building, and maintaining the financial planning infrastructure that drives institutional budgeting, forecasting, and decision-making. The analyst designs and owns interactive dashboards, driver-based financial models, and automated reporting pipelines within Workday Adaptive Planning transforming complex financial data into clear, actionable intelligence for leadership and stakeholders across the University. The role bridges deep technical Workday expertise with strong financial acumen, stakeholder communication, and a commitment to staying at the forefront of agentic AI and emerging FP&A technology. This position reports to the University Controller.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Responsibilities:

  • Workday Adaptive Planning Architecture & Dashboard Development: Build and maintain financial models, reports, driver-based budget templates, and interactive dashboards. Configure dimensions, levels, accounts, assumptions, and versions. Use Elastic Hypercube Technology (Workday/Adaptive) for multi-scenario modeling across departments, divisions, and cost centers. Deliver self-service dashboards and Office Connect reports covering KPIs, budget vs. actuals, and rolling forecasts. 25%
  • Financial Modeling & Forecasting: Own the annual operating budget process compiling direction from the University’s leadership team on revenue and expense projections as well as strategic need. Build what-if scenarios using external drivers such as inflation, enrollment, interest rates, and labor costs. Manage the full forecast cycle from data intake through model refresh to leadership presentation, using real-time integrations and automated recalculation to improve accuracy and speed decisions. 20%
  • Data Analysis & Reporting: Publish monthly and ad hoc budget-to-actual variance reports with plain-language narratives. Build matrix and tabular reports, dashboards, and board-ready financial packages. Translate complex results into clear takeaways for non-financial audiences. Maintain data integrity across Workday reporting structures, including GL integrations and chart-of-accounts alignment. 15%
  • Stakeholder Communication & Partnership: Serve as primary liaison to divisional leaders, budget managers, HR, and IT on all Adaptive Planning matters. Turn model outputs into business narratives that support decision-making. Manage budget cycle communications — timelines, submission deadlines, variance reviews. Present results and scenarios to the Controller, CFO, and senior administrators. 15%
  • Stakeholder Training & Change Management: Deliver Adaptive Planning training for budget managers and departmental users university-wide. Create role-specific guides, video walkthroughs, and quick reference cards; run hands-on workshops and one-on-one coaching. Keep the training library current with platform updates and drive adoption of data-driven planning. 10%
  • Agentic AI & Emerging Technology Innovation: Evaluate emerging Adaptive Planning capabilities, including the Workday Planning Agent, Illuminate AI, Intelligent Variance Analysis, and conversational analytics. Pilot AI tools that automate variance commentary, predictive forecasting, and self-service data access. Track the broader agentic AI landscape and bring recommendations to the Controller. Advance responsible AI adoption with governance, auditability, and human oversight. 10%
  • System Integration & Data Governance: Manage integrations between Adaptive Planning and source systems, including Workday HCM and Financials. Ensure reliable data flows for headcount planning, GL trial balance consolidation, and actuals loading. Maintain version control, audit trails, and governance standards across all planning models. Coordinate with IT and the Workday system administrator on upgrades, feature releases, and integration health. 5%

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related field
  • Minimum 4 years of experience in financial planning, budgeting
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with Workday Adaptive Planning or a comparable ERP/CPM platform (Anaplan, Vena, Planful, OneStream)
  • Experience building financial models, dashboards, and reports for leadership audiences
  • Experience delivering end-user training or change management programs
  • In lieu of a degree, any appropriate combination of relevant education, experience, and/or certifications may be considered.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Workday Adaptive Planning certification (Pro or Specialist level)
  • Experience in a higher education or public sector finance environment
  • Familiarity with Workday Financials and/or Workday HCM
  • Experience with agentic AI tools, LLM-based analytics, or AI-powered FP&A platforms
  • CPA, CMA, or FP&A certification (AFP)
  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or equivalet

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities:

  • Workday Technical Expertise
    • Hands-on proficiency with Workday Adaptive Planning including model building, dimension configuration, sheet design, and dashboard development
    • Ability to build driver-based models, rolling forecasts, and multi-version budget structures within Adaptive Planning
    • Experience creating Workday reports, and visual dashboards for executive audiences
    • Understanding of Workday Adaptive Planning’s Elastic Hypercube Technology (EHT) and in-memory calculation architecture
    • Familiarity with Workday Financials and/or Workday HCM for integration and data sourcing purposes
  • Financial Modeling & Analytical Skills
    • Deep expertise in financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis
    • Ability to build complex, multi-scenario models incorporating both internal drivers and external macroeconomic variables
    • Proficiency in root cause analysis, trend identification, and translating quantitative findings into plain-language narratives
    • Strong working knowledge of GAAP, fund accounting principles, and higher education budget structures (preferred)
  • Communication & Stakeholder Management
    • Proven ability to communicate complex financial data clearly and concisely to audiences ranging from budget managers to senior executives
    • Experience facilitating cross-functional budget reviews, planning workshops, and training sessions
    • Skilled in creating professional presentations, data visualizations, and board-ready financial packages

title: Director Government Affairs
description:
Job Description Summary:

Opening
At The Coca‑Cola Company, we operate in a dynamic environment where public policy and regulatory decisions have a direct impact on business outcomes. We are committed to advancing thoughtful, sustainable solutions that align business priorities with societal needs, helping shape frameworks that enable growth and protect stakeholder interests across markets.

The Senior Director, Government Affairs – Mexico plays a critical role in ensuring our business remains resilient and competitive through strategic engagement with government entities, legislators, opinion leaders, and industry associations. This position leads our public policy agenda for the Mexico Business Unit, proactively identifying opportunities and mitigating risks in the regulatory environment. Acting as a trusted partner to internal leadership and external stakeholders, the role designs and delivers strategies that influence policy development, foster collaborative relationships, and reinforce The Coca‑Cola Company’s reputation for responsible business practices. If you have a strong background in government relations and thrive on navigating complex legislative landscapes, this is an opportunity to shape impactful outcomes for one of the world’s most iconic brands.

What You’ll Do for Us

  • Develop and lead proactive and responsive public policy strategies for the Mexico Business Unit to protect and promote Coca‑Cola’s business interests.
  • Establish and sustain value‑based relationships with decision‑makers across federal, state, and local government, regulatory agencies, trade associations, and supranational institutions influencing the food and beverage industry.
  • Translate emerging regulatory trends into strategic implications for marketing practices, taxation, labeling requirements, and advertising regulations, ensuring business readiness and advocacy alignment.
  • Identify opportunities within government policy, customs regulations, and trade frameworks to enable business growth and enhance operational agility.
  • Serve as a senior integrator across internal teams—Public Affairs and Communications, Legal, Finance, Marketing—and bottling partners to maintain a unified approach to stakeholder engagement.
  • Lead the design and execution of reputation‑building programs with government stakeholders, reinforcing trust and transparency in Coca‑Cola’s commitments.
  • Coordinate system-wide advocacy efforts through strategic partnership with bottlers and active leadership within industry associations to address legislative issues impacting food and beverage sectors.
  • Monitor, assess, and communicate evolving health, environment, and wellness regulations, integrating insights into business planning and risk‑management frameworks.
  • Influence critical conversations with political and legislative actors by presenting data‑driven messages aligned with company priorities and societal trends.
  • Actively embed compliance awareness related to lobbying laws and gift regulations into all government relations initiatives to uphold Coca‑Cola’s ethical standards.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree in Public Policy, Political Science, Law, or related fields preferred.
  • Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in government affairs, public policy, or external relations within a multinational environment.
  • Demonstrated success developing and executing integrated government relations strategies, including engagement with legislators, political leaders, and regulatory authorities.
  • Strong understanding of Mexico’s legislative processes and lobbying compliance requirements; familiarity with health and environmental regulatory frameworks advantageous.
  • Proven experience leading teams and managing external consultants to deliver coordinated advocacy efforts across multiple stakeholders.
  • Ability to synthesize complex regulatory trends and communicate implications effectively to business leadership and cross‑functional teams.
  • Skilled in relationship-building, negotiation, and influencing senior decision-makers to achieve aligned outcomes.
  • Deep knowledge of external dynamics shaping the food and beverage industry, including public policy, taxation, marketing restrictions, and trade agreements.
  • Excellent strategic thinking, project management, and organizational skills with a track record of delivering results in high-stakes, fast-moving environments.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, including ability to craft compelling narratives for diverse audiences.

What We’ll Do for You

  • Provide the platform to shape public policy perspectives for one of the most recognized consumer brands in the world.
  • Enable collaboration with global and regional teams, offering exposure to complex governance models and strategic influence across Latin America.
  • Equip you with advanced analytics, policy insight tools, and stakeholder engagement resources to reinforce your impact and effectiveness.
  • Incorporate continuous learning opportunities to maintain your expertise in regulatory environments and government affairs best practices.

Skills for Workday

  • Public Policy Strategy Development
  • Government Relations and Stakeholder Engagement
  • Regulatory Risk Assessment and Mitigation
  • Cross‑Functional Collaboration and Alignment
  • Lobbying Compliance and Ethical Standards
  • Trade and Customs Policy Knowledge
  • Legislative Analysis and Communication Skills
  • Industry Association Leadership and Coordination
  • Strategic Reputation Management
  • Complex Negotiation and Influence Skills

Functional Interview Questions- Use them as inspiration when crafting functional questions for this position

  • Share an example of a time you mitigated a regulatory risk that could have significantly impacted business operations.
  • Describe a situation where you successfully influenced public policy through multi-stakeholder collaboration.
  • How have you integrated compliance requirements into advocacy strategies during a high-profile initiative?
  • Tell us about a project where you built consensus between internal teams and external government actors to address industry challenges.
  • Provide an example of how you identified and leveraged a regulatory opportunity to create business value.

title: C.N.A wanted
description:

A nursing assistant responsible for providing routine nursing care in accordance with established policies and procedures and as may be directed by the Charge Nurse, RN Supervisor, Director of Nurses or Administrator, to assure that the highest degree of quality resident care can be maintained at all times.

title: Health & Social Care Transformation Senior Consultant, Hybrid
description:
Deloitte is the world’s number one professional services firm and making an impact is more than what we do. It is why we are here. We bring challenge, curiosity and edge to every project, driving positive progress for our clients, our people, our communities and the planet. This purpose inspires us to work to the highest standards and to tackle the challenges that matter. Number one never stops challenging.

Joining us means becoming part of a Technology and Transformation team that brings challenge, curiosity and edge to every engagement. Working with leading technologies and exceptional people, you will deliver meaningful change for high profile local and international clients. You will help shape the future of digital transformation within a people first culture that is collaborative, innovative and welcoming. At Deloitte, the world’s number one professional services firm, you will tackle complex challenges in an environment where number one never stops challenging.


We offer a competitive starting salary of €55,000.00 for this role, with salary adjustments reflecting your experience level and expertise.
.

Why you'll enjoy this new opportunity:

At Deloitte, our Health and Social Care Consulting team is committed to transforming Ireland’s health and social care landscape. This Senior Consultant role offers an exciting opportunity to play a pivotal part in integrated, system-wide change that improves population health outcomes and operational efficiency. You will work across strategy, digital innovation, infrastructure, and operations, tackling complex challenges with significant societal impact. This role provides opportunities to take on greater responsibility, influence transformation programmes, mentor junior colleagues, and contribute to shaping sustainable, high-quality care delivery.

Key skills and prior experience that align well with this position:

  • Demonstrated experience in health and/or social care transformation, ideally within the Irish public sector or similar environments.

  • Strong client-facing consulting or strategic advisory experience, with the ability to analyse complex problems and deliver practical, data-driven solutions.

  • Experience supporting or coordinating complex, multi-stakeholder projects and programmes, including risk management, resource allocation, and governance.

  • Relevant qualifications in healthcare management, social work, clinical disciplines, project management, business, economics, engineering, architecture, or related fields; professional certifications such as Prince2, PMP, or Prosci are highly desirable.

  • Proven ability to mentor and support junior team members, fostering their development and contributing to a collaborative team environment.

What type of work will I be doing?

  • Collaborating with clients to develop integrated health and social care strategies and policies.

  • Designing and supporting the implementation of operating models that improve efficiency and quality of care.

  • Preparing business cases and feasibility studies to support investment decisions and stakeholder engagement.

  • Contributing to the delivery of complex projects and programmes, supporting governance, risk management, and stakeholder communication.

  • Engaging with clinical, operational, and executive stakeholders to ensure alignment and progress.

  • Mentoring and supporting junior colleagues to build capability and promote effective teamwork.

  • Assisting with PMO activities to help ensure delivery against agreed outcomes.

  • Supporting transformation initiatives that integrate people, processes, and technology.

Who is the Hiring Manager?

The hiring manager, Rebecca Ring, is a seasoned leader within Deloitte’s Health and Social Care Consulting team, with deep expertise in health system transformation and strategic advisory. She champions collaborative leadership and fosters an inclusive environment where innovation and practical solutions flourish. Rebecca’s management style emphasises empowerment, continuous learning, and delivering measurable impact for clients and communities.

Where is this role based?

This role is based in Dublin, offering a flexible hybrid working model that combines office presence with remote work. Opportunities to work on client sites will also be available. For more information, please visit the Deloitte Works webpage.

If you meet most of the criteria above, we encourage you to apply. Deloitte is an equal opportunities employer and will ensure that any reasonable accommodations are implemented throughout the recruitment and selection process.

What we offer

Your reward at Deloitte is competitive, purpose driven and designed to support your growth. It is more than salary. We invest in your personal and professional development, empower your work life balance and offer benefits that support you at every stage of life. These include health and wellbeing supports, pension and savings options, training and coaching and enhanced leave options.

title: DevOps Lead
description:
Wapice on vuonna 1999 perustettu suomalainen täyden palvelun ohjelmistoyritys, jonka ratkaisut ovat alan johtavien teollisuus­yritysten käytössä ympäri maailmaa. Tehtävänämme on toimia asiakkaidemme teknologia­partnerina ja auttaa heitä hyödyntämään digitalisaation tuomia mahdollisuuksia parhaalla mahdollisella tavalla.

Wapicella alkaa vuosittain kymmeniä uusia ohjelmistoprojekteja, joiden elinkaaret vaihtelevat muutaman kuukauden kehityssprinteistä vuosien mittaisiin tuotekehityshankkeisiin. Menestyvä ohjelmistokehitys vaatii enemmän kuin toimivat työkalut ja pilviympäristöt. Se vaatii selkeät toimintatavat, laadukkaan kehittäjäkokemuksen, jatkuvan oppimisen kulttuurin ja ihmiset, jotka pystyvät tekemään työnsä tehokkaasti ja motivoituneina.

Etsimme nyt DevOps Leadia kehittämään ohjelmistokehityksen käytäntöjä, työkaluja ja toimintamalleja yhdessä asiantuntijoidemme sekä asiakkaidemme kanssa.

Ensimmäinen tehtäväsi on parantaa Wapicen oman IoT-TICKET -tuotteen DevOps -prosessia, mutta myöhemmin roolisi voi muuttua tukemaan myös räätälöityjä ratkaisuja tekeviä ohjelmistokehitystiimejämme.

DevOps Lead

Mistä roolissa on kyse?

Tehtäväsi on varmistaa, että ohjelmistokehitystiimit voivat keskittyä olennaiseen. Valitset luotettavimmat infraratkaisut ja tuot automaattisen laadunvarmistuksen ketteräksi mutta väistämättömäksi osaksi julkaisuputkea. Toimit sparraajana sekä teknisissä että toimintamalleihin liittyvissä kysymyksissä ja autat tekemään järkeviä päätöksiä niin nykyisten kuin tulevien tarpeiden näkökulmasta.

Työhösi kuuluu esimerkiksi:

  • Infrastruktuurin luotettavuuden parantaminen

  • CI/CD-ratkaisujen suunnittelu ja automaatiotestauksen integroiminen

  • Manuaalisten työvaiheiden ja konfiguraatioiden vähentäminen

  • Ympäröivän organisaation ohjaaminen parempaan DevOps-työskentelyyn

  • Tietoturvallisen julkaisun varmistaminen rakenteilla, työkaluilla ja menetelmillä

  • Kehittäjäkokemuksen (Developer Experience) parantaminen

  • Havaittavuuden ja SLA-mittarien rakentaminen toiminnan tueksi

  • Teknologioiden ja toimintamallien jatkuva kehittäminen

Et ole yksin vastuussa toteutuksesta, vaan toimit asiantuntijana, suunnannäyttäjänä ja mahdollistajana kehitystiimeille.

Ketä etsimme?

Sinulla on jo vuosien kokemus DevOpsiin liittyvistä vastuualueista. Olet työskennellyt kehittäjien kanssa läheisesti ja ymmärrät, että parhaat ratkaisut syntyvät kun teknologian lisäksi huomioidaan ihminen.

Sinulla on näkemystä siitä,

  • miten ohjelmistoarkkitehtuurilla voidaan vaikuttaa DevOps-työn sujuvuuteen

  • millaiset työkalut ja prosessit tukevat tehokasta kehittämistä

  • miten laadunvarmistus ja automaatio kannattaa integroida kehitykseen

  • miten tekninen velka ja ylläpidettävyys huomioidaan pitkällä aikavälillä

  • miten tiimejä voidaan auttaa onnistumaan yhdessä

Arvostamme erityisesti kykyäsi yhdistää tekninen osaaminen ja ihmisten johtaminen. Et toimi esihenkilönä, mutta osaat vaikuttaa ja fasilitoida keskustelua sekä saat ihmiset sitoutumaan yhteisiin toimintatapoihin. Kyseessä on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva, kokoaikainen työsuhde. Sijaintisi voi olla mikä tahansa seuraavista: Helsinki, Vaasa, Turku, Tampere, Seinäjoki, Kuopio, Oulu, Hyvinkää, Jyväskylä.

Sinulla on kokemusta useista seuraavista:

  • Azure-, AWS- tai GCP-ympäristöt

  • Docker, Podman ja Kubernetes

  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Helm, Ansible ym.)

  • Azure DevOps, GitHub, GitLab tai Atlassian-ympäristöt

  • CI/CD-ratkaisut

  • Linux-palvelinympäristöt

  • Python-, Bash- tai PowerShell-skriptaukset

  • Monitorointi ja hälytysratkaisut

  • Tietoturvan huomiointi osana kehitysprosessia

  • Ketterät toimintamallit (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe)

Kaikkea ei tarvitse osata, mutta edellytämme Azure- ja Kubernetes -kokemusta tuotantoympäristössä sekä sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa. Arvostamme enemmän kokonaisnäkemystä kuin yksittäisten teknologioiden täydellistä hallintaa.

Tässä roolissa menestyt, jos

  • nautit ongelmien ratkaisemisesta

  • haluat kehittää toimintatapoja etkä vain ylläpitää nykyisiä

  • osaat perustella teknisiä valintoja liiketoiminnan näkökulmasta

  • pystyt työskentelemään sekä kehittäjien että asiakkaiden kanssa

  • viet asioita eteenpäin oma-aloitteisesti

  • innostut uusien käytäntöjen rakentamisesta

Miksi Wapicelle?

Olemme asiakkaidemme luotettava teknologiakumppani ja luomme parempaa tulevaisuutta digitalisaatioratkaisujen avulla. Wapicella työskentelee noin 320 asiantuntijaa yhdeksällä paikkakunnalla Suomessa.

Kulttuurimme perustuu intohimoon alaamme kohtaan, joustavuuteen, luottamukseen ja hyvinvointiin. Tarjoamme henkilöstöllemme myös monia etuja, kuten:

  • Laaja työterveyshuolto (Mehiläinen)

  • Joustava etätyöskentelykulttuuri ja liukuva työaika

  • Työajan vakuutusten lisäksi vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutus

  • Lounasetu (Epassi)

  • Liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointietu (Epassi)

  • Harrastekerhoja työajan ulkopuolella (esim. sulkapallo, sähly jne.)

  • Yhteisöllisyyttä tukevia virkistystapahtumia järjestetään säännöllisesti, esim. kesäjuhlat, tiimipäivät

  • Break Pro taukoliikuntasovellus tukemaan ergonomiaa ja hyvinvointiasi

  • Osaamisen kehittämisen mahdollisuuksia kuten sertifikaatteja, kursseja ja mentorointia

  • E-kirjojen ja E-lehtien lukuoikeudet (esim. Tekniikan maailma, Kauppalehti, Tivi)

Meillä on upeita asiakkaita ja monipuolisia työtehtäviä. Ylpeimpiä olemme silti ihmisistämme. Lue lisää kulttuuristamme urasivuiltamme tai käy kurkkaamassa sosiaalisen median kanavamme.

Kuulostaako hyvältä?

Hienoa! Jätä hakemuksesi kevyen rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta, ja olemme sinuun yhteydessä prosessin etenemisestä. Hakuaika päättyy 30.9.2026. Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuajan aikana, ja tehtävä täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä, joten haethan heti kun mielenkiintosi heräsi. Olemme sitoutuneita ilmoittamaan tehtävän palkkahaitarin ennen haastatteluvaihetta.

Rekrytiimimme vastaa mielellään mihin tahansa rekrytointiprosessiin tai Wapicella työskentelyyn liittyviin kysymyksiisi. Ota yhteyttä: People Partner Nani Laaksonen (+358102775153) tai People & Culture Manager Susanna Kytöharju (+358504796080). Teknisemmissä ja työtehtävien tarkempaan sisältöön liittyvissä kysymyksissä voit olla yhteydessä rekrytoivaan esihenkilöön Lassi Niemistöön (lassi.niemisto@wapice.com, p. +358102775054).

title: Contractor CRA - Australia
description:

Skills:

  • Advance presentation skills.

  • Client focused approach to work.

  • Ability to interact professionally within a client organization.

  • Flexible attitude with respect to work assignments and new learning.

  • Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and achieve project timelines; utilizing strong analytical skills to make decision autonomously due to the unpredictable nature of the issues that arise.

  • Willingness to work in a matrix environment and to value the importance of teamwork.

  • Strong computer skills including but not limited to the knowledge of a Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS), Electronic Document Management System (EDMS), and MS-Office products such as Excel and Word.

  • Consulting Skills

Knowledge and Experience:
