title: Joker Prinsensgate søkerg butikkmedarbeider
description:
Vårt slagord er Joker -- Den gode naboen. Det er fordi gode naboer og godt naboskap er positive begreper for oss alle. Vi søker deg som vil jobbe hos den gode naboen, du må bry deg, hjelpe til, like å slå av en prat og være en pådriver for det gode naboskapet.

Joker Prinsensgate søker en hyggelig og pålitelig tilkallingsvikar!

Vi ser etter deg som er serviceinnstilt, fleksibel og liker å jobbe med mennesker. Som tilkallingsvikar jobber du ved behov, for eksempel ved sykdom, ferie og perioder hvor vi trenger ekstra hjelp. Det kan være både dag-, kvelds- og helgevakter.

Arbeidsoppgavene vil blant annet være:

  • Kundebehandling og kassearbeid

  • Varepåfylling og rydding

  • Sørge for at butikken er ren og innbydende

  • Andre vanlige butikkoppgaver

Vi ser etter deg som møter kunder med et smil, tar ansvar og kan stille opp på relativt kort varsel når det er behov. Erfaring fra butikk er en fordel, men ikke et krav – god opplæring vil bli gitt.

Interessert?
Send oss en kort søknad og fortell litt om deg selv og når du har mulighet til å jobbe.

Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

Joker-kjeden er NorgesGruppens profilkjede for nærbutikker. Kjeden består av ca. 460 nærbutikker spredt over hele Norge. Merkevaren Joker forvaltes og driftes av Kjøpmannshuset Norge AS, NorgesGruppens største profilhus. Joker er den lokale butikken både der folk bor og ferierer, og vi er den kjeden som har flest søndagsåpne butikker. Vi er møteplassen i byen og på bygda. Vi var først med å løfte frem kjøpmennene som våre fremste talspersoner, og vi mener at våre kjøpmenn og deres ansatte leverer personlig og god service hver dag.

title: Site Contracts Lead - Shanghai
description:
Site Contracts Lead - Shanghai

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health
• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

  • Administers all contract management processes, including coordination with relevant protocol, informed consent, institution, investigator, vendor, consultant, and customer agreement documents at a project level.
  • May May lead (with supervision) multi-country projects including negotiating and preparing contracts, budgets, and related documents for participation in industry-sponsored clinical trials. Provides support to SSUL to agree on country template contract and budget. Produces site-specific contracts from country template. Provide support in submissions for proposed contract and budget for site. Provides support in negotiating budget and contract with site via Site Contracts Service Centre and SSUL with Sponsor until resolution of issues. Performs quality control and arranges execution of CTAs as well as archival of documents into repositories and capture of metadata. Reviews contracts for completeness and accuracy, and ensures that corrections are appropriately made and documented. Provides supports to business development and represents site contracts/Site Start-Up (SSU) at internal or customer meetings.
  • Work with Contract Managers and team members with the active project management of ongoing contract issues; performs follow-up on all outstanding contract issues.
  • Support in generating amended contract and/or budget documents as necessary, preparing contract management documentation for projects, and streamlining the contract/proposal or internal processes; and initiates and introduces creative ideas and solutions.
  • Works within the forecasted country/site contracting timelines, ensures they are complied with and tracks milestone progress in agreed upon SSU tracking system in real time.
    Collaborates with internal and external legal, finance, and clinical operations departments, including communicating and explaining legal and budgetary issues. Facilitates the execution of contracts by company signatories.
    Maintains contract templates and site specific files and databases. Trains and mentors less experienced staff members on departmental Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and ensures quality of team work products.Maintains and updates training material for site contract team. Acts as a communication liaison between site contracts staff and internal and external customers. Provides functional guidance and keeps internal and external teams aware of all contract statuses or pending issues. Prepares correspondence as necessary.
  • Monitors basic financial aspects of the project and the number of hours/tasks available per contract; escalates discrepancies in a timely fashion.
  • Reviews and complies with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Work Instructions (WIs) in a timely manner, keeps training records updated accordingly and ensures timesheet compliance.

Qualifications:

  • BA/BS degree in Business Administration, Public Administration, Public Health, related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience. Advanced degree preferred.
  • High level of contracts management experience.

title: Projekti-insinööri rautatiehankkeille Länsi-Suomeen
description:
Kiinnostaako työt mielenkiintoisten ratahankkeiden parissa? Jos näin on ja arvostat avoimuutta, inspiroivaa työilmapiiriä ja työn tekemisen vapautta, niin me Weladolla etsimme juuri sinua!

Projekti-insinöörinä Weladolla

✨ Pääset valvomaan urakoitsijoiden töitä, toimimaan teknisenä asiantuntijana sekä osaksi projektitiimiä, jossa jokainen omalla panoksellaan takaa onnistuneen projektin.

Työnkuvasi tarkennetaan yhdessä kanssasi kokemuksesi ja kiinnostuksen kohteittesi perusteella. Siihen voi kuulua esimerkiksi asiantuntijan roolissa toimiminen rakennuttamishankkeissa tai kunnossapidon valvonta ja projekti-insinöörin tehtävät yhdessä tiimisi kanssa.

Työtehtävät edellyttävät hyvää suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa.

🏠 Nyt haemme osaajaa Länsi-Suomeen

Menestyt meillä projekti-insinöörinä, jos:

✔️ haluat mahdollistaa muiden menestymisen ja työyhteisömme hyvinvoinnin (kaikkien weladolaisten ykköstehtävä, myös työsopimuksessa)

✔️ sinulla on insinöörin tai diplomi-insinöörin tutkinto

✔️ sinulla on vähintään 12 kk viimeaikaista kokemusta rautateiden rakennuttamis- / valvontatehtävistä

✔️ sinulla on valmius kulkea ja matkustaa

✔️ olet oma-aloitteinen, kykenet itsenäiseen työskentelyyn, mutta osaat toimia myös tiimissä

✔️ haluat kehittyä ja kasvaa asiantuntijana sekä haastaa toimintatapoja ja kehittää toimintaa

✔️ olet valmis sitoutumaan arvoihimme: rohkeasti avoin, empaattinen, tekijöillemme paras.

Miksi Weladolle töi­hin?💜

Weladolaiset ovat laadukkaan asiakastyömme perusta, ja heidän hyvinvointinsa ja kehittymisensä on meille tärkeintä. Tuemme ammatillista kehittymistäsi, työn ja muun elämän yhteensovittamista ja tarjoamme ympäristön, jossa voit toteuttaa sinulle merkityksellistä asiantuntijuutta.

"Weladolla työskennellessä on aidosti tunne, että työntekijöistä huolehditaan" , weladolainen henkilöstökyselyssä 2025.

📌 Lue lisää lupauksistamme työntekijöillemme täältä

📌Tutustu Weladon rekryesittelyvideoon täällä

📌 Inspiroidu uratarinoistamme täällä - saat tietää, mikä tekee Weladosta ainutlaatuisen työpaikan

📌 Voit myös tutustua alusta-ajatteluumme tarkemmin täällä - eli millaisin eri tavoin voit olla osa meitä

Seuraa meitä Instagramissa, Facebookissa ja/tai LinkedInissä, niin näet, millaista arkemme on!

Palkka💰

Kuten aina meillä, palkkataso muodostuu hakijan kokemuksen, osaamisen ja henkilökohtaisesti räätälöitävän tehtävän ja sen tavoitteiden perusteella. Arvioimme, että hakukriteerit huomioiden se voisi olla 3000-4000€ välillä.

Miten ede­tään?📨

Jos tämä kuulosti sinun jutultasi, kerro meille itsestäsi 31.10.2026 mennessä. Juttelemme potentiaalisten tekijöiden kanssa jo hakuaikana, joten älä suotta jätä yhteydenottoasi hakuajan loppuun. Jos jokin jäi mietityttämään tai haluat kuulla tehtävästä lisää, soita tai laita viestiä rohkeasti Jannelle (janne.siira@welado.fi, +358 40 760 6552)

title: Inspector / Resident Project Representative
description:
COME GROW WITH US!

We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Inspector/Resident Project Representative (RPR) to oversee and ensure the quality and compliance during the construction of civil engineering projects. The ideal candidate will be responsible for inspecting construction sites, reviewing plans and specifications, and ensuring that all work is performed in accordance with project requirements

THE ROLE

The Inspector/Resident Project Representative (RPR) plays a critical role in ensuring the successful execution of civil engineering projects by serving as the on-site liaison between the engineering team, contractors, and clients. This position is responsible for observing and documenting all phases of construction to ensure compliance with project specifications, engineering standards, and regulatory requirements.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provide on-site observations/inspections of various types of civil engineering projects including roads (asphalt and concrete), bridges, buildings, and subsurface utilities (water, sewer, and drainage)
  • Review engineering drawings, specifications, and construction plans for knowledge of project requirements
  • Monitor construction activities for compliance with project plans and specifications
  • Observe construction activities for adherence to safety regulations and quality standards
  • Document inspection findings and prepare detailed reports for project engineers/managers and stakeholders
  • Collaborate with contractors, engineers, and government agencies to resolve issues and ensure project success
  • Verify materials and workmanship meet required specifications
  • Provide project manager/engineer possible recommendations for corrective actions when deficiencies are identified
  • Maintain accurate records of inspections, tests, and project progress
  • Record and tracking quantities of contract/construction items installed on a daily basis
  • Knowledge of and routine observations of temporary traffic control signs and devices
  • Have a good and calm demeanor when interacting with the client and general public

QUALIFICATIONS

  • High School Diploma or equivalent
  • Minimum [5] years of experience in the inspection and construction oversight of civil engineering projects
  • LADOTD Certifications in any of the following is preferred:
    • Embankment and Base Course
    • PCC Paving
    • Asphalt Concrete Mixture (ACM) Paving
    • Structural Concrete
  • Knowledgeable in the latest edition of the Louisiana Standard Specification for Roads and Bridges
  • Knowledgeable in various regulatory standards
  • Strong knowledge of construction methods, materials, and regulations
  • Knowledgeable in necessary material testing requirements
  • Proficiency in inspection tools and software (e.g., Procore, Headlight and/or MS Office)
  • Proficient in the use of computers and iPads
  • Excellent organization skills
  • Excellent verbal communication and report-writing skills
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple inspection tasks
  • Ability to maintain a valid driver's license


WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Fieldwork in various weather conditions and terrain
  • Possible work on weekends
  • Occasional office-based tasks for documentation and reporting
  • May require travel to multiple project sites

title: Laboratory Technician
description:
Michigan, United States of America


Job Family Group:

Production and Manufacturing Downstream


Worker Type:

Regular


Posting Start Date:

September 2, 2026


Business Unit:


Experience Level:

Experienced Professionals


Job Description:

What's the Role?

The Laboratory Technician is responsible for providing quality assurance by testing samples against established specifications and supplying customers with accurate, measured, and interpreted results. The role also involves performing routine maintenance and providing occasional repair and troubleshooting support for laboratory equipment.

The Laboratory Technician ensures that products manufactured and distributed by Shell within the envelope conform to Shell internal standards, customer requirements, and legislative regulations through strict adherence to standard quality control testing procedures.

As part of the Shell Lubricants Supply Chain team, the Laboratory Technician contributes to improving the efficiency and reliability of lubricants manufacturing, helping to enhance overall financial performance through the application of quality assurance methodologies.

The role supports Shell's lubricants business through laboratory-based testing of lubricating oils and, when required, provides product development, trialing, and investigative services to various Shell business sectors.

The Laboratory Technician is responsible for:

  • Prioritizing the safety of themselves and their coworkers above all else.

  • Performing quality control testing to ensure products conform to specifications prior to release, including:

    1. Blend oil sample testing
    2. Package filling sample testing
    3. Bulk truck/rail shipping sample testing
    4. Bulk truck/rail receiving sample testing
    5. Tank-to-tank transfer sample testing

  • Using SAP and other computerized systems to support daily operational activities and transactions.

  • Recommending updates or changes to existing formulations to optimize blend properties, where applicable.

  • Performing Blend Formulation and Laboratory functions within the SAP R/3 system.

  • Conducting trial blends of new and modified products to develop updated formulations that meet LQS standards, when requested.

  • Ensuring all lubricant oil and grease formulations remain strictly confidential.

  • Determining corrective actions for off-specification products, including up-treating, reblending, or other disposition methods, while optimizing costs and ensuring compliance with product requirements.

  • Testing, assessing, and recommending corrective actions for non-conforming products in coordination with the Quality Manager.

  • Conducting validation and calibration of laboratory equipment to ensure accurate testing results.

  • Monitoring Statistical Process Control (SPC) data for selected lubricant products to maintain LQS reduced-testing requirements.

  • Assisting the Quality Manager and Regional Area Product Manager with the development and implementation of site and regional quality initiatives and programs.

  • Troubleshooting laboratory equipment issues and test method problems.

  • Following all HSSE (Health, Safety, Security, and Environmental) guidelines in the performance of duties and responsibilities.

What we need from you

  • Must be authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis without requiring visa sponsorship.

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.

  • Relevant post-secondary education preferred.

  • Relevant experience in a laboratory, manufacturing, quality, or related industrial environment preferred.

title: SPAR Åsetorget søker butikkmedarbeider deltid med låseansvar
description:
Butikkmedarbeider med låseansvar – 60 % fast stilling

Vi på SPAR Åsetorget søker en engasjert og pålitelig butikkmedarbeider med låseansvar til en fast 60 % stilling.

Hos oss er kunden alltid i fokus. Vi ønsker derfor en kollega som trives med mennesker, liker høyt tempo og som bidrar til at kundene våre møter en ryddig, innbydende butikk og god service – hver eneste dag.

Om stillingen

Stillingen inngår i en fast 14-dagers vaktplan og innebærer arbeid innenfor hele butikkens åpningstid. Det betyr at du må kunne jobbe både dag, kveld og helg i henhold til turnus.

Stillingen er fast 60 %, men det må påregnes mulighet og behov for ekstra vakter i forbindelse med sesonger, ferieavvikling og annet fravær.

Som butikkmedarbeider med låseansvar får du, i tillegg til ordinære butikkoppgaver, ansvar for åpning og/eller stenging av butikken på aktuelle vakter. Du må derfor være trygg på å ta ansvar og kunne håndtere ulike situasjoner som kan oppstå når du har ansvaret for butikken.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Arbeidsdagen vil være variert og kan blant annet bestå av:

  • Kundebehandling og salg

  • Kassearbeid

  • Varepåfylling og vareplassering

  • Orden, renhold og vedlikehold av butikk

  • Oppfølging av rutiner og kvalitet

  • Åpning og stenging av butikk

  • Låseansvar og ansvar for butikken på aktuelle vakter

  • Andre forefallende butikkoppgaver

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter deg som er serviceinnstilt, ansvarsbevisst og arbeidsom. Du tar initiativ når noe må gjøres og forstår betydningen av å bidra til et godt arbeidsmiljø.

Vi tror du vil trives hos oss dersom du:

  • Er positiv og liker å jobbe med mennesker

  • Er pålitelig og ansvarsbevisst

  • Trives med høyt tempo og varierte arbeidsoppgaver

  • Kan arbeide selvstendig og ta gode beslutninger

  • Samarbeider godt med kolleger

  • Er fleksibel med hensyn til arbeidstid og ekstra vakter

  • Har forståelse for god kundeservice og butikkdrift

Erfaring fra dagligvare eller annen butikk er en fordel, men personlig egnethet, holdninger og motivasjon vil være svært viktig for oss.

Vi tilbyr

Hos SPAR Åsetorget blir du en del av et hyggelig og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med varierte arbeidsdager og mye kundekontakt.

Vi tilbyr en fast 60 % stilling, forutsigbar 14-dagers vaktplan og mulighet for ekstra arbeid ved behov. Du får opplæring i arbeidsoppgavene og rutinene som følger med låseansvaret. Du må være over 18 år.

Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Da håper vi å høre fra deg!

Send oss din søknad der du skriver litt om deg selv og CV

Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg!

SPAR og EUROSPAR-kjeden er NorgesGruppens profilkjede for lokale supermarkeder. Kjeden består av ca. 300 lokale supermarkeder spredt over hele Norge. Merkevaren SPAR forvaltes og driftes av Kjøpmannshuset Norge AS, NorgesGruppens profilhus for kjøpmannseide butikker. I SPAR legger vi vekt på å gi kunden den beste lokale handleopplevelsen og gode tilbud hver uke.

title: Fullstack Developer
description:
What is the purpose of the Fullstack Developer’s role?

The Fullstack Developer’s purpose is to help Snapper deliver excellence to its customers across the backend, frontend (web), and applied data spaces — building customer-facing product features on top of the data foundations designed by our data engineering team.

This is a core role in our Development team, building and testing our backend and frontend applications while implementing data pipelines and models in partnership with our data engineering team. You’ll bring proven experience to this role, employing your skillset to help Snapper deliver excellent product to our customers.


Reports to: Development / Engineering Lead

Direct reports: None

Key relationships: Wider technical team, including our data engineering team, Solution Architecture and DevOps, and the product and design teams

Based in: Wellington, NZ


What does the Fullstack Developer do?

Software development is shifting, with a wider coverage of the technology spectrum made possible through AI. Snapper encourages developers to go deep in one particular space and this role would ideally focus on data engineering.

  • Building and maintaining data pipelines and ETL processes in collaboration with the data engineering team
  • Developing clean, clear and scalable APIs that connect our frontend, backend, and data layers
  • Applying established data models and warehouse patterns to product features, and feeding back a builder’s perspective on them
  • Developing and testing applications, including following and improving best practices for backend, frontend, and data development
  • Pair programming with other developers, sharing and building skillsets across the team
  • Working closely with our security, design, data engineering, DevOps, product and QA teams to build the best products we can
  • Accurately translating user and business requirements into functional code
  • Contributing to planning new projects in collaboration with our wider development and product teams
  • Providing constructive feedback and support to the team via PR reviews
  • Following and improving our processes for CI/CD and its configuration
  • Contributing to proof-of-concept projects to explore new technologies ahead of implementation
  • Championing our release processes to ensure deployments are planned and executed efficiently


What will help you to be successful in this role? ​

This role sits at intermediate to senior level — you’ll bring proven, hands-on experience rather than needing to build the fundamentals on the job:

    • Proven, production experience with Java/Python/Angular/TypeScript
    • Practical experience with Python/PySpark for data engineering tasks
    • Experience with data persistence and ETL best practice
    • Solid AWS experience (Glue, DynamoDB, RDS, Lambda)
    • Comfortable acting as a peer reviewer, giving and receiving direct technical feedback
    • Experience with testing frameworks such as JUnit, Cucumber, Cypress
    • Agile Development experience, specifically Scrum
    • Understanding of state management and data modelling patterns
    • Familiarity with CI/CD and DevOps best practice

You will need 3–6+ years’ professional development experience. You’ll bring genuine curiosity about customer needs and strong empathy for the people who rely on our products, confidence communicating clearly across a diverse team, and comfort working in a fast-paced, changing environment.

To fit with the team, your communication skills will be paramount; you’ll be able to lay out arguments in a well-structured, data-informed, written narrative, and to autonomously query & extract insights from the available data. You’ll know when a technical solution or an emerging trend can be relevant to the challenges at hand, and have firm beliefs held loosely in an open, collaborative mindset.


We want you to do well, and it looks like this: ​

You write reliable, maintainable code that powers reliable transit experiences. You build and improve systems that are stable, performant, and well-tested, identifying areas of improvement to make our internal processes and systems more effective, efficient and impactful. Your work helps keep our products working effectively, underpinning public transit networks doing what they are expected to, getting users to work, school, and home without issue.

You’re part of a team that solves problems. You think through how your solutions affect the whole system. You’re curious about how the Mosaiq technology connects with real-world data, APIs, and other systems across public transport networks. You ask good questions, share ideas, and help shape technical decisions.

You keep things moving without breaking stuff. You balance speed and care, delivering small, well-scoped improvements that make the system better over time. You champion proper process for the right reasons, using version control, testing, observability, and deployment tools responsibly. You value uptime, data accuracy, and doing things in a way future-you would appreciate.

You grow, and help others grow. You regularly seek feedback and offer it with respect and clarity. You take ownership of your own journey, learn from mistakes, and share your knowledge openly — whether through pair programming, PR reviews, or improving documentation and tooling.

You see the power of being in it together. Your communication is well thought out and clear — and works across the team and time zones. You respect deadlines but raise flags early when things change. You default to trusting others and show up in a way that earns that trust back.

The Open Source Software and Software Supply Chain Security Lead Engineer is responsible for defining and operating enterprise governance, standards, processes, and preventative controls that enable the secure use of open source software and reduce software supply chain risk across the software development lifecycle. This role partners closely with CI/CD, DevSecOps, application security, engineering, platform, and risk teams to ensure open source components, build pipelines, artifacts, package sources, and release processes are approved, continuously monitored, remediated, and safely integrated into enterprise applications and delivery pipelines.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Following is a summary of the essential functions for this job. Other duties may be performed, both major and minor, which are not mentioned below. Specific activities may change from time to time.

  • Team Leadership and Talent Development: Lead, mentor, and develop a team of security engineers, analysts, and contractors responsible for open source software governance and software supply chain security initiatives. Establish goals, drive accountability, provide ongoing coaching, and support career development to build a high-performing security organization.

  • Governance and Standards: Define policies, standards, and control requirements for approved open source usage, dependency hygiene, SBOM generation, secure package sourcing, and software supply chain risk management.

  • Secure OSS Lifecycle Management: Establish processes for OSS intake, approval, tracking, ownership, version management, vulnerability remediation, end-of-life component retirement, and exception governance.

  • CI/CD Preventative Controls: Work with CI/CD and platform engineering teams to design and implement automated security gates for curated OSS usage, dependency scanning, license checks, artifact validation, provenance controls, build-time enforcement, and policy-based blocking of high-risk components.

  • Software Supply Chain Risk Reduction: Identify and reduce risks related to vulnerable dependencies, malicious packages, dependency confusion, typosquatting, compromised maintainers, insecure build artifacts, and unauthorized package sources.

  • Software Supply Chain Security: Establish controls for trusted package sources, dependency provenance, build integrity, artifact signing, repository hygiene, tamper resistance, and secure release practices.

  • Threat Response and Incident Detection: Establish capabilities to rapidly identify, assess, and respond to open source supply chain threats, malicious package campaigns, zero-day vulnerabilities, compromised dependencies, and software supply chain security incidents.

  • Tooling and Automation: Support the deployment, tuning, and integration of software composition analysis, SBOM, package repository, vulnerability management, and developer workflow tools.

  • Risk Reporting and Metrics: Develop reporting that measures OSS risk posture, remediation velocity, policy exceptions, adoption of preventative controls, and reduction of high-risk dependencies.

  • Developer Enablement: Create guidance, playbooks, reusable patterns, and consultation models that help engineering teams make secure open source decisions early in the lifecycle.

  • Resource and Program Management: Manage and prioritize work across both full-time teammates and contracted resources, ensuring effective execution of software supply chain security objectives, operational activities, risk remediation efforts, and strategic initiatives. Coordinate resources, budgets, vendor relationships, and project deliverables to achieve business outcomes.

Qualifications
Required Qualifications
The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent education, training, and work-related experience.

  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in security engineering or related cybersecurity roles.

  • Deep specialized knowledge in cybersecurity principles, theories, and concepts.

  • Extensive experience in software development lifecycle security practices.

  • Expertise in threat modeling, security testing, and penetration testing.

  • Proven experience implementing and managing complex information security technologies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated leadership experience managing technical cybersecurity, DevSecOps, application security, or software supply chain security teams, including direct supervision of full-time employees, contractors, and cross-functional technical resources. Proven ability to build, scale, and lead high-performing teams while driving strategic security outcomes.

  • Advanced cybersecurity certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CEH, GIAC).

  • Experience with security automation, orchestration, and advanced threat detection tools.

  • Familiarity with emerging cybersecurity technologies, industry trends, and strategic risk management.

  • Experience in application security, software supply chain security, DevSecOps, vulnerability management, secure engineering, or related cybersecurity functions.

  • Strong understanding of open source software governance, dependency management, SBOM, SCA, secure SDLC, CI/CD pipelines, and software supply chain threats.

  • Working knowledge of relevant security and software supply chain frameworks and standards, including OWASP, NIST Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF), Supply-chain Levels for Software Artifacts (SLSA), and related secure development guidance.

  • Experience applying software supply chain security practices, including provenance, build integrity, artifact signing, secure package repositories, dependency trust, and CI/CD pipeline hardening.

  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD platforms, source code management, package managers, build systems, artifact repositories, and developer workflows.

  • Experience with scripting or automation using languages such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar.

  • Ability to partner directly with engineering, platform, cloud, risk, audit, and compliance stakeholders to explain risk clearly and provide practical remediation guidance.

  • Ability to translate technical risk into executive-ready reporting, measurable outcomes, and actionable remediation plans.

Our Company

The Global Leader in Premium Leaf Tobacco Supply

Universal Leaf Tobacco Company is the world’s leading supplier of premium leaf tobacco, with over 100 years of experience sourcing, processing, and delivering tobacco crops tailored to customer specifications. With operations spanning major tobacco-regions across five continents, we connect hundreds of thousands of farmers to global manufacturers through a reliable, transparent, and traceable supply chain.

Our portfolio includes flue-cured, burley, oriental, and dark tobaccos, supported by deep agronomic expertise and advanced processing capabilities. As an Internal Auditor II at Universal, you will assist in planning, performing, and closing integrated risk-based internal audits across financial, compliance, operational, and information systems areas.   • Document tests and findings in our automated audit workpaper package.
  • Analyze the root cause of audit issues, develop practical recommendations, and appropriately document and communicate to stakeholders.
  • Conduct interviews of all levels of management.
  • Perform data analytics on subsidiary financial and operational data.
  • Provide direct assistance to the external auditors.
  • Perform special projects, as assigned.
  • Understand and exercise discretion and maintain confidentiality.


Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree with concentration in Accounting or Finance preferred; concentrations in IT or other disciplines also considered.
  • Minimum two years of auditing and/or accounting experience or relevant professional work experience in manufacturing environments.
  • Willingness to travel domestically and globally up to 30% of the time.


Preferred Skills

  • Experience in public accounting assurance or advisory practice; Big 4 or reputable regional firm highly valued.
  • Experience in a manufacturing environment.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office suite.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Motivated to work independently and complete responsibilities with little supervision yet work well and promote a team-oriented culture.
  • IS auditing / compliance / corporate governance / SOX experience.
  • Strong organizational abilities, attention to detail, time management, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Knowledge of generally accepted accounting principles, the IIA International Professional Practices Framework (IPPF), COSO’s Internal Control – Integrated Framework.
  • Multi-lingual skills (Spanish or Portuguese)

title: Global Head of Tax
description:
Job Title:

Global Head of Tax

Contract Type:

Time Type:

Job Description:

The Global Head of Tax is responsible for defining and executing the Group's global tax strategy, ensuring that tax governance, compliance, transfer pricing, indirect taxation, tax accounting, and tax risk management support the Group's commercial objectives while maintaining the highest standards of integrity and regulatory compliance.

The role acts as a strategic business partner to executive management, traders, finance, treasury, legal, operations, and M&A teams, providing proactive advice on tax implications of business activities, acquisitions, financings, investments, restructurings, and new market opportunities.

The Global Head of Tax leads a globally distributed tax organization and drives the modernization of tax processes, systems, and controls to support a scalable, technology-enabled tax function.

Key Responsibilities

Tax Strategy & Leadership

  • Define and implement the Group's global tax strategy aligned with business and shareholder objectives.

  • Serve as the primary tax advisor to the Executive Leadership Team and senior management.

  • Ensure tax considerations are integrated into strategic business decisions from inception.

  • Lead and develop a high-performing global tax organization and talent pipeline.

  • Promote a culture of compliance, commerciality, continuous improvement, and innovation.

Corporate Tax & International Tax

  • Oversee all direct tax matters across the Group's global operations.

  • Manage international tax planning, financing structures, holding structures, and cross-border transactions.

  • Ensure appropriate governance around permanent establishment, withholding tax, and corporate income tax matters.

  • Monitor and assess the impact of evolving international tax regulations, including OECD initiatives, BEPS, and Pillar Two.

Transfer Pricing

  • Own the Group's transfer pricing framework and global transfer pricing strategy.

  • Ensure transfer pricing policies remain aligned with business operations and OECD guidelines.

  • Oversee preparation and maintenance of Master Files, Local Files, country-by-country reporting, and benchmarking studies.

  • Manage transfer pricing audits, disputes, and advance pricing arrangements where appropriate.

Indirect Tax & Customs

  • Oversee VAT, GST, sales tax, excise, customs duties, and other indirect taxes globally.

  • Support business operations and trading activities by providing practical, commercially focused advice.

  • Ensure effective management of indirect tax risks arising from complex international trading flows.

  • Drive automation and process improvements in indirect tax determination and reporting.

Tax Accounting & Reporting

  • Oversee income tax accounting and reporting under IFRS.

  • Ensure accurate and timely tax provisions, deferred tax calculations, effective tax rate analysis, and tax disclosures.

  • Partner with Controlling and Accounting teams on quarterly and annual reporting requirements.

  • Ensure readiness for external audits and regulatory reviews.

Tax Risk, Governance & Compliance

  • Establish and maintain the Group's tax governance framework.

  • Ensure timely and accurate compliance with all filing and reporting obligations globally.

  • Oversee management of tax audits, disputes, investigations, and regulatory reviews.

  • Maintain appropriate internal controls over tax processes and reporting.

M&A, Projects & Business Advisory

  • Provide tax structuring advice on acquisitions, divestments, joint ventures, and investments.

  • Support new business initiatives, trading strategies, and geographical expansion projects.

  • Advise on tax implications of corporate finance, treasury, and financing transactions.

  • Partner with Legal and Finance teams to optimize business structures while maintaining compliance.

Tax Technology & Transformation

  • Lead the digital transformation of the tax function.

  • Drive adoption of automation, ERP-integrated tax solutions, AI-enabled tax analytics, and advanced reporting capabilities.

  • Establish data governance and reporting standards supporting real-time tax insight and risk monitoring.

  • Ensure the tax function remains fit for future regulatory and technological developments.

Profile

  • Master's Degree in Tax Law, Economics, Accounting, Finance, or related field.

  • Professional tax qualification preferred (CTA, Swiss Tax Expert, CPA, ACA, equivalent).

  • 15+ years of international tax experience.

  • Significant experience within commodity trading, energy, shipping, financial services, or a similarly complex multinational environment.

  • Prior leadership responsibility for a global tax function.

  • Strong experience managing transfer pricing, corporate tax, indirect tax, and tax accounting matters.

  • Demonstrated success in leading tax transformation and technology initiatives.

  • Deep knowledge of IFRS tax reporting.

  • Strong understanding of OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines.

  • Comprehensive knowledge of BEPS and Pillar Two requirements.

  • Experience with ERP environments (Oracle, SAP, or equivalent).

  • Strong analytical and project management capabilities.

  • Strategic thinker with strong commercial acumen.

  • Influential stakeholder manager capable of engaging at Board and Executive Committee level.

  • Pragmatic decision-maker with balanced risk judgement.

  • Strong communicator capable of translating complex technical issues into business language.

  • Change leader with a track record of building and transforming global teams.

  • International mindset and cross-cultural leadership capability.

TYLin is seeking an experienced Project Manager, Airside to provide design leadership on some of the largest and most complex airport redevelopment programs in North America. This is a unique opportunity for an accomplished aviation professional to lead multidisciplinary design teams, manage key stakeholder relationships, and help deliver world-class airside facilities to shape the long-term development of aviation infrastructure.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a globally recognized aviation practice and contribute to the transformation of some of the world’s most important airport facilities.

We are looking for a project manager with a strong background in airside/airfield design and redevelopment, who has successfully led multidisciplinary design teams on major projects in the United States or internationally. The successful candidate will have experience coordinating architects, engineers, planners, specialty consultants, airport stakeholders, airlines, and operational teams to deliver innovative, functional, and passenger-focused terminal environments.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design delivery of major airfield projects for commercial, regional, and general aviation airports.

  • Manage multidisciplinary design teams including architects, engineers, planners, aviation specialists, and specialty consultants.

  • Coordinate all phases of airside design, including programming, concept design, schematic design, design development, construction documentation, and construction administration.

  • Develop and manage project scope, schedule, budget, staffing plans, and delivery strategies.

  • Facilitate design coordination meetings and ensure alignment between architectural, engineering, operational, and stakeholder requirements.

  • Review and manage design deliverables, technical submissions, and quality assurance processes.

  • Coordinate with construction teams to support constructability reviews, phasing strategies, and implementation planning.

  • Identify project risks and develop mitigation strategies to maintain design quality, schedule, and budget objectives.

  • Strong understanding of airfield planning, architectural design, operational requirements, and airfield layouts.

  • Proven ability to manage project scope, schedule, budget, quality, and client expectations.

  • Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Experience coordinating with airport authorities, airlines, tenants, contractors, and regulatory agencies.

Preferred

  • Experience on large hub airport redevelopment programs valued in the hundreds of millions or billions of dollars.

  • Experience with Design-Build, Progressive Design-Build, CMAR, or Public-Private Partnership (P3) delivery models.

Typical Project Experience

The ideal candidate will have led the design and coordination of projects such as:

  • Airfield layouts

  • Aircraft parking layout design

  • Airport Master Plans

  • Facility requirement analyses

  • Capacity and operational studies

  • Phasing and development plans

Ideal Candidate

You are a collaborative design leader with a passion for aviation infrastructure and a reputation for delivering technically complex airport projects. You excel at bringing together diverse teams, resolving competing priorities, and fostering strong partnerships between clients, contractors, and consultants.

You understand that successful airport projects require more than technical expertise—they demand proactive communication, strategic thinking, and the ability to align multiple stakeholders around a shared vision. Your experience leading large-scale terminal programs has equipped you to confidently navigate the challenges of delivering projects in operational airports while maintaining the highest standards of design quality, safety, and project performance.

TYLin is a global leader in aviation planning, architecture, engineering, and program management. We partner with airport owners to deliver innovative, sustainable, and resilient infrastructure that enhances passenger experience and supports long-term operational success.

Joining our Aviation practice means you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Grow your career within a collaborative, employee-focused organization committed to technical excellence and innovation.

Help shape the next generation of airport terminals by leading designs that are innovative, operationally efficient, and centered on the passenger experience.

Job Description

JOB SUMMARY


This position participates in the management and provision of nursing care for pediatric, adult, and geriatric emergency department patients, with the supervision of a registered nurse. All Emergency Department Technicians will work in both the Emergency Department Treatment Area and the Triage Area.

Must have excellent customer service skills and be a team player. Must recognize changes in patient condition and report changes to the appropriate person. This position will assists in the admission, discharge and transfer of patients and will responded compassionately to patient requests and call lights in a timely manner.

ESSENTIAL JOB RESPONSIBILITIES
Emergency Department Treatment Area:

  • Provides direct care in accordance with treatment plans, as directed by the charge nurse, RN or nursing director.
  • Accompanies patients to various treatments throughout the facility.
  • Completes required documentation accurately and in a timely manner.
  • Performs and assists with patient lifts, transfers, positioning and ambulation.
  • Observes report and document questionable patient conditions to the RN on duty.
  • Assists with patient meals and bathing as directed.
  • Performs nursing care according to the population served on the unit as referenced in the Administrative, Scope of Services Policy.
  • Complies with laws and regulations in maintaining patient information.
  • Performs nursing care according to the population served on the unit as referenced in the Administrative, Scope of Services Policy.
  • Obtains EKG’s, Foley Catheter, and phlebotomy for lab studies and discontinues IV catheter.
  • Performs other duties as needed or assigned.

Emergency Department Triage Area:

  • Provides direct care including first aid, vital signs and assist in implementation of treatment plans as directed by the Designated Charge nurse (RN), or nursing director.
  • Responds to emergency situations and provide first aid as needed during the emergency intake process.
  • Reassures patients and bystanders by working in a confident, efficient manner.
  • Completes quick patient registration and witnessed consent to treat.
  • Expedites triage by communicating chief complaint to Triage RN.
  • Transfers and accompanies patients to various treatments throughout the facility.
  • Completes required documentation accurately and timely.
  • Performs and assists with patient lifts, transfers, positioning, and ambulation.
  • Observes, reports, and documents questionable patient conditions to the RN on duty.
  • Performs care according to the population served on the unit as referenced in the Administrative, Scope of Services Policy.
  • Performs other duties as needed or assigned.

  • Current Kansas Certified Nurse Aide license, and/or current Kansas EMT certificate, OR Certified National Registry Emergency Medical Technician and/or Certified/Registered as a Medical Assistant

title: E&I Shift Engineer
description:
MAIN JOB PURPOSE

The E&I Shift Engineer reports directly to the E&I Manager. His/her primary role is to provide technical expertise in the Repairs and Maintenance of electrical, instrumentation, and controls facilities. The E&I Shift Engineer does not have any direct reports but may be appointed to handle Contractors or Engineering Service providers for specific activities.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Safety and Quality

  • Ensure compliance to Safety and Occupational Health procedures (i.e., use of proper PPEs and reporting of unsafe acts and conditions through SBO, etc.)

  • Ensure compliance to environmental policy (i.e., proper waste segregation and water and energy conservation, etc.)

  • Ensures compliance to GMP and HACCP (i.e., proper hygiene and proper wearing uniforms, etc.)

  • Participates in QBO program

  • Follow prescribed work procedures and company safety rules and regulations

Maintenance

  • Perform diagnostic, troubleshooting, and repair of electrical systems such as: E-house/Electrical substation

  • Substation equipment/s such as: Power Transformer, Medium Voltage Switch Gear, Load Break Switch, Power Control Center (PCC), Capacitor Bank, Harmonic Filter, Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS), Building/Industrial Wiring, Distribution Panels, Motor Control Centers

  • Install, troubleshoot, repair and maintain control systems/equipment (simple to complex) such as: Motor Controls, PLC-Based Control Systems, Electro-pneumatics, Weighing System, Instrumentation and Controls, HMI, Servo Motor and Drives, Sensors and Control, Variable Frequency Drives, Motors, Instruments Calibration

  • Assist Electrical-Instrumentation Engineer and/or Specialists in handling contractors on medium scale Repair and Maintenance and Projects.

  • Prepare work instructions, perform site inspections, monitor activities and check quality of workmanship at site.

  • Assists the E&I Engineer in performing audits and execution of corrective action to ensure compliance with Unilever’s Electrical Safety

  • Prepare work order

  • Completion of Emergency Work Order (EWO)

  • Prepare and organize documentation requirements for Repairs and Maintenance of the following: Wiring diagrams (P&IDs), Procedures for Operation and Maintenance, Equipment/spares List, Repairs and Maintenance Reports, Visual Controls, Test and Calibration Reports, Other Documents necessary for R&M.

  • Designated as Authorized Person. A person who has been appointed in writing by a Senior Authorised Person to carry out specified duties. According to level of authorisation, this may include authority to issue and cancel specified safety documents.

  • Carry out work on high voltage switching.

  • Switching or tripping of high voltage apparatus under emergency conditions

  • Carry out routine duties in substation

  • Isolation of high voltage equipment

  • Carry out testing of high voltage testing using approved testing equipment

  • Earthing on high voltage equipment

  • Designated as ERT

  • Operational Excellence, assist and support the production team in carrying out changeover activities in the line.

  • Work with other technicians to perform troubleshooting.

  • Accomplishes log sheets and report findings.

  • Can act as person-in-charge for activities they are competent in, in the absence of their line manager.

Admin

  • Compliance to company COBP, CR&R

  • Compliance to the GMP and GHK rules of the plant

Focused Improvement

  • Participates in Focused Improvement activities

  • Executes agreed Focused Improvement actions

  • Raises improvement activities (OFI) and OPL

  • Validates results and effectiveness of Focused Improvement activities via real time observations

Maintenance

  • Perform routine activities such as operation, troubleshooting, repairs, and maintenance of Mixers and ensure that machines are available for production

  • Perform preventive and autonomous maintenance task, including CILT, based on the calendar given by the maintenance planner

  • Participates in the EWO (emergency work order) filling up and execution of actions that relates to prevent any similar breakdown

Digital

  • Able to operate simple gadgets such as smart phone and iPad

  • Learn and adapt to digital tools as required by the Company

Manning

  • Participates in trainings and other ad hoc activities as required by the Company

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS REQUIRED

  • Diploma in Electrical Engineering or Any Technical Course Relevant to Stated Functions

  • Preferably with Registered Electrical Engineer (REE) / Registered Master Electrician (RME) License

  • Knowledge in hydraulic, electrical, or electronic process instrumentation and control systems

  • Knowledge of Basic R2S/UMS Principles such as UMS Pillars, OEE Computation, Loss Measurements, Problem Solving Techniques, Statistical Process Control and Cost Variance Analysis

  • Basic knowledge in thermodynamics, heat exchanger, and pressure vessel operation. Basic analytical skills for physico-chemical properties and basic knowledge of raw material quality and specifications.

  • Knowledge of the 5S Principles and the ability to consistently practice them

  • Basic knowledge of OSHAS, EMS, GMP and HACCP

  • Ability to prepare accurate technical reports and communicate clearly both verbally and in writing

  • Must possess basic PC skills, MS Excel skills, Good Communication Skills, comfortable working in an open team environment, have the ability to plan, organize and execute work with a minimum of supervision and have a strong awareness of safety issues.

  • Amenable to work in Gateway Business Park, General Trias, Cavite

title: Pediatric Advanced Practice Clinician (NP/PA) 04/10/2026
description:
Pediatric Advanced Practice Clinician (NP/PA) - 04/10/2026

Job Summary: The Advanced Practice Clinician (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) provide comprehensive medical care to patients served at Choptank Community Health System (CCHS), in accordance with the policies and procedures and philosophy of CCHS. All duties and responsibilities are performed across life cycle (infants, children, adolescents, adults, and geriatric), as applicable. This is an exempt, full-time position in pay grade 9 with the pay range of $92,212.00 - $138,317.00. The Advanced Practice Clinician reports directly to the Chief Clinical Officer.

Required Skills/Abilities:

  • Bilingual and bicultural skills valued.
  • Ensure that standards of quality evidenced based and best practice medical care are met.
  • Serve as a resource and consultant to other advanced practice clinicians.

Education and Experience:

  • Graduate of Accredited APRN or PA Program (or equivalent)
  • Board Certified
  • Primary Care specialist (Family, Pediatrics, Adult, Women's Health, or Midwifery).
  • Must have current APRN or PA license to practice in Maryland.
  • Maintain ongoing professional education as mandated by state regulation.
  • Maryland CDS and DEA license and Basic Life Support.

Working Conditions and Physical Requirements:

  • General clinical office environment
  • Provides patient care
  • Occasional travel
  • Frequent exposure to workplace conditions includes bending, climbing stairs, walking, kneeling, and reaching.
  • Includes fine and gross motor skills, lifting less than 20 pounds, and vision.
  • Occasional exposure to workplace conditions includes air borne pathogens, blood borne pathogens and cleaning agents.

Standards of Behavior:

  • Commitment To Service
  • Respect
  • Quality
  • Teamwork
  • Patient Focus
  • Integrity
  • Accountability
  • Caring & Compassion
  • Professionalism
  • Listening & Responding
  • Safety
  • AIDET

Job Related Competencies:

  • Empathetic Outlook- The ability to perceive and understand the feelings and attitudes of others; the ability to place oneself “in the shoes” of another and to view a situation from their perspective.
  • Attention to Detail- The ability to process detailed information effectively and consistently.
  • Problem Solving- Identifies and analyzes problems weighing the relevance and accuracy of available information. Generates and evaluates alternative solutions and makes effective and timely decisions.
  • Communicates Effectively- Developing and delivering multi-mode communication that conveys a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  • Values And Ethics- Serving with integrity and respect in personal and organizational practices. Ensuring decisions and transactions are transparent and fair.
  • Time Management- The ability to effectively manage one’s time and resources to ensure that work is completed efficiently.

Commitment to Community:

Choptank Community Health System (CCHS) is committed to creating a safe and open healthcare environment that improves health outcomes and values and respects the unique experiences and perspectives of both patients and staff by:

  • Prioritizing access for all individuals;
  • Offering ongoing training for staff to promote health awareness, preventive measures and early detection for the varied patient population on the Eastern Shore;
  • Actively engaging with patients, families and staff;
  • Fostering a workplace culture in which everyone is treated with dignity.

Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Assess and manage patients including conducting history, performing physical examinations, and developing treatment plans for acute and chronic health problems and address preventive health needs appropriate to that clinician's training, experience, and specialty, taking into consideration the ambulatory nature of the health center.
  • Order and review lab and x-ray tests in accordance with evidence based and best practice recommendations.
  • Support services provided in Health Centers, community/school-based health center programs, and Mobile Health Unit, as applicable.
  • At all times interact with patients and staff in accordance with CCHS Standards of Behavior and Code of Ethics
  • Complete Inbox Management and Patient Note documentation and closure in a timely manner as stated in the CCHS Medical Records Documentation Procedure, this includes all patient encounters being signed within 72hours of the date of service.
  • Make appropriate referrals to specialists, subspecialties, hospital emergency rooms, hospital clinics, etc., when good medical judgment dictates such referrals.
  • Provide first-aid to patients but may refer serious injuries or severely acute conditions requiring hospital care to local hospital emergency rooms or in-patient facilities, as appropriate, after stabilizing the patient as clinically necessary at the health center.
  • Participate in medical chart audits, performance improvement, risk management, and peer review activities, and participate in appropriate CCHS committees, when necessary.
  • Provide in-service training sessions for other CCHS staff, as necessary.
  • Attend CCHS staff meetings unless direct patient duties prevent such attendance.
  • Serve as a resource and consultant to other advanced practice clinicians and colleagues, and review problem cases with team as needed.
  • Take night calls and weekend calls in accordance with CCHS policies and procedures.
  • Must obtain and maintain appropriate licensing, credentialing, and privileges according to CCHS policies and procedures. Complete required CME yearly relevant to Board Certification and practice- supported with an annual CME stipend.
  • Participate in educational programs and classes for patients and staff.
  • Coordinated Care/Patient Centered Medical Care Management: Works with all members of the Health Care Team towards achieving coordinated patient centered care.
  • Demonstrates knowledge of the goals and objectives of CCHS’s patient care management plan. Effectively able to perform and communicate individual tasks within role in the process.
  • Participate in CCHS medical activities at any or all sites operated by CCHS including SBHC and MHU, appropriate for specialty, in accordance with CCHS policies and procedures and needs.
  • Participate in CCHS outreach activities in accordance with CCHS policies and procedures.
  • Maintain client confidentiality at all levels of interaction in strict compliance with State and federal laws and regulations.
  • Perform other job-related duties deemed necessary by the Supervising Director and Chief Clinical Officer.
  • Regular, reliable attendance is a requirement of this job. This includes being available at the assigned location during scheduled patient care hours.

Restrictions:

  • May not have any private practice or provide medical services outside of CCHS without the written approval of the CCHS CEO and CMO/CCO.
  • Any other medical practice may not interfere with duties and responsibilities to CCHS and its patients.

  • Certification scholarships available

  • 403(b)

title: Senior Backend Developer - valència
description:
About the Role

Our client, a top IT consultancy, is partnering with a leading financial services organisation, to build a dedicated Generative AI hub in Valencia. This new unit will serve as the engine for organisation's AI-driven transformation, designing and delivering intelligent solutions that modernise financial processes, automate decision-making, and unlock new value across the organisation.

We are looking for a Senior Backend Developer to be one of the founding engineers of this hub. You will help define the technical foundations of an Agentic AI platform built on Azure, contributing from day one to architecture decisions, infrastructure setup, and the delivery of production-grade AI-powered services for the financial sector.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and build the backend services and APIs that power the organisation's Generative AI platform, using Node.js or .NET 8 (ASP.NET Core / EF Core)
  • Implement data ingestion, chunking, cleaning and quality checks pipelines using Azure Data Factory and Azure Document Intelligence
  • Build and maintain vector indexing and semantic search capabilities via Azure Cognitive Search and LightRAG
  • Develop embedding generation pipelines using Azure OpenAI
  • Design and manage multi-layer data storage: Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, Azure Cosmos DB (agent memory), Azure Blob Storage
  • Build and integrate agent tooling using Langchain, Langgraph, FastAPI, A2A, AG-UI and MCP
  • Implement the AIDA orchestration and coordination layer using Mastra (Multi-Agentic Orchestrator)
  • Ensure platform observability and alerting via Azure Monitor and Azure Log Analytics
  • Implement evaluation pipelines for LLM outputs using Azure ML
  • Apply guardrails and output validation using Azure OpenAI and Azure Machine Learning
  • Implement authentication and RBAC using Azure Active Directory
  • Manage secrets and configuration securely via Azure Key Vault
  • Contribute to the technical culture of the hub: code reviews, documentation, architecture decisions, and engineering best practices


Technology Stack

Backend Core

  • Node.js or.NET 8 (ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core)
  • RESTful API design ·Event-driven architectures


Azure Data & AI Services

  • Azure Data Factory — ingestion, chunking, cleaning, DQ checks
  • Azure Document Intelligence — document parsing and understanding
  • Azure Cognitive Search — vector indexing and semantic search
  • Azure OpenAI — LLM access, embedding generation, guardrails and output validation
  • Azure Machine Learning — model evaluation and ML guardrails
  • LightRAG — retrieval engine for RAG pipelines


Storage & Databases

  • Azure SQL ·PostgreSQL — relational data and metadata storage
  • Azure Cosmos DB — short-term and long-term agent memory
  • Azure Blob Storage — file and document storage


Agent Infrastructure

  • Langchain & Langgraph — agent orchestration and chaining
  • FastAPI — lightweight API layer for agent tooling
  • A2A, AG-UI, MCP — agent-to-agent communication and UI protocols
  • Mastra — Multi-Agentic Orchestrator (non-Azure, self-hosted)


Platform & DevOps

  • Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) — agent runtime hosting
  • Azure Active Directory — authentication & RBAC
  • Azure Key Vault — secrets and keys management
  • Azure Monitor · Azure Log Analytics — observability
  • Azure App Service · Azure Static Web Apps — UI/UX deployment


Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of backend development experience in production environments
  • Strong proficiency in Node.js OR .NET 8 / ASP.NET Core (or both)
  • Solid hands-on experience with Azure cloud services: ADF, Cognitive Search, OpenAI, SQL, Cosmos DB
  • Experience building RESTful APIs and microservices in regulated or high-availability environments
  • Familiarity with vector databases, embeddings and RAG-based architectures
  • Understanding of Agentic AI patterns: multi-agent systems, tool use, orchestration, memory layers
  • Experience with containerisation (Docker / Kubernetes / AKS)
  • Proficiency in SQL (Azure SQL, PostgreSQL)
  • Strong understanding of security best practices: authentication, RBAC, secrets management
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices on Azure
  • Ability to work autonomously in a greenfield, fast-paced environment
  • Fluent English — working language for all technical documentation and ceremonies
  • Location - preferably Valencia, but open to other locations with availability to travel occasionally to Valencia; remote in that case.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Python / FastAPI for agent tooling layers
  • Knowledge of Langchain, Langgraph or similar LLM orchestration frameworks
  • Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol), A2A or AG-UI protocols
  • Prior experience in a hub or centre-of-excellence environment
  • Background in financial services, banking or fintech
  • GitHub certification
  • Spanish language skills


Why Join This Team

  • Founding engineer role — shape the architecture and culture of a brand-new GenAI hub from day one
  • Work at the cutting edge of Agentic AI applied to real financial services use cases
  • Backed by the organisation's global engineering community, tooling and career development programmes
  • Valencia-based hub with a collaborative, senior-weighted team
  • Direct exposure to the company's transformation agenda and senior stakeholders

title: Continuous Improvement Engineer
description:
Job Purpose
At Unilever, our products are used by billions of people around the world every day. At our Rexdale manufacturing site, you will help improve how those products are made by turning ideas, data, and hands-on problem solving into practical improvements on the factory floor.

We are looking for a Continuous Improvement Engineer who is curious, collaborative, and motivated to solve real manufacturing challenges. You will work closely with production, maintenance, and site teams to reduce losses, improve equipment performance, strengthen standards, and build more reliable ways of working.

This is a great opportunity for a recent engineering graduate or early-career professional who wants to build hands-on manufacturing experience, develop strong problem-solving skills, and see the direct impact of their work on safety, quality, cost, delivery, and team capability.

Main Responsibilities
• Analyze production downtime, material waste, changeover losses, and process performance data to identify improvement opportunities.
• Investigate manufacturing problems, identify root causes, and support practical solutions that can be sustained by the team.

description:
Founded in 1977 as the Senior Care Action Network, SCAN began with a simple but radical idea: that older adults deserve to stay healthy and independent. That belief was championed by a group of community activists we still honor today as the “12 Angry Seniors.” Their mission continues to guide everything we do.

Today, SCAN is a nonprofit health organization serving more than 500,000 people across Arizona, California, Nevada, New Mexico, Texas, and Washington, with over $8 billion in annual revenue. With nearly five decades of experience, we have built a distinctive, values-driven platform dedicated to improving care for older adults.

Our work spans Medicare Advantage, fully integrated care models, primary care, care for the most medically and socially complex populations, and next-generation care delivery models. Across all of this, we are united by a shared commitment: combining compassion with discipline, innovation with stewardship, and growth with integrity.

At SCAN, we believe scale should strengthen—not dilute—our mission. We are building the future of care for older adults, grounded in purpose, accountability, and respect for the people and communities we serve.

The Job

Performs on-site and desktop auditing of SCAN internal processes and FDRs including SCAN's delegated groups, IPA’s, hospitals and ancillary providers in accordance with CMS and DHCS and contractual requirements to ensure compliance Recognizes and communicates areas for improvement to network providers
Prepares detailed written results of oversight audits by communicating findings, areas of concern and recommendations for improvement, including corrective action requests in accordance with P&P’s Makes recommendations for development of policies and procedures, as well as work flow charts
Conducts closing meetings with audited providers to give them a preliminary overview of completed compliance audits Assists providers in achieving and maintaining compliance with SCAN, Federal, State and NCQA requirements and guidelines including the development and implementation of corrective action plans (CAP), monitoring CAP activities and providing education and tools Responds to audited providers as disagreements with audit findings arise Analyzes submitted reports from providers, including the request for corrections from providers as needed Communicates regulation interpretations and explains their application, provides supplemental information if needed Conducts detailed review, analysis, and interpretation of legislative, statutory, regulatory, and contract language
Conducts all aspects of annual oversight projects, including creation and distribution of mass mailing and individual correspondence; coordination of projects with internal SCAN staff and departments; monitoring and reporting delegated compliance; tracking, trending and reporting upon project status; coordinating with Compliance regarding report submissions and HPMS/regulatory updates Uses critical thinking skills and identifies impactful areas for provider data requirements to develop an effective implementation and communication plans

title: Contracts Intern
description:
Howden Re is the global reinsurance broker and risk, capital & strategic advisor focused on relentless innovation & superior analytics for top client service. ​ ​

About Role

Internship: Contracts

Location: Edina, MN / New York, NY or Remote

Salary: up to $27/hr + overtime
Deadline to apply: Friday 16th October

Introduction

Working with our reinsurance team in North America you’ll learn more about reinsurance broking, risk mitigation solutions, contracts decision making and support our teams, doing real work for Howden Re's current and prospective clients.

What you’ll be doing

Reinsurance is a complex world; the easiest way to think about it is that it’s insurance for the insurers. Working with our teams, you’ll help insurance companies protect their futures, and the people they insure.

As a Contracts Intern, you’ll learn about the reinsurance contracts process and relationships among reinsurance counterparties as you participate in sending final contract documents to reinsurers and clients for execution and tracking status of the documents.

On a day-to-day basis you’ll:

  • Review and create PDFs of final Reinsurance Contracts, Interests and Liabilities Agreements, and related documents at direction of the Contracts Wording Team

  • Transmit final Reinsurance Contracts, Interests and Liabilities Agreements, and related documents to ceding companies and reinsurers at direction of the Broking Team

  • Track status of transmitted documents via tracking tool

  • Monitor and manage Transmittal Shared Mailbox in Outlook

  • Prepare regular reports on status of transmitted documents

  • Follow up with outstanding markets for signatures

  • Compile fully executed documents into single PDF files

  • Update contract files with executed documentation

  • Communicate and coordinate with broker, contract drafter, and transmittal specialist as required

  • Perform other miscellaneous duties as assigned

Who we’re looking for

You’ll be working towards a Bachelor’s degree in any subject. You’ll be able to clearly communicate your thoughts and ideas both in writing and in person. And be able to handle multiple tasks and projects at the same time in a client service, deadline-driven environment.

You will:

  • Actively pursuing a Bachelor’s degree

  • Have a GPA of 3.0+

  • Be proficient in Excel, Word, and PowerPoint

  • Have the ability to explain complex contracts in simple terms so anyone can understand it, either in writing or over the phone

  • Pay close attention to detail, because every small detail matters

  • Legally authorized to work in the US

Our Application process

Our application process is designed to help you show your potential, not to test what you already know!

Online application form: to make sure you’re eligible for the internship, and to upload a resume.

Pre-recorded video interview: You’ll record your answers to a few questions using your phone or laptop, giving you the chance to tell us more about yourself in your own time in a relaxed setting.

Assessment center: Our final stage is an assessment center, which will ideally be in-person, but may be virtual. You'll take part in some fun group activities and meet our team in a relaxed setting. This day is all about getting to know you better and for you to see what it's like to be part of Howden and experience our culture.

Different perspectives make us better

At Howden, we’re committed to fair opportunity, inclusive teams and a culture where everyone belongs. We value people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. We make sure everyone has the chance to succeed. If you bring who you really are, we’ll help you to go further.

We believe in equal opportunities for all employees, regardless of race, religion, gender, age, sexual orientation or disability. And as a Disability Confident employer, we’re committed to removing barriers and supporting you to do your best work. If you need any adjustments during the application process or in the role, just let us know. We’re here to help.

What we offer:

A career that you define. We provide an environment where new ideas are encouraged and celebrated, where people who want to have a real hand in our success thrive. We want people who want to make a difference - not just in the workplace, but in the industry and in the wider community.

Working at Howden Re:

At Howden Re, we’re on a mission to do things differently. Our no silo approach, elite team, and clear focus on innovation and relentless execution means our clients are at the heart of all we do.

As a big 4 global reinsurance broker, we deliberately avoid the one-size-fits-all approach, committing to creating bespoke solutions that address the unique challenges of a modern and dynamic marketplace.
