Job Description:

The Department of Health and Human Services (DHHS), Office of Economic Assistance, is seeking a highly motivated individual with keen attention to detail to join our Team in the DHHS Quality Control (QC) Specialist role. The successful candidate should possess good oral and written communications skills.

The DHHS Quality Control Specialist is responsible for conducting quality control reviews of Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP), Child Support, Medicaid and/or other benefit programs. Incumbents are responsible for auditing a statistically valid, integrated sample of cases to ensure compliance of all applicable regulations, terms, statutes, policies, State and Federal mandates.

“You have the passion; we have the opportunities – let’s make a difference for Nebraskans”


As the DHHS Quality Control Specialist, you will:

  • Conduct quality control reviews of Medicaid, Child Support public assistance programs to ensure compliance with federal and state regulations.
  • Audit a statistically valid sample of cases by reviewing eligibility, payment accuracy, client responsibility, and agency actions.
  • Perform field investigations, including in-home interviews, NFOCUS research, and third-party contacts to verify case information.
  • Analyze and resolve conflicting or incomplete information and determine appropriate sources of verification.
  • Evaluate agency determinations and identify over or under payments; classify and code errors according to federal reporting standards.
  • Communicate error findings professionally to the agency; recommend corrective actions.
  • Monitor error trends and identify systemic issues related to policy, procedures, or automation.
  • Stay current on changes to federal and state regulations, policies, and waivers and apply them accurately to reviews.
  • Present quality control results, data analysis, and recommendations to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Mentor and support colleagues by sharing expertise, reviewing work, and assisting with training and development efforts.
  • Manage workload independently, prioritize assignments, and meet established deadlines while maintaining accuracy.

Hire Rate: $20.011 per hour – non-exempt

Work Schedule: Monday – Friday; 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM

Dress Attire: Business Casual

Location: Statewide pending space availability

Driving is Required


Requirements / Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in business, human services, or a related field, plus two years of experience determining or reviewing public assistance eligibility; OR six years of relevant experience. Any equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.

Preferred Qualifications: Must have Child Support Enforcement experience

  • Strong working knowledge of program-policy and eligibility requirements (specifically in Child Support programs and applications)
  • Prior experience in eligibility determination, case management, or quality assurance
  • Ability to analyze complex cases, accurately interpret policy, and identify errors
  • High attention to detail with strong organizational and time-management skills
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills for documenting findings and collaborating with staff
  • Experience using eligibility systems, data tracking tools, and QC or federal/state reporting processes
  • Ability to work independently, maintain confidentiality, and apply policy objectively and consistently
  • Adaptability to policy changes and evolving program requirements

Other: Valid driver's license or able to provide independent authorized transportation.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

Knowledge of: researching and interpreting public assistance policies and regulations, public assistance eligibility processes, and related computer systems, along with a general knowledge of compliance, audit functions, and data research principles.

Ability to: learn and apply state and federal laws, regulations, and procedures necessary to conduct quality control reviews, as well as an understanding of the role of quality control in public welfare agencies and welfare administration. Incumbents must be able to conduct on-site interviews with applicants, recipients, and public or private sources to obtain information; apply rules and regulations to the verification, determination, and documentation of reviews; utilize computer output information to complete accurate findings; gather, verify, and analyze eligibility and financial data; operate a personal computer and general office equipment, including spreadsheets, word processing, databases, email, internet, and other programs; perform basic math calculations; work independently with minimal supervision; and successfully complete assigned workloads within established deadlines.

title: Python Full Stack Engineer
description:
Archetype is looking for a Full Stack Engineer to join our team in building a multi-tenant, cloud-based case management platform for the Auto Repossession domain.


In this role, you will work across both front-end and back-end development, collaborating closely with the Technical Lead and the wider delivery team.   • Develop field-facing workflows that allow agents to confirm on-site activity, submit case claims, and track case status in real time.

  • Develop and maintain front-end applications using Angular or React, including supporting the migration and modernization of existing applications.
  • Build and consume RESTful APIs and work with external partner integrations, with attention to API versioning and idempotency.

  • 4–6 years of professional experience in full-stack software development.

  • Strong working knowledge of PostgreSQL, including SQL development and database schema design.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting data migration, transformation, or legacy system modernization projects.


What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on a modern cloud-based platform and contribute to the replacement of a legacy system.
  • Exposure to end-to-end product development across front-end, back-end, cloud infrastructure, and data.
  • A collaborative Agile delivery environment.
  • Opportunity to work with AI-powered engineering tools as part of the day-to-day development workflow.
  • Opportunity to work closely with technical and business stakeholders and contribute to key product and architecture decisions.

Job Description

Position Summary:

This position supports student success, personal development, co-curricular engagement, and belonging through student development initiatives, programming, operations, and campus partnerships. The coordinator serves as a key resource for students and helps cultivate a welcoming and culturally responsive environment.


The Student Success Coordinator supervises up to six student staff, which includes hiring, training, development, and evaluation of the staff. This position requires skills for successful, active collaboration across all Cultural Resource Centers (CRCs), such as flexibility, thorough communication, and knowledge of student needs and concerns. In addition, this position will actively model Colorado State University’s Principles of Community.



Essential Duties:

  • Coordinate and implement the B/AACC portfolio of student development programs, including small-scale engagement opportunities and large-scale signature events. Including our biweekly student dialogue, “Real Talk.”
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for new and returning students seeking connection, involvement, support, and engagement through the B/AACC.
  • Supervise the B/AACC Educational Support Team (B.E.S.T.) Student Programming Team, including Lead Peer Coordinators and Peer Coordinators.
  • Co-Coordinate daily operations of the B/AACC, including space reservations, calendar management, B/AACC Library and Art Corner, and ensuring the center remains a welcoming and functional space.
  • Coordinate the B/AACC Volunteer Program, including volunteer recruitment and engagement efforts.
  • Lead communications and outreach efforts that promote student involvement and awareness of B/AACC programs, services, and resources, including event submissions and promotion.
  • Work collaboratively with Cultural Resource Centers, Student Affairs departments, academic units, student organizations, alumni, and community partners on shared programs, outreach efforts, and student success initiatives. Support divisional committees, special projects, and strategic initiatives assigned.

title: Senior NetSuite Consultant (Manuf/WMS)
description:

Role Overview:

We are looking for a senior NetSuite consultant to join our consulting team on a full-time contract basis. The role is focused on delivering high-quality NetSuite implementations and consulting engagements, with particular emphasis on Manufacturing and Warehouse Management System (WMS) solutions.

We are looking for someone who can work confidently with customers, understand how their business operates and translate those requirements into practical NetSuite solutions. The successful candidate will be comfortable leading discovery, solution design, configuration, testing and deployment activities.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Lead or contribute to NetSuite discovery workshops and requirements gathering.

  • Analyse manufacturing and warehouse processes and identify opportunities to simplify and improve them.

  • Design practical NetSuite solutions that balance customer requirements, standard functionality and maintainability.

  • Configure NetSuite and support technical teams where integrations or customisations are required.

  • Prepare functional specifications, solution designs, process documentation and test scenarios.

  • Lead solution walkthroughs and explain proposed solutions clearly to both business and technical stakeholders.

  • Support SIT, UAT, cutover, go-live and post-go-live activities.

  • Work closely with Project Managers, Solution Architects, developers and other consultants.

  • Identify project risks, dependencies and scope considerations early and communicate them clearly.

  • Provide mentoring and practical guidance to less experienced consultants where appropriate.

What You’ll Need:

  • Strong hands-on experience delivering NetSuite implementations, enhancements or transformation projects.

  • Practical NetSuite manufacturing experience, including a strong understanding of manufacturing processes, requirements gathering and solution design.

  • Hands-on experience with NetSuite WMS and warehouse processes.

  • Ability to turn business requirements into practical NetSuite solutions, including configuration, process design, functional specifications and recommendations on standard functionality versus customisation.

  • Confident working directly with customers across discovery, workshops, solution walkthroughs, issue resolution and decision-making.

  • Strong communication skills.

  • Experience across the NetSuite implementation lifecycle, including discovery, requirements, solution design, configuration, testing, training, cutover and post-go-live support.

  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to investigate issues, identify root causes and recommend sensible solutions without over-engineering.

  • Able to produce clear functional documentation, solution designs, process flows, test scenarios and other project deliverables.

  • 5+ years of relevant NetSuite consulting experience, or equivalent senior-level experience.

  • Recent hands-on NetSuite implementation experience rather than purely project management or account management experience.

  • Demonstrable manufacturing experience in NetSuite.

  • Demonstrable NetSuite WMS experience.

  • Strong customer-facing and workshop facilitation experience.

  • Experience taking ownership of functional solution design and configuration.

  • Understanding of field service workflows, including work orders, scheduling and technician activities.

  • Experience with the FSM mobile experience and field-based processes.

  • Understanding of service assets, parts / consumables, time, expenses and service billing.

  • Ability to connect field service processes with broader NetSuite ERP, inventory and financial processes.

  • NetSuite FSM experience as a strong differentiator.

The Logistics Associate supports the organization's supply chain and logistics operations by coordinating shipments, maintaining inventory accuracy, processing orders, and ensuring timely delivery of materials and products. This role works closely with vendors, donors, beneficiaries (schools), carriers, warehouse personnel, and internal stakeholders to maintain efficient operations and high service levels. The candidate will work within existing enterprise systems to assist with data management and reporting as it relates to logistics.

The ideal candidate will be a flexible and creative problem solver, who is comfortable working autonomously or as part of a team. They should also have a customer service mindset and work to provide the best possible experience to donors and beneficiaries while also communicating with our business partners to resolve issues.

The position offers a flexible work schedule and is a hybrid eligible role that depending on work levels and organizational needs could allow for a combination of days in the Little Canada office and working from home (after 30 days of employment).

Key Responsibilities

Logistics Support

  • Coordinate transport of KINF National Programs from KINF’s warehouse to local schools, non-profits, and other destinations, as assigned.

  • Track inbound and outbound shipments to/from KINF warehouse, as assigned.

  • Ensure correct and timely loading of trucks/movement, accurate order processing, timely deliveries, and customer satisfaction.

  • Partner closely with Impact Partnership and Warehouse team to support incoming donor shipments of Gift-in-Kind donations.

  • Communicate the timing of shipments, both inbound and outbound, to internal and external constituents.

  • Coordinate donations of inventory from donors to affiliates, as assigned.

  • Working with multiple shipping systems including a variety of Transport Management Systems as well as standalone shipping programs (FedEx Ship Manager, UPS Worldship)

  • Work closely with our partners and warehouse team in order to make sure fulfillment is happening on a timely schedule.

  • Resolve issues with schools and shipping companies when errors occur, be the first point of contact to make sure that the recipients have the best experience possible

  • Managing data input for shipping analytics and reporting from multiple platforms Sales force, Netsuite and TMS.

  • Must walk and be able to oversee outgoing floor operations with an eye for detail and upholding standard operating procedures


Other duties

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed and is not intended to be a comprehensive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. Additional duties may be assigned as needed to meet organizational needs.


Skills and Preferred Attributes:

  • Passion for mission and service

  • Good written and verbal communication skills

  • Customer Service Experience

  • Strong problem-solving abilities

  • Excellent interpersonal skills

  • Effective time-management skills

  • Essential ability to pay attention to detail on multiple levels (computer, operations, customer service).

  • Highly organized

  • Creative, curious, and committed to excellence.

  • Skilled at operating under pressure and meeting deadlines

  • Committed to facilitating a collaborative team environment


Minimum Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of experience in logistics, supply chain, and dispatch

  • Experience in procurement

  • Experience in logistics software and inventory management systems

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Outlook, Teams) with strong analytical skillset

  • Salesforce experience preferred

  • NetSuite experience preferred


Work Environment & Physical Demands

  • Combination of office and on-site event work

  • Ability to sit for a long period of time

  • Noise level may be low to moderate

  • Ability to lift and move materials up to 20 pounds - bending, lifting, twisting and stretching

  • Travel during the Back-to-School season to support partner events

  • The role requires participation in annual event setup and teardown (ability to lift and move materials up to 30 pounds - bending, lifting, twisting and stretching)


Benefits:

  • 401(k) retirement with up to 5% match

title: Kokenut sähkösuunnittelija
description:
INTEC kasvaa nopeasti, ja etsimme nyt kokenutta sähkösuunnittelijaa vahvistamaan suunnittelutiimiämme Tampereelle tai Helsinkiin.

Etsimme ennen kaikkea vahvaa käytännön tekijää, joka pystyy ottamaan suunnittelutehtäviä itsenäisesti haltuun ja toimimaan luontevasti asiakkaiden kanssa. Tässä tehtävässä sähkösuunnittelu on työn ydin, mutta halutessasi pääset laajentamaan tekemistäsi myös suunnittelupöydän ulkopuolelle esimerkiksi kohdekäynteihin, mittauksiin, kuntoarviointeihin, lämpökuvauksiin ja valvontaan.

Meillä yhdistyvät käytännön tekeminen, monialainen asiantuntijuus ja suoraselkäinen tapa hoitaa asiat.

INTEC lyhyesti

INTEC on rakentamisen ja kiinteistöjen parissa toimiva monialainen asiantuntijayhteisö. Tiimissämme työskentelee asentajataustaisia insinöörejä, kokeneita suunnittelijoita ja projektinjohtajia, joita yhdistää käytännönläheinen tapa tehdä asioita. Haluamme, että suunnitelmat eivät jää vain paperille, vaan toimivat myös käytännössä ja tekevät asiakkaidemme arjesta helpompaa.

INTEC aloitti toimintansa Suomessa vuonna 2024 ja on kasvanut jo 27 ammattilaisen organisaatioksi. Olemme osa pohjoismaista Instalco-konsernia, mutta toimimme Suomessa paikallisesti ja ketterästi. Yhdistämme laajemman verkoston osaamisen pienen organisaation nopeuteen, matalaan hierarkiaan ja käytännönläheiseen tekemiseen.

Rohkeasti omalla tyylillä, asiakkaan paras mielessä, aina.

Mitä pääset tekemään?

Sähkösuunnittelijana työskentelet monipuolisissa kiinteistöjen sähkösuunnitteluhankkeissa ja vastaat omista suunnittelutehtävistäsi itsenäisesti. Olet aktiivisesti yhteydessä asiakkaisiin ja hankkeen muihin osapuoliin, joten tehtävässä pääset työskentelemään teknisen suunnittelun lisäksi lähellä asiakasta ja projektien käytännön toteutusta. Työnkuvaa voidaan aidosti rakentaa oman osaamisesi, kiinnostuksesi ja motivaatiosi mukaan.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluu esimerkiksi:

  • itsenäistä sähkösuunnittelua MagiCADilla

  • omien suunnittelutehtävien suunnittelua ja aikatauluttamista

  • suunnitelmien tarkastamista ja laadun varmistamista

  • asiakas- ja suunnittelukokouksia sekä aktiivista yhteydenpitoa asiakkaisiin

  • yhteistyötä esimerkiksi LVIA- ja automaatiosuunnittelijoiden, rakennuttajien, urakoitsijoiden, arkkitehtien ja muiden hankkeen osapuolten kanssa

  • projektien aikana esiin tulevien teknisten kysymysten ratkaisemista

  • oman kiinnostuksesi mukaan esimerkiksi kohdekäyntejä, mittauksia, kuntoarviointeja, lämpökuvauksia ja valvontaa

  • mahdollisuuksia osallistua uusien työkalujen, palveluiden ja toimintatapojen kehittämiseen asiakastarpeiden pohjalta.

Projektimme vaihtelevat pienistä ja nopeasti etenevistä toimeksiannoista laajempiin kokonaisuuksiin. Teemme paljon esimerkiksi vuokralais- ja liiketilamuutoksia sekä PTS- ja muita kunnossapitohankkeita. Näiden rinnalla toteutamme laajempia saneeraus- ja uudisrakennushankkeita esimerkiksi liike-, toimitila-, varasto- ja logistiikkakiinteistöissä.

Arjessa voi olla samaan aikaan useampi nopeasti etenevä projekti ja niiden rinnalla pidempi hankekokonaisuus. Monipuolisuus on tässä tehtävässä enemmän sääntö kuin poikkeus.

Tehtävä voidaan sijoittaa joko Tampereelle tai Helsinkiin. Tampereella pääset samalla mukaan rakentamaan INTECin kasvavaa paikallista tiimiä ja uutta toimistoa yhdessä nykyisten kollegoidemme kanssa.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?

Etsimme jo kokenutta sähkösuunnittelun osaajaa, joka pystyy työskentelemään itsenäisesti ja ottamaan vastuuta omasta tekemisestään. Mitä monipuolisemmin olet nähnyt erilaisia rakennuksia, toimeksiantoja ja projektivaiheita, sitä paremmat lähtökohdat sinulla on tehtävään.

Toivomme sinulta:

  • vähintään noin viiden vuoden kokemusta sähkösuunnittelusta

  • vahvaa käytännön sähkösuunnitteluosaamista

  • vahvaa MagiCAD-osaamista

  • kokemusta erilaisista suunnitteluprojekteista ja kykyä hoitaa omia suunnittelukokonaisuuksia itsenäisesti

  • monipuolista kokemusta erilaisista rakennus- ja projektityypeistä

  • luontevaa otetta asiakastyöhön ja yhteistyöhön muiden projektiosapuolten kanssa

  • käytännönläheistä, oma-aloitteista ja vastuuta ottavaa työskentelytapaa

  • tehtävään soveltuvaa teknistä koulutusta, esimerkiksi insinööri (AMK)

  • sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa.

Plussaa saat esimerkiksi:

  • kokemuksesta liike-, toimitila-, varasto- tai logistiikkakiinteistöjen suunnittelusta

  • kokemuksesta sekä saneeraus- että uudisrakentamisesta

  • KVR-hankkeiden tuntemuksesta

  • sähköasentajataustasta ja sen tuomasta käytännön ymmärryksestä

  • Revit-osaamisesta

  • kokemuksesta mittauksista, kuntoarvioinneista, lämpökuvauksista, valvonnasta tai muista sähköteknisistä asiantuntijatehtävistä

  • olemassa olevasta sähkösuunnittelupätevyydestä tai koulutus- ja kokemustaustasta, joka antaa valmiudet vaativan tason pätevyyden hakemiseen.

Kaikkea yllä mainittua lisäosaamista ei tarvitse löytyä samasta paketista. Meille tärkeintä on vahva tekninen perusta, laadukas tekeminen, kyky ottaa vastuuta ja asenne, jolla asioita viedään yhdessä eteenpäin.

Miksi INTEC?

Olemme edelleen siinä vaiheessa kasvutarinaa, jossa uusilla ihmisillä on aidosti mahdollisuus vaikuttaa siihen, miten asioita teemme.

Pääset vaikuttamaan, et vain sopeutumaan valmiiseen malliin.
Meillä hyvä idea voidaan viedä nopeasti käytäntöön. Jos asiakastyössä huomataan, että jokin työkalu, osaaminen tai palvelu puuttuu, asiaa voidaan lähteä ratkaisemaan joustavasti asiakkaan tarve edellä. Päätöksenteko on nopeaa, turhaa byrokratiaa on vähän ja työntekijöiden omia ajatuksia halutaan kuulla.

Voit vaikuttaa myös omaan työnkuvaasi.
Meille on tärkeää kuunnella, mikä ihmisiä omassa työssään motivoi. Kaikkien ei tarvitse rakentaa samanlaista uraa tai tehdä täsmälleen samanlaista työnkuvaa. Olemme pystyneet yhdistämään sähkösuunnittelijoiden työhön heidän oman kiinnostuksensa mukaan esimerkiksi mittauksia, kuntoarviointeja, lämpökuvauksia, valvontaa ja muita asiantuntijatehtäviä.

Tässä haussa etsimme nimenomaan kokenutta sähkösuunnittelijaa, joten suunnittelu säilyy tehtävän vahvana ytimenä. Työnkuvaa voidaan kuitenkin kehittää ajan myötä oman osaamisesi, kiinnostuksesi ja motivaatiosi mukaan.

Johto on lähellä tekemistä.
Suunnittelupalveluitamme johtava Antti Heikkilä ja toimitusjohtajamme Joona Lahti ovat molemmat itse suunnittelutaustaisia ja edelleen mukana asiakasprojekteissa. Organisaatiossamme ei ole kerroksia tekemisen ja päätöksenteon välissä.

Projektit eivät mahdu yhteen muottiin.
Pääset työskentelemään erilaisten asiakkaiden, kiinteistöjen ja toimeksiantojen kanssa. Tarjolla on sekä nopeatempoisia pienempiä projekteja että pidempiä ja laajempia hankkeita. Työ ei myöskään rajoitu pelkästään suunnittelupöydän ääreen, vaan oman kiinnostuksesi mukaan tekemiseen voidaan yhdistää myös käytännön kenttätyötä.

Pienen talon ketteryys yhdistyy pohjoismaiseen verkostoon.
INTEC on osa Instalco-konsernia ja laajempaa pohjoismaista INTEC-verkostoa. Tarvittaessa käytettävissä on myös konsernin muuta suunnittelu- ja urakointiosaamista esimerkiksi ratkaisujen toteutettavuuden ja kustannusten sparraamiseen.

Arki saa myös joustaa.
Tehtävä voidaan sijoittaa Tampereelle tai Helsingin Käpylään, ja etätyötä voi tehdä joustavasti. Käytännöistä voidaan sopia elämäntilanteen mukaan. Meillä tärkeämpää on, että yhteistyö toimii ja työt etenevät kuin se, missä työpöytä tiettynä päivänä sijaitsee.

Palkitseminen huomioi kokemuksesi ja osaamisesi.
Palkka muodostuu kokemuksesi, osaamisesi ja tehtävän kokonaisuuden perusteella. Myös vahva tekninen asiantuntijuus huomioidaan, eikä palkkakehitys edellytä meillä automaattisesti siirtymistä projektipäälliköksi. Palkan päälle on mahdollista saada myös tulospalkkiota. Palkkatasosta ja omista odotuksistasi keskustellaan avoimesti heti ensimmäisessä keskustelussa Nawian kanssa.

Työyhteisöön panostetaan myös projektien ulkopuolella.
Työyhteisöämme on kuvattu välittömäksi, avoimeksi ja helposti lähestyttäväksi. Järjestämme INTEC Sport -liikuntaa, yhteisiä aamupaloja, afterworkeja sekä erilaisia tiimi- ja yritystapahtumia. Helsingin Käpylän toimistolta löytyvät myös kuntosali ja darts-taulu. Henkilöstöetuihin kuuluvat lisäksi ePassi, lounasetu ja työterveyshuolto Mehiläisessä.

Asenne & arvot: teemme hommat rohkeasti omalla tyylillä, asiakkaan paras mielessä, aina.

Meille on tärkeää, että työpaikalla voi keskustella avoimesti, kehitysideoita uskaltaa tuoda esiin ja apua saa silloin, kun sitä tarvitsee.

Kiinnostuitko?

Rekrytointi toteutetaan yhteistyössä rekrytointikumppanimme Nawian kanssa.

Jätä hakemuksesi viimeistään sunnuntaina 20.9.2026. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja etenemme sopivien hakijoiden kanssa mahdollisuuksien mukaan jo ennen hakuajan päättymistä.

Ensimmäiset keskustelut tehtävästä käy Nawian rekrytointikonsultti Jari Auronen. Voit olla Jariin yhteydessä myös ennen hakemuksen jättämistä, mikäli haluat keskustella tehtävästä luottamuksellisesti.

Seuraavassa vaiheessa valitut kandidaatit tapaavat INTECin rekrytoivan esihenkilön Antti Heikkilän ja toimitusjohtajan Joona Lahden kasvotusten INTECin Käpylän toimistolla. Haastattelut järjestetään alustavan aikataulun mukaan syyskuun lopussa ja lokakuun alussa.

Rekrytointiprosessista vastaa Nawian konsultti Jari Auronen, johon voit olla yhteydessä prosessin aikana milloin tahansa.

title: Senior Software Engineer, AI
description:
Senior Software Engineer, AI

Practice by Numbers (PBN) | Gurugram, India Scope: AI / Conversational Products & Backend Services

About Practice by Numbers
Practice by Numbers is a dental practice management SaaS platform serving over 1,500 practices across North America — practice management software, VOIP, payment processing, and analytics. We're now expanding into AI-powered automation, building conversational AI products that change how practices interact with their patients.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer with strong, hands-on experience in both backend product engineering and modern AI systems. The ideal candidate can design and build reliable, production-grade services while also developing, integrating, and deploying AI-powered capabilities. As this is a single opening on a small team, we need someone who can take end-to-end ownership across both areas and contribute independently throughout the product development lifecycle.

You'll work on our AI Receptionist — a multi-channel conversational AI (voice, SMS, web chat) for dental practices — and the backend services, APIs, and integrations behind it. Hands-on IC role: you own features end to end, including their production behaviour. Real patient-facing traffic under HIPAA constraints, where correctness and latency both matter.

Reports to: Lead Engineer — AI Location: Gurugram, India — this role is open in Gurugram only Work Mode: In-office Working Hours: Primarily IST (10 AM – 5 PM), with some evening overlap with US teams (until 9–11 PM IST) as needed

What You'll Do

Backend

  • Build and maintain backend services and RESTful APIs in Python (FastAPI / Django)
  • Design schemas and write efficient PostgreSQL queries; use Redis for caching and session state
  • Work with async and event-driven patterns — queues, webhooks, WebSockets, background workers
  • Own the operational side: logging, metrics, alerting, debugging production issues
  • Write unit and integration tests for the business logic you ship

AI & LLM

  • Own the conversation layer for real-time voice — turn-taking, barge-in, and recovery when the agent talks over a caller or stalls mid-turn
  • Debug non-deterministic failures in production: fabricated confirmations, invented practice policies, dropped context across turns
  • Own patient identity resolution over the phone — misheard and misspelled names, shared phone numbers, multi-algorithm phonetic matching
  • Version prompts and tool schemas like code: canary changes, measure impact, roll back regressions
  • Own the eval and regression suite — golden conversation sets, replay of production calls, CI gating on prompt and model changes
  • Design guardrails for patient-facing interactions: no medical advice, no unverified data disclosure, tool-call authorization, PHI excluded from logs and traces, escalation to a human when the agent should stop
  • Own the model and voice vendor abstraction so a provider change is configuration, not a rewrite
  • Keep voice, SMS, and web chat consistent — shared state and knowledge base, channel- appropriate behaviour

Integrations & Data

  • Integrate with practice management systems (Dentrix, Open Dental, Eaglesoft) and internal PBN APIs
  • Implement secure auth flows, including OTP-based patient verification
  • Define SLOs for conversation success and turn latency; own incident response and postmortems for this surface

Collaboration

  • Work with Product Management to turn requirements into working software, surfacing edge cases early
  • Participate in sprint planning, standups, code reviews, and product reviews
  • Document what you build; collaborate across time zones with US-based stakeholders

Required Qualifications

Experience

  • 4+ years of professional software development experience
  • Hands-on experience building backend services and APIs that ran in production
  • Practical experience with LLM-based applications (GPT-4/4o, Claude, or similar) — prompt design, tool calling, handling model output in real systems. Substantial personal or open-source work counts; tutorial-level does not.
  • Experience debugging and improving a system after it shipped

Technical Skills

  • Strong Python — our primary language across AI and backend
  • APIs: RESTful services, webhooks, third-party integrations; FastAPI or Django preferred
  • Databases: PostgreSQL — schema design, indexing, query performance; Redis or similar
  • Async Python (asyncio) and event-driven architectures
  • Cloud: working knowledge of AWS (or GCP/Azure) — compute, storage, managed DBs, queues
  • Version control, code review, and CI/CD as normal parts of your workflow

AI Domain Understanding

  • Shipped an LLM system to real users and debugged it in production; can describe a failure mode you found and fixed
  • Specific view of what current models are unreliable at, and how that shapes what runs unsupervised versus behind a tool call or human review
  • Multi-turn conversation design — state that survives interruptions, topic switches, and mid-call corrections
  • Experience measuring LLM systems: offline evals, judge model calibration, or production quality metrics
  • Working knowledge of token cost and latency trade-offs, including where streaming helps and where it adds complexity

Soft Skills

  • Frame the problem, not just solve it; write down architectural decisions and the tradeoffs you rejected
  • Clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Able to drive your own work to completion without close supervision
  • Comfortable with a fast pace and evolving requirements
  • Willing to work in-office in Gurugram and overlap with US hours when needed

Preferred Experience & Skills

  • Conversational AI — chatbots, voice assistants, or IVR
  • Voice/telephony (Twilio, Vonage) or STT/TTS APIs (Deepgram, ElevenLabs, AssemblyAI)
  • LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) — or a considered view on skippingthem
  • Healthcare / HIPAA compliance knowledge
  • SaaS or B2B product company background; multi-tenant architecture

description:

Please review the following job description:

The Open Source Software (OSS) Senior Security Engineer owns the practical execution of open source software security across governance, engineering workflows, tooling, automation, and risk reduction. The role combines security program leadership with hands-on technical delivery to build secure-by-default OSS lifecycle capabilities and reduce software supply chain exposure.

Responsibility for OSS security governance, software supply chain security, engineering enablement, CI/CD control integration, and proactive management of dependency, build, package, artifact, and provenance risks. The Open Source Software and Software Supply Chain Security Senior Engineer is responsible for defining and operating enterprise governance, standards, processes, and preventative controls that enable the secure use of open source software and reduce software supply chain risk across the software development lifecycle. This role partners closely with CI/CD, DevSecOps, application security, engineering, platform, and risk teams to ensure open source components, build pipelines, artifacts, package sources, and release processes are approved, continuously monitored, remediated, and safely integrated into enterprise applications and delivery pipelines.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Following is a summary of the essential functions for this job. Other duties may be performed, both major and minor, which are not mentioned below. Specific activities may change from time to time.

  • Governance and Standards: Define policies, standards, and control requirements for approved open source usage, dependency hygiene, SBOM generation, secure package sourcing, and software supply chain risk management.
  • Secure OSS Lifecycle Management: Establish processes for OSS intake, approval, tracking, ownership, version management, vulnerability remediation, end-of-life component retirement, and exception governance.
  • CI/CD Preventative Controls: Work with CI/CD and platform engineering teams to design and implement automated security gates for curated OSS usage, dependency scanning, license checks, artifact validation, provenance controls, build-time enforcement, and policy-based blocking of high-risk components.
  • Software Supply Chain Risk Reduction: Identify and reduce risks related to vulnerable dependencies, malicious packages, dependency confusion, typosquatting, compromised maintainers, insecure build artifacts, and unauthorized package sources.
  • Software Supply Chain Security: Establish controls for trusted package sources, dependency provenance, build integrity, artifact signing, repository hygiene, tamper resistance, and secure release practices.
  • Threat Response and Incident Detection: Establish capabilities to rapidly identify, assess, and respond to open source supply chain threats, malicious package campaigns, zero-day vulnerabilities, compromised dependencies, and software supply chain security incidents.
  • Tooling and Automation: Support the deployment, tuning, and integration of software composition analysis, SBOM, package repository, vulnerability management, and developer workflow tools.
  • Risk Reporting and Metrics: Develop reporting that measures OSS risk posture, remediation velocity, policy exceptions, adoption of preventative controls, and reduction of high-risk dependencies.
  • Developer Enablement: Create guidance, playbooks, reusable patterns, and consultation models that help engineering teams make secure open source decisions early in the lifecycle.

Qualifications
Required Qualifications
The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent education, training, and work-related experience.
  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in security engineering or related cybersecurity roles.
  • Deep specialized knowledge in cybersecurity principles, theories, and concepts.
  • Proven experience in software development lifecycle security practices.
  • Deep knowledge of threat modeling, security testing, and penetration testing.
  • Experience implementing and managing complex information security technologies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced cybersecurity certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CEH, GIAC).
  • Experience with security automation, orchestration, and advanced threat detection tools.
  • Familiarity with emerging cybersecurity technologies, industry trends, and strategic risk management.
  • Experience in application security, software supply chain security, DevSecOps, vulnerability management, secure engineering, or related cybersecurity functions.
  • Strong understanding of open source software governance, dependency management, SBOM, SCA, secure SDLC, CI/CD pipelines, and software supply chain threats.
  • Working knowledge of relevant security and software supply chain frameworks and standards, including OWASP, NIST Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF), Supply-chain Levels for Software Artifacts (SLSA), and related secure development guidance.
  • Experience applying software supply chain security practices, including provenance, build integrity, artifact signing, secure package repositories, dependency trust, and CI/CD pipeline hardening.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD platforms, source code management, package managers, build systems, artifact repositories, and developer workflows.
  • Experience with scripting or automation using languages such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar.
  • Ability to partner directly with engineering, platform, cloud, risk, audit, and compliance stakeholders to explain risk clearly and provide practical remediation guidance.
  • Ability to translate technical risk into executive-ready reporting, measurable outcomes, and actionable remediation plans.

The annual base salary for this position is $140,000 - $180,000. Additional incentive pay is available for this position.

description:

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

IMS Forecast Specialist II

Location: Hyderabad, India

Role Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented Forecast Specialist to develop, maintain, and analyze project and study forecasts that support operational and financial decision-making. The role requires close collaboration with Clinical Operations, Finance, Project Management, and cross-functional teams to ensure forecast accuracy, identify risks, and provide actionable business insights.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain project/study forecasts using operational and financial data.
  • Analyze forecast assumptions, trends, and variances against actual performance.
  • Monitor enrollment, milestones, site activations, and project timelines to improve forecast accuracy.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather forecast inputs and validate assumptions.
  • Support monthly and quarterly forecasting cycles, governance reviews, and management reporting.
  • Identify forecast risks, data quality issues, and potential financial impacts.
  • Conduct scenario planning and sensitivity analysis.
  • Create dashboards, reports, and executive summaries to support business decisions.
  • Drive process improvements and forecasting automation initiatives.

Required Qualifications

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in forecasting, business analytics, resource planning, clinical operations, project management, or related areas.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, Power Query, XLOOKUP / VLOOKUP.
  • Experience with forecasting models and reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to work across multiple functions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in Clinical Research, CRO, Biotechnology, or pharmaceutical industries.
  • Knowledge of enrollment forecasting, investigator grants forecasting, project financial management, and resource planning.
  • Familiarity with CTMS, EDC, Oracle, Power BI, or similar forecasting platforms.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Biotechnology, Finance, Statistics, Economics, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

Get to know Syneos Health


Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

Required to become a Certified Medical Interpreter within 6 months of employment

Job Summary: The Patient Services Specialist (PSS) is part of a cross-trained team that performs the following processes necessary for efficient operational function of a health center: pre-registration, registration, appointment confirmation, scheduling, and answer inbound phone calls. The position is responsible for greeting the patient and providing quality customer service. Receives co-payments and gives appropriate receipts to patients, and records payments in practice management system. Verifies insurance information, assists with enrollment in sliding fee and other benefit products. Scans patient related documents to electronic health record (EHR). This is a non-exempt, full-time position in pay grade 1 with the pay range of $16.17 - $19.41. The Patient Service Specialist reports directly to the Practice Manager and/or Operations Director.

Required Skills/Abilities:

  • Must be proficient with technology and computer skills including Microsoft software.
  • Must have basic math skills.
  • The ability to handle cash and accurately complete bank deposit slips.
  • Medical or dental terminology a plus.

Education and Experience:

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Previous customer service experience
  • Preferred experience in various medical settings to include medical, dental, or behavioral health.

Working Conditions and Physical Requirements:

  • Primarily office-based work
  • Travel to various sites required

Standards of Behavior:

  • Commitment To Service
  • Respect
  • Quality
  • Teamwork
  • Patient Focus
  • Integrity
  • Accountability
  • Caring & Compassion
  • Professionalism
  • Listening & Responding
  • Safety
  • AIDET

Job Related Competencies:

  • Empathetic Outlook- The ability to perceive and understand the feelings and attitudes of others; the ability to place oneself “in the shoes” of another and to view a situation from their perspective.
  • Attention to Detail- The ability to process detailed information effectively and consistently.
  • Problem Solving- Identifies and analyzes problems weighing the relevance and accuracy of available information. Generates and evaluates alternative solutions and makes effective and timely decisions.
  • Communicates Effectively- Developing and delivering multi-mode communication that conveys a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  • Values And Ethics- Serving with integrity and respect in personal and organizational practices. Ensuring decisions and transactions are transparent and fair.
  • Time Management- The ability to effectively manage one’s time and resources to ensure that work is completed efficiently.

Commitment to Community:

Choptank Community Health System (CCHS) is committed to creating a safe and open healthcare environment that improves health outcomes and values and respects the unique experiences and perspectives of both patients and staff by:

  • Prioritizing access for all individuals;
  • Offering ongoing training for staff to promote health awareness, preventive measures and early detection for the varied patient population on the Eastern Shore;
  • Actively engaging with patients, families and staff;
  • Fostering a workplace culture in which everyone is treated with dignity.

Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Customer Service
    • Greets patients in a professional manner as they enter the health center.
    • Demonstrates AIDET with all patients, guests, and staff interactions.
    • Consistently answers calls within 3rd ring.
    • Always follows established procedures for handling patient calls and visits.
    • Communicates with patients in a professional manner on the telephone.
  • Notifies Triage Registered Nurse of all emergent patient phone calls as per triage policy.
    • Adheres to and models CCHS Standards of Behavior
    • Works with the clinical staff to coordinate patient flow
    • Keeps patients informed of wait times.
    • Addresses patient concerns with site-based leadership in a timely and responsive manner.
    • Always maintain patient confidentiality.
  • Appointment scheduling
    • Accurately and thoroughly schedule patients according to schedule templates and scheduling guidelines.
    • Informs patients of past due balances, copays, and sliding fee renewal dates when scheduling appointments.
    • Actively manages appointment waitlist.
    • Strives to meet a first call resolution with inbound patient calls.
  • Perform confirmation calls per the appointment reminder procedure.
    • Documents no show and cancel status in the practice management system.
    • Sends no show letters and tracks no show occurrences.
    • Manages same day requests in coordination with clinical team.
    • Follows dental emergency walk in procedure.
    • Reschedules patient appointments as needed.
    • Monitors schedule requests and tickler system for needed appointments.
    • Effectively troubleshoot errors in schedule with site-based leadership.
    • Proactively monitors schedules for provider PAL and meetings that will require appointment rescheduling.
    • Troubleshoots online portal scheduling errors.
    • End of day review verifying all appointments are checked out or documented as no show.
    • Prints the next day schedules for each provider daily.
  • Registration
    • Utilizes 3rd party registration system to update demographic data.
    • For patients unable to use electronic system, will enter and edit appropriate demographic data on patients accurately.
    • Verify demographics, contact numbers, and emergency contacts at every visit.
    • Verifies insurance eligibility and frequencies at every visit per established procedure for all scheduled patients.
    • Appropriate completion of noncovered forms for noncovered services, in accordance with insurance coverage.
    • Ensures sliding fee applications are offered to every patient and updated annually.
    • Determines patient’s eligibility with the sliding scale and verifies proof of income consistent with current policies.
    • Ensures all registration forms are completed during first appointment and verified at every visit and signatures are obtained annually
    • Ensures all insurance information is verified at every visit
    • For new patients, verifies that all required forms are completed prior to registration.
    • For established patients, ensures all registration forms are updated and signed annually.
    • Verifies and updates VFC status.
    • Updates patient’s preferred pharmacy.
    • Converts patients reaching the age of majority to their own guarantor.
  • Payment Collection
    • Receives copayments, self-payments, and gives appropriate receipts
    • Keeps money secure and balanced in locked cash drawer.
    • All monies collected are reconciled daily and placed in the safe at the end of day.
  • Financial Operations
    • Assists patients with billing issues, working with CCHS billing department.
    • End of day review performed in practice management system including collections and cash reconciliation.
  • Performs Other Duties as Required
    • Keeps electronic health record (EHR) buckets current, reviewing at least daily.
    • Takes initiative to solve problems, prioritizes effectively, and recommends improvements to site-based leadership.
    • Traveling to other CCHS locations to provide coverage as needed.
    • Consistently displays professionalism during interaction with CCHS customers, staff, and clinicians.
    • Attends and engages in weekly huddles, monthly site meetings, department meetings, and all staff meetings as required.
    • Maintains inventory of office supplies by communicating low stock to designated person.
    • Ensures the front desk area and patient waiting areas are neat and presentable to assure safe environment.
    • Responsible for mail and package deliveries.
    • Works with other staff to achieve a desirable working environment.
  • Regular, reliable attendance is a requirement of this job.

Benefits:

  • Tuition and education assistance
  • Certification scholarships available
  • Paid holidays (9)
  • Flexible paid time off and vacation scheduling
  • 403(b)
  • 403(b) matching
  • Employee assistance program
  • Flexible spending account
  • Health insurance
  • Dental insurance
  • Vision coverage
  • Life insurance
  • Referral program

title: Legal Expert in Health Innovation & Data Governance (f/m/d)
description:
Job title: Legal Expert in Health Innovation & Data Governance (f/m/d)


Job location: The Central Executive Management Office of BBMRI-ERIC in Graz, Austria (or exceptionally remote work)


Job purpose: As Legal Expert in Health Innovation & Data Governance, your expertise and motivation will make you a core member of the Department for Ethical, Legal & Societal Implications (ELSI) Services & Research. You will work at the centre of European health research, translating the GDPR, the European Health Data Space, the AI Act and the MDR/IVDR into workable governance that let biobanks, researchers and innovators share health data and samples lawfully across borders. You will help shape the future of our Research Infrastructure in Health and Life Sciences towards One Health, digitalization and global perspectives as overarching paradigms in line with BBMRI-ERIC’s 10-Year Roadmap 2025-2035 , which is currently implemented through BBMRI-ERIC’s Work Programme 2025-2027.


Contract: As work-life balance is a high priority at BBMRI-ERIC less than a full-time contract (40 hours/week) can be agreed (e.g. ~85%); also in conjunction with co-affiliation at a University.


Who we are:

BBMRI-ERIC is the European Research Infrastructure for biobanking and biomolecular resources established in 2013 under EU legislation. BBMRI-ERIC enables the development of innovative technology and processes as a cross-domain network that facilitates responsible access to high quality samples, data and biomolecular resources. We achieve this through multidisciplinary expertise and service provision, scientific excellence, knowledge exchange and partnerships in health and life sciences. BBMRI-ERIC’s vision is simplified as: “Biobanking for a Healthier World”. Its headquarters are in Graz, Austria.


BBMRI‐ERIC is an inclusive, equal‐opportunity employer offering attractive conditions and benefits appropriate to an international research organisation. Further information on the vision, mission, governance, and statutes of BBMRI‐ERIC can be found at .


Key Responsibilities:

  • “Sharp legal eye” is central to this role, therefore you will draft, review and negotiate the instruments that underpin cross-border health research i.e. data transfer, material transfer, data access and processing, joint-controllership, and consortium agreements etc.
  • With your profound legal knowledge and expertise you assess data access conditions, data management policies and data governance models against the GDPR and national law, advising on legal basis for secondary use, consent models, pseudonymisation and DPIAs;
  • You prepare BBMRI-ERIC and its Nodes for the European Health Data Space (Regulation (EU) 2025/327) in particular with data holder duties, access frameworks, secure processing environments and opt-out mechanisms;
  • With a high degree of personal responsibility, you work on demanding challenges like implementation of GDPR, the European Health Data Space (EHDS) and the participation and further development of the European Open Science Cloud (EOSC);
  • You advise where the AI Act and the MDR/IVDR meet health research and innovation, in particular focusing on conformity assesment and you follow EU regulatory developments and revisions;
  • Building and maintaining scientific relationships is supported by your clearly structured forms of communication and inspired by your legal expertise;
  • With your legal understanding, you not only liaise easily with external stakeholders but also work and grow within an ELSI team of interdisciplinary experts from the field of social sciences, life sciences, philosophy, bioethics and law.


In this role your required qualifications and skills are:

  • University degree in law (Master, LL.M., Magister/Diplom or equivalent);
  • PhD or an additional qualification in health law, data protection or bioethics would be an advantage;
  • Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience in health law with special focus on health data, research and development in life sciences and at least 3 years of experience in the scientific management of interdisciplinary and international projects (particularly Horizon Europe projects); previous involvement in leading and/or coordinating teams is considered an advantage;
  • Practical experience in drafting and negotiating various contracts and agreements e.g. DTAs, MTAs, DPAs and CAs etc.;
  • Advanced knowledge of GDPR in the sensitive health data domain, including informed consent, secondary use and data sharing (within the EU but also across the globe) and Ethics committees;
  • Working knowledge of the European Health Data Space, and of the AI Act and MDR/IVDR at the intersection with health research and innovation;
  • Good understanding of the EU-landscape of EU Research Infrastructures (ESFRI) is an advantage
  • Ability to follow EU regulatory developments and to translate them into practical advice for a non-legal audience;
  • Knowledge of the Biotech Act and the Clinical Trials Regulation is an advantage;
  • Sound knowledge of project management, and the ability to monitor legal and financial obligations and tasks with ease;
  • Presentation and moderation skills at EU and/or global level;
  • Independent and self-driven working style, with communication and organizational skills that bring teamwork to life;
  • Professional fluency in English, as English is the official working language of BBMRI-ERIC;
  • Ability to deal with challenges in a diplomatic manner;
  • Readiness for moderate travel.

If this role interests you and you bring a strong combination of relevant qualifications, skills, and professional experience, we encourage you to apply, even if you do not meet every requirement listed above. We value diverse backgrounds and perspectives and assess each application holistically, recognizing the unique strengths and contributions that every candidate can bring to our team.

Employment terms and conditions

As we aim to provide a diverse work environment, the work can be performed at the headquarters in Graz with occasional telework options or exceptionally remotely.

The employment follows the Austrian employment law.

What we offer

A minimum annual gross salary of €80,000.00 (based on 40hours/week) will be offered, aligned with European and international standards for comparable roles and responsibilities. The final salary will be determined based on the candidate’s qualifications and experience.


A unique opportunity to work at the center of a European‑level organisation, the role carries significant responsibility and visibility, all within an international, diverse, and intellectually stimulating environment that supports professional development and insight into European-level cooperation.


Balance your free time and your working life independently according to your own ideas: With our flexible working hours, you decide when you work outside our core working hours and you can also take advantage of occasional telework.


A multifaceted, challenging range of tasks with responsibility in a co-operative working environment with flat hierarchies and short decision-making paths, characterise your day-to-day work. Becoming part of BBMRI-ERIC enables interdisciplinary and cross-professional opportunities for collaboration across Europe and beyond.


In addition to the diversity of the various scientific disciplines, we offer a working culture in which diversity is lived and highly valued.


We secure your future: with our comprehensive fringe benefits like complementary health insurance (in addition to public insurance, ÖGK), and a private pension scheme for employments in Austria we take care of your well-being.


Located on the 6th floor of a modern building at the Medical University campus, our comfortable office sits in Graz’s biomedical community and provides an English‑speaking work environment with great networking opportunities.


When you’re not teleworking, convenient tram and bus connections make commuting easy, and a variety of restaurants, bakeries, and grocery stores are within walking distance.


To learn more about working at BBMRI-ERIC, visit .


Equal opportunities

BBMRI-ERIC is committed to providing equal opportunities to all qualified candidates, regardless of their personal characteristics.


Application procedure

For applications to be considered, candidates must submit for their application via our online portal BambooHR:

  • A Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • A letter of motivation or a video link in which you introduce yourself and your application motivation
  • Supporting documents (copies of High School, University and PhD degrees, references, list of publications and project involvements, etc.)


Application deadline is 4 October 2026; anticipated start of work is as soon as possible.


In case of any questions, please contact: Ulrike Rohrer, HR Specialist (ulrike.rohrer@bbmri-eric.eu)

Your Next Career Opportunity – Databricks Administration Specialist

The Databricks Administration Specialist is a hands-on individual contributor role within the Database Engineering team at SBA Communications, responsible for provisioning, administering, and governing the enterprise Databricks platform on Microsoft Azure. Reporting to the Manager, Database Engineering, this position requires a technically skilled professional with deep expertise in Databricks workspace administration, Unity Catalog, identity and access management, infrastructure as code, and Azure data platform integration. The Databricks Administration Specialist will work closely with the Cloud Engineering team to ensure infrastructure-level alignment across Azure networking, storage, and security, and will serve as the primary infrastructure lead. The role plays a critical part in enforcing data governance standards, maintaining the Medallion architecture, supporting EDW/ODS platform operations, and ensuring the Databricks environment meets organizational security, compliance, and cost management requirements.

What You Will Do – Primary Responsibilities

  • Databricks Platform Administration & Engineering: Provision, configure, and manage Databricks workspaces in Azure, including cluster policies, SQL Warehouses, compute governance, and workspace-level security hardening. Enforce secure cluster connectivity and no-policy cluster restrictions in alignment with EDW/ODS platform standards.

  • Unity Catalog & Data Governance: Administer and maintain Databricks Unity Catalog as the system of record for data access governance, including catalog/schema structure, RBAC/ACL policies, row-level and column-level security, data lineage registration, and metadata tagging. Partner with the Manager, Database Engineering to enforce data governance standards and segregation of duties.

  • Identity & Access Management: Manage Databricks user provisioning via SCIM/Automatic Identity Management integrated with Azure Active Directory/Entra ID. Maintain access control matrices, conduct quarterly access reviews (QAR), and ensure MFA enforcement and local password disablement align with organizational policy.

  • Infrastructure as Code & Automation: Design and manage infrastructure provisioning using Terraform and Databricks Asset Bundles (DAB). Support CI/CD pipeline promotion across Dev, QA, and Production environments via Azure DevOps. Maintain repository structure and branching standards per SDLC guidelines.

  • Medallion Architecture Support: Maintain and optimize the Bronze/Silver/Gold medallion zoning architecture within Databricks. Ensure data retention policies, naming/tagging standards, and Unity Catalog object hierarchy align with enterprise data architecture standards.

  • Monitoring, Cost Management & DR: Configure and maintain monitoring using Databricks System Tables, cluster and job-level alerting, and Azure Monitor integration. Manage DBU consumption tracking, right-sizing, and cost guardrails. Support backup and disaster recovery planning in alignment with defined RTO/RPO targets.

  • Collaboration with Cloud & Database Teams: Work closely with the Cloud Engineering team to ensure Databricks infrastructure integrates seamlessly with Azure networking, storage (ADLS Gen2), and security components including ExpressRoute, VNets, and firewall rules. Serve as the infrastructure handoff point to the Databricks Senior Data Engineer for pipeline and workload delivery.

  • Security & Compliance: Collaborate with cybersecurity and compliance teams to enforce data platform security controls including data masking/tokenization in non-production environments, audit logging, access reviews, and SOX/segregation of duties requirements.

  • Documentation & Process Improvement: Maintain accurate platform documentation and contribute to SDLC artifacts, change management templates, and runbooks for Databricks operations and incident response.

  • Continuous Learning: Stay current with evolving Databricks capabilities, Azure data platform developments, Unity Catalog enhancements, and data engineering best practices. Recommend platform improvements that enhance reliability, cost-efficiency, and governance.

  • Other Duties: Completes other projects and duties as assigned.

What You’ll Need – Qualifications & Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, MIS or equivalent;

    • and 3-5 years of progressive experience in data platform or cloud infrastructure engineering, with hands-on expertise in Databricks or Microsoft Azure and enterprise data governance practices.

  • Databricks Certified Data Engineer preferred.

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104) preferred.

  • Expert level competencies in:

    • Databrick Platform Administration (workspaces, cluster policies, SQL Warehouses),

    • Unity Catalog & Data Governance (RBAC, Lineage, row/column-level security)

  • Advanced level competencies in:

    • Azure Data Platform Integration (ALDS Gen2, Azure Networking, Entra ID/SCIM,

    • Medallion Architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold/ Delta/Lake),

    • Monitoring, Cost Management & DR (System Tables, DBU tracking, RTO/RPO)

  • Strong level competencies in:

title: Principal AI & Agent Systems Engineer (gn) @ Fusion Energy Venture, Munich
description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.

About the Venture

We are building a new path to fusion energy. Every major leap in human civilisation has followed a breakthrough in energy, from fire to steam to electricity, and we believe fusion is the next one. Our bet is that it will not come from building bigger machines. It will come from controlling matter with enough precision that fusion becomes a manufacturable technology, atoms aligned exactly enough that fusion happens under controlled conditions, on a chip. This is a semiconductor-scale path to clean power, and our stance is precision over brute force. We start in physics and simulation, then build the physical proof.

About the Role

Reaching a chip-scale approach means working through physics and simulation at a depth that is hard to reach by conventional means, and to do that we need a new class of scientific intelligence. You will work directly with the founders to design that system from the ground up: an AI-driven research platform that can read papers, connect ideas across disciplines, orchestrate simulations, evaluate hypotheses and learn from results. This is not a chatbot or prompt engineering role, and we are not building a foundation model or competing with OpenAI, Anthropic or Google. We believe these systems will need richer representations than today's token-prediction models, so you will help explore new architectures for scientific reasoning, memory, hypothesis generation and autonomous discovery. The better that system works, the faster we get to the physical proof.

What you'll do

  • Design multi-agent research systems and the orchestration that ties them together

  • Build long-term memory architectures for scientific reasoning

  • Create paper ingestion and knowledge extraction pipelines

  • Develop scientific reasoning workflows and connect AI agents to simulation environments

  • Build autonomous experiment and evaluation loops

  • Design retrieval, planning and orchestration systems

  • Integrate state-of-the-art LLMs and open-source models

  • Develop scalable infrastructure for continuous learning

  • Explore next-generation AI architectures for scientific discovery

About You

We care far more about what you have built than about formal credentials. You will thrive here if you enjoy solving problems nobody has solved before, learn quickly and independently, and are comfortable with uncertainty. This role suits someone who wants to help create a new category of scientific intelligence rather than optimise an existing product.

  • You have already built real agent systems, with strong experience across several of: multi-agent architectures, tool use and function calling, agent orchestration, planning systems, long-term memory, knowledge graphs, autonomous research workflows, RAG architectures and evaluation frameworks

  • You write production-quality software with strong Python skills, and you are comfortable with API design and integration

  • You know your way around cloud infrastructure, Docker and containerisation, and databases including vector databases

  • You are comfortable with the mathematical ideas this work draws on, such as linear algebra, optimisation, probability, graph theory and dynamical systems

  • You do not need to be a theoretical physicist, but you should enjoy working on highly technical scientific problems

Nice to have:

  • Physics simulations, scientific computing or computational physics

  • HPC environments

  • Reinforcement learning

  • AI for Science

  • Quantum computing

  • Scientific publishing workflows

  • Open-source AI frameworks

Why Join

  • Our goal is bigger than software. The systems you build will be used to accelerate research in fusion energy, scientific discovery, advanced simulation, AI for physics and quantum technologies. Success here is measured in real scientific progress.

  • Work with an exceptional founding team with scientific and commercial track records across places like LMU, Apple, Amazon, Eurazeo, Sprin-D and McKinsey. Around them is a small group of physicists, simulation experts and AI specialists who value curiosity, independent thinking and the courage to challenge assumptions.

  • We are remote-first, so you can work from Munich, Berlin, London, Lisbon or wherever you do your best work. We keep bureaucracy to a minimum so talented people can move fast and follow promising ideas.

  • This is a chance to help build something before it becomes obvious, and to help solve one of humanity's hardest problems.

title: Worker Care Specialist
description:
Worker Care Specialist

Location: Leeds / Hybrid

Contract: Permanent

Hours: 37.5 per week

We are seeking a detail-focused Worker Care Specialist to manage worker contractual administration, pre‑payroll and pre‑invoicing activities. The role ensures compliance with regulations and client SLAs, accurate and timely pay and invoicing, and a positive experience for workers and stakeholders.

Key responsibilities

  • Manage end-to-end worker administration including document verification, contract issuance and amendments/extensions, medical checks (where required), qualification/certificate tracking and exit documentation.

  • Prepare and review pre‑payroll and pre‑invoice packs to ensure accuracy ahead of pay runs and client billing.

  • Respond promptly to worker and operational queries about pay, contracts and administration, providing clear, accurate information.

  • Monitor time and attendance data, process timesheets and absence records, and manage adjustments including bonuses, deductions and other pay variances.

  • Ensure ongoing compliance with legislation, client requirements and internal processes; identify and escalate risks or changes that may impact pay, invoicing or margin.

  • Work closely with Operations, Sales, Payroll and Finance to resolve issues, control labour costs and protect margin, maintaining clear communication and ownership.

  • Support continuous improvement initiatives, contribute to process documentation and act as a subject-matter contact for the Care Team and apprentices.

What we’re looking for

Experience in workforce administration, HR operations or payroll coordination (staffing/agency back-office experience desirable). Strong attention to detail, ability to meet deadlines, excellent stakeholder communication and confidence using systems and data to drive accurate outcomes.

Skills and competencies

  • Proven accuracy and attention to detail when handling transactional data.

  • Good working knowledge of UK payroll principles and related compliance requirements.

  • Strong IT skills, including experience with payroll/ATS/ERP systems and confident Excel usage.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication with internal and external stakeholders.

  • Organised, able to prioritise multiple tasks and work to strict deadlines.

  • Customer-centric approach with a focus on delivering a positive worker experience.

Why join us

Join a collaborative team where your attention to detail and process focus will directly contribute to smooth pay and billing operations, strong client relationships and an excellent worker experience. This is an ideal role for someone seeking a hands-on, operational position with opportunities to influence improvement.
