title: Associate Director,  Residence Life
description:
Associate Director, Residence Life
Westminster University

Position Type: Full-Time, Benefited

Work Location: Westminster University Campus

1840 South 1300 East

Salt Lake City, UT 84105

What we offer:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Paid Family and Medical Leave
  • 403(b) Retirement Plan with a 5.5% employer contribution
  • Tuition Remission (after a qualifying period of employment)
  • 18 Paid Holidays Annually
  • Cell Phone Plan Discounts


Please apply directly through Westminster University's Career Job Posting.

A completed application will include:

  • Resume
  • Cover letter that describes how your previous experience will contribute to this role and the Westminster community.
  • Three professional references with their full name, job title, organization name, relationship to the applicant, and contact information.


Please submit all required documents through the single Dropbox provided during your application.

About the Role:

As an integral member of the Division of Student Affairs, the Associate Director reports to the Director of Residence Life and Student Dining and provides leadership in the development and administration of a comprehensive, preeminent residence life program. This position advances a high-impact residential experience for approximately 600 students across five residence hall communities.

The Associate Director has primary responsibility for departmental operations, including housing occupancy management, facilities management, risk management, coordination of summer camps and conferences, and the implementation of short- and long-term departmental projects. The position also cultivates and maintains collaborative partnerships with key university departments, including Athletics, Facilities, Campus Safety and Security, the Dean of Students Office, Student Accounts, Student Engagement and Belonging, and Disability Services.

The Associate Director participates in a rotating on-call schedule and serves as a primary responder to student concerns and crises, reported incidents, alleged policy violations, and emergencies affecting the residential community.

This is a 12-month, full-time, benefited position. The Associate Director is required to reside on campus and will be provided a semi-furnished, non-taxable residence, including utilities, internet, cable, and a parking pass, as part of the compensation package and in direct support of the operational responsibilities of the position.

Student Affairs at Westminster is committed to creating an environment that encourages students' exploration of self while pursuing community and working toward academic success. Westminster is a private comprehensive liberal arts institution with a deep commitment preparing students to lead lives of learning, accomplishment, and service and to help them develop skills and attributes vital for success in a diverse and interdependent world.

Westminster centralizes engaged learning that emphasizes theory and practice academic, co-curricular and extra-curricular programs. A culture of imagination and innovation with a committed practice of inclusiveness and respect for differences. Westminster University is in the trendy walkable Sugar House neighborhood with easy access to the Rocky Mountains, downtown Salt Lake City, and many of Utah's natural wonders.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree from an accredited institution in College Student Personnel, Higher Education Administration or related field.
  • Minimum of two years of professional experience in university housing, residence life, conference services or related student affairs work.
  • Working knowledge of FERPA, Clery, Title IX, ADA and Section 504, and related higher education laws.
  • Demonstrated experience working with college students.
  • Demonstrated experience supervising professional staff and leading teams.
  • Demonstrated knowledge and commitment to advancing diverse, equitable, inclusive, and accessible communities.
  • Leadership competencies and skills in problem-solving, responding to crises and emergencies of varying severity, and operational execution.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working with on-campus living, residential populations.
  • Experience with case management, housing management, or student information systems such as Personna, eRezLife, Star Rez, Ellucian Colleague, Advocate or Maxient.

Responsibilities:

Principle Duties and Responsibilities

  • Education, Engagement & Student Success:
  • Promote student learning, leadership development, and success through intentional programming and community-building efforts.
  • Serve as a departmental Conduct Officer vested with authority to investigate and adjudicate allegations of non-academic misconduct consistent with procedures outlined in the Code of Conduct and as directed by the Assistant Dean of Students of Student Life and Operations.
  • Facilitate various alternative dispute and conflict resolution processes (e.g., mediation) in lieu of formal adjudication.
  • Collaborate with key academic affairs and student affairs partners to enhance student learning within residential communities.
  • Ensure proper storage of education records, documentation and administrative case management in Maxient student conduct database in compliance with FERPA, student privacy protections, and university policy.
  • Provide guidance and support to staff regarding student concerns, behavioral issues, and community dynamics.

Housing Operations and Administrative Management:

  • Work with professional and student staff to create and maintain a living and learning environment that supports the mission of Westminster University and Residence Life.
  • Provide leadership in ongoing evaluation of services and program operations related to residence hall management and the residential student experience.
  • Responsible for preparing and maintaining operations timelines, such as reservations, assignments, communications, and move in and move out.
  • Develops and coordinates the room transfer process, winter break and summer term assignments, and the annual housing selection process, and waiting list processes.
  • Provide leadership and management for housing assignments including supervising room management workflow of Residence Life coordinators.
  • Monitor and report room occupancies, and other housing related operations; ensure rosters and occupancy reports are updated and current reflecting room assignment changes. Provide monthly and annual occupancy reports to the Director and appropriate departments and campus partners.
  • Coordinate yearly assignment configuration planning, maintain configuration rosters and floor plans to maximize occupancy, and report plans on maximizing occupancy to the Director.
  • Manage and maximize residence hall facility management software.
  • In conjunction with Student Accounts, manage room billing and housing related charges.
  • Lead and coordinate move-in and move-out processes including residence hall openings and closings.
  • Manage residential mail and package collection and distribution processes.


Facilities, Occupancy and Residential Services:

  • Coordinate with Facilities to minimize the impact of emergency and planned maintenance and facilities work on residents.
  • Collaborate closely with Facilities to report residence hall maintenance and custodial issues and monitor progress toward completion.
  • Oversee coordinated security of residence halls in partnership with Campus Security.
  • Coordinate with Campus Safety to schedule and facilitate fire drills and fire alarm inspections/testing within the residence halls
  • Work in conjunction with Disability Student Services on resident student accommodations.
  • Provide departmental leadership for identifying and assigning accessible living spaces.
  • Coordinate and manage the distribution and tracking of all residential keys and equipment, including card access and key replacements to residence hall facilities.
  • Coordinate with Facilities to establish the annual calendar of residence hall cleaning, maintenance, and inventory replacement.
  • Collaborate closely with Facilities on residence hall furniture inventory, storage, and replacement.
  • Market residence hall facilities with creativity and innovative methods.


Team Development and Supervision:

  • Directly supervise office student staff responsible for customer service regarding housing assignments and facilities, receiving emergency and crisis assistance requests from residents before passing to professional staff, and working on administrative projects.
  • Provides leadership and management of front desk services, including email and phone customer services; recurring check-in and checkout processes, including residence hall openings and closures, including but not limited to early arrivals, late stays, failed departures, etc.
  • Assist professional staff with student employee hiring, training, scheduling, and accountability.
  • Supervise and manage Community Leaders in the functional areas of residence hall facilities.
  • Manage student employment administrative processes.
  • Coordinate and/or deliver staff training related to technology, facilities, assignments, customer service, and overall housing operations.
  • Develop Community Leader training and ongoing education specific to institutional policy, standard operating procedures, protocols, and emergency response procedures to ensure Community Leaders are appropriately confronting and documenting behavioral issues and concerns.
  • Assist in the identification and delivery of departmental goal setting and performance evaluations for facilities and student staff.



Summer Conferences and External Housing Programs:

  • Coordinate and manage residential summer conferences program, including staff selection and training, logistics, emergency response.
  • Liaise with Campus Dining, Event Services, Campus Security, Facilities and other partners to coordinate all aspects of Summer Camps and Conferences.
  • Manage residential summer camp inquiries, sales, invoicing, and budget management.
  • Develop and maintain relationships and serve as a primary site contact for conference groups.
  • Coordinate housing arrangements for guests requiring on-campus housing during their camp or conference.


Leadership, Assessment and University Service:

  • Assist with departmental policy and procedure management; identify and develop needed departmental policies and procedures.
  • Assist Department Director with annual strategic planning and assessment.
  • Assist with department budget management, including processing purchases and tracking spending.
  • Meet regularly with Department Director to review operations.
  • Identify issues of area or departmental concern and take initiative to resolve or report them to director and assist in the identification of potential solutions.
  • Promote and maintain an atmosphere of excellent internal and external customer service within Residence Life.
  • Serve on divisional and other University committees/work groups as assigned.
  • Attend professional workshops, conferences, campus events, etc.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Equal Employment Opportunity:

Westminster University is committed to a diversified workforce, equal opportunity, and nondiscrimination. To this end, Westminster prohibits any form of discrimination or harassment based on race or ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identification, disabilities, genetic information, status as a veteran, or any other category or classification protected by applicable federal, state, or city laws.

title: Title Express Learning & Development Specialist
description:
Copart, Inc. a technology leader and the premier online vehicle auction platform globally, with over 200 facilities located across the world, Copart links vehicle sellers to more than 750,000 buyers in over 190 countries. We believe in providing an unmatched experience, every day and everywhere, driven by our people, processes, and technology.

Position Summary

The Learning & Development Specialist is responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and continuously improving high-quality learning solutions that support operational excellence across Title Express. This role partners with business leaders and subject matter experts to translate complex business processes into engaging, learner-centered training experiences that improve employee performance, operational consistency, and organizational effectiveness.

The Learning & Development Specialist serves as the department's learning design expert by developing instructor-led, virtual, eLearning, multimedia, and blended learning solutions while ensuring all learning materials remain current, accurate, and aligned with business objectives.

Although this role does not have direct supervisory responsibility, the Learning & Development Specialist may facilitate training sessions, workshops, onboarding programs, Train the Trainer initiatives, and other learning events based on business needs.

Essential Functions

Instructional Design & Development

  • Design, develop, implement, and maintain instructor-led, virtual, self-paced, and blended learning programs.

  • Conduct learning needs analyses in partnership with business leaders and subject matter experts.

  • Translate operational procedures, policies, and system enhancements into engaging, learner-focused curriculum.

  • Develop onboarding programs, role-based learning paths, continuing education, certification programs, and knowledge transfer initiatives.

  • Apply instructional design methodologies (ADDIE, SAM, Agile Learning, or similar) and adult learning principles to maximize learner engagement and knowledge retention.

  • Continuously evaluate and improve training materials based on business changes and learner feedback.

Multimedia & Digital Learning

  • Develop interactive eLearning courses and digital learning experiences.

  • Produce instructional videos, demonstrations, simulations, and scenario-based learning.

  • Design graphics, infographics, job aids, facilitator guides, participant materials, and quick reference resources.

  • Leverage AI-enabled technologies and learning tools to improve efficiency and learner engagement.

  • Maintain consistency in branding, formatting, and instructional standards across all learning assets.

Learning Facilitation

  • Facilitate instructor-led and virtual training sessions as business needs require.

  • Conduct Train the Trainer sessions for internal teams and external business partners.

  • Deliver onboarding, refresher training, workshops, webinars, and change management training.

  • Support major business initiatives through classroom instruction and knowledge transfer activities.

Learning Technology & Analytics

  • Develop knowledge assessments, competency validations, surveys, and evaluations.

  • Utilize Microsoft Forms and Learning Management Systems (LMS) to administer learning content and assessments.

  • Analyze learner feedback and training metrics to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

  • Monitor training effectiveness and recommend enhancements to improve business outcomes.

Business Partnership

  • Collaborate with operational leaders, project teams, and subject matter experts to identify learning needs.

  • Participate in enterprise initiatives requiring learning strategy, curriculum development, or organizational readiness.

  • Consult with stakeholders on the most effective instructional approach based on business objectives.

Content Governance

  • Maintain curriculum version control and documentation standards.

  • Ensure training materials remain compliant with current business processes and policies.

  • Conduct periodic audits of learning content to ensure accuracy and effectiveness.

  • Manage updates resulting from system enhancements, process changes, and organizational initiatives.

Continuous Improvement

  • Research industry trends, instructional design best practices, and emerging learning technologies.

  • Recommend innovative learning solutions that improve employee performance and scalability.

  • Identify opportunities to automate, modernize, and streamline learning experiences.

Competencies

Core Competencies

  • Instructional Design

  • Adult Learning Principles

  • Curriculum Development

  • Facilitation & Presentation Skills

  • Multimedia Content Development

  • Project Management

  • Written & Verbal Communication

  • Business Partnership

  • Critical Thinking

  • Problem Solving

  • Continuous Improvement

  • Innovation

  • Adaptability

  • Attention to Detail

  • Time Management

  • Collaboration

  • Customer Focus

Technical Competencies

  • Microsoft 365 Suite

  • Microsoft PowerPoint

  • Microsoft Forms

  • Learning Management Systems (LMS)

  • Video Editing Software

  • eLearning Authoring Tools

  • AI-assisted Content Development

  • Virtual Learning Platforms

Education & Experience

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Instructional Design, Education, Organizational Development, Human Resources, Communications, Business Administration, or a related field; or equivalent combination of education and professional experience.

  • Three (3) or more years of experience designing and developing corporate learning programs.

  • Experience facilitating instructor-led and virtual training.

  • Strong written communication and curriculum development skills.

  • Experience managing multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred

  • Five (5)+ years of instructional design experience.

  • Experience supporting operational or corporate learning environments.

  • Experience designing enterprise-level learning solutions.

  • Experience supporting organizational change initiatives.

Preferred Certifications

  • Certified Professional in Talent Development (CPTD)

  • Associate Professional in Talent Development (APTD)

  • ATD Instructional Design Certificate

  • Kirkpatrick Four Levels® Evaluation Certification

  • Prosci Change Management Certification

title: Operations Supervisor
description:
Summary

The successful Operations Supervisor directs safety, quality, and production for their assigned department and employees while administering SMS group Inc.’ policies and procedures. This is a great opportunity to join our growing team! Apply today!

Who we are

At SMS group, our people are our greatest asset. We offer entrepreneurial environment that promotes a culture of innovation, growth, and inclusion. We offer company events, activities, and opportunities to participate in charitable initiatives that benefit the communities where we are located.

What you'll do

  • Promotes safety initiatives and ensures safety policies are followed at all times.
  • Offers leadership regarding safety, quality, and productivity; offering guidance and direction to subordinates.
  • Maintains a strong shop floor presence to ensure policies and procedures are adhered to, and serves as the primary point of contact for questions and concerns.
  • Conducts hazard assessments to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Reviews production orders and schedules to ascertain product data such as types, quantities, and specifications of products and scheduled delivery dates in order to plan department operations accordingly.
  • Plans department/plant operations, establishing priorities and sequences for optimal productivity.
  • Prepares operational schedules and coordinates manufacturing activities to ensure production and quality of products meets specifications.
  • Reviews production and operating reports and resolves operational, manufacturing, and maintenance problems to reduce costs and prevent operational delays.
  • Inspects machines and equipment to ensure specific operational performance and optimum utilization.
  • Develops and revises operational procedures and observes workers to ensure compliance with these standards.
  • Resolves worker grievances or submits unsettled grievances to Production Superintendent for action.
  • Organizes production data and reports.
  • Directly supervises 0-20 non-supervisory employees.
  • Performs supervisory duties in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws.
  • Responsibilities include enforcing safety and quality policies; interviewing, hiring, and training employees in cooperation with Human Resources; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

What you'll need

  • 6 plus years of overall professional experience in management and/or specific discipline.
  • 4 plus years experience in a position of similar complexity, scope, size and impact.
  • Broad knowledge and experience in industrial manufacturing or repair gained at successive levels of responsibility in multiple areas of plant/factory/heavy industrial environment(s).
  • Knowledge of implementing and complying with corporate policies.
  • Demonstrated prior success in achieving results using team driven philosophies.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in supporting corporate interest from remote site locations, and the ability to communicate and exercise communication and interpersonal skills.

What we offer

Competitive compensation, medical/dental/vision coverage, paid vacation, paid holiday time, 401k with a company match, training, a tuition reimbursement program and more!

title: Speech Therapy (ST)
description:
Requirements:A master’s degree in communication sciences and disorders, certification as speech-language pathologist.

Alternately referred to as speech therapists, speech-language pathologists (or SLPs) work with children and adults who have problems with communication due to a birth defect, developmental disorder, accident or chronic condition. These professionals evaluate, diagnose and treat clients, taking a comprehensive approach to the individual. Here are some of the areas speech-language pathology addresses:

  • Articulation disorders
  • Language disorders
  • Fluency disorders
  • Voice and resonance disorders
  • Hearing disorders
  • Cognitive aspects of communication
  • Social aspects of communication
  • Augmentative and alternative communication modalities
  • Feeding and swallowing disorders

Speech Therapist Responsibilities:

  • Assessing, diagnosing, screening, and preventing language, speech, and swallowing disorders.
  • Communicating with the patient, and liaising with their family members, physicians, and teachers to design effective treatment plans.
  • Using tried and tested therapies in combination with new, innovative techniques to provide the best care.

This is a multidisciplinary role applying the foundation of automation, PAT, and AI for building next-generation data-rich analytical workflows and digital infrastructure for cell therapy development and manufacturing readiness.

The successful candidate will lead the design and implementation of automated analytical methods, integrated laboratory workflows, and practical AI-enabled capabilities that streamline operations and improve infrastructure efficiency. This individual will work at the intersection of analytical science, automation, digital integration, process understanding, and AI-enabled workflow optimization to enable scalable, compliant, and data-rich testing strategies that support product development, lifecycle management, QC transfer, operational decision-making, and real-time or near-real-time process insight.

Why this role matters: This role offers the opportunity to build capabilities that directly influence how analytical methods are developed, automated, transferred, sustained, and digitally scaled. The successful candidate will help accelerate testing timelines, improve data quality, reduce manual variability, strengthen infrastructure utilization, identify AI-enabled operational efficiencies, and advance analytical insights that support process monitoring, control strategy, and QC readiness.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead development, optimization, automation, and lifecycle management of analytical workflows across plate-based, culture-based, molecular, impurity, and related assay formats.

  • Translate manual and semi-manual methods into robust, reproducible automated workflows using liquid handlers, integrated systems, instrument software, and digital tools.

  • Design and execute studies supporting method development, robustness, comparability, verification, validation, QC transfer, and lifecycle management.

  • Evaluate, implement, and sustain automation platforms, PAT tools, instrument integrations, consumables, and enabling technologies that improve throughput, reproducibility, process monitoring, and compliant execution.

  • Advance fit-for-purpose PAT opportunities that enable rapid, real-time, in-line, on-line, or at-line measurements linked to critical quality attributes, critical process parameters, and key process decisions.

  • Integrate automation and PAT outputs with LIMS, ELN, structured data systems, instrument connectivity, electronic batch records, and advanced analytics platforms.

  • Identify, evaluate, and implement practical AI-enabled opportunities that improve operational efficiency, reduce manual or repetitive work, enhance data accessibility, streamline documentation or review workflows, and strengthen laboratory infrastructure utilization.

  • Partner with IT, data science, automation, and laboratory stakeholders to define use cases, data requirements, governance expectations, and adoption pathways for AI-supported workflows in analytical development and manufacturing-adjacent environments.

  • Partner across Process Development, MSAT, QC, Manufacturing, Attribute Sciences, and Analytical Lifecycle Management to align automation and PAT strategies with control strategy, GMP readiness, sampling strategy, and transfer expectations.

  • Author, review, and present technical documentation, data packages, recommendations, and project updates in support of compliant execution, investigations, change controls, and technology transfer.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert and mentor, helping build scalable automation, PAT, AI, digital, and analytical technology capabilities across teams.

  • Hands-on experience developing, optimizing, automating, or transferring analytical methods in a regulated or quality-focused biopharmaceutical, cell therapy, gene therapy, biologics, or complex therapeutic setting.

  • Experience with laboratory automation, liquid handling systems, integrated analytical instruments, assay workflow optimization, or comparable enabling technologies.

  • Experience identifying or implementing AI, advanced analytics, workflow automation, data integration, or digital infrastructure solutions that improve operational efficiency, laboratory productivity, or decision support.

  • Working knowledge of analytical method development, experimental design, data analysis, troubleshooting, technical documentation, GMP expectations, and data integrity principles.

  • Strong communication, collaboration, prioritization, and problem-solving skills with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional and fast-paced environments.

Basic Qualifications:

  • PhD with 2+ years elevant experience in analytical development, method development, method automation, bioassay development, or a related biopharmaceutical laboratory environment.

OR

  • MS with 6+ years, elevant experience in analytical development, method development, method automation, bioassay development, or a related biopharmaceutical laboratory environment.

OR

  • BS with 8+ years of relevant experience in analytical development, method development, method automation, bioassay development, or a related biopharmaceutical laboratory environment.

Career Growth Opportunities:

  • Build visible expertise at the intersection of analytical development, automation, PAT, AI, digital integration, and process understanding.

  • Shape automation, PAT, and AI strategies that influence method development, QC transfer, manufacturing readiness, operational efficiency, infrastructure utilization, and lifecycle management.

  • Partner with cross-functional leaders to drive high-impact technology evaluations, AI-enabled workflow improvements, capability building, and data-driven process monitoring approaches.

  • Grow as a technical subject matter expert, mentor, and strategic contributor within Analytical Development and broader CMC networks.

Preferred Qualifications:

The ideal candidate will bring strong scientific judgment, hands-on automation expertise, curiosity for emerging analytical technologies and AI-enabled operational tools, and the ability to influence in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.

  • Experience developing, optimizing, automating, and deploying analytical methods in biopharma, cell therapy, gene therapy, biologics, or other complex therapeutic environments.

  • Hands-on expertise with liquid handling and automation platforms such as Hamilton, TECAN, Biomek, Integra, or comparable systems.

  • Experience with high-throughput assays and analytical method lifecycle activities, including robustness, comparability, verification, validation, QC transfer, and lifecycle management.

  • Experience with PAT, digital laboratory integration, AI-enabled workflow optimization, LIMS, ELN, structured data systems, instrument connectivity, electronic batch records, or advanced analytics platforms.

  • Experience with data-rich experimentation, design of experiments, multivariate analysis, chemometrics, advanced analytics, automation scripting, Python, machine learning, AI-assisted data interpretation, or comparable tools.

  • Demonstrated interest or experience in applying AI to operational workflows, laboratory infrastructure planning, data accessibility, knowledge management, documentation efficiency, or cross-system process improvement.

  • Working knowledge of GMP, ALCOA+, 21 CFR Part 11 expectations, ICH guidance, regulated documentation, change control, deviation, investigation, and transfer practices.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, influence technical direction, mentor scientists or end users, and build sustainable automation, PAT, AI, or analytical technology capabilities.

Please review the following job description:

The Wholesale Early Careers Development Associate supports a specific portfolio of Wholesale early careers programs with a strong focus on business priorities, stakeholder needs, and disciplined execution. The role develops a practical understanding of the aligned Wholesale businesses, their clients, products, talent needs, and operating environment, then applies that context to program planning, analysis, communications, and delivery.

This is a business-facing role for an analytical, highly accountable professional who can operate with a client mindset, manage multiple stakeholders, and turn broad objectives into clear actions. The Associate partners closely with business leaders, program managers, Recruiting, subject matter experts, and cross-functional teams to deliver work that is relevant, accurate, and responsive to business needs.

LOCATION: Open to candidates within the Truist footprint. Truist in office requirement is 5 days per week.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Following is a summary of the essential functions for this job. Other duties may be performed, both major and minor, which are not mentioned below. Specific activities may change from time to time.

Business Understanding & Client Mindset

  • Develop and maintain knowledge of the aligned Wholesale businesses, including products, clients, strategic priorities, workforce needs, technical expectations, and key business cycles.
  • Use business context to shape program activities, communications, analysis, and recommendations rather than applying a one-size-fits-all approach.
  • Approach business stakeholders as internal clients by understanding their objectives, anticipating needs, responding with urgency, and delivering practical solutions.
  • Conduct research, benchmarking, and structured analysis to support decisions on program structure, timing, content, and talent pipelines.

Program & Business Execution

  • Support end-to-end execution of internship, analyst, and associate programs, including onboarding, training, rotations, performance milestones, conversion, and ongoing development.
  • Own defined workstreams and deliverables, translating business objectives into requirements, workplans, milestones, dependencies, and measurable outcomes.
  • Coordinate business-relevant technical training, leader engagement, manager touchpoints, participant communications, and other program activities.
  • Identify risks and execution gaps, resolve issues within scope, and escalate decisions with clear context and recommendations.
  • Support future-state program design, new pathways, operating model changes, curriculum updates, and manager readiness based on business needs.

Stakeholder Management & Communication

  • Build effective working relationships with business leaders, managers, program teams, Recruiting, Finance, Compliance, and other partners.
  • Prepare concise, accurate communications, pre-reads, executive updates, recommendations, and meeting recaps tailored to the audience and business decision required.
  • Coordinate across stakeholders to clarify ownership, manage dependencies, and maintain momentum against commitments.
  • Demonstrate sound judgment, responsiveness, attention to detail, and follow-through in a visible, fast-paced environment.

Analytics & Technology-Enabled Solutions

  • Use Excel and other analytical tools to organize data, identify trends, evaluate outcomes, and support business decisions.
  • Create clear PowerPoint materials that connect analysis to a business story, recommendation, and decision path.
  • Use approved AI and Microsoft 365 capabilities to improve analysis, synthesis, workflow efficiency, and communication while validating accuracy and business context.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify reporting, automate manual work, strengthen controls, and improve the stakeholder experience.
  • Maintain accurate documentation, decision logs, risk trackers, and governance routines.

Qualifications

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Required

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency with Excel, PowerPoint, and data analysis tools.

Preferred

  • At least two years of experience in Wholesale Banking or knowledge of Investment Banking, Capital Markets, Corporate and Commercial Banking, Wholesale Credit, Payments, or Wealth Management.
  • Experience supporting business leaders, client-facing teams, workforce initiatives, or early career programs.
  • Experience with data visualization, dashboarding, process automation, survey tools, or business intelligence platforms.
  • Experience developing materials for senior leaders and influencing action through analysis and clear recommendations.

title: TEMP Assistant Merchant, Outlet
description:
About us

KnitWell Group, a specialty retail operating company, comprises some of the most iconic brands in America – Ann Taylor, Chico's, Haven Well Within, Lane Bryant, LOFT, Soma, Talbots, White House Black Market. Individually, our brands are unique and strong. Together, we are powerful.


Our common thread is our commitment to create exceptional products, provide memorable experiences, and achieve superior results. Our associates are innovators who thrive through collaboration and are dedicated to excellence. At the heart of it all are the customers we serve. We are dedicated to creating fashion that not only looks good but also makes our customers feel good.


About The Role

This TEMP position is responsible for actively assisting the Merchant with the strategy, development, and selection of merchandise while supporting the department through the entire product lifecycle. Assistant Merchants will be assigned to a specific category.

The impact you can have

  • Prepare weekly/monthly/quarterly reporting and assist Merchant in analyzing performance; initiate and perform additional ad hoc analytical assignments as requested.
  • Review and compile seasonal commits by style, color, and size partnering with Sourcing and Allocation partners.
  • Monitor and track purchase orders and inventory through receipt reconciliation process.
  • Order, track, and organize samples for every season; ensure all photo samples are accurate and follow proper protocol for incorrect samples.
  • Work cross functionally with other partners and teams to ensure accurate product representation for photo shoots and floor sets.
  • Provide data for copy cards for all items in catalog.
  • Review shot sheets for catalog, ensure all product is being shot and has appropriate selling space.
  • Prepare for and attend catalog, store set layout and web thumbnail reviews, to ensure accuracy, timeliness of delivery and placement.
  • Review and correct all catalog and web content for department as released, work with teams to ensure accurate product representation.
  • Maintain knowledge of retail industry trends, shop competition and visit Talbots stores frequently.
  • Consistently check department landing page on the web to ensure accurate product information, gallery ranking, and any helpful customer reviews. Partner with web merchandising team on any callouts.
  • Assist merchant in generating reports weekly to analyze sales and business trends.
  • Gather / recap history as a stepping off point for future buys.

You’ll bring to the role

  • 1 -2 years merchandising, retail sales, buying or internship experience preferred.
  • Broad-based business acumen with the potential to grow to the Merchant level and beyond!
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel skills to include VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, and numerical formulation or and have aptitude to learn these technical applications quickly.
  • Innate sense of fashion and ability to analyze and translate trends
  • Strong communication and organizational skills, ability to multitask and work collaboratively.
  • Excellent attention to detail, understands importance of accuracy and thorough completion of tasks Ability to hit concurrent deadlines, manage and prioritize own workload

On-site: This position works on-site at least 4 days per week consistent with the needs of the business at our Talbots office location in Hingham, MA.

title: Senior Financial Data Analyst
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.

If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.


Skills and Competencies

  • 0-2 years’ experience in credit/financial data analysis and interpretation with knowledge of capital markets; experience in structured finance will be an added advantage
  • Skilled in identifying key credit risk factors and applying relevant credit methodologies to support analysis and decision-making.
  • Excellent Microsoft Office skills, particularly advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills & detail-oriented and well-organized, with a proven ability to excel in team-driven environments.
  • Basic understanding of AI concepts (Generative AI tools and Agentic AI systems), with curiosity and enthusiasm for learning how AI tools can be used to improve processes and drive efficiency leveraging these technologies for research, analysis, or workflow optimization. Interest in exploring AI systems and a willingness to develop awareness of responsible AI practices, including risk management and ethical use.
  • Experience with data science and analytics tools like Python, Power BI, and Alteryx is advantageous along with proficiency in handling large datasets, ensuring data integrity, and applying best practices in data analysis

Education

  • Masters’ degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics from or qualified CA
  • CFA/FRM certification is preferred.

Responsibilities

  • Independently manage routine deliverables such as portfolio review preparation, credit opinions, and outreach materials, while contributing to process improvement initiatives.
  • Apply Moody’s ratings methodologies to create adjusted data, key indicators, ratios, charts, and graphs that enhance ratings and research accuracy.
  • Perform data intake, scrubbing, and validation to ensure accuracy and readiness for research and ratings processes.
  • Analyze financial reports, official statements, and related documents to assess issuer performance and creditworthiness.
  • Partner with analysts and accounting specialists to apply relevant accounting concepts and capture accurate data for ratings.

Being part of the RRS Global Capability Centers provides a unique opportunity to foster skills that are valuable to any future career in the financial services industry. title: Controller
description:
Providence High School is a diverse, mission-inspired community dedicated to preparing young people to thrive in a rapidly changing world. As an independent Catholic school in Burbank, California, we promote the common good and foster a culture of impact to fulfill our mission to be “steadfast in serving all, especially those who are poor and vulnerable.” Providence serves an ethnically diverse student population who live within 75 different zip codes.

Founded by the Sisters of Providence in 1955, Providence High School is the only school in the country that is part of a multi-state health care system. We are governed by an independent Board of Regents and accredited by the California Association of Independent Schools (CAIS), the Western Association of Schools and Colleges (WASC), and the Western Catholic Education Association (WCEA). Other memberships and affiliations include the National Association of Independent Schools, Independent School Management, SoCal People of Color in Independent Schools, California Teacher Development Collaborative, and Making Caring Common of the Harvard Graduate School of Education.

POSITION TITLE:

Controller

REPORTS TO:

Chief Financial & Operations Officer

SUPERVISES:

Accounting Supervisor

FLSA STATUS:

Full-Time, Exempt

Hybrid

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION:

The Controller is a financial leader responsible for the accuracy, integrity, and day-to-day execution of the school’s financial operations, reporting directly to the Chief Financial & Operations Officer (CFOO), directly managing the Accounting Supervisor, and working cross-functionally with Advancement, Enrollment, and Budget Managers. The Controller ensures that all accounting, financial reporting, and internal control systems meet the highest standards of fiduciary responsibility for an institution with an annual operating budget of $20+ million. This role requires a proven track record of enhancing, automating, and optimizing accounting and finance processes, including technical expertise in ERP systems.

The Controller brings exceptional attention to detail, deep technical accounting expertise, consistency and clarity in communication, serving as the CFOO’s primary partner in maintaining financial excellence, regulatory compliance, and institutional trust

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

Accounting & Financial Reporting

  • Overseereconciliation of all accounts to the general ledger,accounts payable, accounts receivable,balance sheet reconciliations,and cash management functions.
  • Ensuretimelyandaccuratemonthly, quarterly, and annual financial statementsin accordance withGAAP and nonprofit accounting standards.
  • Preparedashboards, budget v. actuals, anddetailed financial reports for the CFOO, leadership, and Board committees.
  • Maintain the integrity of all financial records, schedules, and reconciliations.

Internal Controls & Fiduciary Integrity

  • Design, implement, and continuously strengthen internal controls to safeguard institutional assets.
  • Ensure segregation of duties, approval workflows, and documentation standards across all financial processes.
  • Monitor compliance with internal policies, donor restrictions, and Board-approved financial practices.
  • Serve as a key guardian of fiduciary discipline across the institution.

Audit & Compliance

  • Ensuretimelycompletion of audit schedules, confirmations, and required disclosures.
  • Support preparation of Form 990 and other regulatory filings in partnership with the CFOO and external advisors.
  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local financial and tax regulations applicable to independent schools and nonprofit organizations.

Budget Support & Financial Operations

  • Support the CFOO in annual budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.
  • Monitor budget-to-actual performance andidentifydiscrepancies or emerging issues.
  • Partner withleadershipto ensureaccurateexpense coding and financial accountability.
  • Assistinmaintainingmulti-year financialmodelstools.

Restricted Funds & Endowment Accounting

  • Oversee accounting for restricted, temporarily restricted, and unrestricted funds.
  • Ensureaccuratetracking and reporting of endowed funds, capitalcontributions, and donor-restricted contributions.
  • Partner with Advancement and the CFOOto ensure compliance with gift agreements and donor intent.

Systems, Processes & Continuous Improvement

  • Maintain andoptimizefinancial systems, including ERP/accounting platforms(Blackbaud/NXT),reporting tools, and p-cards.
  • Lead process improvements to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and transparency.
  • Ensure consistent financial procedures acrossBudget Managers, departments, and programs.
  • Support documentation and training related to financial policies and procedures.
  • Learnnew technology, including AI, to automate functions

Team Leadership & Collaboration

  • Supervise and mentor accounting and finance staff.
  • Foster a culture of professionalism, accountability,teamwork,service, and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate closely withFacilities, IT,Human Resources,Safety andSecurity,Advancement, and Academicleadership.
  • Serve as a trusted internal resource for financial questions and guidance.
  • Communicate effectively with families, with consistency, clarity, and compassion.


EXPERIENCE:

Required Experience

  • 6+ years of progressive accounting orfinancial managementexperience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • MBA/CPA strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated experience in a Controller role
  • Proven responsibility for financial operations supporting $20M+ annual budgets.
  • Extensive hands-on experience with:
  • GAAP and nonprofit accounting standards
  • Month-end and year-end close processes
  • Internal controls and audit preparation
  • Financial reporting and reconciliations

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in an independent school, higher education, nonprofit, or similarly complex mission-driven organization.
  • Experience working closely with a CFOO and supporting Board-level reporting.
  • Familiarity with tuition-driven revenue models, financial aid accounting, andinvestment/endowmentreporting.


SALARY RANGE:

The annual salary range for this position is $150k - $167k. *Final compensation within this range will be determined based on the candidate’s years of relevant experience, education, and internal equity considerations. title: Patient Service Specialist - Easton Health Center
description:
Office Based Patient Service Specialist (PSS)

Job Summary: The Patient Services Specialist (PSS) is part of a cross-trained team that performs the following processes necessary for efficient operational function of a health center: pre-registration, registration, appointment confirmation, scheduling, and answer inbound phone calls. The position is responsible for greeting the patient and providing quality customer service. Receives co-payments and gives appropriate receipts to patients, and records payments in practice management system. Verifies insurance information, assists with enrollment in sliding fee and other benefit products. Scans patient related documents to electronic health record (EHR). This is a non-exempt, full-time position in pay grade 1 with the pay range of $16.17 - $19.41. The Patient Service Specialist reports directly to the Practice Manager and/or Operations Director.

Required Skills/Abilities:

  • Must be proficient with technology and computer skills including Microsoft software.
  • Must have basic math skills.
  • The ability to handle cash and accurately complete bank deposit slips.
  • Medical or dental terminology a plus.

Education and Experience:

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Previous customer service experience
  • Preferred experience in various medical settings to include medical, dental, or behavioral health.

Working Conditions and Physical Requirements:

  • Primarily office-based work
  • Travel to various sites required

Standards of Behavior:

  • Commitment To Service
  • Respect
  • Quality
  • Teamwork
  • Patient Focus
  • Integrity
  • Accountability
  • Caring & Compassion
  • Professionalism
  • Listening & Responding
  • Safety
  • AIDET

Job Related Competencies:

  • Empathetic Outlook- The ability to perceive and understand the feelings and attitudes of others; the ability to place oneself “in the shoes” of another and to view a situation from their perspective.
  • Attention to Detail- The ability to process detailed information effectively and consistently.
  • Problem Solving- Identifies and analyzes problems weighing the relevance and accuracy of available information. Generates and evaluates alternative solutions and makes effective and timely decisions.
  • Communicates Effectively- Developing and delivering multi-mode communication that conveys a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  • Values And Ethics- Serving with integrity and respect in personal and organizational practices. Ensuring decisions and transactions are transparent and fair.
  • Time Management- The ability to effectively manage one’s time and resources to ensure that work is completed efficiently.

Commitment to Community:

Choptank Community Health System (CCHS) is committed to creating a safe and open healthcare environment that improves health outcomes and values and respects the unique experiences and perspectives of both patients and staff by:

  • Prioritizing access for all individuals;
  • Offering ongoing training for staff to promote health awareness, preventive measures and early detection for the varied patient population on the Eastern Shore;
  • Actively engaging with patients, families and staff;
  • Fostering a workplace culture in which everyone is treated with dignity.

Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Customer Service
    • Greets patients in a professional manner as they enter the health center.
    • Demonstrates AIDET with all patients, guests, and staff interactions.
    • Consistently answers calls within 3rd ring.
    • Always follows established procedures for handling patient calls and visits.
    • Communicates with patients in a professional manner on the telephone.
  • Notifies Triage Registered Nurse of all emergent patient phone calls as per triage policy.
    • Adheres to and models CCHS Standards of Behavior
    • Works with the clinical staff to coordinate patient flow
    • Keeps patients informed of wait times.
    • Addresses patient concerns with site-based leadership in a timely and responsive manner.
    • Always maintain patient confidentiality.
  • Appointment scheduling
    • Accurately and thoroughly schedule patients according to schedule templates and scheduling guidelines.
    • Informs patients of past due balances, copays, and sliding fee renewal dates when scheduling appointments.
    • Actively manages appointment waitlist.
    • Strives to meet a first call resolution with inbound patient calls.
  • Perform confirmation calls per the appointment reminder procedure.
    • Documents no show and cancel status in the practice management system.
    • Sends no show letters and tracks no show occurrences.
    • Manages same day requests in coordination with clinical team.
    • Follows dental emergency walk in procedure.
    • Reschedules patient appointments as needed.
    • Monitors schedule requests and tickler system for needed appointments.
    • Effectively troubleshoot errors in schedule with site-based leadership.
    • Proactively monitors schedules for provider PAL and meetings that will require appointment rescheduling.
    • Troubleshoots online portal scheduling errors.
    • End of day review verifying all appointments are checked out or documented as no show.
    • Prints the next day schedules for each provider daily.
  • Registration
    • Utilizes 3rd party registration system to update demographic data.
    • For patients unable to use electronic system, will enter and edit appropriate demographic data on patients accurately.
    • Verify demographics, contact numbers, and emergency contacts at every visit.
    • Verifies insurance eligibility and frequencies at every visit per established procedure for all scheduled patients.
    • Appropriate completion of noncovered forms for noncovered services, in accordance with insurance coverage.
    • Ensures sliding fee applications are offered to every patient and updated annually.
    • Determines patient’s eligibility with the sliding scale and verifies proof of income consistent with current policies.
    • Ensures all registration forms are completed during first appointment and verified at every visit and signatures are obtained annually
    • Ensures all insurance information is verified at every visit
    • For new patients, verifies that all required forms are completed prior to registration.
    • For established patients, ensures all registration forms are updated and signed annually.
    • Verifies and updates VFC status.
    • Updates patient’s preferred pharmacy.
    • Converts patients reaching the age of majority to their own guarantor.
  • Payment Collection
    • Receives copayments, self-payments, and gives appropriate receipts
    • Keeps money secure and balanced in locked cash drawer.
    • All monies collected are reconciled daily and placed in the safe at the end of day.
  • Financial Operations
    • Assists patients with billing issues, working with CCHS billing department.
    • End of day review performed in practice management system including collections and cash reconciliation.
  • Performs Other Duties as Required
    • Keeps electronic health record (EHR) buckets current, reviewing at least daily.
    • Takes initiative to solve problems, prioritizes effectively, and recommends improvements to site-based leadership.
    • Traveling to other CCHS locations to provide coverage as needed.
    • Consistently displays professionalism during interaction with CCHS customers, staff, and clinicians.
    • Attends and engages in weekly huddles, monthly site meetings, department meetings, and all staff meetings as required.
    • Maintains inventory of office supplies by communicating low stock to designated person.
    • Ensures the front desk area and patient waiting areas are neat and presentable to assure safe environment.
    • Responsible for mail and package deliveries.
    • Works with other staff to achieve a desirable working environment.
  • Regular, reliable attendance is a requirement of this job.

  • Tuition and education assistance
  • Certification scholarships available
  • Paid holidays (9)
  • Flexible paid time off and vacation scheduling

  • 403(b) matching
  • Employee assistance program

title: Instructor – ESL Intensive Program
location: MA Charlestown ESL, Charlestown, MA, US
description:
Job Title: Adjunct Intensive English Program Instructor for CSI

Supervisor's Title: Academic Dean/Program Manager

Department: Academics

General Summary: The English as a Second Language (ESL) instructor will teach courses within the ESL Programs. The instructor will be responsible for planning and delivering ESL curriculum. Along with the classroom hours, there will be a strong focus on using a learning management system and collaborative learning.

Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Teach courses in Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced ESL up to 27.5 hours per week

  • Prepare and submit lesson plans prior to each course session

  • Grade and provide feedback on student work in a timely manner

  • Evaluate and monitor students’ progress the use of various assessment tools

  • Deliver engaging instruction through a variety of student-centered classroom activities

  • Maintain necessary records to report student academic progress (SAP) to the Academic Dean/Program Manager

  • Provide support through academic advising to ensure student growth and retention.

  • Attend and participate in quarterly instructor in-service meetings.

  • Stay well-informed with the trends and developments in ESL studies by attending professional development activities outside of CSI and completing a minimum of two professional growth activities annually

  • Organize and lead fieldtrips for student enrichment once per quarter.

  • Actively contribute to program improvement by proactively providing feedback and participating in various committees

  • Additional tasks as needed

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Knowledge of pedagogical methods teaching ESL
  • Native or near-native ability to speak English

Education and Experience: The position requires a Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in ESL/EFL, TESOL, Applied Linguistics or Linguistics (or related field). At least two years of prior teaching experience to adult learners preferred.

If the Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree is not in ESL/EFL, TESOL, Applied Linguistics or Linguistics (or related field), language teaching faculty must have a specific knowledge base and skill set that includes the following:

  • Language teaching methodology
  • The nature of language/languages (e.g., introduction to linguistics)
  • The structure of English ( e.g., syntax, phonology, morphology, discourse)
  • Second language acquisition
  • Intercultural communication ( e.g., sociolinguistics, cross-cultural studies)
  • Practicum experience

Physical Requirements: While performing the duties of this job, the instructor is regularly required to stand; walk and sit. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment: Normal office working conditions. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

Benefits Offered:

  • Paid Time Off

Job Description:

Shell Assessed Internship Programme (January/May 2027) – Canada
Locations: Calgary, AB | Scotford (Fort Saskatchewan), AB

Explore Your Future. Energize Your Career.

Are you a student ready to explore the energy industry and gain real-world experience with a global leader? The Shell Assessed Internship Programme in Canada offers you the opportunity to work on meaningful projects, develop your skills, and discover what a future career at Shell could look like.

What’s the Role?

As an intern, you’ll be immersed in Shell’s operations and culture, working on real projects that align with your academic background and interests. You’ll be based at one of our key Canadian locations and supported by a dedicated supervisor and mentor throughout your internship.

You’ll receive regular feedback and performance assessments to help you grow and determine if a future with Shell is right for you. Top-performing interns may be offered a return internship or a place in the Shell Graduate Programme, a comprehensive 3-year development journey designed to shape future leaders.

Read more about our strategy here: Our strategy | Shell Global

What you bring

We are looking for a candidate who thrives on new challenges and embraces innovation. You should be confident in your ability to absorb information, analyze problems, make objective decisions, and generate original ideas. The ideal candidate will possess the drive and resilience to achieve goals, the flexibility to collaborate effectively within a team, and the credibility to influence others. Being open to alternative perspectives and views is essential, using them to refine ideas and outcomes.

Eligibility

We are looking for ambitious students who are currently enrolled in a university Bachelor’s or Master’s program and meet the following criteria:

  • At least one more semester of education remaining following your internship
  • Minimum Cumulative GPA (CGPA) of 3.20
  • Legally entitled to work in Canada by way of Canadian Citizenship, Permanent Residency, or a valid work permit which would allow you to work for Shell
  • If you are selected for a role in a safety-sensitive position, you will be required to successfully complete a Medical and/or Alcohol & Drug tests

Technical Internship Programme: Engineering: Chemical, Chemical-Process Control, Electrical, Mechanical

Commercial Internship Programme: Commerce/Business, Computer Science, Mathematical Finance, Data Science, Statistics, Quantitative Finance

What we offer

You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another.

  • Competitive Compensation: Perform at your best with a competitive salary to reflect the number of academic and work terms completed, in addition to pay progressions every 4 months for interns on 8, 12 or 16 month terms
  • Professional Development: Gain access to a wide range of training and development programs.
  • Work-Life Balance: Maximise paid time off and other options that allow you to achieve a fulfilling work-life balance.

  • Supportive Environment: Receive the support you need through mental health programs, comprehensive counseling, and community networks.
  • Inclusive Culture: Join an organization striving to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientations, and life experiences to apply. Get to know more about how we're working towards our DE&I goal here.

Shell has been operating in Canada for more than 100 years and employs about 3,100 people across the country. Our business is providing energy to Canadians and people around the world, and we are one of the few truly integrated oil and gas companies in Canada.

We have a 40% share in the multi-billion dollar LNG Canada project and also maintain other upstream assets and significant downstream operations in Canada through refining and chemicals, and a growing retail business with around 1,400 Shell-branded sites across the country.

title: Scientist, Pharmacokinetics
location: USA - California - South San Francisco (Grand Ave)
description:
Job Description

The Pharmacokinetics, Dynamics, Metabolism, and Bioanalytics (PDMB) organization at our company's Research Laboratories is seeking a highly motivated and collaborative scientist to join the Drug Metabolism and Pharmacokinetics (DMPK) group in South San Francisco (SSF). The Scientist will provide laboratory support for the multi-disciplinary drug discovery effort in SSF, with a focus on supporting preclinical development of therapeutics of various modalities through integrated understanding of drug disposition and pharmacology.

The scientist will work within a highly collaborative team and contribute to characterization of novel drug candidates in a range of therapeutic areas, including immunology, oncology, cardiovascular and metabolic disease, and ophthalmology. The scientist will be responsible for planning and conducting in vitro/ex vivo studies to evaluate the absorption, distribution, metabolism and excretion (ADME) properties of biologics, conjugates and other modalities. The ideal candidate will work with the team and interpret data, integrate, and clearly present results to help the team inform pipeline decisions. The candidate will also contribute to scientific initiatives for further advancing our knowledge of ADME and discovery bioanalytical science.

The successful candidate should have hands-on experience with in vitro and ex vivo cellular assays to characterize biologics and conjugates, as well as LC-MS/MS-based bioanalytical methodologies. Experience handling biological matrices and developing quantitative assays for drug and biomarker measurements is highly desirable. The scientist must be highly motivated, able to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment, and possess excellent scientific, interpersonal, and communication skills.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Education:

  • Bachelor's (with 3 years) or Master's in analytical science, biochemistry, biology, pharmaceutical sciences, chemistry, pharmacology, biochemical engineering, biophysics, or a related discipline and relevant experience

Required Experience and Skills:

  • Demonstrated experience with mammalian cell culture and performing cell-based assays
  • Hands-on experience operating LC-MS/MS instrumentation, preferably SCIEX QQQ platforms, for quantitative bioanalysis
  • Understanding of basic safety protocols, laboratory practices, and quality expectations in a research environment

Preferred Experience and Skills:

  • Previous experience in a research environment or/and in drug discovery and development
  • Demonstrated experience with protein characterization using biochemical or biophysical techniques
  • Previous experience with flow cytometry-based assays and analysis
  • Previous experience developing or performing automated assays
  • General knowledge of PK, ADME and/or drug discovery concepts is a plus not a must
  • Demonstrated creativity and innovation via a publication/presentation record
  • Proficient in using data analysis software, such as graphpad, excel, etc.
  • Experience in using electronic notebooks is desirable

Bioanalysis, Cell-Based Assays, Cell Culture Techniques, Laboratory Techniques, Mammalian Cell Culture, Mammalian Cell Lines, Mass Spectrometry (MS)

title: Corporate Finance Corporate Bank (CF CB) - M&A Analyst (f/m/x)
description:
Job Description:

*English version below*

Über das Team

Corporate Finance für die Corporate Bank (CF CB) berät Kunden (strategische, institutionelle und private Kunden) bei der Strukturierung und Umsetzung von Unternehmens- und Finanzierungstransaktionen mit einem Fokus auf den deutschen Mittelstand. Zu den Kernaufgaben gehören die Beratung beim Verkauf oder Erwerb von Unternehmen bzw. Unternehmensteilen sowie bei wesentlichen Veränderungen der Gesellschafterstruktur, die Strukturierung von Kapitalmarkt- und kapitalmarktnahen Finanzierungen, die Unterstützung strategischer Dialoge mit relevanten Zielkunden sowie die Akquisition und Umsetzung von Corporate-Finance-Produkten (M&A, Equity Solutions, DCM usw.).

Deine wichtigsten Aufgaben

  • Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehören anspruchsvolle quantitative Analysen und deren Umsetzung in kundenreife Lösungen und Präsentationsunterlagen.

  • Du unterstützt das Team bei der Akquisition neuer Mandate und der Beratung unserer Kunden. Dazu gehören die Beschaffung, Analyse und Aufbereitung von Markt- und Unternehmensinformationen sowie Unternehmensanalysen und -bewertungen.

  • Bei der Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Transaktionen übernimmst du unter Anleitung erfahrener Kolleginnen und Kollegen Verantwortung für ausgewählte Projektbestandteile, beispielsweise Bewertungs- und Finanzierungsmodelle, Marketingunterlagen (Teaser, Informationsmemoranden, Management-Präsentationen), Investorenübersichten sowie Due-Diligence Module.

  • Du verfügst über ein schnelles Verständnis von Geschäftsmodellen in unterschiedlichen Branchen und unterstützt Unternehmen mit strategischen Ideen und Lösungsansätzen.

  • Du präsentierst und vertrittst deine Arbeitsergebnisse überzeugend

Deine Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen

  • Du verfügst über relevante Berufserfahrung (mindestens 6-12 Monate) im Bereich Corporate Finance mit Schwerpunkt M&A, die auch durch einschlägige Praktika bei einer Investmentbank, einer Corporate Finance-/M&A-Boutique, Unternehmensberatung, Private-Equity-Gesellschaft oder Wirtschaftsprüfungs-/Steuerberatungsgesellschaft (z. B. Transaction Services) erworben worden sein kann. Darüber hinaus bringst Du fundierte Kenntnisse in Unternehmensanalyse, Rechnungswesen, Unternehmensbewertung und Strategieanalyse mit.

  • Du hast ein Studium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Betriebswirtschaftslehre (ggf. Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen), Rechtswissenschaften oder eines vergleichbaren Fachgebiets mit internationaler Ausrichtung und Schwerpunkt auf Corporate Finance und/oder M&A erfolgreich abgeschlossen.

  • Du zeichnest Dich durch eine hohe Eigenmotivation und ausgeprägte Eigeninitiative aus.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, verfügst über starke analytische Fähigkeiten und gehst Probleme kreativ und lösungsorientiert an.

  • Du besitzt sehr gute organisatorische Fähigkeiten, setzt Prioritäten souverän und kannst mehrere Aufgaben gleichzeitig steuern.

  • Du bist ein Teamplayer, arbeitest gerne in interdisziplinären Projektteams und verfügst über ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.

  • Du verfügst über hervorragende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, sehr gute Präsentationsfähigkeiten sowie professionelle Anwenderkenntnisse in MS Office, FactSet und Bloomberg.

Was wir bieten

Wir bieten dir eine breite Palette von Leistungen, die all deine beruflichen und persönlichen Bedürfnisse abdecken.

Emotional ausgeglichen

Eine positive Haltung hilft dir, die Herausforderungen des Alltags zu meistern – beruflich wie privat. Profitiere von Angeboten wie Beratung in schwierigen Lebenssituationen und Angeboten zur Förderung deiner mentalen Gesundheit.

Körperlich fit

Mit unseren Angeboten zur Aufrechterhaltung deiner persönlichen Gesundheit und einem förderlichen beruflichen Umfeld hilft dir die Bank, körperlich fit zu bleiben. Du profitierst von umfangreichen Check-up-Untersuchungen, Impfangeboten und Beratung zur gesunden Lebensführung.

Sozial vernetzt

Der Austausch mit anderen eröffnet dir neue Perspektiven, bringt dich beruflich wie persönlich voran und stärkt dein Selbstvertrauen und Wohlbefinden. Profitiere von Angeboten wie Unterstützung durch den pme Familienservice, dem FitnessCenter Job, flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodellen (z. B. Teilzeit, Jobtandem, hybrides Arbeiten) sowie einer umfangreichen Kultur der Vielfalt, Chancengleichheit und Teilhabe.

Finanziell abgesichert

Die Bank sichert dich nicht nur während deiner aktiven Karriere, sondern auch für die Zukunft finanziell ab und unterstützt deine Flexibilität sowie Mobilität – egal ob privat oder beruflich. Profitiere von Angeboten wie Beitragsplänen für Altersvorsorge, Bankdienstleistungen für Mitarbeitende, Firmenfahrrad oder dem Deutschlandticket

Die Stelle wird in Voll- und in Teilzeit angeboten.

Da die Benefits je nach Standort geringfügig variieren können, wende dich bei konkreten Fragen gerne an deinen Recruiter oder deine Recruiterin.

Bei Fragen zum Rekrutierungsprozess steht dir Philipp Maass gerne zur Verfügung.

Kontakt Philipp Maass: +49 69 910-48515

___________________________________________________________________

About the team

Corporate Finance for Corporate Bank (CF CB) advises clients (strategic, institutional and private clients) on the structuring and execution of corporate and financing transactions with a focus on the German “Mittelstand”. Its core task is to advise on the sale or acquisition of companies/parts of companies as well as on significant changes in the shareholder structure, the structuring of capital market and capital market-related financings, the support of strategic dialogues with relevant target clients as well as the origination and execution of corporate finance products (M&A, equity solutions, DCM, etc.).

Your key responsibilities

  • Your responsibilities include highly quantitative analyses and their implementation in client-ready solutions and documents

  • You will support the team in the origination of new mandates and in advising our clients: this includes sourcing, analysis and preparation of market and company information, company analyses and valuations

  • During the preparation and execution of transactions, you will be responsible for managing certain parts of the projects such as valuation and financing models, marketing materials (teaser, IMs, management presentations), investor overviews and due diligence workstreams always under the guidance of experienced colleagues

  • You have a quick understanding of business models in different industries and support companies with strategic ideas

  • You discuss and justify your work results

Your skills and experiences

  • Relevant work experience (at least 6-12 months) in corporate finance with a focus on M&A, also as a result of relevant internships in an investment bank, corporate finance boutique, management consultancy, private equity or auditing / tax consulting (e.g. transaction services) as well as strong knowledge of company analysis, accounting and valuation as well as strategy analysis

  • University degree in economics, business administration (and engineering), law or similar with an international orientation and a focus on corporate finance and/or M&A

  • Very strong self-motivation and initiative

  • Structured working style, strong analytical skills and creative problem-solving approach

  • Strong organizational skills as well as the ability to prioritize, coupled with the ability to manage tasks in parallel

  • Team player, ability to work in interdisciplinary project teams and very good communication skills

  • Excellent German and English skills paired with very good presentation skills and professional MS Office, Factset and Bloomberg application skills

What we offer

We provide you with a comprehensive portfolio of benefits and offerings to support both, your private and professional needs.

Emotionally and mentally balanced
A positive mind helps us master the challenges of everyday life – both professionally and privately. We offer consultation in difficult life situations as well as mental health awareness trainings.

Physically thriving
We support you in staying physically fit through an offering to maintain personal health and a professional environment. You can benefit from health check-ups; vaccination drives as well as advice on healthy living and nutrition.

Socially connected
Networking opens up new perspectives, helps us thrive professionally and personally as well as strengthens our self-confidence and well-being. You can benefit from PME family service, FitnessCenter Job, flexible working (e.g parttime, hybrid working, job tandem) as well as an extensive culture of diversity, equity and inclusion.

Financially secure
We provide you with financial security not only during your active career but also for the future. You can benefit from offerings such as pension plans, banking services, company bicycle or “Deutschlandticket”.


Since our offerings slightly vary across locations, please contact your recruiter with specific questions.

This job is available in full and parttime.


In case of any recruitment related questions, please get in touch with Philipp Maass.

Contact Philipp Maass: +49 69 910-48515

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

•Assembling flights–trolleys that have been rebuilt are brought over to the assembly area by the bar/boutique builders. The assembler stages the trolleys according to flight number. *Headsets, hampers and satchels are added, as requested, to the trolleys to complete the flight. Fully assembled flights are pushed into the cold room to await pickup. The worker marks the flight complete on a board in the cold room.

Work assigned schedule which will include multiple shifts, weekends and holidays
