title: E-Crane Operator Trainee
description:
About Us:

For over 30 years, Carver Companies has been a leading provider of construction materials, marine transportation, and infrastructure services across the East Coast. With operations in New York, South Carolina, and Canada, our fundamental belief has been to provide unparalleled service to all while maintaining our values of honesty and integrity both on land and sea.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Operate E-Cranes, loaders, hold loaders, and trimmers to assist with loading, unloading, and moving cargo and heavy materials at port facilities and job sites.
  • Travel to multiple job sites as required.
  • Conduct pre- and post-operational inspections of cranes, loaders, hold loaders, trimmers; report any defects or maintenance needs.
  • Assist with rigging, signaling, and lift coordination under the direction of senior crane operators or supervisors.
  • Assist in securing and organizing cargo on trailers, docks, or storage areas.
  • Work closely with crane operators, riggers, signal persons, dock crews, and supervisors to complete lifting and material handling tasks safely and efficiently.
  • Follow all company, OSHA, and MSHA safety regulations and ensure compliance with PPE requirements.
  • Maintain accurate daily equipment logs, inspection reports, and time records.
  • Communicate clearly with supervisors and team members during lifting operations and material handling tasks regarding operational status, delays, or safety concerns.
  • Assist in crane setup, relocation, and maintenance as needed.
  • Support general port operations, including operating other heavy equipment and labor as assigned when crane operations are not required.

Required Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent (GED).
  • Valid Driver's License
  • 1+ years of experience operating hydraulic cranes or similar heavy equipment in port, construction, or industrial environments.
  • 2-3 years of experience operating material handler in port environment.
  • Demonstrated understanding of crane operation principles, load charts, and signaling.
  • Ability to work effectively as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong commitment to safety and operational excellence.
  • TWIC (Transportation Worker Identification Credential).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • OSHA 10 or 30 certification.
  • Experience in marine terminal or waterfront operations.
  • Familiarity with bulk material handling and vessel loading/offloading procedures.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to sit and operate crane controls for extended periods.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds and perform physical tasks as required.
  • Comfortable working outdoors in all weather conditions and around heavy equipment.
  • PPE required at all times, including hard hat, gloves, safety vest, and steel-toe boots.

Work Environment:

  • Field-based role primarily at marine terminals and job sites.
  • Exposure to noise, dust, vibration, and heavy machinery.
  • Dynamic, safety-critical environment requiring focus and clear communication.
  • Must be available for flexible shifts, including nights, weekends, and overtime, based on vessel schedules.


What We Offer:

  • Highly competitive pay
  • Holidays and paid time off
  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision insurance with additional coverage options available through AFLAC
  • 401(k) retirement plan with up to 8% company match
  • Short-Term and Long-Term Disability
  • Group Life Insurance

  • Emergency Service Worker bonus

Background

The Global Initiative Against Transnational Organized Crime (GI-TOC) is an independent civil society organization headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, with a globally dispersed Secretariat working across 43 countries. Founded in 2013, GI-TOC brings together a global network of more than 810 independent experts and a team of over 150 staff dedicated to understanding and responding to organized crime. Through research, analysis, policy engagement and support to civil society actors, GI-TOC works to deepen understanding of organized crime and strengthen effective, rights-based responses.

The GI-TOC works to:


  • Identify, analyse and map criminal trends and patterns of regional instability, and their impact on illicit flows, governance, development, security, conflict and the rule of law.
  • Connect and support civil society actors working on organized crime and corruption, and on their links to instability and conflict.

Project Assistants work as part of multi-functional teams to deliver GI-TOC activities in an effective and efficient way, in line with GI-TOC policies, guidelines and norms. Job Description For: Sr. Cost Analyst

Division/Department: Finance

Location: Grandview

Type of Position: Full Time

Salary/Wage: Exempt

Reports To: Finance Director

GENERAL DESCRIPTION

The Senior Cost Analyst serves as a strategic business partner to Operations, Sales, Procurement, and Executive Leadership. This position is responsible for financial planning and analysis, manufacturing cost accounting, inventory analysis, KPI development, and profitability improvement initiatives throughout the organization. Working closely with the Director of Finance and Controller, the Senior Cost Analyst provides financial insights that drive operational decision-making, improve manufacturing efficiency, optimize product profitability, and support long-term strategic objectives. This role focuses heavily on manufacturing finance, inventory management, standard costing, and operational performance within a food manufacturing environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Perform detailed cost studies, variance analysis, and cost to serve evaluation to support operation and financial decision making.
  • Conduct profitability analyses by product, customer, business unit, and production line.
  • Track cost behavior over time, highlight emerging patterns, and forecast future impacts.
  • Develop and maintain key performance indicators for manufacturing, inventory, procurement, and financial performance.
  • Create and maintain costing documentation, procedures, and system controls.
  • Analyze manufacturing labor, material, packaging, overhead, and freight costs and present findings to departments heads and executive leaders.
  • Monitor and investigate material, labor, and overhead variances.
  • Evaluate inventory trends, turnover, aging, and working capital utilization.
  • Generate clear, actionable cost reports and dashboards for leadership ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
  • Translate analytical findings into proposed/recommended initiatives, business cases, process improvements and support implementation of those cost-control measures and efficiency improvements.
  • Partner with operations, supply chain, procurement, and finance team to validate assumptions and align on cost strategies.
  • Maintain ongoing oversight of cost drivers, market changes, and internal performance metrics.
  • Analyze production yields, waste, and byproducts to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Develop benchmarks and performance standards to evaluate operational efficiency.
  • Promote financial accountability throughout the organization.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives and strategic projects.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

WORK EXPERIENCE & PERSONAL SKILL REQUIREMENTS

  • 4–7+ years of experience in cost analysis, FP&A, operations finance, or similar analytical roles
  • Solid understanding of cost accounting principles, forecasting, and financial modeling
  • Ability to build automated reporting tools and dashboards
  • Experience with ERP systems in a manufacturing environment
  • Advanced computer skills (Microsoft Office, excel, etc.)
  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and highly organized
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize in a fast-paced environment
  • Good communication and coordination skills
  • Self-motivated with a continuous improvement mindset

EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, business analytics, or related field is required.
  • MBA, Master of Accounting, secondary bachelor’s, or related advanced degrees is preferred.
  • CPA, CMA, or related credentials are required.

title: Myyjä
description:
Haemme Vaasan Motonet-tavarataloon

MYYJÄÄ

Myyjämme ovat ennen kaikkea asiakaspalvelun ja myynnin ammattilaisia, jotka nauttivat asiakkaiden kohtaamisesta ja sopivien ratkaisujen löytämisestä heidän tarpeisiinsa. Työssäsi palvelet asiakkaita varaosatiskillä, myymälässä sekä Motomaatti-palvelupisteellä. Positiivisella asenteella ja aktiivisella myyntiotteella varmistat erinomaisen asiakaskokemuksen, jonka ansiosta asiakkaamme palaavat asioimaan meillä yhä uudelleen.

Lue Motomaatista lisää täältä

Myyjän työpäivä koostuu myös varaosien hyllyttämisestä, noutomyynnin hoitamisesta ja lisäpalveluidemme tarjoamisesta kokonaisvaltaisen ratkaisun löytämiseksi asiakkaillemme. Työtiiminä puhallamme yhteen hiileen, joten työhön voi kuulua myös joustavasti muita myymälän tehtäviä.

🤝 Työsuhde on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen 37,5h/vko

💰 Palkkaus kaupan työehtosopimuksen mukaan


Uudessa työkaverissa arvostamme:

  • Arvojemme mukaista asiakaspalveluhenkisyyttä

  • Varaosien, ajoneuvojen tai autotekniikan tuntemusta tai vahvaa kiinnostusta oppia niistä lisää

  • Innostunutta asennetta myynti- ja myymälätyöskentelyyn

  • Halua puhaltaa yhteen hiileen

  • Omatoimista ja huolellista otetta työhön


Kenelle työ sopii?

Myyjän työ sopii sinulle, jos viihdyt asiakkaiden parissa ja innostut myynnistä. Sinulla voi jo olla kokemusta myynityöstä, varaosista tai ajoneuvoharrastuksesta, mutta se ei ole välttämätöntä. Meille tärkeintä on, että olet motivoitunut oppimaan uutta ja haluat auttaa asiakkaita löytämään juuri heidän tarpeisiinsa sopivat ratkaisut.

Autoalan koulutus, harrastuneisuus tai aikaisempi kokemus varaosista katsotaan eduksesi, mutta ratkaisevinta on innostuksesi myyntityötä kohtaan, halusi oppia uutta ja kehittyä erinomaiseksi myyjäksi. Tärkeintä on utelias asenne ja halu oppia.

Kurkkaa, miten meillä tuetaan myyjän osaamista


🔥 TOP 5 🔥
syytä valita meidät työnantajaksi:

Menestyvä työpaikka - Meillä menee hyvin! Työskennellessäsi meillä pysyt alan kehityksen kärjessä ja saat itsellesi vakavaraisen sekä luotettavan työnantajan.

Jatkuvasti kehittyvä työympäristö - Eteenpäin meneminen on meille tärkeää ja siksi kehitysaskeleita otetaan sitä mukaan, kun kehitettävää löydetään. Uudistuminen on toimintamme pohja ja se on viety arvoihimme saakka.

Mahdollisuus kehittää itseäsi - Työssä kehittyminen on meillä ehdoton kunnia-asia! Jokainen meillä saa edellytykset kehittyä omassa työssään niin sisäisten kuin ulkoistenkin koulutusten parissa. Erityisesti panostamme lähijohtamiseen, johon koulutamme ja opastamme henkilöstöä mm. omien esihenkilö- ja päällikkövalmennusten kautta.

Avulias ja ammattitaitoinen työtiimi - Ketään ei jätetä yksin, vaan yhdessä tekemällä päästään parhaaseen mahdolliseen lopputulemaan. Meillä on kasassa huipputiimi, vaikka mekin kaikki olemme vain ihmisiä.

Työn ja vapaan tasapaino - Kotiin saa ja pitääkin lähteä!


Rekrytoinnin aikataulu

Rekrytointiprosessissa edetään jo hakuaikana, joten hakemuksen kanssa ei kannata turhaan aikailla. Haastattelut aloitetaan sopivien kandidaattien myötä ja valinta tehdään oikean henkilön löydyttyä.

📅 Hae viimeistään 17.9.2026

Haluatko sinä haastatella meitä?

Heräsikö kysymyksiä? Tai haluat muuten vain vaihtaa ajatuksia? Sehän passaa!

Tavaratalopäällikkö Sonja Salo auttaa sinua mielellään. Sonjan tavoitat sähköpostitse Sonja.Salo@bromangroup.fi

Jäämme innolla odottamaan hakemustasi. Jos työ ei ole sinua itseäsi varten, niin vinkkaa siitä henkilölle, kenet ilmoitukselta tunnistit ja hae itse johonkin muuhun tehtävään! Täältä kaikkiin avoimiin työpaikkoihin.

Katso videolta, miten Niko pärjää varaosien tunnistuksessa! Montako itse tunnistat?

Motonet – Arvaa varaosa! - YouTube
Hae mukaan meidän tiimiin!
Motonet työnantajana

Motonet on suomalainen perheyritys, jolla on 40 tavarataloa ympäri Suomen, yksi Virossa sekä myös Ruotsissa! Motonet yhdistää 12 erikoisliikkeen tarjonnan saman katon alle. Olemme Suomen suurin esimerkiksi autoilun, kalastuksen sekä veneilyn tuoteryhmissä. Motonet on osa Broman Group -konsernia.

Olemme Hyvän mielen työpaikka®, ja teemme töitä henkilöstömme mielenterveyden sekä hyvinvoinnin eteen. Kuulumme Oikotien luotsaamaan vastuullisuusyhteisöön Vastuullinen työpaikka, jossa sitoudutaan kehittämään työelämää vastuullisempaan suuntaan. Pidämme omalta osaltamme huolen esimerkiksi kunnon perehdytyksestä, puutumme syrjintään heti ja panostamme esihenkilöidemme osaamiseen.­

title: Senior Scientist, Drug/Device Combo Products (Hybrid)
description:
Job Description

Senior Scientist, Human Factors

The Human Factors team plays a pivotal role in combination product development (both design and process), commercialization, and lifecycle management. This person will lead and manage human factors activities to ensure compliance with US and global regulatory policies/guidance for all combination products and medical devices in our company's portfolio and pipeline, including acquisition products.

This position will interact with all subject-matter experts within the Device Development team as well as with members of numerous internal cross-functional product development teams from concept through product launch and post-market surveillance. The Senior Scientist in this role will be responsible for performing and managing human factors activities to ensure compliance with US and global regulatory policies/guidance for all combination products.

Key Responsibilities and Activities:

  • Perform and manage human factors activities throughout the whole product design and development cycle within the constraints of a regulated environment, including creating human factors plan, working with other disciplines to identify customer needs, intended use and potential hazard/harm, providing product and packaging design inputs/requirements, performing task and use error analysis, designing instructions for use, conducting formative/summative studies, preparing regulatory submission materials, addressing post market surveillance and training need.
  • Partner with marketing, program management, clinical, safety, regulatory, manufacturing, packaging, and labeling to integrate HF, manage risk and ensure regulatory compliance
  • In collaboration with cross-functional colleagues, ensure the management and maintenance of records and databases that support regulatory compliance
  • Collaborate cross- functionally to support and maintain the internal HFE processes to ensure consistency, efficiency and compliance
  • Lead regulatory deliverables: HF protocols/reports, linkage to risk management (ISO 14971), hazard/use-related risk analyses, and submission materials (FDA, EU MDR).
  • Perform scientific literature reviews and database research on various topics independently and synthesize relevant information in support of the human factors research Perform other job related duties or special projects as required.

Qualifications:

  • B.A./B.S in Human Factors, Ergonomics, Cognitive or Experimental Psychology, Sociology plus three years of related experience or M.A/M.S. in one of the above disciplines.
  • Strong knowledge of human factors, device regulatory requirements, and industry standards related to device systems.
  • Prefer to have experience in team and people coaching.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work in a dynamic and fast-paced environment, managing multiple priorities effectively.

title: Quality Analyst
description:
Join us as a Quality Analyst

Function: Supply Chain

Reports to: Site Quality Coordinator

Scope: Local

Location: Boksburg Factory

Terms & Conditions: Full time

ABOUT UNILEVER

With 3.4 billion people in over 190 countries using our products every day, Unilever is a business that makes a real impact on the world. Work on brands that are loved and improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. We are driven by our purpose: to make sustainable living commonplace, and it is our belief that doing business the right way drives superior performance. At the heart of what we do is our people – we believe that when our people work with purpose, we will create a better business and a better world.

At Unilever, your career will be a unique journey, grounded in our inclusive, collaborative, and flexible working environment. We don’t believe in the ‘one size fits all’ approach and instead we will equip you with the tools you need to shape your own future.

CATEGORY/FUNCTION INTRODUCTION

Supply Chain/Operates within the guidelines of standard operating procedures. Has freedom to propose improved quality assurance systems based on consumer / customer complaints. Make decisions "Approval / Rejection" of WIP, Raw material/Packaging Material and finished products. Can stop a production line in the event of a product quality/consumer safety defect being identified.

JOB PURPOSE

Unilever is the place where you can bring your purpose to life with the work that you do – creating a better business and a better world. If you are passionate about quality and you are ready to assist with the quality assurance service to the business to ensure that products produced by the company are fit for use by the consumers according to Company’s specifications and standards. To drive zero defect culture within the organization through UMS and continuous improvement tools in the Quality Pillar. then this role is just for you!

WHAT WILL YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES BE

Inbound

  • Analyses all incoming raw and packaging material for non-conformities against company’s specifications and standards.

  • Raise Supplier non-conformances, report on the non-conformities to the QA Manager and Planning team.

  • Process non-conforming material returns, advise and supervises removal of the defective material from site.

  • Ensures that all transactions are recorded on SAP daily.

  • Follow-up with suppliers on the non-conformance raised and drive corrective actions.

  • Drive packaging supplier approval with supply management.

Manufacturing

  • Carryout online trouble shooting to identify product quality issues and generating of NCA if quality defects are identified.

  • Retrieval of samples from retention location and setting-up against

Customer/consumer complaint sample and preparing all the necessary forms for evaluation when and if required.

  • Evaluating customer/consumer complaints against standards and completing evaluation documentation.

  • Prepare and write reports for consumer/customer services team regarding investigated complaints.

  • Ensure there are up to date PQS standards on the lines and ensure full operator training and PJO’s on online PQS.

  • Drive PQS compliance, trend analysis of the results and ensure manufacturing incident is raised for the out of specification results.

  • Lead the continuous improvement agenda for the quality pillar through implementing Kaizens for QA Matrix top losses (including Manufacturing Quality Incidents,

Consumer complaints, customer complaints, pallets quality conformance and Supplier non conformances)

  • Support the implementation of the Quality Management system, preparation and participates in audits.

  • QNF management to prevent defective stock from being released to trade and liaise with production for rework plans and monitor weekly.

  • Carry out Factory quality assessment on the finished products and decides on the release of the finished goods to the trade.

  • Driving T5Z compliance for packing and making, ensuring procedures are implemented and operations teams are trained and PJO’s are complete.

  • Drive foreign matter compliance for site.

  • Assist when required on trials and innovations.

Outbound

  • Manage the customer returns, analyse for defects, and provide guidance on reworking of the stock.

  • Liaise with the warehouse on the returns of the rejected pallets.

Administrative Activities

  • Generation of QEWO’s

  • Weekly reporting consumer/customer complaints

  • Weekly reporting of D-incidents and PQS Complaince

  • QEWO completion and reviews

Other Duties:

  • Do finished products line inspection for assigned lines when required.

  • Report any non-conformance on the shop floor.

  • Attend OR meetings according to FOS, take actions related to quality, investigate and provide action plans.

  • Interact with QC technicians ensuring that information regarding nonconformances is logged and addressed.

  • Interact with production in identifying when line changeovers occur and the communications of quality problems identified in the packing process.

  • Ensure that all jobs are done safely, without negative impact on the environment.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

Experiences & Qualifications

  • Matric with Maths & Physical Science

  • Diploma / B.Tech Food Tech / Bio Technology, Analytical chemistry or an equivalent qualification

  • Understanding of HACCP requirements

  • 1-3 year experience in manufacturing environment.

Skills

  • Working Knowledge of production and engineering processes, supply chain, and planning.

  • Working Knowledge of PC Skills (Outlook, Excel, Word and Powerpoint, etc.)

  • Fully Operational in WCM QC tools • Working Knowledge WCM Q methodology

  • Working Knowledge of HACCP and GMP's.

  • Working Knowledge of OHS act and safe operating procedures.

title: Systems Administrator, Operational Tech
description:
We’re looking for a technically skilled and collaborative Systems Administrator, Operational Technology Systems to support and improve the critical systems that power electric utility operations. This role supports Operational Technology (OT) platforms including ADMS, OMS, SCADA, Advanced Systems, Mobile Field Client technologies, and OT/IT integrations such as IVR and AMI.

Working closely with Operations, Engineering, and Technology teams, this position helps ensure OT systems are reliable, secure, and aligned with business and operational goals. The role includes troubleshooting and supporting critical production systems, leading system upgrades and improvement initiatives, coordinating with vendors and stakeholders, and contributing to ongoing grid modernization and operational technology projects.

Compensation:

The anticipated hiring range is between $101,100 - 132,720. The final compensation offered is based on the selected candidate's qualifications, experience and skill level. In addition, this position is eligible for an annual bonus with a target payout of 8% based on company performance.

In this position, you will:

Production Support & System Analysis

  • Provide Tier 2/3 support for critical OT systems to minimize downtime and operational impact
  • Troubleshoot system issues, perform root cause analysis, and coordinate resolution with internal teams and vendors
  • Monitor system health, conduct log analysis, and support recovery activities
  • Perform patch management, change management, and ongoing system maintenance
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with software vendors and business stakeholders
  • Participate in an on-call support rotation

System Upgrades, Modernization & Project Leadership

  • Research, plan, test, and implement software patches and version upgrades
  • Lead OT-related software upgrade and implementation projects while coordinating cross-functional teams and IT resources
  • Coordinate testing activities, including user testing and user acceptance testing (UAT)
  • Educate business stakeholders on OT platform capabilities such as ADMS and AMI
  • Follow established change management methodologies and adoption frameworks
  • Support quality assurance activities including requirements validation, test planning, and test case execution

Strategic Systems Support & Business Collaboration

  • Develop expertise in OT business systems and recommend strategic technology improvements
  • Support configuration updates and enhancements to resolve operational business issues
  • Partner with business units to identify operational and process requirements
  • Document business processes and support continuous improvement initiatives
  • Stay informed on emerging technologies and utility industry best practices

Need to have:

  • Associate degree in computer sciences or related field
  • Five or more years of hands-on OT / IT infrastructure work including systems like SCADA, ADMS, OMS etc.
  • Five or more years of direct user interaction experience
  • Current and valid driver’s license

OR

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer sciences or related field
  • Three or more years of hands-on OT / IT infrastructure work including systems like SCADA, ADMS, OMS etc.
  • Three or more years of direct user interaction experience
  • Current and valid driver’s license

Pre-Employment Requirement: Employment is contingent upon successfully completing a pre-employment background check and drug screen

Based in Ramsey, Connexus Energy is Minnesota’s largest electric cooperative, providing electricity, renewable energy alternatives and related services to 150,000 residential and commercial members just north of the Twin Cities. We offer a collaborative work environment with challenging and rewarding work, which provides for professional development and work-life balance in a highly technical, stable and innovative industry. We give back to the communities we have served for more than 80 years by embracing opportunities to volunteer, donate and support economic development. Our talented and friendly staff focuses on achieving our mission of powering our members and communities toward a smarter energy future with a passionate focus on affordability, innovation, safety, and grid reliability.

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
Senior QA Engineer

Chai Vision

Job Title: Senior QA Engineer

Department: Product Development

Reports To: Head of EDI Integrations

Location: Onsite – Pakistan Office

Job Type: Full-Time


About Chai Vision

Chai Vision is a fast-growing eCommerce company managing a portfolio of direct-to-consumer (DTC) brands across high-impact categories—from fitness and wellness to home goods, pet care, children's products, outdoor products, kitchen essentials, and supplements. We scale rapidly on platforms like Shopify, Amazon, and TikTok Shop through a data-driven, community-first approach and a relentless focus on product-market fit.

The organization is driven by a data-informed approach to growth, disciplined operational execution, and a commitment to delivering high-quality products and customer experiences at scale. Chai Vision continues to invest in expanding its omnichannel sales strategy and retail presence worldwide, offering team members the opportunity to contribute within a fast-paced, performance-oriented organization focused on sustainable growth and long-term value creation.

The Role

Chai Vision is hiring its first dedicated Senior QA Engineer to build and operate the shared quality function across the Engineering organization, supporting Development, AI, IoT, integrations, and other engineering initiatives. This is not a manual-testing-only role — you will own the practical QA lifecycle end to end, from test planning and case design through functional, regression, integration, and API testing, to automation, release validation, and defect management.

As the first hire into this function, you will lay the foundation for a scalable QA practice that can grow into a dedicated team with a future QA Lead. You'll work closely with Development, AI, and IoT squads and with engineering leadership to give the organization a clear, reliable answer before every release: is this ready, what was tested, and what risks remain.

What You'll Do

Test Planning & Strategy

  • Translate requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria into comprehensive test scenarios
  • Identify functional, integration, and regression risks before development is complete
  • Create test plans for new features, applications, and releases
  • Define testing approaches based on the risk and complexity of each change
  • Maintain organized, reusable test suites and establish QA standards across engineering

Functional & Regression Testing

  • Perform structured testing across web applications, mobile applications, internal tools, APIs, and IoT/connected-device applications
  • Run functional, regression, smoke, sanity, exploratory, end-to-end, negative, edge-case, and cross-platform testing
  • Validate business workflows and data flows between systems
  • Build and maintain regression coverage for critical paths

API & Integration Testing

  • Validate REST APIs and service integrations, including request/response behavior, status codes, and error handling
  • Test authentication and authorization flows and data passed between systems
  • Investigate integration failures across EDI, ERP, IoT, and other business systems
  • Use tools such as Postman, Insomnia, or equivalent to build automated API test coverage

QA Automation

  • Identify repetitive, high-value test scenarios to automate and build/maintain automated test suites
  • Automate regression and API testing, and critical application workflows
  • Integrate automated tests into development and release workflows where appropriate
  • Maintain and continuously improve test reliability

Mobile & IoT Testing

  • Test iOS and Android applications, including device pairing, Bluetooth/BLE connectivity, and Wi-Fi provisioning
  • Validate device control, data synchronization, device state, and OTA updates
  • Test connectivity failure scenarios and device/application integration
  • Validate physical device behavior when hardware is available

Defect Management & Release Quality

  • Own the QA defect lifecycle from identification through verification, with clear, reproducible bug reports
  • Classify severity and priority, work with developers to reproduce and verify fixes, and track regressions
  • Review release scope, execute smoke/sanity and regression testing, and validate critical workflows before production releases
  • Provide clear release readiness assessments and support post-release validation when required

QA Process & AI-Assisted Testing

  • Help establish the foundation of Chai Vision's QA process: test case structure, defect reporting standards, release checklists, and quality metrics
  • Keep testing workflows practical and lightweight while improving delivery quality
  • Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) to generate test scenarios, expand coverage, and assist with automation — always reviewing and validating AI-generated output
  • Collaborate closely with Development, AI, IoT, Product, and Engineering Leadership across sprint planning, releases, and process improvements

Who You Are

  • You are a senior QA professional who understands that quality is more than finding bugs after development is finished
  • You know how to understand requirements and identify risks before development is complete, and can design comprehensive test scenarios and identify edge cases
  • You are comfortable testing APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems
  • You know how to build regression coverage and automate repetitive testing
  • You can investigate complex defects and communicate risk clearly to developers and engineering leadership
  • You are comfortable working across different types of software rather than being limited to one application
  • You are proactive — if you see a process that is likely to create quality problems, you raise it and help improve it

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 3–5+ years of professional QA/testing experience
  • Strong understanding of functional, regression, smoke, sanity, integration, end-to-end, exploratory, and negative testing
  • Strong API testing experience, including tools such as Postman or equivalent
  • Experience with test automation and working with web and/or mobile applications
  • Strong defect reporting and debugging skills
  • Experience working within Agile/Scrum teams and with Jira or comparable project management tools
  • Practical experience with several automation frameworks (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, Appium, Maestro, Detox, or equivalent)
  • Basic ability to read or write code in one or more languages such as JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Java, or C#
  • Understanding of automated testing within CI/CD environments (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Bitrise, or Fastlane) is highly desirable
  • Preferred: mobile QA (iOS/Android), IoT or connected-device testing, BLE/Wi-Fi device testing, Tuya or similar IoT platforms, e-commerce or ERP/EDI integration testing, and experience establishing QA processes from the ground up

Tools You'll Use

Postman · Playwright · Cypress · Selenium · Appium · Jira · GitHub Actions · Microsoft 365 (Teams, Excel, SharePoint) · Monday.com

Why Work With Us

  • Competitive salary and performance-based growth
  • Work in a fast-growing global eCommerce company with real ownership
  • Collaborative, high-energy environment where ideas become action
  • Opportunity to build and lead systems that drive company-wide impact
  • Holiday and birthday gifts — we celebrate our people
  • Real room to grow as we scale

"If you thrive in a fast-paced, data-driven environment and want to make a real impact at a growing eCommerce company, you'll love working here!"

The Community Development Associate supports Cook Children’s Health Foundation by assisting in all areas of the National and Regional Partnerships Department. The Community Development Associate will provide support for department fundraising initiatives including Children’s Miracle Network Hospitals and Community Partner Events. Execute donor relations activities for individual cmnhospitals.org donors, as well as assist with acquisition list to build Cook Children’s donor pipeline.

Event Logistics: Support team in coordination and scheduling of donor events, on and off campus, as directed. Assist team in ordering supplies and promotional materials. Assist in building Team Raiser / Luminate fundraising pages. Maintain department calendars for campaigns and events.

title: Sr. Principal Scientist, Clinical Operations Immunology Lead
location: USA - California - South San Francisco (Grand Ave)
description:
Job Description

Translational Medicine (TMed) drives early clinical development of novel therapeutics by partnering with Discovery Sciences and Late-Stage Clinical Research to translate scientific discoveries into human proof-of-concept and advance the most promising candidates through the pipeline to patients. Our Clinical and Operations organization designs and executes clinical pharmacology strategies spanning first-in-human studies through proof-of-biology/proof-of-concept and into late-stage development, supporting worldwide marketing applications and lifecycle management.

In a competitive external landscape and fast-paced internal environment, the Immunology Clinical Operations Lead position provides both strategic and operational leadership across early immunology programs, ensuring timely, high-quality execution of clinical studies and clinical pharmacology strategies worldwide. The successful candidate will telescope between strategy and hands-on execution across a portfolio of diverse modalities (e.g. peptides, small molecules, biologics), and partner cross-functionally to develop the needed expertise to successfully advance programs to key inflection points in development. This role is equivalent in level to a Senior Director position.

All candidates located within a 50-mile driving radius of the site will be required to come onsite on a hybrid schedule. Candidates outside of the 50-mile radius are expected to travel onsite on a regular monthly basis.

Why join us:

  • Take a clinical operations leadership role at the intersection of discovery and clinical development to advance novel immunology therapeutics from bench to bedside.

  • Influence strategy, build teams, and deliver high-impact clinical programs that shape the future of patient care.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Co-own and execute the early clinical development strategy for the immunology portfolio with the Head of TMed Immunology

  • Provide comprehensive strategic planning and operational oversight for immunology clinical programs and trials to maximize operational feasibility, efficiency, and ensure consistency and quality across the portfolio

  • Build global network of immunology sites and foster relationships with key investigators for Ph1b/2a patient trials to deliver on clinical program goals

  • Serve as the deep subject matter expert and issue escalation point for early immunology clinical operations

  • Ensure appropriate resources, competencies, and partnerships are in place to meet objectives

  • Critically review strategy and clinical program documents (development plans, investigator’s brochures, protocols, etc.), providing scientific and operational insight to ensure best path forward

  • Partner with Business Development and Licensing to evaluate internal and external opportunities that align with portfolio strategy

  • Actively participate in annual and quarterly planning cycles: identify risks, develop and execute mitigation plans, and track performance metrics and outcomes

  • Ensure immunology data integrity across organization (Book of Business, CTMS, etc.)

  • Build and sustain strong cross-functional relationships (country operations, clinical supplies, data management, regulatory, etc.) across departments, divisions, and geographies

  • Foster the people pipeline: Attract, coach, mentor, and retain talent; provide performance management support; act as ‘player-coach’ to enrich group skillsets. Potential for people management.

  • Represent TMed on enterprise strategic initiatives and lead continuous-improvement efforts that increase clinical efficiency and scientific impact

  • Serve as a member of the TMed Clinical Operations leadership team and contribute to shaping department strategy

Education Requirement

  • Degree in Life Sciences with one of the following experience combinations:

  • Bachelor’s degree + ≥16 years related experience, OR

  • Master’s degree + ≥15 years related experience, OR

  • PhD/PharmD + ≥12 years related experience

  • Related Experience Includes: pharmaceutical industry roles in clinical drug development, clinical trial management, clinical site monitoring/training, medical/regulatory writing, or translational science

Required Experience and Skills

  • Extensive clinical operations experience in the planning and execution of early clinical development trials (Phase 1 and early proof-of-concept)

  • Demonstrated ability to translate knowledge to other areas to effectively collaborate, network, and influence peers, senior leaders, and external partners

  • Proven track record building and leading high-performing cross-functional teams in a matrixed environment

  • Strong decision-making skills, weighing advantages, disadvantages, and business impact for rapid decisions and proven track record delivering results on firm deadlines

  • Ability to work successfully with ambiguity and embrace uncertainty

  • Strong oral and written communication skills

  • Experience attracting, developing, and retaining talent

Preferred Experience and Skills

  • Experience leading clinical programs and trials for gastroenterology, dermatology, and/or rheumatology, especially autoimmune or immune-mediated disorders, including in both large and small pharma contexts

  • Familiarity with broader pharmaceutical industry considerations and trends beyond clinical development

Job Description:

What’s the role

Shell is looking for a Retails Development & Construction Engineer (also known internally as Mobility & Convenience Engineering Non-Fuel Retail & Shop Expert).

Shell Mobility & Convenience is looking for an experienced engineering expert to shape the future of our convenience retail network. As the CR Engineering Senior Expert - Store Development and Construction, you will bring deep convenience retail, shop-format, construction, and value-engineering expertise to help design, optimize, and deploy world-class Non-Fuel Retail solutions across Shell’s global mobility footprint.

This is a high-impact subject matter expert techno-commercial role focused on shop formats, car wash, equipment, fixtures, partner delivery models, and scalable engineering standards. You will work closely with global marketing, local markets, suppliers, and delivery partners, and leverage deep external industry experience to create safe, customer-focused, commercially competitive solutions that support Shell’s ambition to grow convenience and mobility offerings globally.

Shell Mobility & Convenience is one of the world’s largest mobility retailers, operating across more than 80 markets with over 40,000 Shell-branded locations and more than 75,000 EV charge points. Every day, we serve millions of customers and are transforming our retail network to make life’s journeys better—safely, sustainably, and competitively.

You will join our Network Engineering Solutions and Sustainability organization within Mobility & Convenience, a global team partnering with markets to deliver engineering, convenience, and sustainability solutions at pace. A world-class Center of Excellence that combines global scale, local market insight, technical excellence, and a strong focus on customer value.

Accountabilities:

  • Lead global engineering and value-engineering solutions across Non-Fuel Retail (NFR), including convenience shops, car wash, shop equipment, fixtures, materials, signage, and sustainable equipment solutions. Expected to be Mobility & Convenience’s global expert on Zero Based Value Engineering development & principles, as well as asset strategy applied to shop/NFR

  • Develop, maintain, and assure fit for purpose global engineering design standards and playbooks that enable safe, scalable, industry leading cost-competitive, and customer-focused shop formats and NFR solutions. Provide clear design direction to markets and partners to enable localization, scalability and cost efficiency

  • Partner with global marketing, local market teams, suppliers, and delivery partners to optimize shop format design, branding, sourcing, construction, and total cost of ownership

  • Leverage and translate convenience retail trends, customer insights, and competitive benchmarking into engineering solutions that improve commercial performance and customer experience

  • Support the deployment of new shop formats and major format changes, including pilot delivery, reference design principles, unit costing, localization guidance, and replication across markets

  • Lead technical assurance and relationship management for global framework agreement partners supporting mobility shop and format delivery

  • Shape sourcing strategies for shop equipment, fixtures, and delivery partners, leveraging scale to improve quality, cost efficiency, and speed to market

  • Lead and support the population of market engineers involved in shop/NFR projects (detailed design, design, and execution). Build capability across market engineering teams by developing technical guidance, training materials, and accreditation support for shop and NFR design, maintenance, and construction

  • Develop engineering solutions that profitably reduce site energy consumption and emissions across Shell’s mobility network

  • Influence stakeholders in a global virtual environment, aligning engineering solutions with brand, customer experience, safety, sustainability, and commercial objectives

What you bring

  • Must have legal authorization to work in the US on a full-time basis for anyone other than current employer

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction, architecture, project management, or a related technical discipline

  • At least 8 years of relevant engineering, construction, project delivery, and/or convenience retail experience. Experience in the Oil industry is not a must

  • Hands-on experience delivering shop/store, convenience retail, car wash, or similar retail network construction or upgrade projects

title: Lead Financial Strategist
description:
Your role

Finance - Financial Planning & Analysis - M3 - IND

What you'll be doing

Position Overview

Corpay India is looking to hire a Lead Financial Strategist within our Cross-Border division, supporting the payments line of business. This role works closely with business leaders, the Director of Financial Planning & Analytics, and senior management to deliver analytics and strategy that support sustainable revenue growth and customer retention.

What We Need

The Lead Financial Strategist is responsible for forecasting, modeling, and analysis that help identify risks, uncover opportunities, and enhance the sustainable profitability of the business. The role also supports business intelligence projects, prepares management presentations, and translates business concepts into meaningful, actionable analytics.

Stakeholder Engagement and Problem Solving

The incumbent will facilitate design and concept-gathering sessions, engage key stakeholders, and help drive strategic initiatives and projects. Strong problem-solving and conflict-resolution skills are essential to identifying, communicating, and resolving issues effectively.

How We Work

As a Lead Financial Strategist, you will be expected to work from our office location in Chennai. Corpay will set you up for success by providing:

  • Assigned workspace in office set up

  • Company-issued equipment

Role Responsibilities

The responsibilities of the role will include:

  • Champion process improvements and automation to enhance cycle times, accuracy, and executive management visibility.

  • Collaborating with the different stakeholders and teams in managing strategic projects, delivering management presentations on key initiatives to the leadership team.

  • Lead performance management routines and convert results into actionable plans with owners and due dates.

  • Build scalable forecasting models and strengthen driver-based planning across functions or product lines.

  • Modeling to evaluate ROI and perform due diligence for acquisitions and mergers, while also providing support for integration projects post-acquisition.

  • Champion process improvements and automation to enhance cycle times, accuracy, and executive visibility.

  • Prioritize work and ensure delivery across competing deadlines and ad hoc requests.

Qualifications & Skills

  • 15+ years’ experience in Financial Planning and Analytics

  • Business Intelligence tools (Power BI)

  • Budgeting and Forecasting

  • Microsoft Office - PowerPoint, Excel, Word

Other requirements (nice to have):

  • Project Management

  • Experience in Consulting

  • Experience in Mergers and Acquisitions

  • Basic Knowledge of CRM (Salesforce)

  • Microsoft SQL, Visio, SharePoint

  • Contribute to strategic initiatives by offering financial expertise and analysis to assess investment opportunities and potential risks.

  • Analyze, track, and measure the impact of various ongoing revenue initiatives as part of the roles and responsibilities.

  • Analysis of key metrics and trends proactively to support customer revenue retention and growth.

  • Engage with essential stakeholders, senior management, and diverse levels within the sales organization to collect information and data points on key initiatives, facilitating the analysis of business performance.

  • Prepare and distribute precise and timely financial and business reports that bolster the decision-making capabilities of senior management and executives.

  • Identify opportunities and propose enhancements to existing processes, prioritizing increased efficiencies and the integration of value-added analytics.

  • Implement best practices in financial modeling, data analysis, and reporting to improve accuracy and reliability of forecasts.

  • Collaborate with the FP&A team to support revenue initiatives and analysis during the forecast and budget process as needed.

  • Facilitate the design, development, and upkeep of new reports while ensuring the maintenance of necessary management reports.

  • Foster a collaborative and supportive work environment, promoting knowledge sharing and continuous learning.

About Corpay

Corpay is a global technology organization that is leading the future of commercial payments with a culture of innovation that drives us to constantly create new and better ways to pay. title: Maintenance Tech
description:
Position Description:

Performs various maintenance duties necessary to maintain and enhance the value of the community. Supports and aids the Maintenance Supervisor or Property Manager in all phases of the overall physical maintenance of the property. This includes but is not limited to; the general maintenance of the property, expense control, and adherence to preventive maintenance programs and required state and federal safety programs.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following:

  • Bending, stooping, squatting, crawling, and climbing are frequent activities.
  • Lifting and carrying of bulky or heavy items may be required.
  • The individual must own and maintain a basic hand tool inventory.
  • Maintenance knowledge is imperative, along with the capability to assess health and safety requirements.
  • Maintains high standards of resident service and relations for entire staff.
  • Ensures that residents are provided with a clean, safe, well maintained community.
  • Ensures that maintenance requests are handled as quickly, efficiently and effectively as possible and always completed within 24 hours.
  • Ordering parts & communicating with Property Manager & Residents if there will be a delay.
  • Adherence to company monthly preventive maintenance directives, with regard to but not limited to; lighting, fire safety, pool/spa, life/safety hazards, and signage check under the direction of the Maintenance Supervisor or Community Manager.
  • Possesses knowledge of location of gas, electric, irrigation, and water shutoffs, all apartment and fixture shutoffs, and sewer cleanouts and familiarity with posted map.
  • Assists in performing apartment move-in and move-out inspections as directed by Maintenance Supervisor or Property Manager.
  • Knows current condition/status of all vacant apartments.
  • Recommends measures to improve methods of operations, performance, safety and quality of service.
  • Suggests changes in working conditions and use of equipment to increase efficiency of shop, department, or work crew.
  • Performs on-call emergency service as required.
  • Assists the Maintenance Supervisor or Property Manager on special maintenance projects, i.e., preventive maintenance of building components and/or mechanicals.
  • Adheres to Advanced Management Group’s Injury and Illness Prevention Policy and Asbestos and Hazardous Materials Policy.
  • Maintains records and Material Safety Data sheets on all hazardous materials chemicals utilized on site assuring employees are familiar with the precautions on the sheets before using them.
  • Ensures regular and timely communication to Community Manager noting any maintenance problems or life/safety deficiencies.

Maintenance Technician Requirements:

  • High School Diploma or G.E.D preferred.
  • Intermediate to advanced level of vendor relations knowledge and all phases of apartment and preventative maintenance including but not limited to appliance, plumbing, carpentry, electrical, HVAC, painting, drywall education and experience.
  • Must be able to read, speak, write and understand the English language.
  • Possess effective problem solving, verbal and written communication skills.
  • Basic computer skills are required.
  • Position requires equal amounts of sitting, walking, standing and lifting up to 50 lbs., pushing, pulling, climbing, bending and various equipment/tool operation daily.
  • Must have and maintain own tools.
  • Position requires on-call duty.

title: Asiakasneuvoja Sanoma Medialle Jyväskylään
description:
Oletko koskaan saanut niin hyvää palvelua, että olet jäänyt miettimään, miksei sellaista saa aina?

Me uskomme, että erinomainen asiakaskokemus syntyy silloin, kun asiakkaan asia ratkaistaan tehokkaasti, asiakkaan tarpeet ymmärretään aidosti ja hänelle löydetään juuri oikea ratkaisu.

Haemme nyt asiakasneuvojia Sanoma Median asiakaspalveluun Jyväskylään.

Mistä työssä on kyse?

Sanoma on mukana lähes jokaisen suomalaisen arjessa. Asiakkaitamme ovat esimerkiksi Helsingin Sanomien, Aamulehden, Ilta-Sanomien, Ruudun sekä muiden Sanoman tunnettujen mediabrändien tilaajat.

Asiakasneuvojana kohtaat päivittäin suuren määrän erilaisia asiakkaita ja tilanteita. Palvelet asiakkaita puhelimessa, chatissa ja sähköpostitse, mutta puhelin on tärkein työvälineesi.

Työ on nopeatahtista ja tavoitteellista: päivän aikana ratkaiset suuren määrän asiakasyhteydenottoja tehokkaasti, laadukkaasti ja asiakkaan tarpeet huomioiden.

Merkittävä osa tehtävää on asiakkuuksien säilyttäminen ja asiakkaan sitouttaminen Sanoman tuotteisiin ja palveluihin. Kun asiakas harkitsee tilauksensa päättämistä, tehtäväsi on ymmärtää syyt päätöksen taustalla ja löytää ratkaisu, jonka ansiosta asiakas haluaa jatkaa palvelun käyttöä. Työhön kuuluu myös aktiivinen lisämyynti: tunnistat asiakkaan tarpeita ja tarjoat hänelle tuotteita ja palveluita, joista hänelle on aidosti iloa ja hyötyä.

Seuraamme onnistumisia tehokkuuden, palvelun laadun, asiakaskokemuksen ja myynnillisten tavoitteiden näkökulmasta.

Miten onnistut työssäsi?

✅motivoidut tavoitteista ja omien tulosten seuraamisesta

✅työskentelet tehokkaasti myös kiireisessä tilanteissa

✅tunnistat asiakkaan tarpeet ja uskallat ehdottaa ratkaisuja

✅opit uusia asioita nopeasti

✅säilytät positiivisen palveluasenteen haastavissakin tilanteissa

✅haluat kehittyä jatkuvasti paremmaksi asiakaskohtaamisten ammattilaiseksi

Asiakastilanteet vaihtuvat päivän aikana nopeasti, ja ratkaisu on löydettävä usein useita tietolähteitä hyödyntäen. Työssä tarvitaan oma-aloitteisuutta, hyvää tilannetajua ja kykyä viedä asiakkaan asia sujuvasti päätökseen myös silloin, kun ratkaisu ei ole heti ilmeinen.

Aiempi kokemus asiakaspalvelusta, myynnistä tai puhelintyöstä katsotaan eduksi.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen tehtävän tunnetun suomalaisen mediatalon asiakaspalvelussa. Työskentelet osana Rainmakeria yhdessä muiden Sateentekijöiden kanssa.

Lupaamme sinulle:

✅kattavan perehdytyksen ja koulutuksen tehtävään

✅kokeneiden kollegoiden ja esihenkilöiden tuen

✅tavoitteellisen mutta kannustavan työympäristön

✅mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa ansioihisi onnistumisten kautta

✅mahdollisuuden kasvaa ja kehittyä asiakaspalvelun eri tehtävissä

Saat jatkuvaa valmennusta ja tukea, jotta voit kehittää osaamistasi, saavuttaa tavoitteesi ja kasvattaa ansioitasi.


Rainmaker = Mahdollisuus menestyä

Rainmaker on Suomen suurin myynnin ja asiakastyön palveluyritys. Palveluksessamme työskentelee noin 1500 sateentekijöiksikin kutsuttua palvelualan ammattilaista ympäri Suomen sijaitsevissa toimipisteissämme, asiakkaidemme toimitiloissa sekä toimipisteessämme Espanjan Torreviejassa. Haluamme tarjota sekä työntekijöillemme, että asiakkaillemme mahdollisuuksia menestyä!

Meitä sateentekijöitä yhdistää positiivinen asenne ja halu kehittää itseämme. Teemme työtä sen eteen, että sinä saat työstäsi sen, mitä elämässäsi juuri nyt tarvitset. Meillä on tilaa yksilöllisille urapoluille asiakaskohtaamisten maailmassa ja edustamme sekä kotimaisia että kansainvälisiä huippubrändejä eri toimialoilta. Laadukkaat myynnilliset asiakaskohtaamiset ovat meille sydämen asia. Panostamme työhyvinvointiin, hyvään työilmapiiriin ja innostuneeseen työyhteisöön, sillä mielestämme työssä pitää olla myös hauskaa. Työkulttuuriimme kuuluvat myös erilaiset hauskat kilpailut pelillistämisen keinoin.

💙 Edut ja työntekijöiden hyvinvointi

✅ Maksamme myös aluekohtaista toimintarahaa kuukausitasolla, joka voidaan käyttää yhdessäoloon paikallisesti.

✅ Kattava Terveystalon työterveyshuolto.

Heräsikö kiinnostuksesi?

Voit jättää meille hakemuksen kohdasta ”Hae työpaikkaa”. Haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana. Mikäli jokin asia jäi askarruttamaan, voit kääntyä rekrytoijamme Tanjan puoleen. Hänet tavoitat numerosta 040 714 7993 puhelimitse.

Perustiedot:

Aloitus: 2.11.2026
Paikkakunta: Jyväskylä + hybridityö perehdytyksen jälkeen. Toimistomme sijaitsee osoitteessa Kauppakatu 37.
Työsuhteen tyyppi: Toistaiseksi voimassaoleva
Työaika: 30-37.5h/vko. Pääsääntöisesti työvuorot sijoittuvat arkeen klo 8-16.30.
Palkkaus: 12 €/h + tehokkuuteen, laatuun ja lisämyyntiin perustuva palkkiomalli. KTA noin 15e/h. Koulutusjakso kestää yhden kuukauden ja koulutusjakson palkkaus on 85 % sovitusta pohjatuntipalkasta.

title: CHASSIS DIAGNOSTIC TECHNICIAN
description:
Chassis Diagnostic Technician

North Trail RV has been a family-owned and operated RV Dealership in Fort Myers, FL for over 30 years. A career with North Trail RV means unwavering support from a tight-knit group of individuals who care deeply about our craft, one another, and the community we share.

As a member of the North Trail family, you will be provided every opportunity to utilize your skills as part of a collaborative culture that encourages innovation and values kindness and respect above all. In addition to competitive wages, we offer health, dental, and vision insurance. We also offer paid time off, life insurance, HSA, and 401K retirement benefits with employer match.

Join us and discover the North Trail difference for yourself!

A Chassis Diagnostic Technician is responsible for diagnosing, troubleshooting, and repairing mechanical and electrical issues related to the chassis systems of recreational vehicles, including engine, transmission, suspension, braking, steering, and related components. The Chassis Diagnostic Technician requires advanced diagnostic skills and the ability to accurately identify root causes of vehicle performance concerns.

Responsibilities:

  • Perform accurate and efficient comprehensive diagnostics on chassis systems including engine, drivetrain, suspension, steering, and braking systems
  • Utilize diagnostic tools, scan tools, and software to identify faults and error codes
  • Interpret technical manuals, wiring diagrams, and manufacturer bulletins
  • Accurately determine root cause of mechanical and electrical failures
  • Document diagnostic procedures, findings, and recommended repairs clearly and thoroughly
  • Communicate findings with service advisors and management
  • Perform necessary repairs or coordinate with appropriate technicians
  • Conduct road tests to verify concerns and confirm repairs
  • Ensure all work is completed in accordance with manufacturer standards and safety regulations

Requirements:

  • Experience in automotive, diesel, or RV chassis diagnostics
  • Strong understanding of gasoline and/or diesel engine systems
  • Proficiency with diagnostic scan tools and troubleshooting equipment
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics and service manuals
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Strong teamwork and communication with service department staff
  • Valid driver’s license with acceptable driving record
  • Ability to operate large vehicles (Class A/B RV experience preferred)
  • Experience with RV chassis platforms (Ford, Freightliner, Spartan, ect.) preferred
  • OEM training or certifications preferred

title: Crane Operator A
description:
Position Summary:

The Crane Operator A is a senior-level role responsible for the safe and efficient operation of lattice boom and hydraulic cranes in support of port, terminal, and project operations. This position plays a critical role in handling bulk materials, cargo, and heavy equipment while ensuring compliance with safety regulations, operational procedures, and lift plans. The Crane Operator A serves as a lead operator on complex lifts and provides guidance to rigging crews and less-experienced personnel.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Operate lattice boom and hydraulic cranes to safely load, unload, and move bulk materials, cargo, and heavy equipment.
  • Execute lifting operations in accordance with load charts, lift plans, and site-specific requirements.
  • Perform daily pre- and post-operation inspections to ensure cranes and associated equipment are in safe working condition.
  • Coordinate closely with riggers, signal persons, and ground crews to ensure safe and efficient lift execution.
  • Serve as a lead operator on complex or high-risk lifts, providing direction and oversight during operations.
  • Maintain accurate lift logs, inspection records, and operational documentation.
  • Adhere to all OSHA, MSHA, and company safety policies, including proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE).
  • Communicate clearly and effectively with supervisors, crew members, and operations personnel throughout all lifting activities.
  • Identify and report mechanical issues, safety concerns, or hazards promptly.
  • Assist with crane setup, teardown, and mobilization as required.
  • Support general port or project operations when crane work is not required.
  • Mentor and support less-experienced operators and crew members in safe operating practices.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned to support safe and efficient operations.

Required Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or GED equivalent preferred.
  • Minimum of 5+ years of experience operating lattice boom and hydraulic cranes in port, construction, or industrial environments.
  • Demonstrated expertise in reading and applying crane load charts, lift plans, and rigging principles.
  • Proven ability to operate safely in complex, high-traffic environments.
  • Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record.
  • Strong understanding of crane safety standards, signaling, and operational best practices.

Preferred Experience:

  • OSHA 10 or OSHA 30 certification.
  • NCCCO (National Commission for the Certification of Crane Operators) certification or equivalent.
  • Transportation Worker Identification Credential (TWIC) or ability to obtain.
  • Experience operating cranes in marine terminal or waterfront environments.
  • Experience with heavy lifts, bulk material handling, and vessel operations.

Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to sit, climb, and operate crane equipment for extended periods.
  • Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds and perform physically demanding tasks as needed.
  • Ability to work at heights and in varying outdoor conditions, including heat, cold, rain, and wind.
  • Required use of PPE (hard hat, safety vest, steel‑toe boots) in operational areas.

Work Environment:

  • Field-based role at marine terminals, construction sites, and industrial job locations.
  • Exposure to noise, vibration, dust, and heavy equipment operations.
  • Fast-paced, safety-sensitive environment requiring strong focus, coordination, and communication.
  • Work schedules may include shift work, extended hours, weekends, and overtime based on operational demands.

title: Research Assistant - Scholarly Fashion Studies Book Proposal Assistant
description:
The Research Assistant will support the research development and preparation of a scholarly fashion studies book proposal focused on swimwear. Building on an established theoretical framework examining swimwear through the intersections of diversity, social justice, and environmental impact, the position will assist the Lead Faculty Researcher in advancing the project from existing research and annotated bibliographies toward thematic synthesis, structural development, and manuscript planning.

The Research Assistant will contribute to organizing and synthesizing existing scholarship, developing the project’s thematic architecture, researching appropriate publishing formats and requirements, and supporting preparation of materials for submission to prospective academic publishers.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Review existing annotated bibliographies and research notes to identify, organize, and synthesize key themes relevant to the book project.

  • Support refinement of the book’s focus and thematic structure through literature mapping and comparative analysis of existing scholarship.

  • Assist with evaluating potential publication formats, including a single-author monograph and edited volume, and support development of corresponding chapter structures.

  • Support preparation of the book proposal by organizing theoretical frameworks, research findings, chapter concepts, and related project materials.

  • Research publisher requirements and proposal guidelines, including those of Intellect Publishing and other appropriate academic presses.

  • Format and organize proposal materials in accordance with publisher submission requirements.

  • Depending on the final publication strategy, assist with research and organizational support for a potential special issue or edited-volume pathway.

  • Identify and catalogue potential multidisciplinary scholars and contributors whose work addresses relevant gaps in swimwear scholarship.

  • Maintain bibliographies, research files, project documentation, and milestone tracking to support the timely development of the project.

Qualifications – Education, Experience, and Skills

  • Currently enrolled in a graduate program (Master’s or Ph.D.) in Fashion Studies, Art History, Cultural Studies, Sociology, the Humanities, or a closely related field.

  • Strong written communication, organizational, analytical, and research skills.

  • Familiarity with literature reviews, annotated bibliographies, and scholarly research practices.

  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple tasks, and meet agreed-upon project timelines.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to organize research materials and project documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Research interest or prior experience in critical fashion studies, sustainability, body politics, social justice, or related interdisciplinary areas.

  • Familiarity with academic publishing processes, book proposals, or editorial workflows.

WORK MODE:

  • Hybrid/Remote - Employees hired for this position primarily work remotely with the occasional on-campus presence required with advanced notice. Employees in this role will also be expected to use their best judgment to be on campus when necessary in order to best fulfill the responsibilities of their job descriptions. #LI-DNI

title: Test Specialist
description:
CoolIT Systems, Inc. is hiring a full-time Test Specialist (Mechanical/PCL) to lead passive cold plate loop and vertical rack manifold testing and qualification activities. In this role, you will develop and execute test plans to verify products meet internal and customer requirements. You will analyze hardware and software specifications, design test strategies, and evaluate the performance and reliability of electromechanical systems. Responsibilities include conducting temperature, pressure, flow, and mechanical stress tests, identifying design issues, troubleshooting failures through root cause analysis, and supporting engineering improvements. You will also assist with test equipment development, component selection, technical documentation, and detailed reporting of test results and recommendations.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop and implement NPI product validation and qualification test plans for thermal and fluid-cooling systems, focusing on cold plates, manifolds, seals, and electromechanical assemblies.

  • Apply heat transfer and thermodynamics principles and knowledge to interpret thermal tests for liquid-cooled components.

  • Understand hardware and software requirements and design documents to develop comprehensive test strategies and procedures.

  • Design and evaluate validation protocols, including HALT, thermal, pressure, mechanical, flow (PQ), thermal performance (RQ), and packaging integrity testing.

  • Investigate failure modes including fatigue, corrosion, creep, thermal cycle degradation, and manufacturing defects.

  • Perform risk assessments based on bill of material, design reviews, manufacturing processes and other available engineering documents to qualify products.

  • Conduct material compatibility evaluations on metals, elastomers, polymers, fittings, and surface-finished components.

  • Prepare technical reports and validation documentation to support engineering release and customer approval.

  • Analyze test data to validate design performance and recommend design improvements to ensure compliance with technical specifications.

  • Conduct root cause analysis of test failures and coordinate cross-functional corrective actions.

  • Exercise engineering judgment in technical disposition and decisions in collaboration with cross functional teams.

  • Provide technical guidance and training to technicians and technologists.

  • Maintain test logs, records, and reports in alignment with internal processes.

  • Ensure compliance with all lab safety requirements and best practices.

WHO YOU ARE:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering, or other relevant field.

  • Proven experience in solidworks design, including 3D modeling, detailed drawings, assembly design, and design for manufacturability (DFM).

  • A minimum of 3 years of engineering experience in a testing environment.

  • Working knowledge of instrumentation including pressure transducers, temperatures sensors, flow sensors, etc.

  • Solid experience in setting up and using DAQ's, sensors, and actuators for data-driven analysis.

  • Experience in using diagnostic bench tools (oscilloscope, power analyzer, logic analyzer, multimeter, etc.).

  • Demonstrated experience in analyzing, testing, and qualifying electro-mechanical parts and systems.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree is considered an asset.

  • P.Eng designation considered an asset.

  • Experience with data center liquid cooling systems.

  • Familiarity with rack-level cooling infrastructure such as manifolds, hoses, quick disconnects, and fittings.

Skills:

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

  • Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills

  • High attention to detail and technical documentation accuracy.

WHY COOLIT?

We strive to be an employer of choice and as such we believe in rewarding our employees with career and development opportunities that will maintain and strengthen our culture while aligning to our vision and values.

We are a company that is full of vibrant, innovative people who love what we do. Our comprehensive benefits package includes:

  • Vacation and flex days, and paid company-wide shutdown during the holiday season.

  • Comprehensive benefits including Dental, Drugs, Optical, Paramedical and Health Spending. These costs are covered by CoolIT and are enacted from your first day.

  • Dress for your day – in a casual yet professional environment.

  • Retention rewards like “The Big Coffee Break” that reward tenure with additional vacation time and a monetary bonus.

  • Company sponsored RRSP plan

We thank every candidate in advance, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Successful candidates for this position will be required to undergo background checks including criminal records check and education.

ABOUT COOLIT SYSTEMS INC.

Founded in Calgary, Alberta in 2001, CoolIT Systems is the leading Direct Liquid Cooling technology provider for data centers, supercomputers, and desktop computers. We design and manufacture solutions used by the largest tech companies globally.

Recognized as one of “The Americas’ Fastest Growing Companies 2023” by Financial Times and honored with the Deloitte Fast 50 Clean Technology award in 2022, as well as the Deloitte Fast 500 distinctions in both 2021 and 2022, CoolIT's rapid growth is capturing global attention.
