title: Sr. Director, User Experience
description:
Meet the Moment with Alteryx

We're living through a once-in-a-generation shift in how work gets done. Data, automation, and AI are quickly becoming the center of every business decision - and Alteryx is leading the transformation.

You'll be working on the challenges that sit at the heart of modern business. No matter your role, the work you do will help organizations move faster, see more clearly, and tackle questions that used to feel impossible.

If you're ready to meet the moment with innovation, curiosity, and excellence, there's a place for you here.

Senior Director, User Experience

Alteryx | Experience & Insights Organization

Location: Remote (Alteryx is a remote-first company) | Reports to: VP, Experience & Insights

About the Role

Alteryx is a leading AI-ready data and analytics company, bringing 25+ years of category-leading experience into the agentic AI era. More than 8,000 customers around the world rely on Alteryx to turn messy data into trusted, explainable decisions at scale. We're in the middle of an exciting shift: from workflows people run to agentic experiences that reason, act, and deliver outcomes on their behalf. Design is central to making that shift feel trustworthy, intuitive, and genuinely delightful, which is exactly what this role is here to lead.

This is a senior leadership role inside Alteryx's Experience & Insights organization, which also includes Customer Signals, Experience Foundations, and Content. The Senior Director of User Experience will directly manage the leaders of four product design teams — roughly 30 designers in total, spread across the globe — and will partner closely with cross-functional peers so design decisions are grounded in strategy, built on shared foundations, and delivered with real operational rigor.

The opportunity is to scale and elevate the work of the product design teams today while setting the vision for our future design state. We believe strong design leadership rests on three things: the ability to shape design and product strategy (increasingly, AI-powered and agentic product strategy), the discipline to run design as a scalable, measurable operation, and the people leadership skill to grow and unlock a talented global team. This role calls for real depth in all three.

What You'll Do

Design & Product Strategy

  • Evolve the design vision and strategy for Alteryx's product portfolio, with particular focus on shaping how AI-powered and agentic experiences show up for customers, ensuring they feel trustworthy, explainable, and genuinely useful, not just automated.

  • Represent design in senior leadership forums, advocating for user-centered outcomes and defending design quality under commercial pressure.

  • Partner with product management, engineering, and executive leadership to shape roadmaps, influence prioritization, and represent the user's perspective in major product decisions.

  • Translate customer signals — research, telemetry, Voice of Customer, and preview program findings — into design direction, working closely with the leaders who own those disciplines.

Operational Discipline

  • Build and run the operating model for a 30-person, globally distributed design organization: staffing, capacity planning, prioritization frameworks, and design-ops processes that scale across four teams and multiple product lines.

  • Set clear, repeatable processes and expectations for design discovery, design review, and handoff to engineering, so quality and rigor don't depend on any one person being in the room.

  • Establish design metrics and quality bars to demonstrate the team's impact and identify where to improve.

  • Champion the integration of AI across the design practice to streamline repeatable work and create space for the team to experiment with new approaches and focus deeply on solving complex problems.

  • Own budget, tooling, and contractor/vendor relationships supporting the design organization.

People Leadership

  • Directly manage the four design leaders running each product design team, coaching them to grow their own people and raise the bar for their teams.

  • Continue building a culture of rigorous, kind critique and high craft standards across a strong, globally distributed team, protecting what works while pushing it further.

  • Champion career paths, leveling, and growth plans for designers at every level, and be a visible advocate for design careers inside Alteryx.

  • Help the team blaze trails with AI, building their fluency and confidence designing agentic, AI-powered experiences, and modeling curiosity rather than caution.

What You'll Bring

  • 15+ years in product design, including 6+ years leading design managers or leads (not just individual designers) in a SaaS or enterprise software environment.

  • A track record of leading multiple design teams at once across a broad product portfolio; experience with complex, technical, or data-heavy products is a strong plus.

  • Genuine enthusiasm and point of view about designing AI-powered and agentic experiences, not just familiarity with the trend.

  • Demonstrated ability to operate across all levels, from shaping strategy with executives to reviewing craft and providing hands-on design feedback.

  • Experience building and running design operations at scale: resourcing models, metrics, review cadences, and tooling.

  • Experience managing distributed, global teams, with the cultural fluency to lead well across every time zone.

  • Working knowledge of design systems, accessibility, and localization, and the judgment to know when to defer to functional experts versus weigh in directly.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to influence peers and executives without formal authority over adjacent functions like product management, engineering, and research.

  • A genuinely collaborative approach: this role sits inside a broader ecosystem and succeeds only in close partnership with peer leaders across the product, experience & insights, and engineering organizations.

Compensation:

Alteryx is committed to fair, equitable, and transparent compensation. Final compensation will be determined by various factors such as your relevant work experience, education, certifications, skills, and geographic location.

The salary range for this role in the United States is $253,000 - $279,000.

Employees may also be eligible for a wide range of other benefits, such as a bonus or commission, medical, retirement, financial, wellness, time off, employee discounts, and others.

Interested? Learn more and apply today at alteryx.com/careers!

Find yourself checking a lot of these boxes but doubting whether you should apply? At Alteryx, we support a growth mindset for our associates through all stages of their careers. If you meet some of the requirements and you share our values, we encourage you to apply. As part of our ongoing commitment to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace, we’re invested in building teams with a wide variety of backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

Benefits & Perks:

Alteryx has amazing benefits for all Associates which can be viewed here.

For roles in San Francisco and Los Angeles: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Alteryx will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

title: Reinsurance Broker Intern
location: New York – 1350 Avenue Of The Americas
description:
Howden Re is the global reinsurance broker and risk, capital & strategic advisor focused on relentless innovation & superior analytics for top client service. ​ ​

About Role

Internship: Reinsurance Broker

Location: New York, NY or Edina, MN
Salary: up to $30/hour + overtime
Apply by: Friday 16th October       

Introduction

Not many people have ever thought about what insurance companies do when they need insurance. Well, they go to a Reinsurance company or broker. And that’s what we do. We provide brokerage insurance for insurance companies, meaning we have access to the entire market and can secure the best deal for our clients.

What you’ll be doing

As a Reinsurance Broker Intern, you’ll learn more about the world of reinsurance, risk mitigation solutions, contract negotiation, portfolio management, and general reinsurance decision making for our current and prospective clients. You’ll work both independently and as a valued member of the team.

In addition, you’ll also:

  • Help with reinsurance placements and client initiatives

  • Help in tracking reinsurance placements

  • Help with the creation of client marketing materials

  • Perform risk analysis and financial modeling

  • Complete market research and analysis

Who we’re looking for

You’ll be able to clearly communicate your thoughts and ideas both in writing and in person. And be able to handle multiple tasks and projects at the same time in a client service, deadline-driven environment.

You will:

  • Be actively pursuing a degree majoring in Risk Management, Insurance, Finance Mathematics, Accounting or Economics

  • Have a GPA of 3.5+

  • Be proficient in Excel, Word, and PowerPoint

  • Pay close attention to detail, because every small detail matters

  • Legally authorized to work in the US

Our Application process

Our application process is designed to help you show your potential, not to test what you already know!

Online application form: to make sure you’re eligible for the internship, and to upload a resume.

Pre-recorded video interview: You’ll record your answers to a few questions using your phone or laptop, giving you the chance to tell us more about yourself in your own time in a relaxed setting.

Assessment center: Our final stage is an assessment center, which will ideally be in-person, but may be virtual. You'll take part in some fun group activities and meet our team in a relaxed setting. This day is all about getting to know you better and for you to see what it's like to be part of Howden and experience our culture.

Different perspectives make us better

At Howden, we’re committed to fair opportunity, inclusive teams and a culture where everyone belongs. We value people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. We make sure everyone has the chance to succeed. If you bring who you really are, we’ll help you to go further.

We believe in equal opportunities for all employees, regardless of race, religion, gender, age, sexual orientation or disability. And as a Disability Confident employer, we’re committed to removing barriers and supporting you to do your best work. If you need any adjustments during the application process or in the role, just let us know. We’re here to help.

What we offer:

A career that you define. We provide an environment where new ideas are encouraged and celebrated, where people who want to have a real hand in our success thrive. We want people who want to make a difference - not just in the workplace, but in the industry and in the wider community.

Working at Howden Re:

At Howden Re, we’re on a mission to do things differently. Our no silo approach, elite team, and clear focus on innovation and relentless execution means our clients are at the heart of all we do.

As a big 4 global reinsurance broker, we deliberately avoid the one-size-fits-all approach, committing to creating bespoke solutions that address the unique challenges of a modern and dynamic marketplace. Our team is empowered to drive progress, creating opportunities for career and personal development, unlocking new value for clients, fostering long-term partnerships, and using the collective power of Howden to change how the world sees risk and insurance.

When you join Howden Re, you become part of a vibrant and entrepreneurial workplace culture that prioritizes collaboration, ownership, and shared success. Here, your contributions will directly impact our mission to be the global partner of choice in reinsurance and strategic advisory.

Be a part of Howden Re's exciting journey. Together, we are shaping the future of reinsurance.

title: Ingeniero/a SSHE – Especialista Ambiental
description:

Belén, Heredia, Costa Rica
Unilever Planta Belén
⏰ Tiempo Completo | Modalidad Presencial

¿Quieres liderar el cambio hacia operaciones más sostenibles?

En Unilever creemos que los negocios pueden ser una fuerza para el bien. Cada día trabajamos para reducir nuestro impacto ambiental mientras impulsamos resultados excepcionales. Buscamos a una persona apasionada por la sostenibilidad, la gestión ambiental y la eficiencia energética que quiera generar un impacto tangible en nuestra operación.

Si te entusiasma transformar datos en acciones, liderar proyectos de sostenibilidad y contribuir a la construcción de un futuro más responsable, esta oportunidad es para ti.

Shape Your Own Adventure

En Unilever tendrás la libertad de desarrollar tu potencial, liderar iniciativas con impacto real y construir una carrera alineada con tu propósito. Aquí podrás impulsar cambios que beneficien a las personas, al planeta y al negocio mientras desarrollas nuevas capacidades y experiencias.

¿Cuál será tu misión?

Serás responsable de liderar la gestión ambiental, energética y de seguridad patrimonial de la planta, garantizando el cumplimiento legal y corporativo, impulsando iniciativas de sostenibilidad y promoviendo una cultura orientada al cuidado de las personas, los recursos y el medio ambiente.

Principales responsabilidades

  • Liderar la gestión ambiental de la operación y asegurar el cumplimiento de los estándares corporativos y regulatorios.
  • Monitorear, analizar e interpretar indicadores ambientales relacionados con:
    • Residuos (Waste)
    • Agua
    • Energía
    • Emisiones de CO₂
  • Liderar proyectos de sostenibilidad enfocados en la reducción del impacto ambiental y la optimización de recursos.
  • Gestionar y dar seguimiento al Sistema de Gestión de Energía bajo ISO 50001.
  • Coordinar auditorías, inspecciones y reportes regulatorios.
  • Gestionar iniciativas relacionadas con tratamiento de aguas residuales (PTAR).

  • Implementar y asegurar el cumplimiento de los programas de Trabajo en Alturas, Espacios Confinados y Gestión de Sustancias Químicas.

Lo que necesitamos de ti

Formación Académica

  • Bachiller universitario como mínimo.
  • Ingeniería Ambiental.
  • Ingeniería Química.
  • Ingeniería Industrial.
  • Ingeniería Electromecánica.
  • Mantenimiento Industrial o carreras afines.

Experiencia

  • Entre 3 y 5 años de experiencia en entornos industriales o manufactureros.
  • Experiencia en gestión ambiental y sostenibilidad.
  • Experiencia en seguimiento y análisis de indicadores ambientales.
  • Conocimiento o experiencia en Plantas de Tratamiento de Aguas Residuales (PTAR).
  • Experiencia en gestión de requisitos legales ambientales y atención de entidades regulatorias.

Hard Skills no negociables

✅ Tratamiento de aguas residuales (PTAR).
✅ Gestión y análisis de energía eléctrica y térmica.
✅ Gestión y análisis de indicadores ambientales (Waste, Agua, Energía y CO₂).

Conocimientos técnicos clave

  • Gestión de residuos, emisiones, aguas residuales y sustancias químicas.
  • Indicadores ambientales y de sostenibilidad.
  • Energía eléctrica y energía térmica.
  • Sistemas de Gestión de Energía ISO 50001.
  • Legislación ambiental aplicable.
  • Evaluación de riesgos ambientales.
  • Análisis e interpretación de tendencias y métricas.
  • Herramientas de análisis de datos y Microsoft Office.

Será un plus si además cuentas con

  • Auditor Interno ISO 14001 y/o ISO 50001.
  • Conocimiento en Sistemas de Gestión de Energía (SGE).
  • Manejo de Power BI.
  • Conocimientos de análisis estadístico aplicado a indicadores.
  • Posgrado o especialización en Sostenibilidad, Energía, Gestión Ambiental o SHE.
  • Inglés intermedio o avanzado.

Competencias que te harán exitoso/a

  • Comunicación efectiva.
  • Trabajo en equipo.
  • Pensamiento analítico y orientación a datos.
  • Gestión de proyectos.
  • Toma de decisiones basada en riesgos.
  • Capacidad para gestionar múltiples prioridades y trabajar bajo presión.

¿Por qué Unilever?

Porque aquí tendrás la oportunidad de liderar proyectos que generan un impacto positivo en la operación y en el planeta. Formarás parte de un equipo que impulsa la innovación, la sostenibilidad y el crecimiento continuo, en una organización donde podrás construir el futuro que imaginas.

Unilever is an organisation committed to equity, inclusion and diversity to drive our business results and create a better future, every day, for our diverse employees, global consumers, partners, and communities. We believe a diverse workforce allows us to match our growth ambitions and drive inclusion across the business. At Unilever we are interested in every individual bringing their ‘Whole Self’ to work and this includes you! title: Senior Associate to the Quantum team (Venture Creation)
description:
Are you motivated by quantum technologies and want to help shape the future of groundbreaking startups? Can you imagine being part of a vibrant team that scouts, supports, and accelerates the next generation of quantum changemakers?

Then we might have the perfect opportunity at BioInnovation Institute (BII), where we are looking for Senior Associate to join the Quantum Team within BII’s Venture Creation department.

Your Opportunity to Join BII!
BII is a non-profit foundation established by the Novo Nordisk Foundation in 2018. Its mission is to accelerate research and startups to bring forward bold solutions that improve human and planetary health. BII supports collaborative, interdisciplinary innovation across Life Sciences and Deep Tech, helping transform cutting-edge research into viable companies so that new discoveries can deliver real impact for people and society.

As a Senior Associate, you will join BII's Quantum team, one of three specialist teams in our Venture Creation department alongside Human Health and Planetary Health. Working at the forefront of quantum and quantum-enabling technologies, you will help identify, evaluate, and support promising early-stage startups and spinouts from idea to company. From scouting new ventures and assessing opportunities to working closely with founders throughout their growth journey, you will play a key role in strengthening both the next generation of quantum companies and the broader quantum ecosystem.

Your key responsibilities will include:
  • Be the anchor person for the start-ups and spinouts and facilitate the development of the business case, the funding strategy, the team, the Board, and the startups' roadmaps for bringing their products to market
  • Scouting new potential spinouts in close collaboration with research groups and university innovation hubs
  • Be part of doing due diligence of applications with external parties and junior staff
  • Co-developing and refining our program offerings
  • Support the ongoing efforts to establish and maintain good investor relations
  • Support activities across the ecosystem and participate in conferences and other efforts to establish Denmark as an internationally recognized hub for quantum technology.
Professional & Personal Qualifications
We are looking for someone with a strong interest in both advanced technology and commercialization, and in engaging with the founders who drive these ventures. Besides this, you bring the following competencies and skills:
  • MSc, MD, or PhD level in a relevant field (physics, engineering, or similar)
  • 5+ years of relevant professional experience working with deep tech ventures, innovation ecosystems, venture capital, startup development, research commercialization, or related fields
  • Demonstrated experience with early-stage deep tech projects and start-ups
  • Experience in the evaluation, selection, and execution of deep tech projects toward value-creating endpoints
  • Demonstrated ability to understand research results and the potential transition of these into commercial opportunities
  • Established network within the deep tech investment and research communities
  • Project management skills and ability to manage several complex projects simultaneously
  • Proficiency in English at a professional level, both written and spoken
  • Strong stakeholder management skills
As BII continues to grow and expand its impact in supporting early-stage startups, we seek a colleague who is motivated by being part of a scaling organization and working closely with ambitious founders.

Working at BII
At BII, we offer a purpose-driven community where science and innovation create meaningful change and impact in society. BII’s entrepreneurial environment is shaped and nurtured every day by our employees, start-ups, and everyone who joins us in bringing science to life. This role offers a unique opportunity to join Europe’s largest innovation and incubation initiative within life sciences and deep tech.

BII is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, at Ole Maaløes Vej 3, 2200 Copenhagen N. From Copenhagen, the Secretariat supports strategy, governance, and coordination across BII’s international activities.

See our open positions at BII on our career page or on LinkedIn.

Equal Opportunities
At BII, we believe innovation starts with people. As a community of changemakers, we believe the best ideas emerge when people with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences come together around a shared purpose.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace built on equal opportunities, where everyone can thrive and where pay is fair, equitable, and based on the principle of equal pay for equal work. We welcome all applications regardless of race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, religion, or socio-economic background.

Curious for more?
If you are curious to know more about the position, please contact Jakob Svagin, Director (Quantum) on email jsn@bii.dk or phone: +45 28 72 04 88.

To apply, please send your CV and academic certificate(s) as well as answer the screening questions by clicking the “Apply now” button. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, no later than Monday, 28th of September 2026.

The interview process is expected to take place in October. The start date is as soon as possible; however, we are flexible and will consider individual notice periods and availability.

  3. Enforces traffic laws and arrests or issues summons to traffic law violators. Reports unsafe road conditions and directs the flow of traffic when required. Investigates traffic accidents.
  4. Performs checks on dwellings, buildings, grounds, and property to ensure the prevention of damage by fire, theft, and/or vandalism.
  5. Collects complete and accurate information and prepares clear and concise reports and affidavits. Keeps records of all activities per established agency policy.
  6. Protects crime scenes, gathers and preserves matters of evidence, takes and records testimonies, and directs and coordinates activities on-site until relieved by a superior officer, and assists detectives in specialized investigations.
  7. Serves warrants, capiases, court orders, and other legal processes, and locates and arrests persons wanted on warrants or court orders.
  8. Makes arrests and testifies in the prosecution of law violators and conducts preliminary and/or detailed investigations of the commission of crime or law violations.
  9. Foresees potential danger and eliminates or controls it. Performs law enforcement activities without injuring self or others.
  10. Provides backup to other law enforcement personnel.
  11. Assesses situations, secures scenes, and restores order including the use of restraints and force where appropriate up to and including deadly force.
  12. Operates and maintains emergency and non-emergency equipment, including computerized information management systems to retrieve or enter information.
  13. Attends staff meetings to exchange information, and attends in-service training and technical/professional classes, seminars, and/or conferences to improve technical/professional skills.
  14. Assists the general public and other governmental agencies.
  15. Performs other duties as required or assigned.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  1. Certification by the State of Louisiana Peace Officer Standards & Training Council as Law Enforcement Officer. (Lateral Transfers Only)
  2. Must be willing to attend 16-18 weeks at an Academy to obtain Certification by the State of Louisiana Peace Officer Standards & Training Council as Law Enforcement Officer.

At a minimum, all employees must be at least 21 years of age (upon the date of hire); have a high school diploma or equivalency; have no felony, drug, or domestic violence convictions; pass all required pre-employment screenings; possess a valid Louisiana driver’s license; be able to communicate both verbally and in writing as required; and possess basic computer skills such as typing, writing reports, and sending and/or receiving emails as applicable to the position.

WORKING CONDITIONS AND ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

  1. Must be able to work in any geographically defined region within Natchitoches Parish.
  2. Must be able to work shift work, any days/hours including weekends and holidays as required.
  3. In the event of a hurricane, major storm, natural or human-made disaster that may threaten the area, the employee will be expected to work.

ADA COMPLIANCE:

May involve lifting, carrying, pushing, or pulling. Must be able to exert enough force based on Cooper Institute Standards to chase, apprehend, restrain, and control potentially violent and combative law violators, offenders, and detainees. Must possess and maintain physical agility, and strength, including good coordination and reflexes. Tasks may also involve standing, sitting, walking, and driving for long periods of time.

Environmental Hazards: The job requires inside and outside work; ability to tolerate inclement weather including heat, humidity, cold, fog, and sleet. Possible exposure to hazardous materials and conditions, toxic conditions, fumes, odors, vibration, dust, confined areas, animal/human waste and/or bodily fluids.

Sensory Requirements: This job requires normal visual acuity and field of vision, hearing, and speaking.

TRAVEL:

Extensive travel inside/outside of Natchitoches Parish (80 - 100%).

title: Senior Risk Officer
description:
Job Title:

Senior Risk Officer

Contract Type:

Time Type:

Full time

Job Description:

The Gasoline Senior Risk Officer is a member of the Risk team based in Singapore, reporting to the Risk Manager, and is responsible for leading and delivering P&L and position analysis to Management and the Front Office. The role works in close collaboration with traders, operations, trade support, accounting and back office, and is a key control function ensuring quality reporting of trading performance and risk analysis for the region.

Main Responsibilities

  • Manage daily production and reporting of P&L, positions and exposures from the trading system(s); validate positions and P&L in an expedient manner and ensure accurate P&L attribution into risk buckets and P&L drivers
  • Manage daily checks and ensure the integrity and completeness of trades booked in the trading system(s)
  • Daily pricing exposure reconciliation with trading and operations
  • Build and monitor in-house forward curves and check the accuracy and consistency of forward curves against market values; understand how the forward curves are constructed and assess whether the curve methodologies applied are robust
  • Check and monitor the marked to market (“MTM”) of physical deals entered in the ETRM/trading systems
  • Analyse mark-to-market valuations, risk positions, basis changes, curves and volatilities and P&L results daily
  • Check and reconcile futures trades between the trading systems/ETRM and clearing agents and exchanges
  • Monitor consumption of VAR against desk limits and escalate breaches to risk management; demonstrate a good understanding of the drivers of VAR applicable to the desk
  • Responsible for reviewing and resolving breaks from month end and year end reconciliations on a timely basis, and contribute to the reporting of trading results and positions to senior management
  • Develop and maintain risk reporting and analytics to communicate positions, P&L and market risk to traders and management, and follow the risk strategies of the trading desks independently
  • Review and maintain information reliability in the trading systems, including costs, and assess the reasonableness of costs entered by operations
  • Provide critical thinking around risk reporting processes, quantification and analysis of more complex commodity exposures of trading activities
  • Identify and assist in the implementation of process improvements, from system testing and implementation through to desk level processes
  • Identify and communicate operational risk, and define risk mitigating measures and priorities
  • Coordinate with Compliance to ensure compliance requirements are met
  • Prepare various reports and analysis for publishing internally and to the Management Board, as the case may be
  • Liaise closely with Front Office, Operations, Trade Support, Controlling, Credit Risk, Market Risk and IT
  • Training and mentoring of Junior Risk Officers
  • Identify control gaps, unusual trading activity and red flags and escalate to management with proposed solutions on a timely basis
  • Back up and support other desks’ Risk Officers when required
  • Ad-hoc duties as assigned by manager


Profile

The individual should have the following:

  • Bachelor’s degree with a major in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Accountancy, Mathematics, Statistics, Computing or equivalent
  • Minimum 5 years (and typically more than 6 years) of relevant experience in a similar role in the commodity trading business, preferably within a major trading house, an oil major, investment bank or hedge fund
  • Strong understanding of the mechanics of derivatives (futures, swaps and options) and physical trading, including the ability to calculate positions and P&L, marked to market and hedging concepts, and the various types of trading strategies and Incoterms, specific to Gasoline desk
  • Demonstrated excellent knowledge of commodities and financial instruments, with excellent knowledge of and a strong interest in trading activities;
  • Proficient with ETRM systems and proficiency in Microsoft Excel is a must; VBA, Power BI, Python or SQL skills are a strong advantage
  • Good knowledge of analytics tools and technologies
  • Fluent in spoken and written English; ability to speak Chinese will be a plus
  • Experience in Gasoline desk risk is preferred but strong candidate with experience with other desks will also be considered.

Other Attributes/Pre-requisites

  • Curious, proactive, rigorous, meticulous, numerate and self-motivated
  • Able to work independently and yet a team player, with strong team spirit
  • Strong control awareness and mindset
  • Strong interpersonal skills and strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Organised and able to work in a fast paced and time sensitive environment
  • High degree of accuracy and efficiency under set deadlines
  • Ability to work under pressure in a dynamic environment
  • Ability to work late hours and some SG public holidays when necessary

If you think the open position you see is right for you, we encourage you to apply!

title: Relationship Specialist (Full Time)
description:
STATUS: Full time / Non-Exempt

REPORTS TO: Branch Manager

LOCATION: Hilton Branch

COMPENSATION: The starting hourly wage for this position is expected to be between $23.50 - $24.00 per hour. The actual hourly wage will be determined based on experience and other-job related factors, consistent with applicable law.

HOURS: 37.5 hours per week

SCHEDULE: Hours may vary based on the following branch hours*: Monday 8:30 – 4:30 / Tuesday 8:30 – 4:30 / Wednesday 9:30 – 4:30 / Thursday 8:30 – 5:30 / Friday 8:30 – 6:30 / Saturday 8:30 – 1:30*

*Must be available to work 2-3 Saturdays per month. Hours may vary based on current or future business needs.

Position Overview


The primary function of the Relationship Specialist is to assist new and existing members with their immediate, short term and long-term financial needs/goals through exceptional service and problem solving. This position regularly combines all aspects of member services, account opening functions, as well as, actively involving other member contact departments (consumer lending, mortgage, investment and retirement services) and support/back-office staff to fulfill member needs. The successful incumbent is flexible enough to greet/welcome incoming members, act as a financial services consultant and perform teller transactions.


Essential Functions

  • Deliver extraordinary member service by demonstrating and maintaining exceptional knowledge and expertise of all financial products and services, as well as, providing highly effective resolution of member issues.
  • Develop loyal member relationships by identifying and understanding needs, providing sound advice and tailoring the right financial solutions. Create the member experience by providing a positive image and maintaining all member service standards.
  • Promote the Credit Union’s products and services and deepen relationships by tailoring the best solution for members through appropriate sales activities (member needs assessments, onboarding and follow-ups, outbound calling, etc.).

  • Connect members to the new branch persona, by greeting/welcoming members, facilitating their physical orientation to the branch and guiding them on the usage of technology (teller pod, iPads, mobile applications, website loan applications, etc.).

  • Assist branch management in all operations matters including, but not limited to, compliance, policies and procedures, balancing, cash ordering, replenishments and maintenance, branch audits, monthly tracking reports and member service issues.

Skills

  • Excellent communication (verbal, written and listening) skills

  • Ability to use ATM, calculator, fax machine, vault, surveillance equipment and money counter. Fluent in the use of tablets, smart technology (i.e.: iPhone/android, etc.), cash recycler technology.

description:
Conference & Event Planner

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. Why Syneos Health

Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

JOB SUMMARY

The Global Corporate Communications & Marketing (GCC&M) team is seeking a Conferences, Meetings & Events Planner to support the planning and execution of conferences, meetings and events. Reporting to the Executive Director, Conferences, Meetings & Events, this role will assist with event logistics, coordination and administrative support for the Go-To-Market (GTM) team across the region.

This full-time role requires strong organization, communication and follow-through skills, with the ability to support multiple events, timelines and shifting priorities. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, collaborative and able to coordinate work accurately while partnering with GCC&M Centers of Excellence, vendors and business stakeholders.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support planning and execution for conferences, meetings and events, including stakeholder coordination, planning materials, calls, sponsorship support, hotel blocks, collateral and promotional items.
  • Coordinate with external vendors, including exhibit, promotional and printing partners, to help deliver event needs within established guidelines and budgets.
  • Assist with event promotion coordination with Content Strategy, Digital Analytics and External Communications, including emails, landing pages and social media.
  • Support customer-facing teams with attendee lists, CRM campaigns and meeting scheduler training.
  • Assist with vendor, hotel, conference association, speaker and service provider coordination, including gathering information and supporting contract-related administration.
  • Support development of programs, agendas, budgets and services based on host requirements and established budget parameters.
  • Build and update Cvent registration sites and assist with registration, attendee communications and related updates.
  • Maintain event records and financial details, including invoice tracking, payment support and budget documentation.
  • Coordinate with GCC&M Centers of Excellence to support conference and event goals, timelines and deliverables.
  • Coordinate audio-visual, transportation, displays and other event requirements.
  • Support evaluation of service providers by gathering information and comparing options against event requirements.
  • Prepare and distribute event reports, updates and materials to participants, vendors and other stakeholders as needed.
  • Assist with post-event summaries, budget recaps and participant feedback to help improve future events.
  • Coordinate internal team meetings and events, both in person and virtual, as needed.
  • Support financial administration, including POs, invoices, budget tracking, monthly accruals and reconciliation.
  • Travel up to 25% to support annual sales meetings, conferences and events onsite.

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

The candidate should exercise sound judgment, manage assigned tasks and timelines, and communicate progress proactively in a collaborative environment.

  • Bachelor’s degree in hospitality, business, communications or related field.
  • 2-3 years of conference, meeting or event planning experience.
  • Healthcare, CRO or biopharmaceutical services experience preferred.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word.
  • Experience with Cvent or similar event management tools required.
  • Experience with Trello or similar project management tools preferred.
  • Detail-oriented, with the ability to coordinate multiple tasks and deadlines.
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills in a team environment.
  • Strong interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills across calls, virtual meetings and in-person settings.
  • Able to communicate effectively with attendees, vendors and internal stakeholders in person or virtually.
  • Flexible and adaptable in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Able to work both independently on assigned tasks and collaboratively as part of a team.

At Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality-of-life balance. The benefits for this position may include a company car or car allowance, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, Company match 401k, eligibility to participate in Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and individual performance, and flexible paid time off (PTO) and sick time. Because certain states and municipalities have regulated paid sick time requirements, eligibility for paid sick time may vary depending on where you work. Syneos complies with all applicable federal, state, and municipal paid sick time requirements.

Salary Range:

$56,400.00 - $95,900.00

The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

title: Principal AI Full-Stack Engineer - madrid
description:
About Peak3

Peak3 is an award-winning vertical SaaS provider, enabling more relevant, convenient, and affordable insurance protection for everyone through our technology and ingenuity. Together with our clients, we create a more resilient and innovative future.

We combine insurance core, distribution, and AI solutions to deliver a step change in performance for insurers, MGAs, and insurance intermediaries. From greenfield embedded insurance ventures to multi-country core modernization programs, our SaaS solutions power top customers across life, health, and P&C insurance.

Our 500+ colleagues are based across over 15 countries in Europe, Asia and the Middle East – with an ambitious roadmap to scale further.


About The Role

As a Principal AI Full-Stack Engineer on the AI Platform team, you'll own the design, build, and operation of the agentic AI systems powering our core insurance products — architecting LLM inference chains, building production AI infrastructure, shipping full-stack features from model to UI, and setting technical direction for the team. You should be as comfortable debugging a RAG recall failure in production as whiteboarding agent memory architectures with research or debating interaction patterns with design.


Responsibilities

  • Build agentic AI applications end-to-end — RAG pipelines, multi-agent orchestration, tool calling, workflows — and ship insurance agents that run in production.
  • Design and optimize LLM inference chains: prompt engineering, structured outputs, fine-tuning (LoRA/PEFT), evals, and observability.
  • Stand up production-grade AI infrastructure: vector databases, semantic retrieval, model gateways, inference acceleration, and cost governance.
  • Own full-stack delivery — frontend (React/Next.js), backend (Python/TypeScript), cloud-native deployment (K8s/Serverless) — taking demos to policy volumes in the millions.
  • Partner with actuarial, underwriting, and claims experts to turn domain knowledge into trustworthy, explainable, auditable AI systems.

Experience & Qualifications

  • Proven track record shipping and operating production software at scale, ideally including an LLM/AI system taken from prototype to production.
  • Fluent in Python or TypeScript and a modern frontend framework, with genuine comfort spanning backend, frontend, infrastructure, data, and model code.
  • Hands-on LLM engineering depth: RAG/retrieval, function/tool calling, agent frameworks (LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or custom), systematic evals, prompt- and model-level optimization.
  • Solid AI infrastructure grounding — vector databases, embedding models, model deployment/serving, inference optimization, distributed systems — with the operational discipline for regulated environments.
  • Strong product instincts: can turn ambiguous problems into well-scoped solutions, cares about real user impact, and argues for simplicity when complexity isn't earned.
  • High agency — prototypes and drives progress without waiting for complete specs.

Nice to Have

  • Taken an LLM system from 0 to 1 — prototype to real users, revenue, and operational load, including on-call and incident reviews.
  • Agent infrastructure experience: secure execution sandboxes (gVisor, Firecracker, WASM), agent memory/state architectures, model routing, workflow orchestration.
  • External technical signals — open-source contributions, technical writing, conference talks.
  • Interest in multimodal AI, long-context engineering, applied AI safety/alignment, or RLHF.
  • Finance or insurance domain experience (engineering ability and learning velocity matter more).


Our stack: Python, TypeScript, React/Next.js, Postgres, Kubernetes, and various vector databases and LLM providers. Prior experience with every part isn't required — strong fundamentals and fast learning matter more.

title: Bli MENY Brakerøya sin nye tilkallingshelt i ferskvareavdelingen!
description:
I MENY elsker vi mat! For oss er god mat en lidenskap, og noe av det viktigste som finnes. Hos oss er alle MATarbeidere, uansett om du jobber i ferskvaredisken, kolonialen, i kassen eller på kontoret. Å være en MATarbeider i MENY betyr at du alltid gjør ditt beste for å veilede og inspirere kundene våre til matglede. Sammen skal vi hjelpe flere å spise bedre, og leve bedre.

Stillingsomfang: tilkalling

Arbeidstid: dag, kveld og helg - som tilkalling vil du ikke ha faste vakter, men bli kontaktet ved behov
Oppstart: snarest - eller etter avtale

Søknadsfrist: vi behandler søknader fortløpende

Tidspunktet for vaktene kan endres på sikt og det vil være mulighet for flere vakter ved behov og jobbing i høytider/ferier.


For å søke må du ha fylt 18 år, du må også kunne beherske norsk

Hvem er du og hva skal du gjøre?
Som MATarbeider i vår ferskvareavdeling vil du ha en hektisk og spennende hverdag med stor variasjon i arbeidsoppgavene. Du vil ekspedere kunder, skjære og tilberede ulike ferskvarer som kjøtt, fisk og ost, du vil fylle varer og naturlig nok ta oppvasken. Du vil også arbeide i bakeriavdelingen der oppgavene består i å steke brød, rydde, legge opp varer til neste dag og hjelpe kunder. For å trives med dette må du like å ha kontakt med mennesker, ha gode samarbeidsevner og ikke være redd for å brette opp ermene for å ta i et tak.

Våre kunder forventer at du har kunnskap om mat, men fortvil ikke selv om "Hellstrøm" ikke er ditt etternavn. Vi lærer deg alt vi kan om torsk, svinekjake, culotte og Kraftkar, men det er uten tvil en fordel om du har basiskunnskap og interesse for mat fra før av. Om du har relevant fagbrev er det selvfølgelig et pluss! For å lykkes må du være en som liker å prate med mennesker, takler utfordringer, tunge løft, hektisk tempo og ikke være redd for å smake på nye ting.

Hvordan er det å jobbe i MENY?
Hos oss vil du blant annet lære å ta ansvar, mestre stress, håndtere mennesker og ikke minst butikkdrift. Vi har en interaktiv kursplattform, ulike klasseromskurs som gir deg faglig påfyll og et traineeprogram med fokus på å gå fra ansatt til å bli leder, for å nevne noe. Satser du på MENY, satser MENY på deg!

Når du starter, skal vi ta deg godt imot og gi deg den opplæringen du trenger. Alle ansatte i MENY får selvfølgelig uniform, lønn etter tariff og subsidiert kantine. I tillegg har vi sosiale sammenkomster i ny og ne, rabatt på treningssenter og arbeidstider som ofte passer godt i kombinasjon med studier.

Når det gjelder trivsel på jobb, vil vi trekke frem samholdet. Som en av våre matarbeidere blir du en del av et team som jobber mot felles mål, for din innsats vil påvirke butikken, kundene og kollegene dine. Vi verdsetter gjensidig omtanke og støtte, og det er rom for feil så lenge du lærer og utvikler deg – for er du trygg er du god. Vår visjon er at vår lidenskap endrer folks matvaner, og det håper vi du vil bidra til.

description:
I MENY elsker vi mat! For oss er god mat en lidenskap, og noe av det viktigste som finnes. Hos oss er alle MATarbeidere, uansett om du jobber i ferskvaredisken, kolonialen, i kassen eller på kontoret. Å være en MATarbeider i MENY betyr at du alltid gjør ditt beste for å veilede og inspirere kundene våre til matglede. Sammen skal vi hjelpe flere å spise bedre, og leve bedre.

Oppstart: snarest - eller etter avtale

For å søke må du ha fylt 18 år, du må også kunne beherske norsk.

Hvem er du og hva skal du gjøre?
Som MATarbeider i vår ferskvareavdeling vil du ha en hektisk og spennende hverdag med stor variasjon i arbeidsoppgavene. Du vil ekspedere kunder, skjære og tilberede ulike ferskvarer som kjøtt, fisk og ost, du vil fylle varer og naturlig nok ta oppvasken. Våre kunder forventer at du har kunnskap om mat, men fortvil ikke selv om "Hellstrøm" ikke er ditt etternavn. Vi lærer deg alt vi kan om torsk, svinekjake, culotte og Kraftkar, men det er uten tvil en fordel om du har basiskunnskap og interesse for mat fra før av. Om du har relevant fagbrev er det selvfølgelig et pluss! For å lykkes må du være en som liker å prate med mennesker, takler utfordringer, tunge løft, hektisk tempo og ikke være redd for å smake på nye ting.

Hos oss vil du blant annet lære å ta ansvar, mestre stress, håndtere mennesker og ikke minst butikkdrift. Satser du på MENY, satser MENY på deg!

Når du starter, skal vi ta deg godt imot og gi deg den opplæringen du trenger. Alle ansatte i MENY får selvfølgelig uniform, lønn etter tariff og subsidiert kantine. Når det gjelder trivsel på jobb, vil vi trekke frem samholdet. Som en av våre matarbeidere blir du en del av et team som jobber mot felles mål, for din innsats vil påvirke butikken, kundene og kollegene dine. Vi verdsetter gjensidig omtanke og støtte, og det er rom for feil så lenge du lærer og utvikler deg – for er du trygg er du god. Vår visjon er at vår lidenskap endrer folks matvaner, og det håper vi du vil bidra til.

title: Yard Operator/ Fork Truck Operator
description:
Galleher Industries is a trusted manufacturer and value-added distributor of metal and lumber components serving commercial truck body and trailer manufacturers across the country. Founded in 1937 and headquartered in Pomona, California, Galleher has grown into a multi-location operation with facilities in California, Texas, Indiana, and New Jersey.

Our team is known for quality, responsiveness, and operational excellence. As we continue to grow, we are looking for dependable team members who take pride in safety, accountability, and getting the job done right.

Position Summary

The Yard Operator is responsible for the safe and efficient movement, loading, unloading, storage, and staging of steel, lumber, and other materials to support yard and warehouse operations. This role plays a critical part in ensuring customer orders are fulfilled accurately and on time while maintaining inventory accuracy and yard organization.

This is a hands-on position that requires prior experience handling large, oversized freight and operating industrial material handling equipment in both indoor and outdoor environments. This is not a pick/pack warehouse role.

Key Responsibilities

Material Handling & Yard Operations

  • Safely load and unload materials from flatbeds, trailers, and delivery vehicles.
  • Operate forklifts, Combi-Lifts, and other material handling equipment to move steel, lumber, and oversized materials throughout the yard and warehouse.
  • Transport raw materials to designated workstations, storage areas, and shipping locations.
  • Stage, organize, and prepare materials for customer delivery and internal production needs.
  • Ensure customer loads are completed accurately and meet delivery schedules and customer-specific requirements.

Inventory & Accuracy

  • Locate and move stock to pallets, racks, or designated storage areas.
  • Perform inventory movements, order reconciliation, and system transactions as needed.
  • Identify and report damaged materials, shortages, or quality concerns.
  • Maintain accurate inventory records and activity logs.

Safety & Compliance

  • Follow all company policies, safety rules, and legal guidelines.
  • Perform required equipment inspections before use and report maintenance concerns promptly.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe yard / warehouse environment.
  • Support a strong safety culture by identifying and reporting hazards or unsafe conditions.

General Support

  • Complete physical tasks accurately and efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Support other warehouse / yard duties as assigned.
  • Be willing to learn and support basic wood fabrication or material prep processes as needed.

QualificationsEducation

  • High school diploma or GED required

Required Experience & Skills

  • 3–5 years of prior warehouse, yard, shipping, or industrial material handling experience required
  • 3–5 years of forklift experience required; this is not an entry-level forklift role
  • Hands-on experience operating a Combi-Lift is required for this role
  • Must have experience safely loading, unloading, and moving large, oversized, and bulky freight
  • Experience working in an indoor / outdoor industrial environment required
  • Ability to maintain accurate inventory records and activity logs
  • Strong communication skills and ability to follow instructions
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment

Physical Requirements

  • Must be able to lift and move materials weighing 50–100 pounds
  • Must be physically capable of safely performing essential job duties in an active yard / warehouse setting

Additional Requirements

  • Valid driver’s license required
  • Reliable transportation required
  • Must be able to pass a background check and pre-employment drug screen and maintain a drug-free workplace

Why Join Galleher?

At Galleher, you’ll join a team that values hard work, safety, and reliability. We offer the opportunity to make an immediate impact in a growing operation while working alongside people who take pride in doing things the right way.

title: Payment Scheme Compliance Specialist
description:

The Payment Scheme Compliance Specialist will have strong experience monitoring and managing the relationships with payment schemes, keeping up to date with Visa and Mastercard’s regulations to maintain total compliance with them. The scope of this position is to escalate and mitigate potential company risks and safeguard the business against non-compliance risks or operational disruptions.


JOB DESCRIPTION:
Payment Scheme Relationship Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for all communication between the company and Visa/Mastercard representatives
  • Monitoring and managing the regulations and releases of Visa/Mastercard, by translating, summarizing and updating payment scheme changes to internal teams or management.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with Visa/Mastercard, managing direct communications and official inquiries, regarding, and not limited to, product launches and policy updates.


Risk Mitigation:

  • Identify and escalate potential operational issues or risks, by ensuring the company is fully compliant with the payment schemes’ regulations and rules, in a timely manner
  • Support scheme fraud investigations for acquiring customers.
  • Maintain visibility of fines, remediation progress, and compliance status through dashboards and regular reporting.
  • Submit risk reports to Visa/Mastercard when necessary.
  • Provide compliance guidance and training to merchants and partners.
  • Support Sales and Customer Success with scheme-related queries, high-risk merchant onboarding, RFP responses, and customer communications.


PERSON SPECIFICATION:

  • 3-5 years hands-on experience in a relevant role managing card schemes compliance and payment schemes relationships (Visa & Mastercard), within the Payments/EMI/FinTech space is a must
  • Strong knowledge of Visa/Mastercard compliance frameworks, mandate cycles, and non‑compliance processes.
  • Proven ability to manage cross‑functional compliance deliverables.

  • Excellent communication and investigation skills with the ability to simplify and communicate complex regulatory content to the relevant teams
  • Proactive persona with the ability to work in fast-paced environments.

Jesuit Volunteer Corps (JVC) is a post-graduate volunteer service program that places young adults to live and work in solidarity with marginalized populations across the United States. title: Principal ASIC Integration Engineer
description:
This is us

At Avenga, we believe that human creativity empowers technology that matters. Operating globally, our 6000+ specialists provide a full spectrum of services, including business and tech advisory, enterprise solutions, CX, UX and Ul design, managed services, product development, and software development.

This is the job

We are looking for an experienced Principal ASIC / SoC Architect to join an international engineering project focused on ASIC solutions for high-volume, cost-sensitive electronic products.

In this role, you will influence the complete ASIC development and production lifecycle: from system architecture, technology selection, and third-party IP evaluation through tape-out, manufacturing, testing, and yield optimization.

You will combine deep semiconductor expertise with a strong understanding of commercial and manufacturing considerations. Your decisions will directly affect product performance, power consumption, die size, system cost, production readiness, and supply-chain resilience.

The engagement is expected to last at least one year, with a possibility of extension for an additional year. We welcome candidates from across the EU, with priority given to professionals based in the Scandinavian countries. Candidates based in the US may also be considered.

The role involves regular travel to Denmark, potentially several times per month, as well as periodic travel to the US, other European countries, and Asia.

This is you

  • You have at least 8 years of experience in ASIC microarchitecture, ASIC design, or SoC design within an electrical engineering environment.

  • You have completed multiple successful ASIC or SoC tape-outs and have taken designs through the full development lifecycle.

  • You have a strong understanding of ASIC and SoC architecture and microarchitecture, including system-level architectural trade-offs.

  • You have hands-on experience evaluating, selecting, and integrating third-party semiconductor IP, including analog, compute, and memory IP.

  • You understand semiconductor foundry processes, process nodes, and PDKs, as well as their impact on power, performance, cost, yield, and production readiness.

  • You have solid knowledge of semiconductor packaging, assembly, testing methodologies, fault coverage, and production-test optimization.

  • You understand yield fundamentals, including the relationship between die size and yield, silicon test data, production-line yield analysis, and yield optimization.

  • You are familiar with Design-for-Cost, Design-for-Manufacturing, Design-for-Assembly, and Design-for-Yield principles.

  • You understand wafer economics, OSAT operations, packaging and test costs, and the main drivers of semiconductor unit cost.

  • You can evaluate technical decisions in the context of system BOM cost, manufacturing feasibility, production timelines, and supply-chain risk.

  • You are comfortable collaborating with foundries, OSAT partners, IP vendors, and multidisciplinary internal teams.

  • You are available for regular international business travel, particularly to Denmark.

This is your role

  • Collaborate with electrical engineers to define requirements, evaluate architectural options, and develop ASIC specifications.

  • Lead system-level trade-off analyses across performance, power, die size, unit cost, manufacturability, yield, and production readiness.

  • Lead the technical evaluation, selection, and integration of third-party analog, compute, memory, and other semiconductor IP.

  • Represent the electrical engineering team in technical discussions with foundries, OSAT partners, and IP vendors.

  • Track semiconductor technology roadmaps and work with external partners to address manufacturing constraints and bottlenecks.

  • Influence process-node and PDK selection based on performance, power, cost, yield, and foundry maturity.

  • Drive Design-for-Cost, Design-for-Manufacturing, Design-for-Assembly, and Design-for-Yield considerations throughout the architecture and design process.

  • Guide floorplanning, die-size optimization, pin count and placement, and packaging decisions.

  • Provide technical input to semiconductor cost models covering wafer economics, OSAT location, packaging, test time, yield, and other unit-cost drivers.

  • Partner with test and validation engineers to define strategies that maximize fault coverage while minimizing test time and production costs.

  • Incorporate supply-chain resilience and multi-sourcing flexibility into architectural and manufacturing decisions.

  • Analyze production-line yields and silicon test data with internal and external validation teams to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

  • Collaborate with technical and commercial stakeholders throughout the complete ASIC lifecycle, from architecture and technology selection to tape-out, manufacturing, testing, and yield optimization.

What awaits you at Avenga?


At Avenga, everyone matters. We provide equal opportunities in recruitment, career development, and leadership, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, religion, or any other characteristic. We are committed to fostering a work environment where our diverse community of employees, candidates, and business partners actively shapes our growth. By bringing together people from different backgrounds and experiences, we build a workplace where everyone feels free to be themselves while honoring the boundaries of others.

title: Community Health Worker
description:
Purpose: The Community Health Worker (CHW) works to improve the health and wellbeing of peers who are PHA residents in public housing and Leased Housing (Section8) participants by connecting them to health and social services, providing social support, and helping them to advocate for their health needs. Our CHW focuses on public safety, safe & healthy housing, and how the physical environment affects the health and wellbeing of families. They engage in community building efforts to improve the safety of the neighborhoods that they serve, and to help residents come together to advocate for their housing rights.

Essential Tasks of the Position:

The Community Health Worker supports the PHA residents by addressing the social and health care needs of the PHA residents; connecting residents to primary care, behavioral health, and other resources either within the PHA organization or within the community.


  • Work one-on-one with residents to address health concerns.
  • Work one-on-one with residents to assess their healthcare and social service needs and to refer and connect to services whenever possible.
  • Work one-to-one with residents to set health-promoting goals and help them to meet these goals.
  • Document all client progress in the case management database.
  • Maintain confidentiality of client information, processes, and data.
  • Meet regularly with Resident Services Department (RSD) Wellness Team and other PHA staff for program development and event planning and to monitor and evaluate program success.
  • Communicate regularly with community partners, service providers and PHA staff.
  • Attend monthly networking meetings convened by Community Health Worker Association of Rhode Island (CHWARI); to collectively problem solve and to share resources.
  • Network with existing health and community-based organizations to learn about opportunities for their clients and share their clients’ needs with these agencies.
  • Support the work of other Resident Services Department staff and Property Management staff to address resident social determinants of health.


Position Requirements and Qualifications:

Education Level

  • High school diploma or GED

Experience in Related Field

  • CHWARI CORE Community Health Worker Certification is required.
  • Experience with customer service, social services, health care or community-related work is preferred.

Knowledge, skills, abilities, licenses and certifications

  • Ability to speak both Spanish and English fluently and to write English fluently, required.
  • Strong preference will be given to individuals living in public housing and participants in the Section 8 Program.
  • Determination to make a difference in their own community.
  • Excellent listening and communication skills.
  • Compassionate, empathetic, respectful & logical.
  • Open to working closely with clients who struggle with health-related issues of all kinds, including mental illness and addiction at all levels.
  • Respectful, sensitive and non-judgmental towards individuals who may suffer from traumas and/or disabilities.
  • Strong interpersonal and social skills with an ability to collaborate with a variety of individuals from a wide range of professional and personal backgrounds.
  • Strong presence in one-on-one meetings.

Environmental Parameters

  • Ability to work in an office environment.

  • Strength: Ability to lift up to 50 lb.

title: RV FURNITURE UPHOLSTERER
description:
RV Furniture Upholsterer

North Trail RV has been a family-owned and operated RV Dealership in Fort Myers, FL for over 30 years. A career with North Trail RV means unwavering support from a tight-knit group of individuals who care deeply about our craft, one another, and the community we share.

As a member of the North Trail family, you will be provided every opportunity to utilize your skills as part of a collaborative culture that encourages innovation and values kindness and respect above all. In addition to competitive wages, we offer health, dental, and vision insurance. We also offer paid time off, life insurance, HSA, and 401K retirement benefits with employer match after 1 year.

Join us and discover the North Trail difference for yourself!

The RV Furniture Upholsterer is responsible for repairing, rebuilding, and upholstering furniture and interior components in recreational vehicles (RVs). This position requires experience working with a variety of fabrics, vinyl, leather, foam, and wood structures while maintaining factory-quality standards. The RV Furniture Upholsterer works closely with the service department to restore or customize furniture to meet customer expectations.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Repair, recover, and reupholster RV furniture, including sofas, dinettes, recliners, captain's chairs, headboards, and cushions.

  • Measure, cut, sew, and install upholstery materials including vinyl, leather, fabric, and specialty RV materials.

  • Repair or rebuild wooden furniture frames and structural components when required.
  • Match existing fabrics and patterns whenever possible to maintain the original appearance.
  • Perform custom upholstery modifications and customer-requested upgrades.

  • Document repairs and communicate with service advisors regarding job status and additional repair needs.

Requirements

  • Knowledge of upholstery materials, adhesives, foam products, and repair techniques.

  • Ability to lift up to 75 pounds and move heavy furniture safely.

  • Commitment to producing high-quality workmanship.
  • Produce repairs that meet or exceed manufacturer and dealership quality standards.

title: Clinical Trial Technology Project Manager (COA & eCOA)
description:
Job Description

COA Sr. Specialist is responsible for providing end-to-end COA systems project management support including, but not limited to, gathering study-specific user requirements, executing UAT tasks, managing project timelines, managing and enforcing COA systems Standards. COA Sr. Specialist also monitors system change requests and acts as Company's COA systems subject matter expert while liaising with external vendors. Accountable for making decisions regarding COA process, issue resolution, and deviations from standards.

Applies COA systems expertise on day-to-day activities when issues are escalated. Communicates with internal and external stakeholders and escalates risks. May participate and lead in process improvement initiatives, standards development and maintenance. Responsible for creating and enforcing COA systems standards, managing vendor performance, and supporting training &education of stakeholders.

Primary Activities

1. Execute COA systems development process from Kickoff to system go live, ongoing system change control, system closeout and database lock activities.

2. Defines/redesigns COA development processes across vendor base. Identifies areas for process improvement and leads improvement activities

3. Creates and enforces the use of COA systems standards. Responsibilities may include creation / revision of COA systems standards, collaboration with vendors and internal stakeholders to define requirements, and monitoring standards utilization rate

4. Performs peer-review of the COA systems specific documentations for quality (e.g. comparing paper COA measures with Developer version etc.)

5. Manages vendor performance and relationship(s). Responsibilities may include defining and implementing process with vendor representatives, monitoring and analyzing vendor and Company performance metrics, performing root cause analysis and identifying corrective actions, and serving as point of escalation for vendor issues.

6. Serves as project manager of all COA systems activities for protocols assigned. Uses interpersonal, negotiating, and project management skills to perform the following tasks:

·Project plan development, execution, and change control. Coordinates resolution & risk mitigation of all COA systems related issues and end of study vendor deliverables

·Activity definition and sequencing, duration estimation, schedule development, and schedule control.

·Risk management planning (i.e., risk identification, analysis, and response planning, as well as risk monitoring and control).

·Communication planning, information distribution, performance reporting, and project closure.

7. Obtains internal and external stakeholder feedback; this may include meeting with vendor project managers and/or meeting with subject matter experts or representatives from stakeholder functional areas.

8. Provides support for successful integration of Company and vendor systems.

9. Provides support for problem resolution between COA vendors and Company's Clinical Trial Team.

10. May participate in training and education for stakeholders. May develop, or assist in development of, reference and/or training material. May provide cross-functional internal and external communication as needed.

11. May provide support for the development / maintenance of relevant documentation, including applicable SOPs, job aids, and guidance documentation.

12. May mentor new staff.

13. May lead a continuous improvement special project or any other project or perform any other COA related task deemed appropriate by management.

Requirements

Education: B.A. or B.S. degree, preferably in life sciences, computer science, engineering or related discipline.

Experience: 6 years’ experience in Clinical Data Management with at least 4 years’ of COA working experience

Knowledge and Skills:

  • Demonstrate knowledge of COA systems development processes

  • Knowledge of the clinical development process, preferably through submission; thorough knowledge of clinical data management

  • Effective written and verbal communication skills

  • Ability independently perform and manage multiple tasks at one time and meet deadlines in a complex environment working both internal or external to the Company,

Required Skills:

Adaptability, Clinical Data Management, Clinical Research, Communication, Data Analysis, Data Quality Assurance, Data Reporting, Data Review, Data Validation, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), Identifying Risks, Medical Terminology, Peer Reviewing, Process Improvement Projects, Product Risk Management, Project Coordination, Project Development, Project Management, Project Planning, Projects Design, Risk Management, Standards Development, Teamwork, Vendor Management, Vendor Risk Management

Er du blid, serviceinnstilt og liker å ha litt fart i arbeidsdagen? Da kan du være den vi ser etter!

Joker Stabekk søker en hyggelig og pålitelig butikkmedarbeider i deltidsstilling. Vi ser etter deg som er over 18 år, liker å jobbe med mennesker og ønsker å bidra til gode handleopplevelser for kundene våre.

Hos oss er den gode naboen viktig. Vi ønsker at kundene skal møte en butikk som er hyggelig, ryddig og innbydende – og medarbeidere som ser kunden og gjerne gjør det lille ekstra.

  • Kundeservice og salg

  • Kassearbeid

  • Varepåfylling og vareplassering

  • Rydding og renhold

  • Andre daglige oppgaver i butikken

Vi ser etter deg som

  • Er blid, positiv og serviceinnstilt

  • Er ansvarsbevisst og pålitelig

  • Trives med høyt tempo og varierte arbeidsoppgaver

  • Kan jobbe selvstendig og sammen med andre

Send oss en kort søknad og CV. Vi vurderer søknader fortløpende og gleder oss til å høre fra deg!
