title: Tin Management Architect
description:
ASML US, LP brings together the most creative minds in science and technology to develop lithography machines that are key to producing faster, cheaper, more energy-efficient microchips. We design, develop, integrate, market and service these advanced machines, which enable our customers - the world’s leading chipmakers - to reduce the size and increase the functionality of their microchips, which in turn leads to smaller, more powerful consumer electronics. Our headquarters are in Veldhoven, the Netherlands, and we have 18 office locations around the United States including main offices in Wilton, CT, Chandler, AZ, San Jose, CA and San Diego, CA.

Job Mission

We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced Tin Management Architect to join the Source Research department in San Diego and lead the definition and evolution of the next-generation Tin Management architecture for future lithography light sources.

ASML's leadership in lithography depends on continued innovation in source technology. A key challenge for future EUV systems is the management of tin debris generated during the laser-produced plasma (LPP) process. Effective Tin Management is critical to protecting source hardware, maintaining optical performance, enabling higher source power, and reducing cost of technology. As the Tin Management Architect, you will define the long-term technology roadmap and system architecture required to address these challenges. Working across research, modeling, and product development teams, you will evaluate architectural trade-offs, identify key technology gaps, guide research investments, and shape future source concepts.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong systems thinking and the ability to operate effectively in a multidisciplinary environment. Success in this role requires balancing physics, engineering, modeling, manufacturability, and cost considerations to drive architectural decisions at the fuzzy front end of product development.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Define and drive the long-term Tin Management architecture and technology roadmap, identifying architectural challenges, technology gaps, development priorities, tradeoffs, and critical learning required to guide future EUV source development.

  • Shape experimental strategies and learning plans for research test rigs, ensuring test campaigns address key architectural questions and produce actionable system-level insights.

  • Define the modeling, simulation, AI, and data capabilities required to support Tin Management decisions, and guide their development in collaboration with Virtual Source, analysis, and research teams.

  • Drive technical alignment between research, system engineering, product development teams, and external stakeholders to ensure Tin Management learnings influence future product architectures and node development.

  • Capture, document, and communicate architectural learnings and technology recommendations to leadership and development teams through reports, reviews, and executive presentations.

  • Work independently and across multidisciplinary teams to pursue new knowledge, demonstrate new capabilities, and solve critical system-level challenges.

  • Provide technical leadership for critical Tin Management initiatives while remaining actively engaged in hands-on technology development, experimentation, modeling, and problem solving for approximately 50% of the role.

  • Perform other duties as assigned or required.

Qualifications

  • Ph.D. in Physics, Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related discipline, with 5+ years of relevant experience, and demonstrated expertise in complex physical systems and one or more areas such as thermodynamics, fluid dynamics, plasma physics, lasers, photonics, or related technologies.

  • Strong background in experimentation, modeling, simulation, and data-driven decision making.

  • Experience applying computational modeling, data analytics, AI/ML, and digital engineering tools to technology development challenges.

  • Proven experience developing and maintaining multi-year technology roadmaps, aligning technical maturity, cost and integration readiness with business strategy.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction across organizational boundaries through technical leadership, collaboration, and sound engineering judgment.

  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively as a part of a team and lead investigation and research efforts involving multiple stakeholders and constraints.

  • Deep understanding of scientific research methods and a passion for learning and innovation.

  • The successful candidate will not only have excelled in their technical field, but will have demonstrated inter-personal and communications strengths.

  • Ability to clearly and logically communicate ideas and knowledge to various audiences.

  • Ability to work extended hours and second shift as required to support critical experiments, investigations, and program objectives.

Other information

PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee routinely is required to sit; walk; talk; hear; use hands to keyboard, finger, handle, and feel; stoop, kneel, crouch, twist, reach, and stretch.

title: Port Operator C
description:
Position Summary:

The Port Operator C is responsible for the safe and efficient operation of heavy machinery in a port and terminal environment. This role supports vessel loading and unloading, bulk material handling, and overall yard operations. The ideal candidate is safety-focused, experienced in operating multiple types of equipment, and able to perform effectively in a fast-paced, maritime setting.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Operate heavy equipment to load, unload, and transport bulk materials such as aggregates, scrap, and other cargo.
  • Support vessel operations, including staging, material handling, and coordination with terminal personnel.
  • Operate a variety of equipment, including wheel loaders, excavators, forklifts, skid steers, haul trucks, water trucks, fuel trucks, and sweepers.
  • Transport bulk materials efficiently between docks, yards, and storage facilities.
  • Perform routine pre- and post-operation equipment inspections and report mechanical issues or safety concerns.
  • Maintain clean and organized work areas, including docks, yards, and storage zones.
  • Follow all OSHA, port, and company safety policies and operational procedures.
  • Communicate effectively with supervisors, crane operators, and ground personnel to coordinate movement and operations.
  • Perform basic equipment maintenance, including fueling, greasing, and fluid checks.
  • Assist with general labor tasks, including cleanup and operational support, as needed.
  • Immediately report any damage to equipment, vessels, vehicles, or property.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned to support safe and efficient operations.

Required Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or GED equivalent preferred.
  • Minimum of 1 year of experience operating heavy equipment in an industrial, construction, or similar environment.
  • Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate at least two types of heavy equipment (e.g., loader, forklift, excavator).
  • Strong understanding of equipment safety practices and basic maintenance procedures.

Preferred Experience:

  • Prior experience working in a port, terminal, or marine environment.
  • OSHA 10 or OSHA 30 certification.
  • Transportation Worker Identification Credential (TWIC) or ability to obtain.
  • Experience with bulk material handling and vessel loading operations.

Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to stand, walk, climb, and operate equipment for extended periods.
  • Ability to work in outdoor conditions, including exposure to heat, cold, rain, and snow.
  • Required use of PPE (hard hat, safety vest, steel‑toe boots) in operational areas.

Work Environment:

  • Outdoor port and terminal environment with exposure to weather, noise, dust, and heavy machinery.
  • Fast-paced, safety-sensitive setting requiring coordination with marine crews, yard personnel, and equipment operators.
  • Flexible schedule required, including shift work, extended hours, and weekends based on vessel and operational needs.

Fort Scott USD 234 is seeking a qualified and service-oriented Director of Technology to provide leadership and oversight for the District's technology systems, infrastructure, cybersecurity, devices, and technical support services. The Director of Technology works collaboratively with district and building administrators, instructional staff, support staff, and outside vendors to ensure technology resources are reliable, secure, efficient, and aligned with the educational and operational needs of the District.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

title: Automation Controls Technician
description:
Position: Automations Controls Technician

Location/Department: Lancaster, PA/Factory-Maintenance

Status: Full-Time Hourly Non-Exempt
Job Code: P186
Reports To: Facilities Manager

Our Company

Lancaster Leaf Tobacco Co Inc. is a subsidiary of Universal Corporation, the leading global leaf tobacco supplier. Lancaster Leaf manages Universal’s dark air cured tobacco operations in all relevant traditional dark air-cured origins. Operations in Lancaster, PA. consist of a processing facility, storage facility, and main office which also houses Universal’s dark air cured regional headquarters. The Company also has a cutting/flavoring line in the Dominican Republic. Lancaster Leaf supplies virtually all of the major cigar manufacturers in the U.S. with filler, binder, and wrapper from the U.S. and other origins. In addition to domestic supply, Lancaster exports filler, binder, and wrapper to international cigar manufacturers. Lancaster Leaf contracts directly with farmers in all dark air cured growing regions of the U.S. which include Pennsylvania, Connecticut, Massachusetts, Virginia, Tennessee and Kentucky.

The Global Leader in Premium Leaf Tobacco Supply

Universal Leaf Tobacco Company is the world’s leading supplier of premium leaf tobacco, with over 100 years of experience sourcing, processing, and delivering tobacco crops tailored to customer specifications. With operations spanning major tobacco-regions across five continents, we connect hundreds of thousands of farmers to global manufacturers through a reliable, transparent, and traceable supply chain.

Our portfolio includes flue-cured, burley, oriental, and dark tobaccos, supported by deep agronomic expertise and advanced processing capabilities. Beyond the leaf, we offer value-added services such as customized blending, next-generation nicotine solutions, recycled by-products, and digital traceability tools that enhance efficiency and sustainability across the supply chain. Universal Leaf Tobacco is more than a supplier – we are a long-term partner committed to responsible sourcing, farmer support, and continuous innovation. By investing in agricultural communities and upholding the highest standards of quality and compliance, we help ensure a resilient tobacco supply for generations to come.

Summary

As an Automation Controls Technician at Lancaster Leaf Tobacco Company you are responsible for supporting, troubleshooting, programming, and improving automated control systems throughout the Lancaster Leaf Tobacco Factory. This position works closely with Maintenance, Operations, Engineering, outside vendors, and production leadership to maintain reliable equipment performance, reduce downtime, improve process controls, and support safe and efficient factory operations. The role requires strong knowledge of programmable logic controllers, industrial electrical systems, HMI interfaces, VFDs, sensors, instrumentation, and manufacturing equipment.

What You’ll Be Doing (Essential Duties)

  • Program, troubleshoot, modify, and maintain PLC systems used in factory production, processing, packaging, by-product handling, receiving, storage, and utility operations.
  • Support automated equipment including conveyors, presses, dryers, optical sorters, scales, sensors, drives, motor controls, safety circuits, HMI panels, and related control devices.
  • Diagnose electrical, mechanical, instrumentation, network, and control system issues to reduce downtime and restore equipment to safe operating condition.
  • Develop and modify PLC logic, HMI screens, alarms, recipes, setpoints, interlocks, and control sequences to support operational needs and continuous improvement projects.
  • Maintain current backups, documentation, drawings, I/O lists, program versions, and change records for control systems.
  • Work with Maintenance and Operations personnel to identify recurring equipment issues, complete root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions.
  • Assist with installation, commissioning, testing, and startup of new equipment, upgraded controls, and automation improvement projects.
  • Provide technical support and basic training to maintenance technicians, operators, and supervisors on control system operation, troubleshooting, and safe restart procedures.
  • Coordinate with outside contractors, OEM technicians, and vendors to support equipment upgrades, software changes, system troubleshooting, and repairs.
  • Ensure PLC programming and automation work complies with company safety policies, lockout/tagout requirements, electrical safety expectations, machine guarding requirements, and applicable codes.
  • Support preventive maintenance activities by inspecting control panels, verifying sensors and safety devices, reviewing alarm history, and identifying opportunities to improve equipment reliability.
  • Partner with production leadership to improve throughput, quality, safety, traceability, runtime, and efficiency across factory processing lines.
  • Respond to urgent breakdowns and provide on-call or overtime support when required by production demands.
  • Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

Minimum Requirements

  • Associate’s degree or technical school certificate.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience programming, troubleshooting, or maintaining PLC-controlled equipment in a manufacturing, processing, warehouse, agricultural, food, tobacco, or industrial environment.
  • Working knowledge of PLC programming, ladder logic, HMI systems, VFDs, industrial sensors, motor controls, safety circuits, relays, starters, and control panels.
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, control schematics, ladder logic, wiring diagrams, equipment manuals, and technical documentation.
  • Experience troubleshooting industrial electrical systems up to 480 volts and understanding safe work practices around energized equipment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose issues quickly and communicate recommended repairs clearly.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize multiple issues, and support production needs in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to document changes, repairs, and system information accurately.

At The Coca‑Cola Company, our purpose is to refresh the world and make a difference through brands and partnerships that generate value for customers and consumers. We are seeking a Senior Director II, Specialty Retail to lead national account management and commercial strategy for key Specialty Retail portfolios while advancing enterprise-level objectives for revenue, profitability, and long-term growth. title: Service Delivery Manager
description:
What is the purpose of the Service Delivery Manager role?

The Service Delivery Manager (SDM) is a critical liaison between Mosaiq's engineering and delivery teams and customer-facing teams, Customer Success (CS) and Sales.

This role makes sure the customer-facing team's queries and expectations are understood and prioritised correctly on the technical side, and that key information, technical progress and any constraints are explained in a way CS and Sales can use with confidence.


Day-to-day it triages incident management and service delivery from within the technical team, translating in both directions so sales prospects and existing customers have timely and useful information (through our customer-facing team) about how Mosaiq is working to help them.

  • The SDM reports to the Head of Product
  • The SDM has no direct reports
  • Key relationships include Customer Success, Sales, Product teams, technical delivery and occasionally external partners and customers
  • Based in Wellington, NZ (with responsibility for real-time comms with UK team requiring early or late work hours to cross over UKT/NZT)



What the Service Delivery Manager does

  • Acts as the primary technical liaison for CS and Sales, translating customer-reported issues, questions and needs into clear technical requirements and priorities for the delivery team
  • Translates technical delivery status, constraints and incident updates into plain-English updates CS and Sales can pass on to customers with confidence
  • Coordinates incident management practice including triage, escalation, communication and resolution through proactive and internal coordination and communication
  • Acts as the escalation point for major or high-impact incidents, coordinating technical resources and feeding clear, timely updates to CS for onward customer communication
  • Owns operational service performance, including operational KPIs, and reports these in terms CS and Sales can use in their own customer conversations
  • Builds and maintains a working rhythm with UK-based CS that accounts for the time difference, so urgent customer issues reach the technical team promptly regardless of NZ office hours
  • Works with Sales on pre-sales technical questions as required, helping scope what's feasible and translating this into terms Sales can use with prospects
  • Proactively identifies risks, trends and systemic issues from patterns in what comes through CS and Sales, and drives continuous improvement
  • Maintains and evolves service operations documentation and process, so translation between technical and customer-facing teams stays consistent as Snapper scales
  • Produces monthly Operations reports capturing platform outages, changes, trends, milestones, and other metrics and KPIs



What will help you succeed in this role

  • Proven experience in a service delivery or technical account role, ideally sitting between engineering and a customer-facing team rather than fronting the customer directly
  • Strong understanding of service management, incident management and SLA-driven operations
  • A genuine translator's instinct — equally comfortable in a technical stand-up and a customer success conversation, without losing accuracy in either direction
  • Ability and desire to learn Mosaiq's technical landscape, language, and tooling in depth
  • Comfortable working async and across time zones, with the discipline to protect your own time outside the agreed UK-overlap window
  • Calm, structured decision-making whether in day-to-day prioritisation or high-pressure incidents. Open listening, understanding, and clear, confident communication are key capabilities here
  • Experience developing and maintaining operational processes, documentation and reporting



What success looks like

CS and Sales trust you as the clearest route into technical delivery, customer needs arrive at engineering already well-translated and prioritised

Technical updates reach CS in language that helps with customer conversations, and answer questions proactively

Incidents are triaged, escalated and resolved within agreed timeframes, with the right people informed at the right time, with NZ/UK time differences factored in

The technical team understands what CS and Sales need, and the CS and Sales team understand what's realistic, where priorities lie, and have confidence in the information they are receiving

Risks and systemic issues are spotted early from patterns in what customers raise, and turned into practical improvements.

We have a sustainable rhythm of communicating between teams in different timezones, and our global team provides an advantage through it

Your role is to consult with clients on their Pension needs and member engagement requirements.

• Portfolio Management: Maintain a personal portfolio of clients for whom you deliver consulting and broking services with an agreed portfolio and growth target.
• Client Engagement: Actively interact with clients to identify business needs, articulate challenges, and propose tailored solutions.
• Relationship Management: Proven ability to build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with clients and key stakeholders, ensuring high levels of satisfaction and fostering ongoing collaboration and business growth.
• Strategic Guidance: Provide expert advice and strategic direction to clients, aligning their operational processes with business objectives.
• Project Leadership: Lead and manage project teams, ensuring effective coordination, resource allocation, and communication.
• Business Development: Identify new business opportunities, prepare proposals, and contribute to the growth of the consultancy practice. Create and identify opportunities to grow our role with those clients and generate more revenue. This includes opportunities outside of pensions, including flex, healthcare, wellbeing, international and general insurance, working with other members of the HEB team. Work with the wider HEB team to ensure all other services are effectively delivered to those clients.
• Stakeholder Management: Maintain and strengthen relationships with key stakeholders to ensure ongoing collaboration and business growth.
• Quality Assurance: Ensure the highest standards of project delivery and client satisfaction and ensuring that all services agreed in the scope of services are delivered within agreed timeframes.


Other responsibilities:
• Maintain an expert knowledge of the Pensions market and products, to be able to provide the highest levels of guidance and insights;
• Responsible for supporting the Head of DC in building and enhancing proposition development, owning key aspects of delivery, and ensuring that all team members are informed and up to date with the latest developments.
• Collaborate with the Head of DC to develop strategic insights and innovative ideas. Research industry trends and emerging topics to position Howden as a thought leader.
• Plan, organise and deliver webinars/ events that showcase our services and expertise in key industry topics.
• Support the new business team from time-to-time with pitches and proposals, in your capacity as a Pensions expert, to support the winning of new clients into HEB.
• Develop strong working relationships with the HEB protection, flex, healthcare, wellbeing and international teams, to ensure client opportunities are being uncovered, developed and closed.
• Skilled in supporting the pension team by imparting knowledge and expertise, providing guidance and support in both technical and consultancy areas, and serving as a role model and go-to person for team members.
Due to the changing nature of the business, the jobholder may from time to time be required to undertake other activities of a similar nature that fall within their capabilities.

Skills, abilities & personal qualities
• Interpersonal skills – the ability to create trust and confidence with clients and the wider HEB business
• Communication skills – the ability to negotiate, influence and demonstrate empathy as required
• Creativity – consult with clients and construct effective solutions reflecting their needs and to develop new ideas and propositions.
• Commerciality – work in a way that creates financial opportunities for the business and protects revenue
• Professionalism – able to consistently deliver to the highest standards and expectations of our clients
• Self-development – continue to learn and grow, as required by the different responsibilities of the role
• Organisation & Time management - highly effective at managing a busy schedule of work
• Analytical Skills - highly effective at questioning clients and analysing data and info to determine actions
• IT Skills – strong application skills, especially the Microsoft Office suite of products

• Qualifications – Desirable but not essential Diploma in Financial Planning
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• Ability to lead and motivate teams.
• Capacity to handle pressure and setbacks with a positive attitude
• High ethical standards and integrity in all professional dealings.

Hybrid / Home based

Happy to travel for client visits

What do we offer in return?

A career that you define. At Howden, we value diversity – there is no one Howden type. Instead, we’re looking for individuals who share the same values as us:

  • Our successes have all come from someone brave enough to try something new

  • We support each other in the small everyday moments and the bigger challenges

  • We are determined to make a positive difference at work and beyond

title: Safety Technician
description:
Who we are:

Ferroglobe is one of the world’s leading suppliers of silicon metal, silicon-based and manganese-based specialty alloys and ferroalloys, serving a customer base across the globe in dynamic and fast-growing end markets, such as solar, automotive, consumer products, construction and energy.

Learn more about our Transformation Story here: Who we are

What you will do:

The Safety Technician at Ferroglobe is responsible for assisting the Safety Manager in implementing safety programs, policies, and procedures to ensure a safe workplace through compliance with health, wellness, environmental, and safety laws. The ideal candidate will have a keen eye for detail to identify and mitigate potential hazards, effectively communicate the importance of safety to employees, and proactively discover opportunities for safety improvements. The ability to interpret and clearly communicate OSHA guidelines and administrative rulings is essential. The ultimate goal is to achieve zero accidents and exceed industry standards for occupational health and safety. Develop, implement, and oversee comprehensive health and safety policies and procedures to ensure compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.

  • Daily Facility Walkthroughs: Conduct daily walkthroughs of the facility at the beginning and end of each shift to assess the workplace for potential hazards.
  • Communication: Maintain daily communication with employees and management regarding safety needs and requirements.
  • Hazard Identification: Identify and remediate any discovered safety issues, adopting preventive measures.
  • Safety Awareness: Display a comprehensive understanding of safety, environmental, and health issues.
  • Compliance Monitoring: Ensure compliance with safety laws and procedures.
  • Problem Solving: Identify and recommend solutions to safety issues, and support the adoption of preventive initiatives.
  • Accident Investigation: Assist the Safety Manager in accident investigations and implementing corrective action measures.
  • Project Support: Work on safety-related projects of limited complexity in a support role.
  • Management: Contractor management expereince
  • Training: Speaking in front of small groups on safety training for new hires and current employee's.

What we seek:

  • Degree: Associate’s Degree in Occupational Safety & Health, Environmental Management, or related field, or relevant work experience.
  • Communication Skills: Ability to communicate clearly and objectively, both verbally and in writing.
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Solid understanding of safety, environmental health issues, laws, and OSHA regulations.
  • Organizational Skills: Strong organizational skills with the ability to complete tasks assigned by management promptly.
  • Attention to Detail: Exceptional attention to detail with a proactive approach.
  • Shift Availability: Availability to work all shifts, including evenings and weekends.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office including Powerpoint

What We Offer:

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental insurance, Flexible Spending Accounts, Company-Paid Short-Term Disability and Basic Life, Voluntary Life and LTD, Employer 401k Match and paid time off.

Working Environment:

  • Performs jobs under varying conditions (dust, oil, grease, hot and humid temperatures, fumes, noise, etc.)
  • Ability to lift 50lbs, Floor to waist, Waist to shoulder. Overhead, Carry 20 feet
  • Wears proper PPE in the manufacturing area (shoes, safety glasses, and hearing protection)

title: Project Manager, Aviation (Terminal Design)
description:
TYLin is a globally recognized, full-service infrastructure consulting firm committed to providing innovative, cost-effective, constructible designs for the global infrastructure market. With over 3,000 employees throughout the Americas, Asia, and Europe, the firm provides support on projects of varying size and complexity. Together, we enhance conventional designs with smarter, more resilient systems. We provide people with better mobility. We steward precious resources by finding more sustainable solutions.

Job Summary

TYLin is seeking an experienced Project Manager – Aviation (Terminal Design) to lead the planning, design, and delivery of complex airport terminal projects for major aviation programs. This is an exciting opportunity to join a globally recognized aviation practice and contribute to the transformation of some of the world’s most important airport facilities.

We are looking for a project manager with a strong background in airport terminal design and redevelopment, who has successfully led multidisciplinary design teams on major terminal projects in the United States or internationally. The successful candidate will have experience coordinating architects, engineers, planners, specialty consultants, airport stakeholders, airlines, and operational teams to deliver innovative, functional, and passenger-focused terminal environments.

Responsibilities & Qualifications

The Opportunity

As Project Manager – Aviation (Terminal Design), you will be responsible for managing the design and delivery of complex airport terminal projects from concept development through construction support.

You will serve as a key leader within multidisciplinary project teams, ensuring design excellence while balancing operational requirements, passenger experience, sustainability goals, technical standards, budget constraints, and schedule objectives.

This role requires a strong understanding of airport terminal planning, architectural design coordination, aviation operations, and the complexities of delivering projects within active airport environments.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design delivery of major airport terminal projects, including new construction, renovations, expansions, and modernization programs.

  • Manage multidisciplinary design teams including architects, engineers, planners, interior designers, aviation specialists, and specialty consultants.

  • Serve as the primary project interface with airport owners, airlines, tenants, regulatory agencies, and other key stakeholders.

  • Coordinate all phases of terminal design, including programming, concept design, schematic design, design development, construction documentation, and construction administration.

  • Develop and manage project scope, schedule, budget, staffing plans, and delivery strategies.

  • Facilitate design coordination meetings and ensure alignment between architectural, engineering, operational, and stakeholder requirements.

  • Guide teams through complex design challenges related to passenger flow, security, baggage handling, concessions, accessibility, and airport operations.

  • Review and manage design deliverables, technical submissions, and quality assurance processes.

  • Coordinate with construction teams to support constructability reviews, phasing strategies, and implementation planning.

  • Identify project risks and develop mitigation strategies to maintain design quality, schedule, and budget objectives.

  • Prepare executive-level presentations, project reports, and client communications.

  • Mentor junior project managers and contribute to the continued growth of TYLin’s Aviation practice.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Planning, Construction Management, or a related discipline.

  • 10+ years of progressive experience managing airport terminal design and redevelopment projects.

  • Demonstrated experience delivering major terminal projects at commercial airports in the United States or internationally.

  • Experience leading multidisciplinary design teams on complex aviation projects.

  • Strong understanding of airport terminal planning, architectural design, passenger processing, and operational requirements.

  • Proven ability to manage project scope, schedule, budget, quality, and client expectations.

  • Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Experience coordinating with airport authorities, airlines, tenants, contractors, and regulatory agencies.

Preferred

  • Registered Architect (RA) or Professional Engineer (PE) license.

  • Experience delivering projects for the Port Authority of New York & New Jersey (PANYNJ).

  • Experience with major hub airports and large-scale terminal redevelopment programs.

  • Experience with alternative delivery methods including Design-Build, Progressive Design-Build, CMAR, or Public-Private Partnerships (P3).

  • Experience with airport-specific design standards and regulatory requirements.

  • PMP certification.

Typical Project Experience

The successful candidate will have experience managing terminal projects such as:

  • New terminal facilities

  • Terminal expansions and modernization programs

  • Passenger concourses and gate areas

  • Check-in and ticketing facilities

  • Security checkpoint improvements

  • Baggage handling and passenger processing areas

  • Airline tenant spaces and operational facilities

  • Airport lounges and premium passenger facilities

  • Interior architecture and passenger experience improvements

  • Terminal utility, systems, and infrastructure upgrades

  • Airport sustainability and resiliency improvements

Ideal Candidate

You are an experienced aviation project manager who understands the unique challenges of designing and delivering complex airport terminals. You combine strong project leadership skills with a deep understanding of architectural coordination, airport operations, and passenger experience.

You are comfortable managing executive-level stakeholder relationships, guiding multidisciplinary teams, and making informed decisions that balance design excellence, operational efficiency, constructability, and long-term airport objectives.

Why TYLin?

TYLin partners with airport owners, airlines, and public agencies around the world to deliver innovative aviation infrastructure that enhances mobility, connectivity, and the passenger experience. As part of our Aviation practice, you will collaborate with some of the industry's most respected aviation professionals on landmark airport programs.

We offer:

  • The opportunity to lead transformational airport terminal projects.

  • Collaboration with internationally recognized aviation architects, engineers, and planners.

  • A dynamic, multidisciplinary environment focused on innovation and technical excellence.

  • Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits.

  • Career growth opportunities within a global infrastructure consulting firm.

Join Us

If you are an experienced aviation project manager with a passion for delivering exceptional airport terminal design projects, we invite you to join TYLin.

Help shape the future of aviation by creating terminal environments that are efficient, resilient, sustainable, and designed around the passenger experience.


Additional Information

TYLin is committed to pay equity. As part of that commitment, we have provided the base compensation range of $153,600 - $210,600 annually for this position and local market. We recognize that each candidate brings a unique set of skills, experience, education and competencies to the table that will be reflected in our offer. title: Senior Specialist, Vaccines Technology
description:
Job Description

At our company, we aspire to be the premier research-intensive biopharmaceutical company. We're at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions that advance the prevention and treatment of diseases in people and animals. Join our team and contribute to our mission of using leading-edge science to save and improve lives around the world.

Our Engineers support internal and external manufacturing operations remain operational, continuously improve and innovate. With our extensive range of facilities and environments, our Engineers have opportunities across many diverse areas including Biological, Chemical, Automation, Capital Projects, Maintenance, Safety, Process Development, Technical Services, Utilities and Validation.

The Senior Specialist, Vaccines Technology position is responsible for providing technical support to formulation, primary filling, inspection, and/or packaging operations within our product's Points of Dispensing (POD) vaccine manufacturing facility at the Wilson, North Carolina site. This position will be an individual contributor and member of the Technical Team within the Vaccines Integrated Process Team (IPT).

This will be an engineering role focused on startup of the POD vaccine manufacturing facility as well as providing future routine operational support. This role will act as the technical subject matter expert for all aspects of commissioning, tech transfer, start up, validation, licensure, and ongoing technical support for their area of assignment.

Responsibilities

  • Utilize technical expertise, experience, independent judgment, and decision-making to build robust processes that support consistent and reliable supply.
  • Resolve and escalate technical issues impacting supply within the daily, weekly, and monthly IPT management processes.
  • Provide ownership for Manufacturing Execution System (MES) batch record and facilitate changes as needed to support business needs.
  • Ensure that assigned processes are developed in a robust manner and Critical Process Parameters (CPP) defined such that vaccines filled at the Wilson site consistently meets critical quality attributes.
  • Act as technical subject matter expert during regulatory inspections for area of assignment.
  • Ensure that process development and validation data is generated and documented in a manner that supports successful licensure and positive interactions with regulatory agencies.
  • Execute change management for the PT and provide scientific/technical justification for proposed changes to support business needs.
  • Investigate, determine root cause, and implement robust Corrective Action and Preventive Action (CAPAs) for any process-related compliance discrepancies noted during day-to-day activities and/or audits and escalate as per IPT management processes.
  • Ensure that technical startup activities for area of assignment are managed such that project deliverables and timelines are well defined in advance and met.
  • Recommend continuous improvement, productivity, and capital projects for the IPT.
  • Partner with Operations, Quality, and other groups to execute projects that support the strategic goals of the IPT.
  • Maintain a culture of continuous improvement and MPS focused on standard work, making problems visible, minimizing waste, reducing process variability, and problem-solving.
  • Actively participate on cross-functional teams in an inclusive manner to advance project goals and achieve deliverables.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor degree or higher in Engineering or Science, or related areas of study.
  • Minimum of four (4) years of direct pharmaceutical packaging experience.
  • Minimum of two (2) years of hands-on engineering or technical support experience in a cGMP biopharmaceutical/vaccine manufacturing environment, including direct participation in equipment validation/revalidation.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently as a team member.
  • Demonstrated strong interpersonal skills with the ability to influence and support others through a culture of inclusion, feedback, and empowerment.
  • Working knowledge of current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMPs) and of regulatory requirements as they apply to the vaccine/pharmaceutical industry.
  • Willing to work irregular hours to support multi-shift operation on an as-needed basis.
  • Experience supporting regulatory inspections including Federal Drug Administration (FDA).
  • Technical writing experience with investigations, change requests, standard operating procedures, batch records, protocols, etc.

Preferred

  • Aseptic filling, qualified inspection processes, Cleaning-in-Place (CIP) and Sterilization-in-place (SIP) systems, pharmaceutical packaging and serialization/aggregation.
  • Leading manufacturing/packaging projects and investigations.
  • Continuous Improvement, Lean Manufacturing, Problem Solving, and/or Right First-Time methodologies.
  • Familiarity with Change Execution Management tools.
  • SAP/MES working knowledge.
  • Working in a Center for Biologics Evaluation and Research (CBER) regulated environment.
  • Demonstrated data analysis skills and experience setting up process control limits (advanced Excel, statistical software packages (Minitab), etc.).

Required Skills:

Business Management Tools, Contractor Oversight, Customer Service, Detail-Oriented, Driving Continuous Improvement, Engineering Design, Engineering Standards, Facility Management, OSHA Regulations, Process Engineering, Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) Writing, Technical Problem-Solving, Utilities Management, Vendor Management

title: Senior MES Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Job Description

Our Manufacturing & Supply Division is dedicated to being the most trusted supplier of biopharmaceuticals worldwide. Our facilities, along with our external contractors, suppliers, and partners, create a reliable global manufacturing network that’s devoted to delivering a high-quality, reliable supply to customers and patients on time, every time.

Our site in Schachen employs a diverse group of highly skilled scientists, engineers, technicians, and process specialists from more than 15 nations and provides an important contribution to our company’s endeavor to bring new innovative medicines to patients as fast as possible, while applying highest quality standards to all activities.

The Biotech facility, at our Schachen site, is a state-of-the-art facility that enables and advances our best work. By integrating leading-edge technology with a dynamic, activity-based workspace, the facility will support seamless connection and collaboration within and across teams and functions. Schachen Biotech provides biologics drug substance manufacturing for early-phase clinical supply and the implementation of technology innovations into the pipeline.

We are currently seeking a Senior MES Engineer (m/f/d) who will provide dedicated MES technical solution implementation and support, will coordinate and prioritize maintaining and developing MES (PAS-X) recipes, maintaining and improving the existing GMBR Design Standards, supporting MES integration with the automation layer, provide expertise and technical knowledge in a cross-site and cross-functional collaboration.

The Schachen site Process Automation MES team provides a strategic link between our early and late-stage pipeline and will be responsible for developing and maintaining of ‘Line of Sight’ for new technology and innovative processes. The Senior MES Engineer (m/f/d) will support and work towards simplification, standardization and continuous improvement of technical alignment and streamline of implemented MES solutions between early nodes in the network and the Schachen site.

Bring energy, knowledge, innovation, and leadership to carry out the following:

  • Inspire Diversity and Inclusion – building effective working relationships within a cross-functional team across different cultures and backgrounds.

  • Develop and implement optimal methodologies for the management of local MES System, in compliance with company policies, quality regulations and industry norms.

  • Provide support for Tech Transfer of Process Technologies from early-stage pipeline facilities and drive to GMP Operational Status, and support line of sight to commercial supply from MES perspective.

  • Own and support the integration between PAS-X and the site automation layer, including DeltaV batch integration, review-by-exception data flows, and PAS-X Automation standard or approved integration patterns; support future DeltaV and PAS-X interface projects at Schachen.

  • Support investigations by finding resolutions to MES and automation problems.

  • Support, maintain, and develop MES GMBRs and new capabilities as required by the pipeline products.

  • Collaborate with other technical functions to provide robust MES GMBRs and functionality that deliver reliable and sustainable performance.

  • Prepare and perform Change Controls and ensure they are open and closed on time in compliance with required quality standards.

  • Provide expertise and technical knowledge to technical functions on MES functionality, GMBR implementation, EBR execution topics.

  • Performing MES administration and maintenance and ensuring the system remains in a validated state.

  • Identify opportunities for continuous improvement in the business process flows or in the technical implementation and workflow within the MES area.

  • Developing and updating Automation MES SOP’s, Automation MES training packages and conducting dedicated MES trainings.

  • Support audit and regulatory inspections as MES SME; ensure ALCOA+ data-integrity principles across electronic batch records.

  • Ensuring all documents are compliant with SDLC requirements.

  • Any other duties assigned by the Process Automation MES Lead.

  • Represent the Schachen Process Automation MES team within our company’s global & corporate teams.

To excel in this role, you will more than likely have the following skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Science discipline or equivalent practical experience of at least 5 years of experience in MES area, PAS-X system experience preferred.

  • At least 3 years of experience in Automation or Engineering function for Biologics, Food, Medical Devices, or pharmaceutical industries.

  • Thorough knowledge of computer validation/SDLC requirements and change control procedures. (e.g., GAMP 5)

  • Demonstrated hands-on PAS-X experience (Werum/Körber) is preferred, including Master Recipe Management, GMBR/MBR design and build, PAS-X Master Data, Weigh & Dispense, equipment tracking, and eRec/eSig paperless batch record execution.

  • Proven ability of working cross functionally, delivering technical solutions for MES (PAS-X) issues.

  • PAS-X 3.3.x / Core version awareness.

  • Basic knowledge in batch review-by-exception concepts.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and know when to escalate for resolution.

  • Proven experience in commissioning and validation, test protocol execution (e.g., Kneat eVal), is an advantage.

  • Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills.

  • Effective oral / written communication skills in English (C1)

Required Skills:

Change Controls, Data Integrity, Deviation Management, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Proper Documentation, Standards Compliance, Strategic Thinking, Technical Leadership, Technical Problem-Solving, Technical Writing

Preferred Skills:

Electronic Batch Records, PAS-X

This position reports to the Director of Plants and Facilities Operations, and is responsible for the care and maintenance of landscaped areas, lawns, trees, irrigation systems, and outdoor facilities. Required Qualifications:

title: Steel Fabrication Supervisor (Night Shift)
description:
For over four decades, Big Top has manufactured and installed high-performance fabric structures in the United States, delivering American-made quality, innovation, and reliability. We don’t just build shelters - we engineer solutions that optimize operations, safeguard assets, and provide a competitive edge for companies worldwide. With the support and financial backing of Altamont Capital Partners, we are in an exciting phase of growth, expansion, and innovation.


Job Summary: The Steel Fabrication Supervisor is responsible for ensuring production goals, quality standards, and safety requirements are consistently met. This role coordinates workflow and monitors project timelines to maintain efficient shop performance. The supervisor enforces compliance with company policies, industry standards, and safety regulations while driving continuous improvement in productivity and workmanship. Strong leadership, technical expertise, and the ability to troubleshoot equipment or process issues are essential to success in this position. This position will report directly to the day shift Steel Fabrication Supervisor.


Supervisory Responsibilities: Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include training employees; assigning and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.


FLSA Classification: Non-Exempt


Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

· Reviews drawings, work orders, and specifications to ensure all work aligns with project requirements and company standards.

· Assigns daily work based on production priorities, employee skill level, equipment availability, material readiness, and required delivery dates; monitors progress throughout the shift and adjusts resources to protect schedule, quality, and throughput.

· Ensures all night shift Steel Fab activities comply with safety regulations, quality standards, and best practices.

· Conducts in-process inspections to verify quality, accuracy, and conformance to drawings.

· Identifies potential delays and develops alternative plans to maintain production timelines.

· Investigates non-conformance issues; performs root cause analyses and implements corrective actions.

· Trains new fabricators on shop expectations, equipment use, fabrication procedures, quality standards, safety practices, and production processes; identifies skill gaps across the team and coordinates cross-training, qualification development, and coaching to improve flexibility, consistency, and bench strength.

· Promotes employee engagement, accountability, and teamwork while maintaining a positive and productive work environment.

· Maintains accurate records of production output, labor hours, and material usage.

· Identifies and troubleshoots minor equipment issues, conducting repairs as needed to minimize downtime.

· Ensures all equipment is properly calibrated, serviced, and maintained in accordance with manufacturer guidelines and company standards.

· Other duties as assigned.


Required Skills & Abilities:

· Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and guide a diverse team.

· Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.

· Ability to read and interpret fabrication drawings and blueprints.

· Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

· Detail-oriented, organized, and capable of managing multiple priorities.

· Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite.

· Ability to become forklift certified within 90 days.

· Ability to accurately use ERP/MRP systems and basic production documentation.

· Knowledge of steel fabrication processes and shop equipment operation.

· Reasoning abilities to include the ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions; the ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.

· Mathematical skills to include the ability to work with mathematical concepts such as add, subtract, multiply, fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.

· Language skills to include the ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations; the ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals; and the ability to effectively present information and respond to questions.


Education & Experience:

· High school diploma or equivalent required.

· Previous fabrication experience required. Previous lead, supervisor, or equivalent shop leadership experience preferred.

Physical Demands:

  • Must be able to lift (50lbs) on a regular basis.

title: Retail Execution Specialist - Denver, CO
description:
Job Description Summary:

Join Team our team for an Exciting Career with Advanced Hydration!

If you’re interested in starting a career where sales, insights, sports and creativity intersect—you’ve come to the right place.

Our Advanced Hydration Team is looking for a Retail Execution Specialist (RES) to join our team in the Dallas Area. Advanced Hydration seeks energetic, passionate, and positive individuals who want to join the biggest underdog fight in the history of consumer-packaged goods. Our Retail Execution Team will bring our OBSESSION with becoming #1 in Advanced Hydration to life in-store.

As a Retail Execution Specialist (RES), you will be the ultimate ambassador for our Advanced Hydration Brands. You'll be responsible for amplifying the execution of our fan and athlete-loved brands on shelves and displays in-store, focusing on execution, merchandising, and upselling. Your role is crucial in driving sales growth and maximizing the presence of our brands within your assigned territory.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

· Sales Growth and Merchandising: Identify and capitalize on opportunities to grow the base business, increase sales, optimize display space, and improve productivity while maintaining excellent customer service.

· Creative Display Management: Assist with the installation and maintenance of creative displays aligned with branding initiatives, creating disruption points throughout the store to engage consumers with our brands.

· Brand Ambassadorship: Actively interact with store personnel and consumers to provide in-depth product knowledge and insights, ensuring a positive brand experience.

· Program Execution: Efficiently execute all sales programs and initiatives, including selling-in promotional programs, ensuring customer compliance, and achieving maximum brand potential.

· Collaboration: Partner with Coca-Cola Merchandisers and the Advanced Hydration Field team to execute sales and merchandising plans effectively, maintain product inventory levels, minimize out-of-stocks, and uphold company merchandising standards.

· Customer Insights: Gather and report customer needs, problems, interests, and competitive activities, providing valuable input to internal teams for continuous improvement and increased customer goodwill.

· Territory Account Maintenance: Handle tasks such as checking date codes, managing account adherence to plan-o-grams, replacing decals or tags, and transporting, building, and maintaining point-of-sale advertising and coupons for territory accounts as needed.

· Technology Utilization: Utilize company-provided technology for real-time daily reporting, analyze reports, and leverage insights to drive success in-store.

REQUIREMENTS:

· Bachelor's degree or relevant experience preferred

· Entry-level applicants with a willingness to learn will be considered; candidates with 0-2 years’ experience in sales, merchandising, marketing, or customer service are encouraged to apply

· Must be located in the Denver, CO Area or willing to relocate at your own expense

· Strong selling skill set and ability to influence store/ownership personnel through fact-based data selling, problem solving, and creative thinking

· Self-motivated with the ability to work independently within a large territory and multitask across a large number of stores

· Strong interpersonal and time-management skills; ability to effectively communicate successes, challenges, and opportunities, verbally and in writing, cross-functionally and through all levels of management

· Entrepreneurial spirit and enthusiasm for our brands and their purpose

· Must be able to lift upwards of 25-50 lbs with frequent bending, reaching, and kneeling to support product display building and events

· Occasional off-hours/weekend work, as needed

· Must have a personal vehicle, maintain an excellent driving record, and hold a valid driver’s license for use during work hours; willingness to drive throughout the territory is essential, including the ability to drive long distances as needed

· Motor Vehicle Records must satisfy company standards per Driving Policy

The Coca-Cola Company will not offer sponsorship for employment status (including, but not limited to, H1-B visa status and other employment-based nonimmigrant visas) for this position. Accordingly, all applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis and must not require The Coca-Cola Company's sponsorship to continue to work legally in the United States.

Skills:

Communication, Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Inventory Management, Leadership, Learning Quickly, Marketing, Merchandising, Merchandising Standards, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Office, Organizing, People Management, Planograms (POGs), Problem Solving, Product Displays, Product Inventory Management, Professional Etiquette, Professional Presentation, Relationship Building, Sales, Time Management, Willingness to Learn, Working Independently

Pay Range:

United States: 45,000 - 74,561 USD


Base pay offered may vary depending on geography, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. A full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position, is offered.

7.5

Location(s):

United States of America

Remote

Travel Required:

76% - 100%

No

September 13, 2026

We are taking deliberate action to nurture an inclusive culture that is grounded in our company purpose, to refresh the world and make a difference. We act with a growth mindset, take an expansive approach to what’s possible and believe in continuous learning to improve our business and ourselves. We focus on four key behaviors – curious, empowered, inclusive and agile – and value how we work as much as what we achieve. We believe that our culture is one of the reasons our company continues to thrive after 130+ years. Visit Our Purpose and Vision to learn more about these behaviors and how you can bring them to life in your next role at Coca-Cola.

title: Marketplace Compliance & Regulatory Senior Project Leader - H/F
description:
Marketplace Compliance & Regulatory Senior Project Leader

📍Poste basé à Lille ou Paris

🌎 ADEO, QUI SOMMES-NOUS ?

ADEO est une communauté internationale d’entreprises (Leroy Merlin, Weldom, Bricoman…) de 115 000 leaders avec une ambition commune : être utile aux habitants du monde.

Au sein du siège du groupe, notre mission est de soutenir nos enseignes à travers le monde. Dans un secteur du retail en transformation, nous avons pour ambition de réinventer notre utilité aux habitants et de relever le défi de construire la plateforme mondiale de l’habitat.

Notre département Omnicommerce a pour mission de délivrer une expérience omnicanale 5* à nos clients.

Les marketplaces Leroy Merlin et Tecnomat accélèrent leur développement à l'échelle internationale. Face au renforcement des obligations réglementaires et pour préparer le statut de très grande plateforme en ligne (VLOP) d'ici fin 2027, nous structurons nos équipes de conformité. Nous recherchons un.e Marketplace Compliance & Regulatory Senior Project Leader pour piloter ces transformations opérationnelles et sécuriser nos activités.

Rattaché(e) directement au Head of Product & Tech Marketplace, vous sécurisez le développement de la Marketplace en appliquant les normes réglementaires européennes et locales.

  • Gérer les relations directes et le traitement des demandes prioritaires émanant des autorités.

  • Cartographier les risques opérationnels et déployer les systèmes de contrôle interne.

  • Former les équipes opérationnelles aux impacts métiers et encadrer à terme l'équipe compliance.

🥇 VOTRE PROFIL

  • Parcours au sein d'une plateforme e-commerce d'envergure (VLOP) ou en cabinet de conseil/audit spécialisé.

  • Capacité à piloter des projets de manière transversale avec des interlocuteurs variés.

  • Capacité d'arbitrage et de décision face aux urgences réglementaires.

🎁 En tant que collaborateur d’ADEO Services, vous bénéficiez :

  • D’un environnement stimulant qui encourage l’initiative et l’esprit entrepreneurial

  • De formations adaptées à votre métier pour développer vos compétences

  • De perspectives d’évolution et de mobilité interne au sein d’un groupe international

  • De primes collectives trimestrielles et de la possibilité de devenir actionnaire

  • D’une politique de télétravail flexible

  • D’un soutien à la mobilité douce : participation à l’achat de vélos et trottinettes, ainsi qu’une indemnité pour le covoiturage

ADEO s’engage pour plus de diversité et d’inclusion, avec un accord et un engagement pour l’accompagnement des personnes en situation de handicap. Nous soutenons nos futurs collaborateurs et collaboratrices dans l’adaptation de leur poste de travail.

Prêt(e) à construire la plateforme de l'habitat de demain ? On a hâte de découvrir votre parcours !

—

Senior Project Leader Trust & Safety Marketplace

📍Position based in Lille or Paris

🌎 ADEO, WHO ARE WE?

ADEO is an international community of companies (Leroy Merlin, Weldom, Bricoman...) of 115,000 leaders with a common ambition: to be useful to the inhabitants of the world.

At the group's headquarters, our mission is to support our business units around the world. In a retail sector under transformation, our ambition is to reinvent our usefulness to inhabitants and meet the challenge of building the world's home platform.

Our Omnicommerce department's mission is to deliver a 5-star omnichannel experience to our customers.

Leroy Merlin and Tecnomat marketplaces are expanding their international footprint. To address growing regulatory requirements and prepare for Very Large Online Platform (VLOP) status by late 2027, we are scaling our compliance structure. We are hiring a Marketplace Compliance & Regulatory Program Manager to drive these operational upgrades and secure our growth.

🎯 YOUR MISSION

Reporting directly to our Head of Marketplace Product & Tech, you secure marketplace operations by implementing European and local standards.

  • Frame and drive regulatory compliance projects (GDPR, Digital Services Act, P2B, Extended Producer Responsibility).

  • Manage direct relationships and handle priority requests from regulatory authorities.

  • Map operational risks and deploy internal control mechanisms.

  • Coordinate cross-functional workstreams with legal, technical, and commercial teams.

  • Master's Degree (Business, Engineering, or University).

  • Prior track record in a major e-commerce platform (VLOP) or a specialized consulting/audit firm.

Hardskills:

  • Thorough understanding of e-commerce and digital platform regulations.

  • Autonomous data analysis skills to validate key operational metrics.

  • Professional fluency in French and English, both spoken and written.

Softskills:

  • Structured approach to solving complex problems under tight timelines.

  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional projects across multiple teams.

  • Clear decision-making capability when managing regulatory priorities.

🎁 As an ADEO Services employee, you benefit from:

  • A stimulating environment that encourages initiative and entrepreneurial spirit

  • Quarterly collective bonuses and the opportunity to become a company shareholder

Ready to build tomorrow's home platform? We look forward to meeting you!

title: Data Engineer - Information Systems
description:
• Forbes named Mesa Public Schools in their list of 2024 Best Employers in Arizona.
  • East Valley Tribune names Mesa Public Schools as Best Place to Work in East Valley for multiple years.

Employment Type:

Full-time

Base Salary:

$73,403.00

Class/Calendar:

D61-IS, 12 months

Benefits:

Vacation, sick leave, holidays, retirement matched through the Arizona State Retirement System, health, and life insurance

Performance Pay:

Available annually

New Hire Experience:

1% of the base hourly rate granted for each year of verified like experience (within ten years) beyond the requirement, up to a ten-year maximum

New Hire Education:

1% of the base hourly rate awarded for an AA or higher degree if not required for the position

Job Summary:

Mesa Public Schools is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Data Engineer. You will assume a strategic role in developing and maintaining the data infrastructure for our K-12 system. Working closely with cross-functional teams, including a Senior Research Analyst and Business Intelligence Lead, a Senior Data Engineer and other research and reporting team members, you will lead the creation and implementation of a cohesive and extensive enterprise-wide data model. Collaborating with a diverse team of data experts and educators, you will play a pivotal role in leveraging data insights to enhance educational outcomes.

Key Responsibilities:

Technical Expertise and Cloud Adoption

  • Provide technical knowledge for major data strategies, driving the organization’s success in adopting modern data models and cloud technologies.
  • Guide technical architecture for projects such as data replication, metadata management, DBaaS, data modeling and data security.
  • Develop proof-of-concept prototypes and initial implementation models to support the vision and strategy of the district.
  • Leverage your deep understanding of SQL and knowledge of development languages (e.g. Python, R) to guide the development and maintenance of data engineering pipelines, supporting modeling and analytics needs.
  • Define and maintain reusable data development patterns, engineering standards, version control and data frameworks.

Database Technology and Platform Designs

  • Apply expert knowledge of database technology to support legacy DBMSs and design overall data platform solutions.
  • Utilize knowledge and understanding of ETL/ELT processes to create and/or expand the current data model
  • Utilize a variety of technologies, including SQL, R, Python, and other relevant tools, to manage and analyze large amounts of education data.
  • Implement data hygiene practices to ensure statistical efficiency, accuracy, and quality in educational data.

Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement

  • Work closely with global and district-level stakeholders, including educators, IT professionals, compliance teams, and risk management, to identify, support, and implement data-driven projects.
  • Establish relationships with IT leaders, systems leaders, data engineers, and technical specialists to advance proposed architectural solutions.

Team Membership

  • Represent the team in architectural discussions, focusing on data aggregation, data flows, deployment strategies and governance.
  • Have a passion for innovation with a test and learn mindset, ensuring the team remains adaptable to evolving educational needs.

Agile Development and Delivery

  • Embrace Agile methodologies in the development process, supporting the effective scaling of digital pilot initiatives from ideation to working pilots and deliverables.

Other Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with Research and Evaluation team to build consistent, accurate and available data solutions in specialized software (i.e. PowerBI, Tableau, Excel, etc)
  • Independently define problem statements and extract user requirements for data analysis and business intelligence solutions
  • Develop and present analyses and reports using data visualization and storytelling best practices
  • Produce documentation to ensure consistency, quality and transparency across the district
  • Participate in data quality issue analysis and resolution recommendations
  • Combine data files from multiple sources efficiently and effectively to create a clean data set for analysis
  • Write custom SQL queries
  • Foster a continuous learning, professional development and growth mindset amongst team members
  • Maintain department procedures and policies in alignment with district, state and federal statutes and regulations
  • Prepare various reports for professional, technical, and non-technical audiences to provide and/or convey information
  • Collaborate with senior engineer and other team members in the department to ensure accurate visualizations, data elements and consistent practices are adhered to.
  • Produce documentation to ensure data consistency, quality and transparency across the district
  • Provide training on the proper and effective use of data tools
  • Assist other personnel as may be required for the purpose of supporting them in the completion of their work activities

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, STEM, or other related field, advanced degree preferred
  • Minimum of 2 years of data analysis and/or engineering in a K-12 educational system or related field

Skills & Competencies:

  • Models the attributes and skills of the MPS Portrait of a Graduate
  • Demonstrates commitment to the MPS Promise that every student is known by name, served by strength and need, and graduates ready for college, career and community
  • Proficient knowledge of data analytics, data wrangling and data blending/integration
  • Proficient knowledge of data visualization and/or reporting tools (e.g. PowerBI, Tableau, IBM Cognos, etc)
  • Proficiency in SQL and experience in cloud solutions (e.g. Azure, AWS, etc.)
  • Ability to write and utilize SQL to extract, ingest and manipulate data.
  • Understanding of database and cloud architecture, with experience in cloud-based data storage and warehousing
  • Familiarity with Agile Development and Delivery, source control and the software development life cycle
  • Demonstrated ability to independently conduct ad-hoc data analysis and reporting.
  • Proficient in data processing technologies and Agile development processes.
  • Strong analytical abilities and problem-solving skills
  • Demonstrated skill and knowledge of computer applications in the use of research and analysis (Excel, R, etc.)
  • Ability to communicate, both verbally and in writing, clearly and effectively for all levels and types of audiences (technical and non-technical)
  • Strong leadership skills with a self-starter attitude and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

Work Environment & Physical Requirements:

  • Primarily works in an office with a computer and multiple monitors
  • Works closely with IT staff, data analysts, administrators, and educators to ensure data accuracy and support decision-making
  • Required to meet reporting deadlines for funding, compliance, and district performance evaluations
  • Requires extended periods of sitting and working on a computer
  • Primarily a desk job, but may involve setting up data systems, troubleshooting servers, or working with IT hardware
  • Occasional travel within the district to different schools or offices for meetings or system support
